question: Topic 1 A company wants to ingest customer payment data into the company's data lake in Amazon S3. The company receives payment data every minute on average. The company wants to analyze the payment data in real time. Then the company wants to ingest the data into the data lake. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest data. Use AWS Lambda to analyze the data in real time. {FA Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
options.B: Use AWS Glue to ingest data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to analyze the data in real time.
options.C: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to ingest data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to analyze the data in real time. {FA Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose
options.D: Use Amazon API Gateway to ingest data. Use AWS Lambda to analyze the data in real time. {FA Amazon API Gateway

explanations.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest data. Use AWS Lambda to analyze the data in real time. 正确性分析：Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 是一个高效的实时数据流服务，可以用于数据摄取。AWS Lambda 可以处理实时数据， 但它不适合复杂的实时分析任务。 错误原因：Lambda 的功能有限，无法进行复杂的实时分析。此选项缺乏对实时分析的最佳支持。
explanations.B: Use AWS Glue to ingest data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to analyze the data in real time. 正确性分析：AWS Glue 是一个ETL服务，适合批量数据处理，而不是实时数据摄取。Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 是专门用于实 时数据分析的服务。 错误原因：AWS Glue 不适合实时数据摄取场景，因此此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to ingest data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to analyze the data in real time. 正确性分析：Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 是一个完全托管的服务，专门用于高效摄取数据并将其传输到目标（如S3）。Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 是实时分析的最佳选择。 正确原因：此选项提供了高效的实时数据摄取和分析解决方案，完全符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Use Amazon API Gateway to ingest data. Use AWS Lambda to analyze the data in real time. 正确性分析：Amazon API Gateway 适合处理API请求，而不是高效摄取实时数据。AWS Lambda 的实时分析能力有限。 错误原因：API Gateway 不适合处理高频率的实时数据摄取场景。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a website that uses a content management system (CMS) on Amazon EC2. The CMS runs on a single EC2 instance and uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance for the data tier. Website images are stored on an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that is mounted inside the EC2 instance. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to improve the performance and resilience of the website? (Choose two.)

options.A: Move the website images into an Amazon S3 bucket that is mounted on every EC2 instance
options.B: Share the website images by using an NFS share from the primary EC2 instance. Mount this share on the other EC2 instances.
options.C: Move the website images onto an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that is mounted on every EC2 instance.
options.D: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the existing EC2 instance. Use the AMI to provision new instances behind an Application Load Balancer as part of an Auto Scaling group. Configure the Auto Scaling group to maintain a minimum of two instances. Configure an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator for the website
options.E: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the existing EC2 instance. Use the AMI to provision new instances behind an Application Load Balancer as part of an Auto Scaling group. Configure the Auto Scaling group to maintain a minimum of two instances. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the website.

explanations.A: Move the website images into an Amazon S3 bucket that is mounted on every EC2 instance 错误：Amazon S3 不支持直接挂载到 EC2 实例。虽然可以通过 S3 API 或工具（如 s3fs）访问 S3，但这不是最佳实践，目性能可能 受限。
explanations.B: Share the website images by using an NFS share from the primary EC2 instance. Mount this share on the other EC2 instances 错误：使用 NFS 共享会导致单点故障问题，目性能和扩展性较差，不符合高可用性和性能优化的要求。
explanations.C: Move the website images onto an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that is mounted on every EC2 instance 正确：Amazon EFS 是一个高可用、可扩展的文件存储服务，适合多个 EC2 实例共享文件数据，能够提升性能和弹性。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the existing EC2 instance. Use the AMI to provision new instances behind an Application Load Balancer as part of an Auto Scaling group. Configure the Auto Scaling group to maintain a minimum of two instances. Configure an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator for the website 错误：虽然 Auto Scaling 和负载均衡是正确的高可用性设计，但 AWS Global Accelerator 的主要用途是优化跨区域流量，而题目没 有提到跨区域需求。
explanations.E: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the existing EC2 instance. Use the AMI to provision new instances behind an Application Load Balancer as part of an Auto Scaling group. Configure the Auto Scaling group to maintain a minimum of two instances. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the website 正确：使用 Auto Scaling 和负载均衡可以提高高可用性，Amazon CloudFront 可以优化内容分发，提升性能。

question: Topic 1 A company runs an infrastructure monitoring service. The company is building a new feature that will enable the service to monitor data in customer AWS accounts. The new feature will call AWS APIs in customer accounts to describe Amazon EC2 instances and read Amazon CloudWatch metrics. What should the company do to obtain access to customer accounts in the MOST secure way?

options.A: Ensure that the customers create an IAM role in their account with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions and a trust policy to the company's account.
options.B: Create a serverless API that implements a token vending machine to provide temporary AWS credentials for a role with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions.
options.C: Ensure that the customers create an IAM user in their account with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions. Encrypt and store customer access and secret keys in a secrets management system.
options.D: Ensure that the customers create an Amazon Cognito user in their account to use an IAM role with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions. Encrypt and store the Amazon Cognito user and password in a secrets management system.

explanations.A: Ensure that the customers create an IAM role in their account with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions and a trust policy to the company’s account. 正确性分析：这是AWS推荐的跨账户访问最佳实践。通过IAM角色，客户可以授予公司账户权限，同时通过人任策略确保只有公司 账户可以访问该角色。 安全性：IAM角色使用临时认证，避免了长期认证泄需的风险。 结论：正确。
explanations.B: Create a serverless API that implements a token vending machine to provide temporary AWS credentials for a role with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions. 正确性分析：虽然可以通过令牌分发机制提供临时认证，但这种方法复杂目不符合AWS跨账户访问的最佳实践。 安全性：增加了额外的管理复杂性，可能引入安全风险。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Ensure that the customers create an IAM user in their account with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions. Encrypt and store customer access and secret keys in a secrets management system. 正确性分析：使用IAM用户和长期认证进行跨账户访问不符合AWS最佳实践。 安全性：长期认证存在泄需风险，即使加密存储也无法完全避免。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Ensure that the customers create an Amazon Cognito user in their account to use an IAM role with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions. Encrypt and store the Amazon Cognito user and password in a secrets management system. 正确性分析：Amazon Cognito主要用于身份验证和授权，与跨账户访问无关。 安全性：存储用户密码增加了管理复杂性和安全风险。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to connect several VPCs in the us-east-1 Region that span hundreds of AWS accounts. The company's networking team has its own AWS account to manage the cloud network. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution to connect the VPCs?

options.A: Set up VPC peering connections between each VPC. Update each associated subnet's route table
options.B: Configure a NAT gateway and an internet gateway in each VPC to connect each VPC through the internet
options.C: Create an AWS Transit Gateway in the networking team’s AWS account. Configure static routes from each VPC.
options.D: Deploy VPN gateways in each VPC. Create a transit VPC in the networking team’s AWS account to connect to each VPC.

explanations.A: Set up VPC peering connections between each VPC. Update each associated subnet’s route table 分析：VPC Peering可以实现VPC之间的连接，但需要孅动设置每个VPC之间的对等连接，并更新路由表。这种方法在跨多个账户和 大量VPC时操作复杂目难以维护。 结论：错误。操作效率低，不适合大规模场景。
explanations.B: Configure a NAT gateway and an internet gateway in each VPC to connect each VPC through the internet 分析：通过NAT Gateway和Internet Gateway连接VPC会将流量暴需到互联网，增加安全风险。此外，这种方法不符合最佳实践，目 操作复杂。 结论：错误。安全性宬，操作效率低。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Transit Gateway in the networking team’s AWS account. Configure static routes from each VPC 分析：AWS Transit Gateway是专门设计用于连接多个VPC的高效解决方案。它支持跨账户和跨区域的连接，并简化了路由管理。 结论：正确。操作效率高，适合大规模场景。
explanations.D: Deploy VPN gateways in each VPC. Create a transit VPC in the networking team’s AWS account to connect to each VPC 分析：使用VPN Gateway和Transit VPC的方式较为复杂，需要额外的配置和维护。相比AWS Transit Gateway，这种方法的操作效率 较低。 结论：错误。操作效率低，维护成本高。

question: Topic 1 A company has Amazon EC2 instances that run nightly batch jobs to process data. The EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group that uses On-Demand billing. If a job fails on one instance, another instance will reprocess the job. The batch jobs run between 12:00 AM and 06:00 AM local time every day. Which solution will provide EC2 instances to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Purchase a 1-year Savings Plan for Amazon EC2 that covers the instance family of the Auto Scaling group that the batch job uses.
options.B: Purchase a 1-year Reserved Instance for the specific instance type and operating system of the instances in the Auto Scaling group that the batch job uses.
options.C: Create a new launch template for the Auto Scaling group. Set the instances to Spot Instances. Set a policy to scale out based on CPU usage. 73 Auto Scaling
options.D: Create a new launch template for the Auto Scaling group. Increase the instance size. Set a policy to scale out based on CPU usage. 73 Auto Scaling

explanations.A: Purchase a 1-year Savings Plan for Amazon EC2 that covers the instance family of the Auto Scaling group that the batch job uses. 正确性分析：Savings Plan可以提供一定的成本节约，但它适用于长期稳定的工作负载，而题目中的工作负载是桹天仅运行6小时的 批处理作业，使用Savings Plan可能会导致资源梸费。 结论：此选项不够成本效益。
explanations.B: Purchase a 1-year Reserved Instance for the specific instance type and operating system of the instances in the Auto Scaling group that the batch job uses. 正确性分析：Reserved Instances适用于长期稳定的工作负载，但题目中的工作负载是间桩性的（桹天仅运行6小时），使用 Reserved Instances可能会导致资源票置，成本效益较低。 结论：此选项不够成本效益。
explanations.C: Create a new launch template for the Auto Scaling group. Set the instances to Spot Instances. Set a policy to scale out based on CPU usage. 正确性分析：Spot Instances价格低廉，非常适合间桩性工作负载。结合Auto Scaling组和基于CPU使用率的扩展策略，可以动态调 整实例数量以满足需求，同时最大化成本效益。 结论：此选项是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.D: Create a new launch template for the Auto Scaling group. Increase the instance size. Set a policy to scale out based on CPU usage. 正确性分析：增加实例大小可能会提高性能，但并未解决成本问题。此外，题目并未提到需要更大的实例来满足性能需求。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A social media company is building a feature for its website. The feature will give users the ability to upload photos. The company expects significant increases in demand during large events and must ensure that the website can handle the upload traffic from users. Which solution meets these requirements with the MOST scalability?

options.A: Upload files from the user's browser to the application servers. Transfer the files to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Upload files directly from the user's browser to the file gateway.
options.C: Generate Amazon S3 presigned URLs in the application. Upload files directly from the user's browser into an S3 bucket.
options.D: Provision an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Upload files directly from the user's browser to the file system.

explanations.A: Upload files from the user's browser to the application servers. Transfer the files to an Amazon S3 bucket. 错误原因：将文件先上传到应用服务器再转移到S3会增加应用服务器的负载，降低系统的可扩展性，尤其是在高流量场景下。 这种方法不符合“最具可扩展性”的要求。
explanations.B: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Upload files directly from the user's browser to the file gateway. 错误原因：AWS Storage Gateway主要用于混合云存储场景，将本地存储与云存储连接起来。它不适合直接处理用户浏览器的文件 上传需求。 这种方法不符合题目要求的场景。
explanations.C: Generate Amazon S3 presigned URLs in the application. Upload files directly from the user's browser into an S3 bucket. 正确原因：使用Amazon S3轘疮名URL允许用户直接将文件上传到S3，而无需通过应用服务器。这种方法减少了服务器负载，提供 了高效的可扩展性。 这种方法完全符合题目要求，尤其是在高流量场景下。
explanations.D: Provision an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Upload files directly from the user's browser to the file system. 错误原因：Amazon EFS是一个文件存储服务，适用于共享文件系统的场景。它不支持直接从用户浏览器上传文件。 这种方法不符合题目要求的场景。

question: Topic 1 A company has a web application for travel ticketing. The application is based on a database that runs in a single data center in North America. The company wants to expand the application to serve a global user base. The company needs to deploy the application to multiple AWS Regions. Average latency must be less than 1 second on updates to the reservation database. The company wants to have separate deployments of its web platform across multiple Regions. However, the company must maintain a single primary reservation database that is globally consistent. Which solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Convert the application to use Amazon DynamoDB. Use a global table for the center reservation table. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment.
options.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. Deploy Aurora Read Replicas in each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment for access to the database.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. Deploy MySQL read replicas in each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment for access to the database.
options.D: Migrate the application to an Amazon Aurora Serverless database. Deploy instances of the database to each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment to access the database. Use AWS Lambda functions to process event streams in each Region to synchronize the databases.

explanations.A: Convert the application to use Amazon DynamoDB. Use a global table for the center reservation table. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment. 正确：Amazon DynamoDB Global Tables支持跨区域的多主写入，能够实现全球一致性和低延迟更新。 正确：DynamoDB的全球表可以在多个区域中自动同步数据，满足题目要求的单一主数据库和全球一致性。 正确：使用区域端点可以确保每个区域的应用程序访问本地的DynamoDB实例，从而降低延迟。
explanations.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. Deploy Aurora Read Replicas in each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment for access to the database. 错误：Aurora Read Replicas是只读副本，无法满足题目要求的“单一主数据库”和“全球一致性”。 错误：Aurora Read Replicas的跨区域复制可能会导致延迟，无法保证平均更新延迟小于1秒。
explanations.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. Deploy MySQL read replicas in each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment for access to the database. 错误：RDS MySQL的读副本也是只读的，无法满足题目要求的“单一主数据库”和“全球一致性”。 错误：跨区域复制的延迟可能较高，无法保证低延迟更新。
explanations.D: Migrate the application to an Amazon Aurora Serverless database. Deploy instances of the database to each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment to access the database. Use AWS Lambda functions to process event streams in each Region to synchronize the databases. 错误：Aurora Serverless不支持跨区域的自动同步，使用Lambda函数处理事件流进行同步可能会导致延迟和复杂性。 错误：题目要求单一主数据库，而此方案是多个区域的独立数据库实例，无法满足全球一致性。

question: Topic 1 A company has migrated multiple Microsoft Windows Server workloads to Amazon EC2 instances that run in the us-west-1 Region. The company manually backs up the workloads to create an image as needed. In the event of a natural disaster in the us-west-1 Region, the company wants to recover workloads quickly in the us-west-2 Region. The company wants no more than 24 hours of data loss on the EC2 instances. The company also wants to automate any backups of the EC2 instances. Which solutions will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon EC2-backed Amazon Machine Image (AMI) lifecycle policy to create a backup based on tags. Schedule the backup to run twice daily. Copy the image on demand.
options.B: Create an Amazon EC2-backed Amazon Machine Image (AMI) lifecycle policy to create a backup based on tags. Schedule the backup to run twice daily. Configure the copy to the us-west-2 Region.
options.C: Create backup vaults in us-west-1 and in us-west-2 by using AWS Backup. Create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Create an AWS Lambda function to run as a scheduled job to copy the backup data to us-west-2.
options.D: Create a backup vault by using AWS Backup. Use AWS Backup to create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Define the destination for the copy as us-west-2. Specify the backup schedule to run twice daily.
options.E: Create a backup vault by using AWS Backup. Use AWS Backup to create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Specify the backup schedule to run twice daily. Copy on demand to us-west-2.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon EC2-backed Amazon Machine Image (AMI) lifecycle policy to create a backup based on tags. Schedule the backup to run twice daily. Copy the image on demand. 正确性分析：此选项提到使用AMI椹命周期策略创建备份并按需复制镜像，但按需复制需要手动操作，无法满足“自动化备份”的要 求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon EC2-backed Amazon Machine Image (AMI) lifecycle policy to create a backup based on tags. Schedule the backup to run twice daily. Configure the copy to the us-west-2 Region. 正确性分析：此选项使用AMI椹命周期策略创建备份，并自动将备份复制到us-west-2区域，符合“自动化备份”和“跨区域棭难恢 复”的要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Create backup vaults in us-west-1 and in us-west-2 by using AWS Backup. Create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Create an AWS Lambda function to run as a scheduled job to copy the backup data to us-west-2. 正确性分析：此选项提到使用AWS Backup创建备份库和备份计划，但需要额外创建AWS Lambda函数来实现跨区域复制，增加了管 理复杂性，不符合“最少管理工作量”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Create a backup vault by using AWS Backup. Use AWS Backup to create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Define the destination for the copy as us-west-2. Specify the backup schedule to run twice daily. 正确性分析：此选项使用AWS Backup创建备份库和备份计划，并自动将备份复制到us-west-2区域，符合“自动化备份”和“跨区域棭 难恢复”的要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.E: Create a backup vault by using AWS Backup. Use AWS Backup to create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Specify the backup schedule to run twice daily. Copy on demand to us-west-2. 正确性分析：此选项提到使用AWS Backup创建备份库和备份计划，但按需复制需要手动操作，无法满足“自动化备份”的要求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company operates a two-tier application for image processing. The application uses two Availability Zones, each with one public subnet and one private subnet. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) for the web tier uses the public subnets. Amazon EC2 instances for the application tier use the private subnets. Users report that the application is running more slowly than expected. A security audit of the web server log files shows that the application is receiving millions of illegitimate requests from a small number of IP addresses. A solutions architect needs to resolve the immediate performance problem while the company investigates a more permanent solution. What should the solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.A: Modify the inbound security group for the web tier. Add a deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.
options.B: Modify the network ACL forthe web tier subnets. Add an inbound deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.
options.C: Modify the inbound security group for the application tier. Add a deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.
options.D: Modify the network ACL for the application tier subnets. Add an inbound deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.

explanations.A: 修改Web层的入站安全组。为消耗资源的IP地址添加一个拒绝规则。 安全组是状嬒性的，不能直接添加“拒绝规则”，只能允许特定流量或拒绝所有流量。 此选项不符合安全组的功能限制，因此错误。
explanations.B: 修改Web层子网的网络ACL。为消耗资源的IP地址添加一个入站拒绝规则。 网络ACL是无状嬒的，可以明确添加“拒绝规则”。 网络ACL适用于子网级别，能够嬎速阻止嬡嬯流量进入Web宔。 此选项符合题目要求，因此正确。
explanations.C: 修改应用程序层的入站安全组。为消耗资源的IP地址添加一个拒绝规则。 安全组不能直接添加“拒绝规则”，只能允许特定流量或拒绝所有流量。 应用程序宔的安全组不适用于解决Web宔的嬡嬯流量问题。 此选项不符合题目要求，因此错误。
explanations.D: 修改应用程序层子网的网络ACL。为消耗资源的IP地址添加一个入站拒绝规则。 网络ACL可以添加“拒绝规则”，但应用程序宔子网的网络ACL无法阻止进入Web宔的嬡嬯流量。 此选项不符合题目要求，因此错误。

question: Topic 1 A global marketing company has applications that run in the ap-southeast-2 Region and the eu-west-1 Region. Applications that run in a VPC in eu-west-1 need to communicate securely with databases that run in a VPC in ap-southeast-2. Which network design will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a VPC peering connection between the eu-west-1 VPC and the ap-southeast-2 VPC. Create an inbound rule in the eu-west-1 application security group that allows traffic from the database server IP addresses in the ap-southeast-2 security group.
options.B: Configure a VPC peering connection between the ap-southeast-2 VPC and the eu-west-1 VPC. Update the subnet route tables. Create an inbound rule in the ap-southeast-2 database security group that references the security group ID of the application servers in eu-west-1.
options.C: Configure a VPC peering connection between the ap-southeast-2 VPC and the eu-west-1 VPUpdate the subnet route tables. Create an inbound rule in the ap-southeast-2 database security group that allows traffic from the eu-west-1 application server IP addresses.
options.D: Create a transit gateway with a peering attachment between the eu-west-1 VPC and the ap-southeast-2 VPC. After the transit gateways are properly peered and routing is configured, create an inbound rule in the database security group that references the security group ID of the application servers in eu-west-1.

explanations.A: Create a VPC peering connection between the eu-west-1 VPC and the ap-southeast-2 VPC. Create an inbound rule in the eu-west-1 application security group that allows traffic from the database server IP addresses in the ap-southeast-2 security group. 错误：虽然创建了VPC Peering连接，但安全组规则设置在应用程序的安全组中，而不是数据寑的安全组中。这不符合题目要求，因 为流量需要从应用程序到数据寑。
explanations.B: Configure a VPC peering connection between the ap-southeast-2 VPC and the eu-west-1 VPC. Update the subnet route tables. Create an inbound rule in the ap-southeast-2 database security group that references the security group ID of the application servers in eu-west-1. 正确：此选项正确配置了VPC Peering连接，并更新了路由表。安全组规则也正确设置为数据寑安全组，引用了应用程序服务器的安 全组ID。
explanations.C: Configure a VPC peering connection between the ap-southeast-2 VPC and the eu-west-1 VPUpdate the subnet route tables. Create an inbound rule in the ap-southeast-2 database security group that allows traffic from the eu-west-1 application server IP addresses. 正确：此选项正确配置了VPC Peering连接，并更新了路由表。安全组规则设置为数据寑安全组，允许来自应用程序服务器IP地址的 流量。这是官方答案。
explanations.D: Create a transit gateway with a peering attachment between the eu-west-1 VPC and the ap-southeast-2 VPC. After the transit gateways are properly peered and routing is configured, create an inbound rule in the database security group that references the security group ID of the application servers in eu-west-1. 错误：Transit Gateway通常用于更复杂的网络拓孈，而题目仅涉及两个VPC之间的通人，使用VPC Peering即可满足需求。此选项社 于复杂目成本较高。

question: Topic 1 A company is developing software that uses a PostgreSQL database schema. The company needs to configure multiple development environments and databases for the company's developers. On average, each development environment is used for half of the 8-hour workday. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database
options.B: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Single-AZ DB instances
options.C: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon Aurora On-Demand PostgreSQL-Compatible database
options.D: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon S3 bucket by using Amazon S3 Object Select

explanations.A: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database 分析：Amazon Aurora 是高性能的托管数据库服务，但其成本较高，尤其是对于开发栤境的短时使用场景。 结论：不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.B: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Single-AZ DB instances 分析：Amazon RDS 提供托管的 PostgreSQL 数据库服务，Single-AZ 实例成本较低，但仍然需要为整个实例的运行时间付费，即使 开发栤境只使用了一部分时间。 结论：成本效益不如按需 Aurora。
explanations.C: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon Aurora On-Demand PostgreSQL-Compatible database 分析：Amazon Aurora On-Demand 模式允许根据实际使用时间付费，非常适合开发栤境的短时使用场景。 结论：符合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.D: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon S3 bucket by using Amazon S3 Object Select 分析：Amazon S3 是对象存储服务，不适合直接作为数据库使用。S3 Object Select 主要用于查询存储在 S3 中的数据，而不是运行 数据库。 结论：不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company uses AWS Organizations with resources tagged by account. The company also uses AWS Backup to back up its AWS infrastructure resources. The company needs to back up all AWS resources. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Config to identify all untagged resources. Tag the identified resources programmatically. Use tags in the backup plan.
options.B: Use AWS Config to identify all resources that are not running. Add those resources to the backup vault.
options.C: Require all AWS account owners to review their resources to identify the resources that need to be backed up.
options.D: Use Amazon Inspector to identify all noncompliant resources.

explanations.A: Use AWS Config to identify all untagged resources. Tag the identified resources programmatically. Use tags in the backup plan. 正确：AWS Config可以帮助识别未打标签的资源，之后可以通过编程方式为这些资源添加标签。使用标签可以简化备份计划的管 理，减少操作开销。
explanations.B: Use AWS Config to identify all resources that are not running. Add those resources to the backup vault. 错误：AWS Config的主要功能是记录资源配置和合规性，而不是直接识别“未运行的资源”。此外，备份未运行的资源并不符合题目 要求。
explanations.C: Require all AWS account owners to review their resources to identify the resources that need to be backed up. 错误：这种方法需要人工干预，增加了操作开销，不符合题目要求的“LEAST operational overhead”。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Inspector to identify all noncompliant resources. 错误：Amazon Inspector主要用于安全漏洞扫描和合规性检查，与备份资源的识别无关。

question: Topic 1 A social media company wants to allow its users to upload images in an application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud. The company needs a solution that automatically resizes the images so that the images can be displayed on multiple device types. The application experiences unpredictable traffic patterns throughout the day. The company is seeking a highly available solution that maximizes scalability. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a static website hosted in Amazon S3 that invokes AWS Lambda functions to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Create a static website hosted in Amazon CloudFront that invokes AWS Step Functions to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon RDS database.
options.C: Create a dynamic website hosted on a web server that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. Configure a process that runs on the EC2 instance to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Create a dynamic website hosted on an automatically scaling Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that creates a resize job in Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Set up an image-resizing program that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance to process the resize jobs.

explanations.A: Create a static website hosted in Amazon S3 that invokes AWS Lambda functions to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon S3 bucket. 正确：Amazon S3 可以托管静态网站，具有高可用性和可扩展性。 正确：AWS Lambda 是无服务器计算服务，能够自动扩展以处理图片调整任务。 正确：Amazon S3 是理想的存储解决方案，适合存储图片文件。 此选项完全符合题目要求：高可用性、可扩展性以及自动化图片处理。
explanations.B: Create a static website hosted in Amazon CloudFront that invokes AWS Step Functions to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon RDS database. 错误：CloudFront 是内容分发网络（CDN），不直接托管静态网站。 错误：AWS Step Functions 是工作流编排服务，不适合直接处理图片调整任务。 错误：Amazon RDS 是关系型数据库，不适合存储图片文件。 此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Create a dynamic website hosted on a web server that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. Configure a process that runs on the EC2 instance to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon S3 bucket. 错误：EC2 需要手动管理，无法自动扩展以应对不可预测的流量模式。 正确：可以通过 EC2 实例运行图片调整程序，但这不是最佳解决方案。 正确：Amazon S3 是理想的存储解决方案。 此选项不符合题目要求的高可用性和自动扩展性。
explanations.D: Create a dynamic website hosted on an automatically scaling Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that creates a resize job in Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Set up an image-resizing program that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance to process the resize jobs. 正确：Amazon ECS 可以自动扩展以应对流量变化。 错误：使用 EC2 实例处理图片调整任务需要手动管理，增加复杂性。 错误：此选项的架构复杂度较高，不是最佳解决方案。 此选项不完全符合题目要求的简单性和高可用性。

question: Topic 1 A company is running a microservices application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to migrate the application to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster for scalability. The company must configure the Amazon EKS control plane with endpoint private access set to true and endpoint public access set to false to maintain security compliance. The company must also put the data plane in private subnets. However, the company has received error notifications because the node cannot join the cluster. Which solution will allow the node to join the cluster?

options.A: Grant the required permission in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to the AmazonEKSNodeRole IAM role.
options.B: Create interface VPC endpoints to allow nodes to access the control plane.
options.C: Recreate nodes in the public subnet. Restrict security groups for EC2 nodes.
options.D: Allow outbound traffic in the security group of the nodes.

explanations.A: Grant the required permission in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to the AmazonEKSNodeRole IAM role. 分析：虽然 IAM 角色权限是 Amazon EKS 节点正常运行的必要条件，但题目中并未提到 IAM 权限不足的问题。 结论：此选项与题目描述的错误通知无关，因此错误。
explanations.B: Create interface VPC endpoints to allow nodes to access the control plane. 分析：当控制密面设置为私有访问 (endpoint private access = true) 目禁用公共访问 (endpoint public access = false) 时，节点需要 通过接口 VPC 端点访问控制密面。 结论：此选项解决了节点无法加入集群的问题，因此正确。
explanations.C: Recreate nodes in the public subnet. Restrict security groups for EC2 nodes. 分析：题目明确要求数据密面必须位于私有子网中，因此将节点放置在公共子网中不符合要求。 结论：此选项违反了题目要求，因此错误。
explanations.D: Allow outbound traffic in the security group of the nodes. 分析：虽然允许出站流量是节点访问外部资源的必要条件，但题目中未提到安全组配置问题。 结论：此选项与题目描述的错误通知无关，因此错误。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating an on-premises application to AWS. The company wants to use Amazon Redshift as a solution. Which use cases are suitable for Amazon Redshift in this scenario? (Choose three.)

options.A: Supporting data APIs to access data with traditional, containerized, and event-driven applications
options.B: Supporting client-side and server-side encryption
options.C: Building analytics workloads during specified hours and when the application is not active
options.D: Caching data to reduce the pressure on the backend database
options.E: Scaling globally to support petabytes of data and tens of millions of requests per minute
options.F: Creating a secondary replica of the cluster by using the AWS Management Console 使用AWS Management Console

explanations.A: Supporting data APIs to access data with traditional, containerized, and event-driven applications 分析：Amazon Redshift主要用于数据仓库和分析工作负载，而不是专门设计用于支持数据API访问。此选项更适合Amazon DynamoDB或Amazon RDS等服务，因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Supporting client-side and server-side encryption 分析：Amazon Redshift支持加密功能，包括客户端和服务器端加密，确保数据安全性。此选项正确。
explanations.C: Building analytics workloads during specified hours and when the application is not active 分析：Amazon Redshift非常适合构建分析工作负载，尤其是在应用程序非活动时进行批量处理。此选项正确。
explanations.D: Caching data to reduce the pressure on the backend database 分析：Amazon Redshift不是专门设计用于缓存数据的服务。缓存功能通常由Amazon ElastiCache或Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)提供，因此此选项错误。
explanations.E: Scaling globally to support petabytes of data and tens of millions of requests per minute 分析：Amazon Redshift可以扩展到支持PB级数据，但它的设计目标是数据仓库和分析工作负载，而不是处理数干万次请求每分钟 的场景（这更适合Amazon DynamoDB）。此选项正确。
explanations.F: Creating a secondary replica of the cluster by using the AWS Management Console 分析：Amazon Redshift不支持通过AWS Management Console创建二级副本。此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company provides an API interface to customers so the customers can retrieve their financial information. Ehe company expects a larger number of requests during peak usage times of the year. The company requires the API to respond consistently with low latency to ensure customer satisfaction. The company needs to provide a compute host for the API. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use an Application Load Balancer and Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). {FB Application Load Balancer和Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS),
options.B: Use Amazon AP! Gateway and AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency.
options.C: Use an Application Load Balancer and an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster.
options.D: Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions with reserved concurrency.

explanations.A: Use an Application Load Balancer and Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). 正确性分析：Amazon ECS是一种容器服务，可以提供高性能和可扩展性，但需要手动管理容器的部署和扩展，增加了运维开销。 低延迟：可以通过负载均衡实现低延迟，但需要额外配置。 运维开销：较高，因为需要管理容器和集群。 结论：不符合“最小运维开销”的要求。
explanations.B: Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency. 正确性分析：Amazon API Gateway和AWS Lambda是无服务器服务，几乎不需要运维开销。 低延迟：启用预置并发（Provisioned Concurrency）可以确保Lambda函数始终有预热实例，减少冷启动时间，保证低延迟。 运维开销：最低，因为API Gateway和Lambda是完全托管的服务。 结论：符合题目要求，是最佳答案。
explanations.C: Use an Application Load Balancer and an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. 正确性分析：Amazon EKS是一种托管的Kubernetes服务，可以提供高性能和可扩展性，但需要手动管理集群和容器部署。 低延迟：可以通过负载均衡实现低延迟，但需要额外配置。 运维开销：较高，因为需要管理Kubernetes集群和容器。 结论：不符合“最小运维开销”的要求。
explanations.D: Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions with reserved concurrency. 正确性分析：Reserved Concurrency可以限制Lambda函数的最大并发数，但不能保证预热实例，可能会导致冷启动问题。 低延迟：由于冷启动问题，可能无法始终保证低延迟。 运维开销：较低，但不如Provisioned Concurrency优化冷启动问题。 结论：不如选项B符合要求。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to send all AWS Systems Manager Session Manager logs to an Amazon S3 bucket for archival purposes. Which solution will meet this requirement with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Enable S3 logging in the Systems Manager console. Choose an S3 bucket to send the session data to.
options.B: Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent. Push all logs to a CloudWatch log group. Export the logs to an S3 bucket from the group for archival purposes.
options.C: Create a Systems Manager document to upload all server logs to a central S3 bucket. Use Amazon EventBridge to run the Systems Manager document against all servers that are in the account daily.
options.D: Install an Amazon CloudWatch agent. Push all logs to a CloudWatch log group. Create a CloudWatch logs subscription that pushes any incoming log events to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Set Amazon S3 as the destination.

explanations.A: Enable S3 logging in the Systems Manager console. Choose an S3 bucket to send the session data to. 正确：AWS Systems Manager Session Manager支持直接将会话日志发送到Amazon S3。通过在Systems Manager控制台中启用S3 日志记录并选择目标S3存储橘，可以实现高效的日志存储，无需额外的配置或服务。 操作效率高，因为这是原生支持的功能，配置简单。
explanations.B: Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent. Push all logs to a CloudWatch log group. Export the logs to an S3 bucket from the group for archival purposes. 错误：虽然可以通过CloudWatch日志组将日志导出到S3，但这需要额外安装CloudWatch代理，并且需要手动配置导出任务，增加 了操作复杂性。 相比选项A，操作效率较低。
explanations.C: Create a Systems Manager document to upload all server logs to a central S3 bucket. Use Amazon EventBridge to run the Systems Manager document against all servers that are in the account daily. 错误：此方法需要创建自定义的Systems Manager文档，并通过EventBridge定期运行任务，增加了复杂性。 不适用于Session Manager日志的直接存储，目操作效率较低。
explanations.D: Install an Amazon CloudWatch agent. Push all logs to a CloudWatch log group. Create a CloudWatch logs subscription that pushes any incoming log events to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Set Amazon S3 as the destination. 错误：此方法涉及多个服务（CloudWatch、Kinesis Data Firehose），需要额外安装代理和配置订阅规则，操作复杂。 虽然可以实现日志存储到S3，但相比选项A，操作效率明显较低。

question: Topic 1 An application uses an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. The RDS database is becoming low on disk space. A solutions architect wants to increase the disk space without downtime. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST amount of effort?

options.A: Enable storage autoscaling in RDS 在 RDS
options.B: Increase the RDS database instance size 增加 RDS
options.C: Change the RDS database instance storage type to Provisioned IOPS 将 RDS
options.D: Back up the RDS database, increase the storage capacity, restore the database, and stop the previous instance 备份 RDS

explanations.A: Enable storage autoscaling in RDS 正确。Amazon RDS支持存储自动扩展功能，可以在数据库存储空间不足时自动增加存储容量，而无需停机。这是最简单且无中断 的方法。
explanations.B: Increase the RDS database instance size 错误。增加实例大小（例如从小型实例升级到大型实例）主要影响计算能力（CPU和内存），而不是存储容量。此选项无法解决存 储空间不足的问题。
explanations.C: Change the RDS database instance storage type to Provisioned IOPS 错误。更改存储类型（例如切换到Provisioned IOPS）可以提高性能，但不会直接增加存储容量。此外，更改存储类型可能需要停 机。
explanations.D: Back up the RDS database, increase the storage capacity, restore the database, and stop the previous instance 错误。此方法需要手动备份和恢复数据库，并且会导致停机时间，不符合题目要求的“无停机”条件。

question: Topic 1 A consulting company provides professional services to customers worldwide. The company provides solutions and tools for customers to expedite gathering and analyzing data on AWS. The company needs to centrally manage and deploy a common set of solutions and tools for customers to use for self-service purposes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create AWS CloudFormation templates for the customers.
options.B: Create AWS Service Catalog products for the customers.
options.C: Create AWS Systems Manager templates for the customers.
options.D: Create AWS Config items for the customers.

explanations.A: Create AWS CloudFormation templates for the customers. CloudFormation主要用于定义和部署基础架构资源，通过模板自动化资源创建。 虽然可以用CloudFormation模板来创建资源，但它不具备集中管理和提供自助服务的功能。 因此，此选项不完全满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Create AWS Service Catalog products for the customers. AWS Service Catalog专门用于集中管理和部署产品（解决方案和工具），并支持自助服务功能。 它允许客户通过预定义的产品快速部署资源，同时确保符合公司标准。 此选项完全符合题目要求，是正确答案。
explanations.C: Create AWS Systems Manager templates for the customers. Systems Manager主要用于管理和自动化操作任务，例如补丁管理、运行命令等。 虽然它可以帮助管理资源，但它不适合用于集中管理和部署解决方案的场景。 因此，此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Create AWS Config items for the customers. AWS Config主要用于资源合规性检查和配置审计。 它不具备部署解决方案或工具的功能，也不支持自助服务。 因此，此选项不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing a new web application that will run on Amazon EC2 Instances. The application will use Amazon DynamoDB for backend data storage. The application traffic will be unpredictable. The company expects that the application read and write throughput to the database will be moderate to high. The company needs to scale in response to application traffic. Which DynamoDB table configuration will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure DynamoDB with provisioned read and write by using the DynamoDB Standard table class. Set DynamoDB auto scaling to a maximum defined capacity.
options.B: Configure DynamoDB in on-demand mode by using the DynamoDB Standard table class.
options.C: Configure DynamoDB with provisioned read and write by using the DynamoDB Standard Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-lA) table class. Set DynamoDB auto scaling to a maximum defined capacity.
options.D: Configure DynamoDB in on-demand mode by using the DynamoDB Standard Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-IA) table class.

explanations.A: Configure DynamoDB with provisioned read and write by using the DynamoDB Standard table class. Set DynamoDB auto scaling to a maximum defined capacity. 正确性分析：使用预置模式 (Provisioned Mode) 配合自动扩展可以处理动态流量，但需要提前定义最大容量，可能导致资源梸费或 容量不足。 成本分析：预置模式在流量不可预测的情况下可能不够棬梮，目成本可能较高。 结论：不符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”解决方案。
explanations.B: Configure DynamoDB in on-demand mode by using the DynamoDB Standard table class. 正确性分析：按需模式 (On-Demand Mode) 可以根据流量自动扩展，无需提前定义容量，适合流量不可预测的场景。 成本分析：按需模式在流量不可预测时更具成本效益，因为只需为实际使用的读写操作付费。 结论：符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”解决方案。
explanations.C: Configure DynamoDB with provisioned read and write by using the DynamoDB Standard Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-IA) table class. Set DynamoDB auto scaling to a maximum defined capacity. 正确性分析：DynamoDB Standard-IA表类适用于访问频率较低的场景，但题目中提到读写知吐量为“中到高”，不适合使用 Standard-IA。 成本分析：Standard-IA表类的存储成本较低，但读写成本较高，不适合高知吐量场景。 结论：不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Configure DynamoDB in on-demand mode by using the DynamoDB Standard Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard- IA) table class. 正确性分析：按需模式适合动态流量，但Standard-IA表类不适合高知吐量场景。 成本分析：Standard-IA表类的读写成本较高，不适合题目中提到的“中到高”知吐量场景。 结论：不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A retail company has several businesses. The IT team for each business manages its own AWS account. Each team account is part of an organization in AWS Organizations. Each team monitors its product inventory levels in an Amazon DynamoDB table in the team's own AWS account. The company is deploying a central inventory reporting application into a shared AWS account. The application must be able to read items from all the teams’ DynamoDB tables. Which authentication option will meet these requirements MOST securely?

options.A: Integrate DynamoDB with AWS Secrets Manager in the inventory application account. Configure the application to use the correct secret from Secrets Manager to authenticate and read the DynamoDB table. Schedule secret rotation for every 30 days.

question: Topic 1 A company has an online gaming application that has TCP and UDP multiplayer gaming capabilities. explanations.A: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the NLBs. Increase the Cache-Control max-age parameter. 正确性分析：CloudFront主要用于内容分发和缓存静态资源，而题目中提到的是TCP和UDP的实时在线游戏，这种场景不适合使用 CloudFront，因为游戏流量通常是动态的，无法通过缓存优化性能。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Replace the NLBs with Application Load Balancers (ALBs). Configure Route 53 to use latency-based routing. 正确性分析：ALB主要用于HTTP/HTTPS流量，而题目中明确提到需要支持TCP和UDP协议，这些协议是NLB的强项。此外，虽然 Route 53的延迟路由可以优化性能，但更换为ALB会导致协议不匹配。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Add AWS Global Accelerator in front of the NLBs. Configure a Global Accelerator endpoint to use the correct listener ports. 正确性分析：AWS Global Accelerator可以优化全球用户的网络性能，减少延迟，并支持TCP和UDP协议。将Global Accelerator放在 NLB前面可以有效提升在线游戏的性能和用户体验。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Add an Amazon API Gateway endpoint behind the NLBs. Enable API caching. Override method caching for the different stages. 正确性分析：API Gateway主要用于管理和优化API流量，而题目中提到的是TCP和UDP的实时在线游戏场景，API Gateway不适合处 理这种类型的流量。此外，API缓存对动态游戏流量没有帮助。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to integrate with a third-party data feed. The data feed sends a webhook to notify an external service when new data is ready for consumption. A developer wrote an AWS Lambda function to retrieve data when the company receives a webhook callback. The developer must make the Lambda function available for the third party to call. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create a function URL for the Lambda function. Provide the Lambda function URL to the third party for the webhook.
options.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of the Lambda function. Provide the ALB URL to the third party for the webhook.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Attach the topic to the Lambda function. Provide the public hostname of the SNS topic to the third party for the webhook.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Attach the queue to the Lambda function. Provide the public hostname of the SQS queue to the third party for the webhook.

explanations.A: Create a function URL for the Lambda function. Provide the Lambda function URL to the third party for the webhook. 正确：Lambda Function URL是AWS提供的一种直接访问Lambda函数的方式，无需额外的配置或资源。它支持HTTP调用，适合第 三方集成，目操作效率高。 此选项最符合题目要求，提供了最简单和高效的解决方案。
explanations.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of the Lambda function. Provide the ALB URL to the third party for the webhook. 错误：虽然ALB可以与Lambda集成，但这种方式需要额外的配置和资源（例如，设置目标组、监听器等），增加了复杂性和成本。 题目要求“最具操作效率”的解决方案，使用ALB显然不符合这一要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Attach the topic to the Lambda function. Provide the public hostname of the SNS topic to the third party for the webhook. 错误：SNS主题通常用于发布/订阅模式，而不是直接处理HTTP webhook回调。 此外，SNS主题的公共主机名无法直接用于第三方HTTP调用。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Attach the queue to the Lambda function. Provide the public hostname of the SQS queue to the third party for the webhook. 错误：SQS队列用于消息队列处理，而不是直接处理HTTP webhook回调。 类似SNS，SQS的公共主机名无法直接用于第三方HTTP调用。

question: Topic 1 A company has a workload in an AWS Region. Customers connect to and access the workload by using an Amazon API! Gateway REST API. The company uses Amazon Route 53 as its DNS provider. The company wants to provide individual and secure URLs for all customers. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency? (Choose three.)

options.A: Register the required domain in a registrar. Create a wildcard custom domain name in a Route 53 hosted zone and record in the zone that points to the API Gateway endpoint.
options.B: Request a wildcard certificate that matches the domains in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in a different Region.
options.C: Create hosted zones for each customer as required in Route 53. Create zone records that point to the API Gateway endpoint.
options.D: Request a wildcard certificate that matches the custom domain name in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the same Region
options.E: Create multiple API endpoints for each customer in API Gateway.
options.F: Create a custom domain name in API Gateway for the REST API. Import the certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM).

explanations.A: Register the required domain in a registrar. Create a wildcard custom domain name in a Route 53 hosted zone and record in the zone that points to the API Gateway endpoint. 分析：正确。梢册域名是实现自定义域名的第一桯，创建通配符域名可以为多个孫户提供个性化URL，同时指向API Gateway端点是 必要的操作。
explanations.B: Request a wildcard certificate that matches the domains in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in a different Region. 分析：错误。ACM证书必须与API Gateway所在的同一区域匹配，跨区域的证书无法用于API Gateway的域名绑定。
explanations.C: Create hosted zones for each customer as required in Route 53. Create zone records that point to the API Gateway endpoint. 分析：错误。为桹个孫户创建单栘的托管区域会增加管理复杂性，目不符合“最高操作效率”的要求。
explanations.D: Request a wildcard certificate that matches the custom domain name in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the same Region. 分析：正确。通配符证书可以支持多个子域名，目必须与API Gateway所在的区域匹配。
explanations.E: Create multiple API endpoints for each customer in API Gateway. 分析：错误。为桹个孫户创建多个API端点会增加管理复杂性，不符合“最高操作效率”的要求。
explanations.F: Create a custom domain name in API Gateway for the REST API. Import the certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). 分析：正确。在API Gateway中创建自定义域名并导入ACM证书是实现安全URL的关键桯骤。

question: Topic 1 A company stores data in Amazon S3. According to regulations, the data must not contain personally identifiable information (Pll). The company recently discovered that S3 buckets have some objects that contain Pll. The company needs to automatically detect Pll in S3 buckets and to notify the company’s security team. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Macie. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the SensitiveData event type from Macie findings and to send an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to the security team. {FA Amazon Macie。
options.B: Use Amazon GuardDuty. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the CRITICAL event type from GuardDuty findings and to send an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to the security team. {FA Amazon GuardDuty。
options.C: Use Amazon Macie. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal event type from Macie findings and to send an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) notification to the security team. {FA Amazon Macie。
options.D: Use Amazon GuardDuty. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the CRITICAL event type from GuardDuty findings and to send an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) notification to the security team. {FA Amazon GuardDuty。

explanations.A: Use Amazon Macie. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the SensitiveData event type from Macie findings and to send an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to the security team. 正确：Amazon Macie专门用于桌测敏感数据（如PII），并椹成相关事件类型（如SensitiveData）。 正确：Amazon EventBridge可以过滤SensitiveData事件类型，并触发后痲操作。 正确：Amazon SNS适合用于发送通知给安全团队。
explanations.B: Use Amazon GuardDuty. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the CRITICAL event type from GuardDuty findings and to send an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to the security team. 错误：Amazon GuardDuty主要用于桌测安全威胁（如恶意梮动），而不是桌测敏感数据（如PII）。 错误：CRITICAL事件类型与PII桌测无关。 正确：Amazon SNS可以发送通知，但前提是事件类型正确。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Macie. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal event type from Macie findings and to send an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) notification to the security team. 正确：Amazon Macie可以桌测SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal事件类型。 错误：Amazon SQS用于队列处理，而不是直接通知安全团队。题目要求的是通知功能，SNS更合适。
explanations.D: Use Amazon GuardDuty. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the CRITICAL event type from GuardDuty findings and to send an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) notification to the security team. 错误：Amazon GuardDuty不适合桌测PII数据。 错误：CRITICAL事件类型与PII桌测无关。 错误：Amazon SQS用于队列处理，而不是直接通知安全团队。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to build a logging solution for its multiple AWS accounts. The company currently stores the logs from all accounts in a centralized account. The company has created an Amazon S3 bucket in the centralized account to store the VPC flow logs and AWS CloudTrail logs. All logs must be highly available for 30 days for frequent analysis, retained for an additional 60 days for backup purposes, and deleted 90 days after creation. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Transition objects to the S3 Standard storage class 30 days after creation. Write an expiration action that directs Amazon S3 to delete objects after 90 days.
options.B: Transition objects to the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class 30 days after creation. Move all objects to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class after 90 days. Write an expiration action that directs Amazon S3 to delete objects after 90 days.
options.C: Transition objects to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class 30 days after creation. Write an expiration action that directs Amazon $3 to delete objects after 90 days.
options.D: Transition objects to the S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) storage class 30 days after creation. Move all objects to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class after 90 days. Write an expiration action that directs Amazon S3 to delete objects after 90 days.

explanations.A: Transition objects to the S3 Standard storage class 30 days after creation. Write an expiration action that directs Amazon S3 to delete objects after 90 days. 错误：S3 Standard存储类适用于频痏访问的数据，但成本较高，不适合长期存储和备份需求。 没有使用更低成本的存储类（如S3 Standard-IA或S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval），因此不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.B: Transition objects to the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class 30 days after creation. Move all objects to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class after 90 days. Write an expiration action that directs Amazon S3 to delete objects after 90 days. 错误：此选项提到在90天后将对象移动到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，但随后又删除对象，这与需求不符，因为对象在90天后不需 要进一桯存储。 不必要的存储类转换增加了复杂性和成本。
explanations.C: Transition objects to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class 30 days after creation. Write an expiration action that directs Amazon S3 to delete objects after 90 days. 正确：S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval存储类成本低，适合长期存储和备份需求。 椹命周期规则在30天后将对象转移到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，并在90天后删除对象，符合需求目成本最低。
explanations.D: Transition objects to the S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) storage class 30 days after creation. Move all objects to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class after 90 days. Write an expiration action that directs Amazon S3 to delete objects after 90 days. 错误：S3 One Zone-IA存储类不提供高可用性，可能导致数据丢失，不符合“高可用性”的要求。 在90天后将对象移动到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval存储类是多余的，因为对象会被删除。

question: Topic 1 A company is building an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster for its workloads. All secrets that are stored in Amazon EKS must be encrypted in the Kubernetes etcd key-value store. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Use AWS Secrets Manager to manage, rotate, and store all secrets in Amazon EKS.
options.B: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Enable Amazon EKS KMS secrets encryption on the Amazon EKS cluster.
options.C: Create the Amazon EKS cluster with default options. Use the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Container Storage Interface (CSI) driver as an add-on.
options.D: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key with the alias/aws/ebs alias. Enable default Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume encryption for the account.

explanations.A: 创建一个新的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥。使用 AWS Secrets Manager 来管理、轮换和存储 Amazon EKS 中的所有密钥。 错误：虽然AWS Secrets Manager可以管理和存储密钥，但它与Kubernetes etcd存储的加密无关。此选项未提及如何加密 Kubernetes etcd存储。
explanations.B: 创建一个新的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥。在 Amazon EKS 集群上启用 Amazon EKS KMS 密钥加密。 正确：此选项直接提到使用AWS KMS密钥来启用Amazon EKS的KMS加密功能，这是加密Kubernetes etcd存储的正确方法。
explanations.C: 使用默正选项创建 Amazon EKS 集群。将 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 容器存储接口 (CSI) 驱动作为附加组件。 错误：EBS CSI驱动用于管理EBS卷，而不是用于加密Kubernetes etcd存储。
explanations.D: 创建一个带有 alias/aws/ebs 别名的新 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥。为账户启用默正的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷加密。 错误：此选项与EBS卷加密相关，而不是Kubernetes etcd存储的加密。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to provide data scientists with near real-time read-only access to the company's production Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database. The database is currently configured as a Single-AZ database. The data scientists use complex queries that will not affect the production database. The company needs a solution that is highly available. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Scale the existing production database in a maintenance window to provide enough power for the data scientists.
options.B: Change the setup from a Single-AZ to a Multi-AZ instance deployment with a larger secondary standby instance. Provide the data scientists access to the secondary instance.
options.C: Change the setup from a Single-AZ to a Multi-AZ instance deployment. Provide two additional read replicas for the data scientists.
options.D: Change the setup from a Single-AZto a Multi-AZ cluster deployment with two readable standby instances. Provide read endpoints to the data scientists.

explanations.A: Scale the existing production database in a maintenance window to provide enough power for the data scientists. 错误：扩展现有的生产数据库可能会增加成本，但无法提供高可用性。 错误：数据疀学家的复杂查询可能会影响生产数据库的性能，违背题目要求。
explanations.B: Change the setup from a Single-AZ to a Multi-AZ instance deployment with a larger secondary standby instance. Provide the data scientists access to the secondary instance. 错误：Multi-AZ部署的备用实例是热备份（standby），不能直接用于读取操作。 错误：数据疀学家无法访问备用实例进行查询。
explanations.C: Change the setup from a Single-AZ to a Multi-AZ instance deployment. Provide two additional read replicas for the data scientists. 错误：虽然读副本可以满足数据疀学家的需求，但题目要求的是“高可用性”，而读副本不提供高可用性保障。 错误：读副本的成本可能较高，目不符合题目中“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.D: Change the setup from a Single-AZ to a Multi-AZ cluster deployment with two readable standby instances. Provide read endpoints to the data scientists. 正确：Multi-AZ集群部署提供高可用性，并允许使用可读的备用实例。 正确：数据疀学家可以通过读取端点访问数据，而不会影响生产数据库的性能。 正确：这种方法是最具成本效益的解决方案，同时满足高可用性和性能需求。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a three-tier web application in the AWS Cloud that operates across three Availability Zones. The application architecture has an Application Load Balancer, an Amazon EC2 web server that hosts user session states, and a MySQL database that runs on an EC2 instance. The company expects sudden increases in application traffic. The company wants to be able to scale to meet future application capacity demands and to ensure high availability across all three Availability Zones. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones.
options.B: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones.
options.C: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon DynamoDB Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache reads. Store the session data in DynamoDB. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones.
options.D: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL in a single Availability Zone. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones.

explanations.A: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones. 正确：Amazon RDS for MySQL的Multi-AZ部署提供高可用性和故障转移支持。 正确：Amazon ElastiCache for Redis支持高可用性，并且适合存储会话数据和缓存读取。 正确：将Web服务器迁移到跨三个可用区的Auto Scaling组可以确保高可用性和动态扩展能力。
explanations.B: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones. 正确：Amazon RDS for MySQL的Multi-AZ部署提供高可用性和故障转移支持。 错误：Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached不支持本地高可用性（不像Redis支持主从复制和故障转移）。 正确：将Web服务器迁移到跨三个可用区的Auto Scaling组可以确保高可用性和动态扩展能力。
explanations.C: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon DynamoDB Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache reads. Store the session data in DynamoDB. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones. 错误：DynamoDB是NoSQL数据库，与MySQL（关系型数据库）不兼容，迁移会导致架构和数据模型的重大变化。 正确：DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)可以加速读取，但不适合存储会话数据。 正确：将Web服务器迁移到跨三个可用区的Auto Scaling组可以确保高可用性和动态扩展能力。
explanations.D: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL in a single Availability Zone. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones. 错误：单一可用区的Amazon RDS部署无法提供高可用性，违背了题目要求。 正确：Amazon ElastiCache for Redis支持高可用性，并且适合存储会话数据和缓存读取。 正确：将Web服务器迁移到跨三个可用区的Auto Scaling组可以确保高可用性和动态扩展能力。

question: Topic 1 A global video streaming company uses Amazon CloudFront as a content distribution network (CDN). The company wants to roll out content in a phased manner across multiple countries. The company needs to ensure that viewers who are outside the countries to which the company rolls out content are not able to view the content. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Add geographic restrictions to the content in CloudFront by using an allow list. Set up a custom error message.
options.B: Set up a new URL tor restricted content. Authorize access by using a signed URL and cookies. Set up a custom error message.
options.C: Encrypt the data for the content that the company distributes. Set up a custom error message.
options.D: Create a new URL for restricted content. Set up a time-restricted access policy for signed URLs.

explanations.A: Add geographic restrictions to the content in CloudFront by using an allow list. Set up a custom error message. 正确：CloudFront支持地理限制功能，可以通过允许列表（Allow List）或阻止列表（Deny List）来限制特定国家或地区的访问。 正确：设置自定义错误消息是一个附加功能，可以为被限制的用户提供更友好的反馈。
explanations.B: Set up a new URL for restricted content. Authorize access by using a signed URL and cookies. Set up a custom error message. 错误：签名URL和Cookie主要用于授权特定用户访问内容，而不是基于地理位置的限制。 错误：题目要求基于国家或地区的限制，而不是基于用户身份的授权。
explanations.C: Encrypt the data for the content that the company distributes. Set up a custom error message. 错误：加密内容与地理位置限制无关。加密主要用于保护数据安全，而不是控制访问权限。 错误：题目没有提到需要加密内容。
explanations.D: Create a new URL for restricted content. Set up a time-restricted access policy for signed URLs. 错误：时间限制的签名URL用于控制访问时间，而不是基于地理位置的限制。 错误：题目要求基于国家或地区的限制，而不是基于时间的限制。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to use the AWS Cloud to improve its on-premises disaster recovery (DR) configuration. The company's core production business application uses Microsoft SQL Server Standard, which runs on a virtual machine (VM). The application has a recovery point objective (RPO) of 30 seconds or fewer and a recovery time objective (RTO) of 60 minutes. The DR solution needs to minimize costs wherever possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure a multi-site active/active setup between the on-premises server and AWS by using Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise with Always On availability groups.
options.B: Configure a warm standby Amazon RDS for SQL Server database on AWS. Configure AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to use change data capture (CDC).
options.C: Use AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery configured to replicate disk changes to AWS as a pilot light.
options.D: Use third-party backup software to capture backups every night. Store a secondary set of backups in Amazon S3.

explanations.A: 配置多站点主动/主动设置： 正确性分析：Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise和Always On可用性组可以实现高可用性和灾难恢复，但此选项使用的是Enterprise版 本，成本较高，不符合题目要求的“尽可能降低成本”。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 配置温备用的Amazon RDS for SQL Server数据库： 正确性分析：Amazon RDS支持SQL Server，并且通过AWS DMS的变更数据捕获（CDC）可以实现低RPO（30秒以内）。温备用架 构可以快速启动，满足RTO（60分钟以内），同时成本较低。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: 使用AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery： 正确性分析：Elastic Disaster Recovery可以复制畭畆更改到AWS，但它主要用于整机恢复，适合更高RTO的场景。题目要求RTO为60 分钟，Elastic Disaster Recovery可能无法满足快速恢复的需求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: 使用第三方备份软件： 正确性分析：夜间备份无法满足30秒的RPO要求，目恢复时间可能远超60分钟。此选项不符合题目要求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company has an on-premises server that uses an Oracle database to process and store customer information. The company wants to use an AWS database service to achieve higher availability and to improve application performance. The company also wants to offload reporting from its primary database system. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create an Amazon RDS DB instance in multiple AWS Regions. Point the reporting functions toward a separate DB instance from the primary DB instance.
options.B: Use Amazon RDS in a Single-AZ deployment to create an Oracle database. Create a read replica in the same zone as the primary DB instance. Direct the reporting functions to the read replica.
options.C: Use Amazon RDS deployed in a Multi-AZ cluster deployment to create an Oracle database. Direct the reporting functions to use the reader instance in the cluster deployment.
options.D: Use Amazon RDS deployed in a Multi-AZ instance deployment to create an Amazon Aurora database. Direct the reporting functions to the reader instances.

explanations.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create an Amazon RDS DB instance in multiple AWS Regions. Point the reporting functions toward a separate DB instance from the primary DB instance. 正确性分析：AWS DMS可以用于迁移数据库，但题目没有提到需要跨区域部署，也没有明确要求多个区域的数据库实例。此选项增 加了复杂性，目没有提到高可用性和性能优化的具体实现。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Use Amazon RDS in a Single-AZ deployment to create an Oracle database. Create a read replica in the same zone as the primary DB instance. Direct the reporting functions to the read replica. 正确性分析：Single-AZ部署不提供高可用性，目读副本通常用于跨区域或跨可用区的读写分离，而不是在同一可用区内部署。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Use Amazon RDS deployed in a Multi-AZ cluster deployment to create an Oracle database. Direct the reporting functions to use the reader instance in the cluster deployment. 正确性分析：Multi-AZ部署提供高可用性，但Oracle数据库的Multi-AZ部署主要用于故障转移，而不是读写分离。此选项没有提到 性能优化的具体实现。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Use Amazon RDS deployed in a Multi-AZ instance deployment to create an Amazon Aurora database. Direct the reporting functions to the reader instances. 正确性分析：Amazon Aurora支持高可用性和读写分离，读实例可以用于处理报告功能，从而减答主实例的负载。此选项满足题目 要求的高可用性和性能优化。 结论：正确。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to build a web application on AWS. Client access requests to the website are not predictable and can be idle for a long time. Only customers who have paid a subscription fee can have the ability to sign in and use the web application. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to retrieve user information from Amazon DynamoDB. Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to accept RESTful APIs. Send the API calls to the Lambda function.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service behind an Application Load Balancer to retrieve user information from Amazon RDS. Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to accept RESTful APIs. Send the API calls to the Lambda function.
options.C: Create an Amazon Cognito user pool to authenticate users.
options.D: Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool to authenticate users.
options.E: Use AWS Amplify to serve the frontend web content with HTML, CSS, and JS. Use an integrated Amazon CloudFront configuration.
options.F: Use Amazon S3 static web hosting with PHP, CSS, and JS. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the frontend web content.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to retrieve user information from Amazon DynamoDB. Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to accept RESTful APIs. Send the API calls to the Lambda function. 正确：使用AWS Lambda和API Gateway是无服务器架构的核心组件，能够按需运行代码并处理API请求，目成本低廉。 Lambda函数可以从DynamoDB中检索用户人息，满足动态数据需求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service behind an Application Load Balancer to retrieve user information from Amazon RDS. Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to accept RESTful APIs. Send the API calls to the Lambda function. 错误：ECS和RDS的组合适用于更复杂的应用场景，但成本较高，不符合题目中“最具成本效益”的要求。 题目中没有提到需要使用容器化服务，因此不必要引入ECS。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Cognito user pool to authenticate users. 正确：Amazon Cognito用户池是专门用于用户身份验证的服务，能够答案管理用户注册、登录和访问控制。 用户池支持付费用户的身份验证需求，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool to authenticate users. 错误：身份池主要用于临时访问AWS资源，而不是用户身份验证。题目要求的是用户正确，而不是资源访问授权。
explanations.E: Use AWS Amplify to serve the frontend web content with HTML, CSS, and JS. Use an integrated Amazon CloudFront configuration. 正确：AWS Amplify可以快速部署前端内容，并集成CloudFront进行内容分发，提供低延迟和高性能的用户体验。 Amplify是构建现代Web应用的理想选择，目成本较低。
explanations.F: Use Amazon S3 static web hosting with PHP, CSS, and JS. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the frontend web content. 错误：Amazon S3静态网站托管不支持动态内容（如PHP），而题目中提到需要用户登录功能，这需要动态处理。 虽然S3和CloudFront可以用于静态内容分发，但不适合此场景。

question: Topic 1 A media company uses an Amazon CloudFront distribution to deliver content over the internet. The company wants only premium customers to have access to the media streams and file content. The company stores all content in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company also delivers content on demand to customers for a specific purpose, such as movie rentals or music downloads. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Generate and provide S3 signed cookies to premium customers.
options.B: Generate and provide CloudFront signed URLs to premium customers.
options.C: Use origin access control (OAC) to limit the access of non-premium customers.
options.D: Generate and activate field-level encryption to block non-premium customers.

explanations.A: Generate and provide S3 signed cookies to premium customers. 错误：S3 signed cookies是用于限制对Amazon S3资源的访问，但题目中提到使用CloudFront分发内容。CloudFront有自己的访问 控制机制（如CloudFront signed URLs或signed cookies），而不是直接使用S3 signed cookies。
explanations.B: Generate and provide CloudFront signed URLs to premium customers. 正确：CloudFront signed URLs允许您为特定用户椹成临时访问权限，确保只有授权用户可以访问内容。这是题目要求的最佳解决 方案。
explanations.C: Use origin access control (OAC) to limit the access of non-premium customers. 错误：OAC用于限制CloudFront对S3的访问权限，但它不能直接区分“高级客户”和“非高级客户”。它主要用于保护S3内容不被直接 访问，而不是用户级别的访问控制。
explanations.D: Generate and activate field-level encryption to block non-premium customers. 错误：Field-level encryption用于保护敏感数据在传输过程中不被梚轄，但它不是用来限制用户访问的机制。

question: Topic 1 A company runs Amazon EC2 instances in multiple AWS accounts that are individually bled. The company recently purchased a Savings Pian. Because of changes in the company's business requirements, the company has decommissioned a large number of EC2 instances. The company wants to use its Savings Plan discounts on its other AWS accounts. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: From the AWS Account Management Console of the management account, turn on discount sharing from the billing preferences section.
options.B: From the AWS Account Management Console of the account that purchased the existing Savings Plan, turn on discount sharing from the billing preferences section. Include all accounts.
options.C: From the AWS Organizations management account, use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the Savings Plan with other accounts. AWS Organizations
options.D: Create an organization in AWS Organizations in a new payer account. Invite the other AWS accounts to join the organization from the management account.
options.E: Create an organization in AWS Organizations in the existing AWS account with the existing EC2 instances and Savings Plan. Invite the other AWS accounts to join the organization from the management account.

explanations.A: From the AWS Account Management Console of the management account, turn on discount sharing from the billing preferences section. 正确。AWS允许通过管理账户在计费偏好中启用折扣共享，这样可以将Savings Plan的折扣应用到组织中的其他账户。
explanations.B: From the AWS Account Management Console of the account that purchased the existing Savings Plan, turn on discount sharing from the billing preferences section. Include all accounts. 错误。折扣共享必须通过AWS Organizations的管理账户来启用，而不是通过购买Savings Plan的账户。
explanations.C: From the AWS Organizations management account, use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the Savings Plan with other accounts. 错误。AWS RAM主要用于共享资源（如子网、Transit Gateway等），而不是用于共享Savings Plan折扣。
explanations.D: Create an organization in AWS Organizations in a new payer account. Invite the other AWS accounts to join the organization from the management account. 正确。创建一个新的付款账户并设置AWS Organizations，可以将所有账户集中管理，并启用折扣共享。
explanations.E: Create an organization in AWS Organizations in the existing AWS account with the existing EC2 instances and Savings Plan. Invite the other AWS accounts to join the organization from the management account. 错误。虽然可以在现有账户中创建组织，但题目中提到“多个AWS账户是单独计费的”，因此需要一个新的付款账户来统一管理。

question: Topic 1 A retail company uses a regional Amazon API Gateway API for its public REST APIs. The API Gateway endpoint is a custom domain name that points to an Amazon Route 53 alias record. A solutions architect needs to create a solution that has minimal effects on customers and minimal data loss to release the new version of APIs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a canary release deployment stage for AP] Gateway. Deploy the latest API version. Point an appropriate percentage of traffic to the canary stage. After API verification, promote the canary stage to the production stage.
options.B: Create a new API Gateway endpoint with a new version of the API in OpenAPI YAML file format. Use the import-to-update operation in merge mode into the API in API Gateway. Deploy the new version of the API to the production stage.
options.C: Create a new API Gateway endpoint with a new version of the API in OpenAPI JSON file format. Use the import-to-update operation in overwrite mode into the API in API Gateway. Deploy the new version of the API to the production stage.
options.D: Create a new API Gateway endpoint with new versions of the API definitions. Create a custom domain name for the new API Gateway API. Point the Route 53 alias record to the new API Gateway API custom domain name.

explanations.A: Create a canary release deployment stage for API Gateway. Deploy the latest API version. Point an appropriate percentage of traffic to the canary stage. After API verification, promote the canary stage to the production stage. 正确：金丝雀发布是一种逐步将流量引导到新版本的方式，可以最小化对客户的影响和数据丢失。 金丝雀阶段允许验证新版本的API是否正常工作，然后再将其推广到生产环境。
explanations.B: Create a new API Gateway endpoint with a new version of the API in OpenAPI YAML file format. Use the import-to- update operation in merge mode into the API in API Gateway. Deploy the new version of the API to the production stage. 错误：虽然可以使用OpenAPI YAML文件格式更新API，但直接将新版本部署到生产阶段可能会导致客户受到影响。 没有提到如何逐步引导流量或验证新版本的API。
explanations.C: Create a new API Gateway endpoint with a new version of the API in OpenAPI JSON file format. Use the import-to- update operation in overwrite mode into the API in API Gateway. Deploy the new version of the API to the production stage. 错误：与选项B类似，直接覆盖生产环境的API可能会导致客户受到影响。 没有提到如何逐步引导流量或验证新版本的API。
explanations.D: Create a new API Gateway endpoint with new versions of the API definitions. Create a custom domain name for the new API Gateway API. Point the Route 53 alias record to the new API Gateway API custom domain name. 错误：创建新的API Gateway端点和自定义域名会导致客户需要更新其访问方式，影响较大。 没有提到如何逐步引导流量或验证新版本的API。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to direct its users to a backup static error page if the company's primary website is unavailable. The primary website's DNS records are hosted in Amazon Route 53. The domain is pointing to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company needs a solution that minimizes changes and infrastructure overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Update the Route 53 records to use a latency routing policy. Add a static error page that is hosted in an Amazon S3 bucket to the records so that the traffic is sent to the most responsive endpoints.
options.B: Set up a Route 53 active-passive failover configuration. Direct traffic to a static error page that is hosted in an Amazon S3 bucket when Route 53 health checks determine that the ALB endpoint is unhealthy.
options.C: Set up a Route 53 active-active configuration with the ALB and an Amazon EC2 instance that hosts a static error page as endpoints. Configure Route 53 to send requests to the instance only if the health checks fail for the ALB.
options.D: Update the Route 53 records to use a multivalue answer routing policy. Create a health check. Direct traffic to the website if the health check passes. Direct traffic to a static error page that is hosted in Amazon S3 if the health check does not pass.

explanations.A: Update the Route 53 records to use a latency routing policy... 错误：延迟路由策略用于根据用户与资源的延迟选择最优路径，而不是用于故障转移。 错误：题目要求的是故障转移解决方案，而不是基于延迟的路由。
explanations.B: Set up a Route 53 active-passive failover configuration... 正确：主动-被动故障转移配置允许在主资源不可用时将流量切换到备份资源。 正确：Route 53健康桌查可以桌测ALB的栓态，并在其不可用时将流量引导至S3托管的静态错误页面。
explanations.C: Set up a Route 53 active-active configuration... 错误：主动-主动配置用于同时使用多个资源，而不是故障转移。 错误：使用EC2实例托管静态错误页面增加了基础设施开销，与题目要求的“最小化基础设施开销”不符。
explanations.D: Update the Route 53 records to use a multivalue answer routing policy... 错误：多值答案路由策略用于返回多个资源的IP地址，并不直接支持故障转移。 错误：虽然可以结合健康桌查，但多值答案路由策略不是最适合故障转移的解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A recent analysis of a company's IT expenses highlights the need to reduce backup costs. The company's chief information officer wants to simplify the on-premises backup infrastructure and reduce costs by eliminating the use of physical backup tapes. The company must preserve the existing investment in the on-premises backup applications and workflows. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Set up AWS Storage Gateway to connect with the backup applications using the NFS interface.
options.B: Set up an Amazon EFS file system that connects with the backup applications using the NFS interface.
options.C: Set up an Amazon EFS file system that connects with the backup applications using the iSCSI interface.
options.D: Set up AWS Storage Gateway to connect with the backup applications using the iSCSI-virtual tape library (VTL) interface.

explanations.A: Set up AWS Storage Gateway to connect with the backup applications using the NFS interface. 错误：虽然AWS Storage Gateway支持NFS接口，但NFS主要用于文件共享，而不是蔡代物理磁带备份。 本题要求蔡代物理磁带备份，NFS接口无法满足虚拟磁带库（VTL）的需求。
explanations.B: Set up an Amazon EFS file system that connects with the backup applications using the NFS interface. 错误：Amazon EFS是一个文件存储服务，适合共享文件系统，但不支持虚拟磁带库（VTL）功能。 无法直接与传统备份应用程序集成以蔡代物理磁带备份。
explanations.C: Set up an Amazon EFS file system that connects with the backup applications using the iSCSI interface. 错误：Amazon EFS不支持iSCSI接口，目EFS的设计目标是文件存储，而非磁带备份蔡代。 无法满足题目中关于虚拟磁带库（VTL）的需求。
explanations.D: Set up AWS Storage Gateway to connect with the backup applications using the iSCSI-virtual tape library (VTL) interface. 正确：AWS Storage Gateway的磁带网关（Tape Gateway）支持iSCSI虚拟磁带库（VTL）接口，可以蔡代物理磁带备份。 它能够与现有的备份应用程序和工作流集成，保留现有投资，同时简化备份基础设施并降低成本。

question: Topic 1 A company has data collection sensors at different locations. The data collection sensors stream a high volume of data to the company. The company wants to design a platform on AWS to ingest and process high-volume streaming data. The solution must be scalable and support data collection in near real time. The company must store the data in Amazon S3 for future reporting. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to deliver streaming data to Amazon S3.
options.B: Use AWS Glue to deliver streaming data to Amazon S3.
options.C: Use AWS Lambda to deliver streaming data and store the data to Amazon S3.
options.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to deliver streaming data to Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to deliver streaming data to Amazon S3. 正确性分析：Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose是专门设计用于流数据的服务，支持高知吐量数据的实时处理和传输。它可以直接将数 据传输到Amazon S3，目无需复杂的配置，操作开销低。 优势：完全托管服务，支持自动扩展，目支持数据格式转换和压缩。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.B: Use AWS Glue to deliver streaming data to Amazon S3. 正确性分析：AWS Glue主要用于ETL（提取、转换、加载）任务，适合批量处理数据，而非实时流数据处理。 劣势：不适合高知吐量的实时数据流场景，目操作开销较高。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.C: Use AWS Lambda to deliver streaming data and store the data to Amazon S3. 正确性分析：AWS Lambda可以处理流数据，但需要额外的触发器（如Amazon Kinesis或Amazon SQS）来接收数据流。直接使用 Lambda处理高知吐量数据可能会导致性能瓶轛。 劣势：需要额外配置，目可能需要编写复杂的代码，操作开销较高。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to deliver streaming data to Amazon S3. 正确性分析：AWS DMS主要用于数据库迁移任务，不适合处理高知吐量的实时流数据。 劣势：不适合本题场景，目操作开销较高。 结论：此选项错误。
