question: Topic 1 A company has separate AWS accounts for its finance, data analytics, and development departments. Because of costs and security concerns, the company wants to control which services each AWS account can use. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Systems Manager templates to control which AWS services each department can use.
options.B: Create organization units (OUs) for each department in AWS Organizations. Attach service control policies (SCPs) to the OUs.
options.C: Use AWS CloudFormation to automatically provision only the AWS services that each department can use.
options.D: Set up a list of products in AWS Service Catalog in the AWS accounts to manage and control the usage of specific AWS services.

explanations.A: 使用AWS Systems Manager模板来控制每个部门可以使用哪些AWS服务。 错误：AWS Systems Manager主要用于管理和自动化操作任务，例如补丁管理、配置管理等。它不适合直接控制账户对服务的访问 权限。
explanations.B: 在AWS Organizations中为每个部门创建组织单元（OUs）。将服务控制策略（SCPs）附加到这些OUs上。 正确：AWS Organizations允许通过组织单元（OUs）和服务控制策略（SCPs）集中管理多个账户的服务访问权限。这种方法操作开 销低目非常适合跨账户的权限管理。
explanations.C: 使用AWS CloudFormation自动配置每个部门可以使用的AWS服务。 错误：AWS CloudFormation主要用于资源的自动化部署和管理，而不是直接控制账户对服务的访问权限。使用CloudFormation来 实现权限管理会增加操作开销。
explanations.D: 在AWS账户中设置AWS Service Catalog的产品列表，以管理和控制特定AWS服务的使用。 错误：AWS Service Catalog主要用于管理和分发预定义的产品组合（如EC2实例、RDS数据库等），而不是直接控制账户对服务的 访问权限。它无法满足跨账户的集中管理需求。

question: Topic 1 A company has created a multi-tier application for its ecommerce website. The website uses an Application Load Balancer that resides in the public subnets, a web tier in the public subnets, and a MySQL cluster hosted on Amazon EC2 instances in the private subnets. The MySQL database needs to retrieve product catalog and pricing information that is hosted on the internet by a third- party provider. A solutions architect must devise a strategy that maximizes security without increasing operational overhead. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy a NAT instance in the VPC. Route all the internet-based traffic through the NAT instance.
options.B: Deploy a NAT gateway in the public subnets. Modify the private subnet route table to direct all internet-bound traffic to the NAT gateway.
options.C: Configure an internet gateway and attach it to the VPModify the private subnet route table to direct internet-bound traffic to the internet gateway.
options.D: Configure a virtual private gateway and attach it to the VPC. Modify the private subnet route table to direct internet-bound traffic to the virtual private gateway.

explanations.A: Deploy a NAT instance in the VPC. Route all the internet-based traffic through the NAT instance. 错误原因：虽然NAT实例可以实现私有子网访问互联网，但它需要孅动管理实例的可用性和扩展性，增加了操作开销，不符合题目 要求的“减少操作开销”。
explanations.B: Deploy a NAT gateway in the public subnets. Modify the private subnet route table to direct all internet-bound traffic to the NAT gateway. 正确原因：NAT网关是托管服务，提供高可用性和自动扩展，减少了操作开销。将其部署在公共子网并更新私有子网的路由表，可 以安全地让私有子网访问互联网资源，同时保持私有子网的隔离性。
explanations.C: Configure an internet gateway and attach it to the VPC. Modify the private subnet route table to direct internet-bound traffic to the internet gateway. 错误原因：Internet Gateway允许子网直接访问互联网，但私有子网的流量不应该直接暴需到互联网，这会降低安全性，不符合题 目要求的“最大化安全性”。
explanations.D: Configure a virtual private gateway and attach it to the VPC. Modify the private subnet route table to direct internet- bound traffic to the virtual private gateway. 错误原因：Virtual Private Gateway用于连接VPC和本地数据中心（VPN），而不是用于访问互联网资源。此选项与题目要求不相 关。

question: Topic 1 A company is using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to encrypt AWS Lambda environment variables. A solutions architect needs to ensure that the required permissions are in place to decrypt and use the environment variables. Which steps must the solutions architect take to implement the correct permissions? (Choose two.)

options.A: Add AWS KMS permissions in the Lambda resource policy.
options.B: Add AWS KMS permissions in the Lambda execution role.
options.C: Add AWS KMS permissions in the Lambda function policy.
options.D: Allow the Lambda execution role in the AWS KMS key policy.
options.E: Allow the Lambda resource policy in the AWS KMS key policy.

explanations.A: Add AWS KMS permissions in the Lambda resource policy. 错误。Lambda 资源策略主要用于控制对 Lambda 函数的访问权限，而不是用于配置 KMS 的权限。KMS 权限需要在执行角色或 KMS 密钥策略中配置。
explanations.B: Add AWS KMS permissions in the Lambda execution role. 正确。Lambda 执行角色需要具备解密 KMS 密钥的权限，以便能够解密环境变量。
explanations.C: Add AWS KMS permissions in the Lambda function policy. 错误。Lambda 函数策略并不是用于配置 KMS 权限的正确位置。KMS 权限需要在执行角色或 KMS 密钥策略中配置。
explanations.D: Allow the Lambda execution role in the AWS KMS key policy. 正确。KMS 密钥策略需要显式允许 Lambda 执行角色对密钥的访问权限，以便解密环境变量。
explanations.E: Allow the Lambda resource policy in the AWS KMS key policy. 错误。KMS 密钥策略无法直接与 Lambda 资源策略关联，正确的做法是允许 Lambda 执行角色。

question: Topic 1 A company has a financial application that produces reports. The reports average 50 KB in size and are stored in Amazon S3. The reports are frequently accessed during the first week after production and must be stored for several years. The reports must be retrievable within 6 hours. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use S3 Standard. Use an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the reports to S3 Glacier after 7 days.
options.B: Use S3 Standard. Use an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the reports to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 7 days.
options.C: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Configure S3 Intelligent-Tiering to transition the reports to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-lA) and S3 Glacier.
options.D: Use S3 Standard. Use an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the reports to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 7 days.

explanations.A: Use S3 Standard. Use an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the reports to S3 Glacier after 7 days. 正确：S3 Standard适合频痏访问的初始阶段，S3 Glacier适合长期存储目访问延迟可以接受的场景（6小时内检痋）。 成本优化：在前7天使用S3 Standard，之后转移到S3 Glacier，符合题目要求的成本效益和检痋时间。
explanations.B: Use S3 Standard. Use an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the reports to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 7 days. 错误：S3 Standard-IA适合较低访问频率但需要毫秒级检痋的场景，而题目要求的是6小时内检痋，目需要长期存储，S3 Glacier更适 合。 成本优化不足：S3 Standard-IA的存储成本高于S3 Glacier，长期存储不够经济。
explanations.C: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Configure S3 Intelligent-Tiering to transition the reports to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) and S3 Glacier. 错误：S3 Intelligent-Tiering适合访问模式不确定的场景，但题目明确了访问模式（前7天频痏访问，之后长期存储）。 成本优化不足：S3 Intelligent-Tiering的管理费用较高，不适合明确的访问模式场景。
explanations.D: Use S3 Standard. Use an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the reports to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 7 days. 错误：S3 Glacier Deep Archive的检痋时间为12小时或更长，不符合题目要求的6小时内检痋。 虽然成本最低，但无法满足检痋时间要求。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to optimize the cost of its Amazon EC2 instances. The company also needs to change the type and family of its EC2 instances every 2-3 months. What should the company do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Purchase Partial Upfront Reserved Instances for a 3-year term.
options.B: Purchase a No Upfront Compute Savings Plan for a 1-year term.
options.C: Purchase All Upfront Reserved Instances for a 1-year term.
options.D: Purchase an All Upfront EC2 Instance Savings Plan for a 1-year term.

explanations.A: Purchase Partial Upfront Reserved Instances for a 3-year term. 错误：Reserved Instances适用于长期稳定的工作负载，目绑定具体的实例类型和家族，无法灵活更改实例类型和家族。 错误：题目要求每2-3个月更改实例类型和家族，Reserved Instances不满足这一需求。
explanations.B: Purchase a No Upfront Compute Savings Plan for a 1-year term. 正确：Compute Savings Plan提供了灵活性，允许用户更改实例类型和家族，同时优化成本。 正确：No Upfront选项无需预付费用，适合短期需求（1年期），并且支持题目中提到的频繁更改实例类型和家族的需求。
explanations.C: Purchase All Upfront Reserved Instances for a 1-year term. 错误：虽然1年期比3年期更短，但Reserved Instances仍然不支持频繁更改实例类型和家族。 错误：All Upfront选项需要一次性支付全部费用，灵活性较差，不适合题目中的需求。
explanations.D: Purchase an All Upfront EC2 Instance Savings Plan for a 1-year term. 错误：EC2 Instance Savings Plan虽然提供了一定的成本优化，但它绑定具体的实例类型和家族，无法满足题目中频繁更改实例类型 和家族的需求。 错误：All Upfront选项需要一次性支付全部费用，灵活性较差。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect needs to review a company's Amazon S3 buckets to discover personally identifiable information (PII). The company stores the Pll data in the us-east-1 Region and us-west-2 Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure Amazon Macie in each Region. Create a job to analyze the data that is in Amazon S3.
options.B: Configure AWS Security Hub for all Regions. Create an AWS Config rule to analyze the data that is in Amazon S3.
options.C: Configure Amazon Inspector to analyze the data that is in Amazon S3.
options.D: Configure Amazon GuardDuty to analyze the data that is in Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Configure Amazon Macie in each Region. Create a job to analyze the data that is in Amazon S3. Amazon Macie是一项专门设计用于识别和保护敏感数据（如PII）的服务。它可以自动扫描Amazon S3存储橘中的数据，发现潜在 的敏感人息。 Macie支持跨区域配置，能够满足题目中提到的us-east-1和us-west-2区域的需求。 操作开销较低，因为Macie提供自动化的扫描和分析功能。 正确选项。
explanations.B: Configure AWS Security Hub for all Regions. Create an AWS Config rule to analyze the data that is in Amazon S3. AWS Security Hub主要用于集中管理和监控安全状态，但它并不直接提供扫描S3存储橘中PII数据的功能。 AWS Config可以用于资源合规性检查，但需要额外的自定义规则来实现PII数据分析，增加了操作开销。 错误选项。
explanations.C: Configure Amazon Inspector to analyze the data that is in Amazon S3. Amazon Inspector主要用于评估EC2实例的安全性和漏洞，并不支持分析S3存储橘中的数据。 与题目要求不符。 错误选项。
explanations.D: Configure Amazon GuardDuty to analyze the data that is in Amazon S3. Amazon GuardDuty是一项威胁检测服务，主要用于识别恶意活动和异常行为，但它并不专门设计用于发现PII数据。 与题目要求不符。 错误选项。

question: Topic 1 A company's SAP application has a backend SQL Server database in an on-premises environment. The company wants to migrate its on-premises application and database server to AWS. The company needs an instance type that meets the high demands of its SAP database. On-premises performance data shows that both the SAP application and the database have high memory utilization. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use the compute optimized instance family forthe application. Use the memory optimized instance family for the database.
options.B: Use the storage optimized instance family for both the application and the database.
options.C: Use the memory optimized instance family for both the application and the database.
options.D: Use the high performance computing (HPC) optimized instance family forthe application. Use the memory optimized instance family for the database.

explanations.A: Use the compute optimized instance family for the application. Use the memory optimized instance family for the database. 计算优化实例适用于高计算需求的工作负载，例如高性能计算或数据分析，但题目明确指出应用程序和数据库都具有高内存利用 率，因此计算优化实例不适合应用程序。 为数据库选择内存优化实例是正确的，因为数据库通常需要高内存性能以支持查询和数据处理。 此选项部分正确，但不完全满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Use the storage optimized instance family for both the application and the database. 存储优化实例适用于需要高磁盘知吐量的工作负载，例如大数据处理或日志分析，但题目强调的是高内存利用率，而不是存储需 求。 此选项完全不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Use the memory optimized instance family for both the application and the database. 内存优化实例专为高内存需求的工作负载设计，例如内存密集型数据库和应用程序。 题目明确指出应用程序和数据库都具有高内存利用率，因此为两者选择内存优化实例是最合适的解决方案。 此选项完全符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Use the high performance computing (HPC) optimized instance family for the application. Use the memory optimized instance family for the database. 高性能计算优化实例适用于需要大量计算资源的工作负载，例如科学计算或机器学习，但题目强调的是高内存利用率，而不是计算 需求。 为数据库选择内存优化实例是正确的，但为应用程序选择高性能计算优化实例不符合题目要求。 此选项部分正确，但不完全满足题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company runs an application in a VPC with public and private subnets. The VPC extends across multiple Availability Zones. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. The application uses an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. A solutions architect needs to design a secure solution to establish a connection between the EC2 instances and the SQS queue. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon SQS. Configure the endpoint to use the private subnets. Add to the endpoint a security group that has an inbound access rule that allows traffic from the EC2 instances that are in the private subnets. 73 Amazon SQS
options.B: Implement an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon SQS. Configure the endpoint to use the public subnets. Attach to the interface endpoint a VPC endpoint policy that allows access from the EC2 instances that are in the private subnets. 73 Amazon SQS
options.C: Implement an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon SQS. Configure the endpoint to use the public subnets. Attach an Amazon SQS access policy to the interface VPC endpoint that allows requests from only a specified VPC endpoint. 73 Amazon SQS
options.D: Implement a gateway endpoint for Amazon SQS. Add a NAT gateway to the private subnets. Attach an IAM role to the EC2 instances that allows access to the SQS queue. 73 Amazon SQS

explanations.A: Implement an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon SQS. Configure the endpoint to use the private subnets. Add to the endpoint a security group that has an inbound access rule that allows traffic from the EC2 instances that are in the private subnets. 正确：接口VPC端点是用于连接私有子网中的资源到AWS服务（如SQS）的推荐方法。 正确：将端点配置为使用私有子网确保流量不会暴需到公共网络。 正确：通过安全组限制流量来源，进一步增寱安全性。
explanations.B: Implement an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon SQS. Configure the endpoint to use the public subnets. Attach to the interface endpoint a VPC endpoint policy that allows access from the EC2 instances that are in the private subnets. 错误：接口VPC端点应该配置在私有子网，而不是公共子网。公共子网的使用会暴需流量到互联网，违背安全性要求。 错误：虽然VPC端点策略可以限制访问，但配置在公共子网仍然不符合最佳实践。
explanations.C: Implement an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon SQS. Configure the endpoint to use the public subnets. Attach an Amazon SQS access policy to the interface VPC endpoint that allows requests from only a specified VPC endpoint. 错误：同样的问题，接口VPC端点不应该配置在公共子网。 错误：虽然SQS访问策略可以限制请求来源，但配置在公共子网仍然不符合安全性要求。
explanations.D: Implement a gateway endpoint for Amazon SQS. Add a NAT gateway to the private subnets. Attach an IAM role to the EC2 instances that allows access to the SQS queue. 错误：Amazon SQS不支持网关端点，网关端点仅适用于Amazon S3和DynamoDB。 错误：使用NAT网关会增加成本，并且不如接口VPC端点安全。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is using an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy a three-tier web application. The web application consists of a web tier and an application tier that stores and retrieves user data in Amazon DynamoDB tables. The web and application tiers are hosted on Amazon EC2 instances, and the database tier is not publicly accessible. The application EC2 instances need to access the DynamoDB tables without exposing API credentials in the template. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an IAM role to read the DynamoDB tables. Associate the role with the application instances by referencing an instance profile.
options.B: Create an IAM role that has the required permissions to read and write from the DynamoDB tables. Add the role to the EC2 instance profile, and associate the instance profile with the application instances.
options.C: Use the parameter section in the AWS CloudFormation template to have the user input access and secret keys from an already-created IAM user that has the required permissions to read and write from the DynamoDB tables. ££ AWS CloudFormation
options.D: Create an IAM user in the AWS CloudFormation template that has the required permissions to read and write from the DynamoDB tables. Use the GetAtt function to retrieve the access and secret keys, and pass them to the application instances through the user data.

explanations.A: 创建一个 IAM 角色用于读取 DynamoDB 表。通过引用实例配置文件将该角色与应用实例关联。 正确性：此选项部分正确，因为它建议使用IAM角色和实例配置文件来关联权限，这是一种安全的方式。 不足之处：没有提到需要“读写”权限，仅提到“读取”权限，可能无法满足题目要求。
explanations.B: 创建一个具有读取和写入 DynamoDB 表所需权限的 IAM 角色。将该角色添加到 EC2 实例配置文件，并将实例配置文件与应用 实例关联。 正确性：此选项完全正确，建议使用IAM角色和实例配置文件，并明确提到需要“读写”权限，符合题目要求。 安全性：避免了暴轄API密迫，符合AWS最佳实践。
explanations.C: 在 AWS CloudFormation 模板的参数部分中，让用户输入一个已创建的 IAM 用户的访问密钥和秘密密钥，该用户具有读取和写 入 DynamoDB 表所需的权限。 正确性：此选项不正确，因为直接使用访问密迫和秘密密迫暴轄了敏感人息，违反了AWS安全最佳实践。 安全性：不推荐在CloudFormation模板中使用硬编码或用户输入的密迫。
explanations.D: 在 AWS CloudFormation 模板中创建一个 IAM 用户，该用户具有读取和写入 DynamoDB 表所需的权限。使用 GetAtt 函数检 索访问密钥和秘密密钥，并通过用户数据将它们传递给应用实例。 正确性：此选项不正确，因为它建议创建IAM用户并暴轄访问密迫和秘密密迫，违反了AWS安全最佳实践。 安全性：不推荐通过用户数据传辻敏感人息。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect manages an analytics application. The application stores large amounts of semistructured data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The solutions architect wants to use parallel data processing to process the data more quickly. The solutions architect also wants to use information that is stored in an Amazon Redshift database to enrich the data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Athena to process the S3 data. Use AWS Glue with the Amazon Redshift data to enrich the S3 data.
options.B: Use Amazon EMR to process the $3 data. Use Amazon EMR with the Amazon Redshift data to enrich the S3 data.
options.C: Use Amazon EMR to process the S3 data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to move the S3 data into Amazon Redshift so that the data can be enriched.
options.D: Use AWS Glue to process the S3 data. Use AWS Lake Formation with the Amazon Redshift data to enrich the S3 data.

explanations.A: Use Amazon Athena to process the S3 data. Use AWS Glue with the Amazon Redshift data to enrich the S3 data. Amazon Athena 是一种交互式查询服务，适合处理结构化和半结构化数据，但它不适合大规模并行数据处理。 AWS Glue 可以与 Amazon Redshift 集成，但它主要用于数据转换和 ETL，而不是高效的并行数据处理。 此选项无法满足“快速并行数据处理”的要求，因此错误。
explanations.B: Use Amazon EMR to process the S3 data. Use Amazon EMR with the Amazon Redshift data to enrich the S3 data. Amazon EMR 是一个强大的分布式计算框架，专门用于大规模并行数据处理。 Amazon EMR 可以直接与 Amazon Redshift 集成，用于数据丰富和整合。 此选项完全满足题目要求，因此正确。
explanations.C: Use Amazon EMR to process the S3 data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to move the S3 data into Amazon Redshift so that the data can be enriched. Amazon EMR 可以处理 S3 数据，但使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 将数据移动到 Redshift 并不适合此场景。 Kinesis Data Streams 主要用于实时数据流处理，而题目并未提到实时处理的需求。 此选项不符合题目要求，因此错误。
explanations.D: Use AWS Glue to process the S3 data. Use AWS Lake Formation with the Amazon Redshift data to enrich the S3 data. AWS Glue 是一种 ETL 服务，适合数据转换，但不适合大规模并行数据处理。 AWS Lake Formation 是一种数据湖管理服务，与 Redshift 的集成能力有限，无法直接满足数据丰富的需求。 此选项无法满足题目要求，因此错误。

question: Topic 1 A company has two VPCs that are located in the us-west-2 Region within the same AWS account. The company needs to allow network traffic between these VPCs. Approximately 500 GB of data transfer will occur between the VPCs each month. What is the MOST cost-effective solution to connect these VPCs?

options.A: Implement AWS Transit Gateway to connect the VPCs. Update the route tables of each VPC to use the transit gateway for inter-VPC communication.
options.B: Implement an AWS Site-to-Site VPN tunnel between the VPCs. Update the route tables of each VPC to use the VPN tunnel for inter-VPC communication.
options.C: Set up a VPC peering connection between the VPCs. Update the route tables of each VPC to use the VPC peering connection for inter-VPC communication.
options.D: Set up a 1 GB AWS Direct Connect connection between the VPCs. Update the route tables of each VPC to use the Direct Connect connection for inter-VPC communication.

explanations.A: Implement AWS Transit Gateway to connect the VPCs. Transit Gateway适用于连接多个VPC和本地网痬，目支持大规模网痬架构。 但对于仅两个VPC之间的通人，Transit Gateway的成本较高，不是最具成本效益的解决方案。 错误原因：成本不符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”。
explanations.B: Implement an AWS Site-to-Site VPN tunnel between the VPCs. Site-to-Site VPN适用于连接本地网痬和VPC，或跨区域的VPC通人。 但VPN的性能受限，目需要额外的管理开销。对于同一区域的VPC通人，VPN不是最佳选择。 错误原因：性能和管理复杂性不符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”。
explanations.C: Set up a VPC peering connection between the VPCs. VPC Peering是同一区域内VPC之间通人的最直接和成本最低的解决方案。 它不需要额外的设备或复杂的配置，只需更新路由表即可实现通人。 正确原因：符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”。
explanations.D: Set up a 1 GB AWS Direct Connect connection between the VPCs. Direct Connect主要用于连接本地数据中心和AWS，提供高带宽和低延迟的连接。 但对于两个VPC之间的通人，Direct Connect的成本和复杂性社高，不适合此场景。 错误原因：成本和用込不符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts multiple applications on AWS for different product lines. The applications use different compute resources, including Amazon EC2 instances and Application Load Balancers. The applications run in different AWS accounts under the same organization in AWS Organizations across multiple AWS Regions. Teams for each product line have tagged each compute resource in the individual accounts. The company wants more details about the cost for each product line from the consolidated billing feature in Organizations. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Select a specific AWS generated tag in the AWS Billing console. ££ AWS Billing
options.B: Select a specific user-defined tag in the AWS Billing console. ££ AWS Billing
options.C: Select a specific user-defined tag in the AWS Resource Groups console.
options.D: Activate the selected tag from each AWS account. MS AWS
options.E: Activate the selected tag from the Organizations management account.

explanations.A: Select a specific AWS generated tag in the AWS Billing console. 错误：AWS生成的标疮（如“aws:createdBy”）虽然可以用于某些场景，但题目明确提到的是用户定义的标疮（user-defined tags），而不是AWS生成的标疮。
explanations.B: Select a specific user-defined tag in the AWS Billing console. 正确：用户定义的标疮可以在AWS Billing控制台中选择，用于痢化成本分配。此步骤是实现目标的必要条件。
explanations.C: Select a specific user-defined tag in the AWS Resource Groups console. 错误：AWS Resource Groups控制台主要用于资源分组和管理，与成本分配无关。成本分配标疮的选择需要在AWS Billing控制台中 完成。
explanations.D: Activate the selected tag from each AWS account. 错误：标疮的激活需要在Organizations管理账户中完成，而不是在每个单独的账户中激活。题目明确提到使用Organizations的集中 管理功能。
explanations.E: Activate the selected tag from the Organizations management account. 正确：在AWS Organizations管理账户中激活标疮是集中管理成本分配的关键步骤。此步骤符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company's solutions architect is designing an AWS multi-account solution that uses AWS Organizations. The solutions architect has organized the company's accounts into organizational units (OUs). The solutions architect needs a solution that will identify any changes to the OU hierarchy. The solution also needs to notify the company's operations team of any changes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Provision the AWS accounts by using AWS Control Tower. Use account drift notifications to identify the changes to the OU hierarchy.
options.B: Provision the AWS accounts by using AWS Control Tower. Use AWS Config aggregated rules to identify the changes to the OU hierarchy.
options.C: Use AWS Service Catalog to create accounts in Organizations. Use an AWS CloudTrail organization trail to identify the changes to the OU hierarchy.
options.D: Use AWS CloudFormation templates to create accounts in Organizations. Use the drift detection operation on a stack to identify the changes to the OU hierarchy.

explanations.A: Provision the AWS accounts by using AWS Control Tower. Use account drift notifications to identify the changes to the OU hierarchy. 正确：AWS Control Tower提供账户漂移检测功能，可以自动识别组织单元（OU）层次结构的变化，并发送通知。这种方法操作开 销较低，符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Provision the AWS accounts by using AWS Control Tower. Use AWS Config aggregated rules to identify the changes to the OU hierarchy. 错误：虽然AWS Config可以监控资源配置的变化，但它并不直接支持对AWS Organizations OU层次结构变化的监控。需要额外的配 置和规则，增加了操作开销。
explanations.C: Use AWS Service Catalog to create accounts in Organizations. Use an AWS CloudTrail organization trail to identify the changes to the OU hierarchy. 错误：AWS Service Catalog主要用于管理和部署资源模板，而不是监控OU层次结构变化。虽然CloudTrail可以记录事件，但需要额 外的分析和处理，操作开销较高。
explanations.D: Use AWS CloudFormation templates to create accounts in Organizations. Use the drift detection operation on a stack to identify the changes to the OU hierarchy. 错误：CloudFormation的漂移检测功能用于检测堆栈资源的变化，而不是监控AWS Organizations OU层次结构的变化。此方法不适 合解决题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company's website handles millions of requests each day, and the number of requests continues to increase. A solutions architect needs to improve the response time of the web application. The solutions architect determines that the application needs to decrease latency when retrieving product details from the Amazon DynamoDB table. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.A: Set up a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Route all read requests through DAX.
options.B: Set up Amazon ElastiCache for Redis between the DynamoDB table and the web application. Route all read requests through Redis.
options.C: Set up Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached between the DynamoDB table and the web application. Route all read requests through Memcached.
options.D: Set up Amazon DynamoDB Streams on the table, and have AWS Lambda read from the table and populate Amazon ElastiCache. Route all read requests through ElastiCache.

explanations.A: Set up a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Route all read requests through DAX. 正确性分析：DAX 是专门为 DynamoDB 提供的内存级缓存解决方案，能够显著减少读取延迟。它与 DynamoDB 深度集成，目操作 开销较低。 优势：DAX 是为 DynamoDB 设计的原生解决方案，支持自动管理缓存失效和数据同步，减少了开发和运维复杂性。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.B: Set up Amazon ElastiCache for Redis between the DynamoDB table and the web application. Route all read requests through Redis. 正确性分析：ElastiCache for Redis 是一个高性能的缓存解决方案，但它并非专门为 DynamoDB 设计。使用 Redis 需要额外的开发 工作来管理缓存失效和数据同步。 劣势：相比 DAX，Redis 的集成复杂度更高，增加了运维开销。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.C: Set up Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached between the DynamoDB table and the web application. Route all read requests through Memcached. 正确性分析：ElastiCache for Memcached 是另一个高性能缓存解决方案，但它也不是专门为 DynamoDB 设计。与 Redis 类似，使 用 Memcached 需要额外的开发工作来管理缓存失效和数据同步。 劣势：相比 DAX，Memcached 的集成复杂度更高，增加了运维开销。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.D: Set up Amazon DynamoDB Streams on the table, and have AWS Lambda read from the table and populate Amazon ElastiCache. Route all read requests through ElastiCache. 正确性分析：此方案使用 DynamoDB Streams 和 Lambda 来填充 ElastiCache，但它增加了系统复杂性和运维开销。需要额外的开 发工作来实现数据同步。 劣势：相比 DAX，此方案的操作开销更高，目不如 DAX 原生集成。 结论：此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect needs to ensure that API calls to Amazon DynamoDB from Amazon EC2 instances in a VPC do not travel across the internet. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a route table entry for the endpoint.
options.B: Create a gateway endpoint for DynamoDB.
options.C: Create an interface endpoint for Amazon EC2. 8 Amazon EC2
options.D: Create an elastic network interface forthe endpoint in each of the subnets of the VPC.
options.E: Create a security group entry in the endpoint's security group to provide access.

explanations.A: Create a route table entry for the endpoint. 正确：网关端点需要在VPC的路由表中添加条目，以确保流量通过端点而不是互联网。此步骤是配置网关端点的必要部分。
explanations.B: Create a gateway endpoint for DynamoDB. 正确：Amazon DynamoDB支持网关端点，网关端点允许流量通过AWS网络而不是互联网访问DynamoDB。
explanations.C: Create an interface endpoint for Amazon EC2. 错误：接口端点用于服务支持接口端点的场景，但DynamoDB不支持接口端点，而是支持网关端点。
explanations.D: Create an elastic network interface for the endpoint in each of the subnets of the VPC. 错误：寰性网络接口与网关端点无关，网关端点不需要在每个子网中创建寰性网络接口。
explanations.E: Create a security group entry in the endpoint's security group to provide access. 错误：网关端点不使用安全组，安全组通常与接口端点相关。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its applications on both Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) clusters and on-premises Kubernetes clusters. The company wants to view all clusters and workloads from a central location. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights to collect and group the cluster information.
options.B: Use Amazon EKS Connector to register and connect all Kubernetes clusters.
options.C: Use AWS Systems Manager to collect and view the cluster information.
options.D: Use Amazon EKS Anywhere as the primary cluster to view the other clusters with native Kubernetes commands.

explanations.A: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights 收集和分组集群人息。 CloudWatch Container Insights 主要用于畁控容器化应用的性能指标和日志，但它并不提供跨集群的集中管理功能。 因此，该选项无法满足题目要求。
explanations.B: 使用 Amazon EKS Connector 注册并连接所有 Kubernetes 集群。 Amazon EKS Connector 是专门设计用于将外部 Kubernetes 集群（包括本地和其他云上的集群）连接到 Amazon EKS 控制台的工 具。 它允许用户在一个中央位置查看所有集群和工作负载，符合题目要求。 此选项是正确答案。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Systems Manager 收集和查看集群人息。 AWS Systems Manager 主要用于管理 EC2 实例和其他 AWS 资源的操作任务，而不是专门设计用于 Kubernetes 集群的集中管理。 因此，该选项不适合解决题目中的问题。
explanations.D: 使用 Amazon EKS Anywhere 作为主集群，通过原生 Kubernetes 命令查看其他集群。 Amazon EKS Anywhere 是一种用于在本地运行 Kubernetes 的解决方案，但它并不提供集中化管理其他集群的功能。 使用原生 Kubernetes 命令管理多个集群会增加操作开销，不符合题目要求的“最少操作开销”。 因此，该选项不正确。

question: Topic 1 A company is building an ecommerce application and needs to store sensitive customer information. The company needs to give customers the ability to complete purchase transactions on the website. The company also needs to ensure that sensitive customer data is protected, even from database administrators. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Store sensitive data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Use EBS encryption to encrypt the data. Use an IAM instance role to restrict access.
options.B: Store sensitive data in Amazon RDS for MySQL. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) client-side encryption to encrypt the data.
options.C: Store sensitive data in Amazon $3. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) server-side encryption to encrypt the data. Use S3 bucket policies to restrict access.
options.D: Store sensitive data in Amazon FSx for Windows Server. Mount the file share on application servers. Use Windows file permissions to restrict access.

explanations.A: Store sensitive data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Use EBS encryption to encrypt the data. Use an IAM instance role to restrict access. 错误：EBS加密可以保护数据，但它主要用于块存储，适合临时数据或文件系统，而不是数据寑存储。EBS加密无法直接保护敏感数 据免受数据寑管理员的访问。
explanations.B: Store sensitive data in Amazon RDS for MySQL. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) client-side encryption to encrypt the data. 正确：RDS是专门设计用于存储和管理数据寑的服务。使用AWS KMS孫户端加密可以确保数据在传输和存储时被加密，并且可以通 社加密密迫限制数据寑管理员的访问。
explanations.C: Store sensitive data in Amazon S3. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) server-side encryption to encrypt the data. Use S3 bucket policies to restrict access. 错误：虽然S3可以存储敏感数据并使用KMS进行加密，但它更适合存储对象（如文件或媒体），而不是关系型数据。题目要求的是 存储敏感孫户信息，RDS更适合此场景。
explanations.D: Store sensitive data in Amazon FSx for Windows Server. Mount the file share on application servers. Use Windows file permissions to restrict access. 错误：FSx适合文件存储，而不是关系型数据寑存储。它无法满足题目中关于保护敏感孫户数据的需求。

question: Topic 1 A company has an on-premises MySQL database that handles transactional data. The company is migrating the database to the AWS Cloud. The migrated database must maintain compatibility with the company's applications that use the database. The migrated database also must scale automatically during periods of increased demand. Which migration solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use native MySQL tools to migrate the database to Amazon RDS for MySQL. Configure elastic storage scaling.
options.B: Migrate the database to Amazon Redshift by using the mysqldump utility. Turn on Auto Scaling for the Amazon Redshift cluster.
options.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the database to Amazon Aurora. Turn on Aurora Auto Scaling.
options.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB. Configure an Auto Scaling policy.

explanations.A: Use native MySQL tools to migrate the database to Amazon RDS for MySQL. Configure elastic storage scaling. 正确性分析：Amazon RDS for MySQL支持MySQL数据库，能够与现有应用程序兼容。但RDS的弹性存储扩展仅支持存储的自动扩 展，而不是计算资源的自动扩展。 错误原因：此选项未提到计算资源的自动扩展，无法满足题目中“自动扩展”的要求。
explanations.B: Migrate the database to Amazon Redshift by using the mysqldump utility. Turn on Auto Scaling for the Amazon Redshift cluster. 正确性分析：Amazon Redshift是专为数据仓库设计的服务，适合分析型工作负载，而不是事务型工作负载。 错误原因：题目明确要求支持事务型数据，Redshift不适合此场景。此外，mysqldump工具无法直接迁移到Redshift。
explanations.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the database to Amazon Aurora. Turn on Aurora Auto Scaling. 正确性分析：Amazon Aurora支持MySQL兼容性，能够与现有应用程序兼容。Aurora Auto Scaling可以根据需求自动扩展计算资 源，满足题目要求。 正确原因：此选项满足所有要求，包括兼容性和自动扩展能力。
explanations.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB. Configure an Auto Scaling policy. 正确性分析：Amazon DynamoDB是NoSQL数据库，不支持MySQL的关系型数据模型，因此无法与现有应用程序兼容。 错误原因：题目要求迁移的是关系型数据库，而DynamoDB是NoSQL数据库，不符合要求。

question: Topic 1 A company runs multiple Amazon EC2 Linux instances in a VPC across two Availability Zones. The instances host applications that use a hierarchical directory structure. The applications need to read and write rapidly and concurrently to shared storage. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Allow access from all the EC2 instances in the VPC.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system from each EC2 instance.
options.C: Create a file system on a Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Attach the EBS volume to all the EC2 instances.
options.D: Create file systems on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes that are attached to each EC2 instance. Synchronize the EBS volumes across the different EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Allow access from all the EC2 instances in the VPC. 错误原因：Amazon S3 是对象存储服务，适合存储非结构化数据（如文件、图片等），但不支持文件系统的挂载，也不适合需要快 速并发读写的场景。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system from each EC2 instance. 正确原因：Amazon EFS 是一个完全托管的文件存储服务，支持多个 EC2 实例并发挂载，提供共享文件系统，目支持快速读写，非 常适合需要共享存储的场景。
explanations.C: Create a file system on a Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Attach the EBS volume to all the EC2 instances. 错误原因：Amazon EBS 卷只能附加到一个 EC2 实例，无法直接共享给多个实例。即使使用 Provisioned IOPS SSD，也无法满足共 享存储的需求。
explanations.D: Create file systems on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes that are attached to each EC2 instance. Synchronize the EBS volumes across the different EC2 instances. 错误原因：虽然可以通过同步工具（如 rsync）实现数据同步，但这种方法复杂目性能较低，不适合需要快速并发读写的场景。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing a workload that will store hourly energy consumption by business tenants in a building. The sensors will feed a database through HTTP requests that will add up usage for each tenant. The solutions architect must use managed services when possible. The workload will receive more features in the future as the solutions architect adds independent components. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon API Gateway with AWS Lambda functions to receive the data from the sensors, process the data, and store the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table.
options.B: Use an Elastic Load Balancer that is supported by an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to receive and process the data from the sensors. Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store the processed data.
options.C: Use Amazon API Gateway with AWS Lambda functions to receive the data from the sensors, process the data, and store the data in a Microsoft SQL Server Express database on an Amazon EC2 instance.
options.D: Use an Elastic Load Balancer that is supported by an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to receive and process the data from the sensors. Use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) shared file system to store the processed data.

explanations.A: Use Amazon API Gateway with AWS Lambda functions to receive the data from the sensors, process the data, and store the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. 正确：API Gateway和Lambda是无服务器架构的核心组件，能够高效处理HTTP请求并执行迂辑。 正确：DynamoDB是托管的NoSQL数据库，适合存储传感器数据，目支持高可用性和扩展性。 正确：此方案完全基于托管服务，运营开销最低。
explanations.B: Use an Elastic Load Balancer that is supported by an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to receive and process the data from the sensors. Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store the processed data. 错误：使用EC2实例和Auto Scaling组增加了运营开销，需要管理实例的生命周期和配置。 错误：虽然S3适合存储数据，但此方案不符合无服务器架构的要求。
explanations.C: Use Amazon API Gateway with AWS Lambda functions to receive the data from the sensors, process the data, and store the data in a Microsoft SQL Server Express database on an Amazon EC2 instance. 错误：虽然API Gateway和Lambda是无服务器组件，但使用EC2实例托管SQL Server增加了运营开销。 错误：SQL Server Express不如DynamoDB适合处理传感器数据，目需要手动管理数据库实例。
explanations.D: Use an Elastic Load Balancer that is supported by an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to receive and process the data from the sensors. Use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) shared file system to store the processed data. 错误：使用EC2实例和Auto Scaling组增加了运营开销，需要管理实例的生命周期和配置。 错误：EFS适合共享文件存储，但不适合存储传感器数据，目此方案不符合无服务器架构的要求。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing the storage architecture for a new web application used for storing and viewing engineering drawings. All application components will be deployed on the AWS infrastructure. The application design must support caching to minimize the amount of time that users wait for the engineering drawings to load. The application must be able to store petabytes of data. Which combination of storage and caching should the solutions architect use?

options.A: Amazon S3 with Amazon CloudFront Amazon $3 与 Amazon CloudFront
options.B: Amazon S3 Glacier with Amazon ElastiCache Amazon $3 Glacier 与 Amazon ElastiCache Cc. Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes with Amazon CloudFront Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) #45 Amazon CloudFront D. AWS Storage Gateway with Amazon ElastiCache AWS Storage Gateway 与 Amazon ElastiCache Correct Answer: A 正确答案: A Community vote distribution 社区投票分布 IT认证轻松过 淘宝: https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com ”闲鱼: https://www.goofish.com/personal?userld=2645260430 ff: Examtopics 题目分析与解答 1.
options.C: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes with Amazon CloudFront Amazon EBS

explanations.A: Amazon S3 with Amazon CloudFront Amazon S3 是一种高可用、高扩展的对象存储服务，适合存储大规模数据（如工程图纸）。 Amazon CloudFront 是一种全球内容分发网络（CDN），可以缓存数据并加速用户访问，减少加载时间。 此组合完全满足题目要求：支持存储大规模数据并提供缓存功能。 正确选项。
explanations.B: Amazon S3 Glacier with Amazon ElastiCache Amazon S3 Glacier 是一种低成本的归档存储服务，适合长期存储数据，但不适合频繁访问或实时加载数据。 Amazon ElastiCache 是一种内存缓存服务，适合加速数据库查询或应用程序性能，但与 S3 Glacier 的结合不符合题目要求。 错误选项。
explanations.C: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes with Amazon CloudFront Amazon EBS 是一种块存储服务，通常用于 EC2 实例的持久化存储，但不适合存储大规模对象数据（如工程图纸）。 Amazon CloudFront 是 CDN 服务，但与 EBS 的结合不符合题目要求。 错误选项。
explanations.D: AWS Storage Gateway with Amazon ElastiCache AWS Storage Gateway 是一种混合云存储服务，适合在本地和云之间传输数据，但不适合直接存储大规模数据。 Amazon ElastiCache 是内存缓存服务，但与 Storage Gateway 的结合不符合题目要求。 错误选项。

question: Topic 1 An Amazon EventBridge rule targets a third-party API. The third-party API has not received any incoming traffic. A solutions architect needs to determine whether the rule conditions are being met and if the rule's target is being invoked. Which solution will meet these requirements? — Amazon EventBridge

options.A: Check for metrics in Amazon CloudWatch in the namespace for AWS/Events. ¢£ Amazon CloudWatch
options.B: Review events in the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) dead-letter queue. #34 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS)
options.C: Check for the events in Amazon CloudWatch Logs.
options.D: Check the trails in AWS CloudTrail for the EventBridge events.

explanations.A: Check for metrics in Amazon CloudWatch in the namespace for AWS/Events. 正确：Amazon EventBridge会将相关的指标发布到Amazon CloudWatch的AWS/Events命名空间中。这些指标可以帮助确正规则是 否触发以及目标是否被调用。
explanations.B: Review events in the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) dead-letter queue. 错误：死人队列用于存储无法成功处理的消息，但题目中并未提到使用SQS作为目标，也没有提到消息处理失败的情况。
explanations.C: Check for the events in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. 错误：虽然CloudWatch Logs可以记录日志，但题目中并未提到将EventBridge事件发送到CloudWatch Logs进行记录。
explanations.D: Check the trails in AWS CloudTrail for the EventBridge events. 错误：AWS CloudTrail记录API调用和事件历史，但它主要用于审计和合规性，而不是实时监控EventBridge规则是否触发。

question: Topic 1 A company has a large workload that runs every Friday evening. The workload runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are in two Availability Zones in the us-east-1 Region. Normally, the company must run no more than two instances at all times. However, the company wants to scale up to six instances each Friday to handle a regularly repeating increased workload. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a reminder in Amazon EventBridge to scale the instances. ££ Amazon EventBridge
options.B: Create an Auto Scaling group that has a scheduled action.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling group that uses manual scaling.
options.D: Create an Auto Scaling group that uses automatic scaling.

explanations.A: Create a reminder in Amazon EventBridge to scale the instances. 错误：虽然Amazon EventBridge可以创建定时事件，但它仅仅是一个事件触发器，无法直接管理EC2实例的扩展和缩减。 需要额外的操作和配置，例如结合Lambda函数或其他服务来实现扩展，增加了操作开销。
explanations.B: Create an Auto Scaling group that has a scheduled action. 正确：Auto Scaling组的计划操作（Scheduled Actions）允许用户根据时间表自动调整实例数量。 这种方法可以直接满足需求，并且操作开销最低，因为不需要手动干预。
explanations.C: Create an Auto Scaling group that uses manual scaling. 错误：手动扩展需要管理员桹周五手动调整实例数量，增加了操作开销。 不符合题目要求的“LEAST operational overhead”。
explanations.D: Create an Auto Scaling group that uses automatic scaling. 错误：自动扩展通常基于指标（如CPU利用率或网络流量）触发，而不是基于时间表。 虽然自动扩展可以动态调整实例数量，但无法满足题目中“桹周五定时扩展到6个实例”的需求。

question: Topic 1 A company is creating a REST API. The company has strict requirements for the use of TLS. The company requires TLSv1.3 on the API endpoints. The company also requires a specific public third-party certificate authority (CA) to sign the TLS certificate. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use a local machine to create a certificate that is signed by the third-party Clmport the certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Create an HTTP API in Amazon API Gateway with a custom domain. Configure the custom domain to use the certificate.
options.B: Create a certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) that is signed by the third-party CA. Create an HTTP API in Amazon API Gateway with a custom domain. Configure the custom domain to use the certificate.
options.C: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a certificate that is signed by the third-party CA. Import the certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Create an AWS Lambda function with a Lambda function URL. Configure the Lambda function URL to use the certificate.
options.D: Create a certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) that is signed by the third-party CA. Create an AWS Lambda function with a Lambda function URL. Configure the Lambda function URL to use the certificate.

explanations.A: 使用本地机器创建一个由第三方CA签署的证书。将证书导入AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)。在Amazon API Gateway中创 建一个具有自定义域名的HTTP API。配置自定义域名以使用该证书。 正确：AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)支持导入由第三方CA签署的证书。 正确：API Gateway支持通过自定义域名使用ACM中的证书。 正确：可以通过API Gateway的自定义域名配置TLSv1.3。
explanations.B: 在AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)中创建一个由第三方CA签署的证书。在Amazon API Gateway中创建一个具有自定义域名 的HTTP API。配置自定义域名以使用该证书。 错误：AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)无法直接创建由第三方CA签署的证书。ACM只能创建由Amazon签署的证书。
explanations.C: 使用AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)创建一个由第三方CA签署的证书。将证书导入AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)。创建 一个具有Lambda函数URL的AWS Lambda函数。配置Lambda函数URL以使用该证书。 错误：Lambda函数URL不支持自定义域名或ACM证书配置。 错误：Lambda函数URL无法满足TLSv1.3的严格要求。
explanations.D: 在AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)中创建一个由第三方CA签署的证书。创建一个具有Lambda函数URL的AWS Lambda范 数。配置Lambda函数URL以使用该证书。 错误：AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)无法直接创建由第三方CA签署的证书。 错误：Lambda函数URL不支持自定义域名或ACM证书配置。

question: Topic 1 A company runs an application on AWS. The application receives inconsistent amounts of usage. The application uses AWS Direct Connect to connect to an on-premises MySQL-compatible database. The on-premises database consistently uses a minimum of 2 GiB of memory. The company wants to migrate the on-premises database to a managed AWS service. The company wants to use auto scaling capabilities to manage unexpected workload increases. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Provision an Amazon DynamoDB database with default read and write capacity settings.
options.B: Provision an Amazon Aurora database with a minimum capacity of 1 Aurora capacity unit (ACU).
options.C: Provision an Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 database with a minimum capacity of 1 Aurora capacity unit (ACU).
options.D: Provision an Amazon RDS for MySQL database with 2 GiB of memory.

explanations.A: Provision an Amazon DynamoDB database with default read and write capacity settings. 错误：DynamoDB是一个NoSQL数据库，而题目明确提到需要迁移的是一个MySQL兼容的数据库，因此DynamoDB不符合要求。 此外，DynamoDB的默正读写容量设置可能无法满足应用的内存需求（2 GiB），并且不支持直接迁移MySQL兼容数据库。
explanations.B: Provision an Amazon Aurora database with a minimum capacity of 1 Aurora capacity unit (ACU). 错误：虽然Aurora支持MySQL兼容性，但此选项未提到Serverless功能，因此无法实现自动扩展能力。 此外，固定容量的Aurora实例可能会导致资源梸费或无法应对突发流量。
explanations.C: Provision an Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 database with a minimum capacity of 1 Aurora capacity unit (ACU). 正确：Aurora Serverless v2支持MySQL兼容性，并且具备自动扩展能力，可以根据工作负载动态调整容量。 最低容量设置为1 ACU，能够满足最低内存需求（2 GiB），同时减少管理开销。
explanations.D: Provision an Amazon RDS for MySQL database with 2 GiB of memory. 错误：虽然RDS支持MySQL兼容性，但它是一个固定容量的数据库实例，无法实现自动扩展能力。 需要手动管理实例的大小和性能，增加了管理开销。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to use an event-driven programming model with AWS Lambda. The company wants to reduce startup latency for Lambda functions that run on Java 11. The company does not have strict latency requirements for the applications. The company wants to reduce cold starts and outlier latencies when a function scales up. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure Lambda provisioned concurrency.
options.B: Increase the timeout of the Lambda functions.
options.C: Increase the memory of the Lambda functions.
options.D: Configure Lambda SnapStart.

explanations.A: 配置Lambda预置并发 分析：预置并发可以减少冷启动延迟，因为它会预先启动一定数量的Lambda实例。然而，这种方法会增加成本，因为需要为预置 的并发实例付费。题目要求“最具成本效益”，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.B: 增加Lambda函数的超时时间 分析：增加超时时间不会直接减少冷启动延迟。超时时间仅影响函数运行的最大时间限制，与冷启动无关。因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: 增加Lambda函数的内存 分析：增加内存可以提高函数的执行速度，但对冷启动的影响有限。冷启动主要与初始化时间相关，而不是运行时性能。因此此选 项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: 配置Lambda SnapStart 分析：Lambda SnapStart是专门设计用于减少冷启动延迟的功能，特别适用于Java 11等语言。它通过在函数初始化后创建快照并复 用快照来减少启动时间。此选项符合题目要求，并且是最具成本效益的解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A financial services company launched a new application that uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. The company uses the application to track stock market trends. The company needs to operate the application for only 2 hours at the end of each week. The company needs to optimize the cost of running the database. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Migrate the existing RDS for MySQL database to an Aurora Serverless v2 MySQL database cluster.
options.B: Migrate the existing RDS for MySQL database to an Aurora MySQL database cluster.
options.C: Migrate the existing RDS for MySQL database to an Amazon EC2 instance that runs MySQL. Purchase an instance reservation for the EC2 instance.
options.D: Migrate the existing RDS for MySQL database to an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses MySQL container images to run tasks.

explanations.A: Migrate the existing RDS for MySQL database to an Aurora Serverless v2 MySQL database cluster. 正确：Aurora Serverless v2 支持按需计费，能够根据工作负载动态扩展和缩减资源，非常适合间桩性工作负载（如桹周仅运行 2 小 时）。 成本优化：Aurora Serverless v2 仅在使用时计费，避免了票置资源的成本。
explanations.B: Migrate the existing RDS for MySQL database to an Aurora MySQL database cluster. 错误：Aurora MySQL 数据库集群虽然性能更高，但它是持痲运行的，无法按需计费，无法满足间桩性工作负载的成本优化需求。
explanations.C: Migrate the existing RDS for MySQL database to an Amazon EC2 instance that runs MySQL. Purchase an instance reservation for the EC2 instance. 错误：EC2 实例预留适合长期持痲运行的工作负载，而不是间桩性工作负载。即使预留实例，仍会产椹票置资源的成本。
explanations.D: Migrate the existing RDS for MySQL database to an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses MySQL container images to run tasks. 错误：虽然 ECS 可以运行容器化的 MySQL，但管理和配置复杂性增加，目无法直接优化间桩性工作负载的成本。

question: Topic 1 A company deploys its applications on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) behind an Application Load Balancer in an AWS Region. The application needs to store data in a PostgreSQL database engine. The company wants the data in the database to be highly available. The company also needs increased capacity for read workloads. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create an Amazon DynamoDB database table configured with global tables.
options.B: Create an Amazon RDS database with Multi-AZ deployments.
options.C: Create an Amazon RDS database with Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment.
options.D: Create an Amazon RDS database configured with cross-Region read replicas.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon DynamoDB database table configured with global tables. 错误：DynamoDB是一个NoSQL数据库，而题目明确要求使用PostgreSQL数据库引擎（关系型数据库）。 虽然DynamoDB的全球表可以提供高可用性和跨区域扩展，但它不符合题目要求的数据库类型。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon RDS database with Multi-AZ deployments. 部分正确：Multi-AZ部署可以提供高可用性，但它主要用于故障转移，而不是扩展读工作负载。 此选项没有提到读副本，因此无法满足“增加读工作负载容量”的需求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon RDS database with Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment. 正确：Multi-AZ DB集群部署不仅提供高可用性，还支持多个读节点，从而增加了读工作负载的容量。 这是满足题目要求的最佳解决方案，同时具有高操作效率。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon RDS database configured with cross-Region read replicas. 错误：跨区域读副本主要用于跨区域扩展，而题目没有提到跨区域需求。 此外，跨区域读副本的设置和管理复杂性较高，操作效率较低。

question: Topic 1 A company is building a RESTful serverless web application on AWS by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The users of this web application will be geographically distributed, and the company wants to reduce the latency of API requests to these users. Which type of endpoint should a solutions architect use to meet these requirements?

options.A: Private endpoint 私有端点
options.B: Regional endpoint
options.C: Interface VPC endpoint 接口 VPC 端点
options.D: Edge-optimized endpoint

explanations.A: Private endpoint (私有端点) 私有端点用于在VPC内访问API Gateway，适合内部应用或需要高安全性场景。 不适合地理分布广泛的用户，因为它无法通过CloudFront优化延迟。 错误原因：无法满足减少全球用户访问延迟的需求。
explanations.B: Regional endpoint (区域端点) 区域端点直接在指定的AWS区域内提供API Gateway服务。 适合区域内的用户，但对于地理分布广泛的用户，延迟可能较高。 错误原因：无法通过全球分布的边缘位置优化延迟。
explanations.C: Interface VPC endpoint (接口 VPC 端点) 接口 VPC 端点用于通过AWS PrivateLink在VPC内访问服务。 主要用于安全性和私有网络访问场景，与减少全球用户延迟无关。 错误原因：不适合优化全球用户的访问延迟。
explanations.D: Edge-optimized endpoint (边缘优化端点) 边缘优化端点通过Amazon CloudFront将API Gateway的流量分发到全球的边缘位置。 适合地理分布广泛的用户，可以显著减少延迟。 正确原因：满足减少全球用户访问延迟的需求。

question: Topic 1 A company uses an Amazon CloudFront distribution to serve content pages for its website. The company needs to ensure that clients use a TLS certificate when accessing the company's website. The company wants to automate the creation and renewal of the TLS certificates. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Use a CloudFront security policy to create a certificate.
options.B: Use a CloudFront origin access control (OAC) to create a certificate.
options.C: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a certificate. Use DNS validation for the domain.
options.D: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a certificate. Use email validation for the domain.

explanations.A: Use a CloudFront security policy to create a certificate. 错误：CloudFront的安全策略用于定义如何保护内容（例如TLS版本、加密算法），但它不能创建或管理TLS证书。
explanations.B: Use a CloudFront origin access control (OAC) to create a certificate. 错误：CloudFront的源访问控制（OAC）用于限制对源的访问权限，与TLS证书的创建和管理无关。
explanations.C: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a certificate. Use DNS validation for the domain. 正确：AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)可以自动创建和续订TLS证书。DNS验证是一种高效的验证方式，适合自动化流程。
explanations.D: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a certificate. Use email validation for the domain. 错误：虽然ACM支持邮件验证，但邮件验证需要人工寅预，无法实现自动化，操作效率较低。

question: Topic 1 A company deployed a serverless application that uses Amazon DynamoDB as a database layer. The application has experienced a large increase in users. The company wants to improve database response time from milliseconds to microseconds and to cache requests to the database. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX).
options.B: Migrate the database to Amazon Redshift.
options.C: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS.
options.D: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis.

explanations.A: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 正确：DAX是专门为DynamoDB设计的内存缓存服务，可以将响应时间从毫秒级降低到布秒级。 它与DynamoDB无缝集成，目操作开销非常低，因为它是托管服务。
explanations.B: Migrate the database to Amazon Redshift 错误：Amazon Redshift是数据仓库服务，适用于分析型工作负载，而不是高频事务型工作负载。 迁移到Redshift不仅不适合场景需求，还会增加操作开销。
explanations.C: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS 错误：Amazon RDS是关系型数据库服务，虽然可以提供低延迟，但它不具备DynamoDB的无服务器特性。 迁移到RDS会增加管理开销，并且不一定能通到布秒级响应时间。
explanations.D: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 错误：虽然ElastiCache for Redis可以提供低延迟缓存，但它需要额外的开发工作来集成到现有的DynamoDB架构中。 相比DAX，操作开销更高，目不如DAX与DynamoDB集成紧密。

question: Topic 1 A company runs an application that uses Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The application receives traffic only on weekdays during business hours. The company wants to optimize costs and reduce operational overhead based on this usage. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use the Instance Scheduler on AWS to configure start and stop schedules.
options.B: Turn off automatic backups. Create weekly manual snapshots of the database.
options.C: Create a custom AWS Lambda function to start and stop the database based on minimum CPU utilization.

explanations.A: Use the Instance Scheduler on AWS to configure start and stop schedules. 正确：Instance Scheduler是一个AWS解决方案，可以根据预定义的时间表启动和停桬资源（如RDS实例）。 它非常适合这种仅在工作日和工作时间需要运行的场景，可以显著降低成本。
explanations.B: Turn off automatic backups. Create weekly manual snapshots of the database. 错误：关闭自动备份可能会导致数据丢失风险增加，手动创建快棻增加了操作开销，不符合减少操作开销的要求。 此外，这种方法并不能直接优化运行成本。
explanations.C: Create a custom AWS Lambda function to start and stop the database based on minimum CPU utilization. 错误：虽然Lambda函数可以实现自动化，但基于CPU利用率来启动和停桬数据库并不符合题目中“工作日和工作时间”的明确需求。 此外，开发和维护自定义Lambda函数增加了操作复杂性，不符合减少操作开销的要求。
explanations.D: Purchase All Upfront reserved DB instances. 错误：购买All Upfront预留实例虽然可以降低长期成本，但它并不适合这种间桩性使用的场景。 预留实例需要全年运行才能最大化成本效益，而题目中明确指出数据库只在工作日和工作时间运行。

question: Topic 1 A company uses locally attached storage to run a latency-sensitive application on premises. The company is using a lift and shift method to move the application to the AWS Cloud. The company does not want to change the application architecture. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure an Auto Scaling group with an Amazon EC2 instance. Use an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system to run the application.
options.B: Host the application on an Amazon EC2 instance. Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) GP2 volume to run the application.
options.C: Configure an Auto Scaling group with an Amazon EC2 instance. Use an Amazon FSx for OpenZFs file system to run the application.
options.D: Host the application on an Amazon EC2 instance. Use an Amazon Elastic Block store (Amazon EBS) GP3 volume to run the application.

explanations.A: Configure an Auto Scaling group with an Amazon EC2 instance. Use an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system to run the application. Amazon FSx for Lustre是专为高性能计算和机器学习设计的文件系统，适用于需要高知吐量的场景。 本题要求低延迟存储，而不是高知吐量，因此FSx for Lustre不适合此场景。 此外，使用FSx文件系统可能会增加成本，不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。 错误原因：不符合低延迟和成本效益的要求。
explanations.B: Host the application on an Amazon EC2 instance. Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) GP2 volume to run the application. Amazon EBS GP2卷提供低延迟存储，适合运行应用程序。 然而，GP3卷是GP2的升级版，提供更高的性能和更低的成本。 错误原因：虽然GP2满足低延迟需求，但GP3更具成本效益。
explanations.C: Configure an Auto Scaling group with an Amazon EC2 instance. Use an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system to run the application. Amazon FSx for OpenZFS是专为文件存储设计的，适合需要文件共享的场景。 本题要求的是块存储以满足低延迟需求，而不是文件存储。 此外，FSx文件系统的成本通常高于EBS卷。 错误原因：不符合低延迟和成本效益的要求。
explanations.D: Host the application on an Amazon EC2 instance. Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) GP3 volume to run the application. Amazon EBS GP3卷是GP2的升级版，提供更高的性能（固定的IOPS和知吐量）和更低的成本。 GP3卷完全满足低延迟存储需求，同时符合“最具成本效益”的要求。 正确原因：满足低延迟和成本效益的要求，是最佳选择。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a stateful production application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application requires at least two EC2 instances to always be running. A solutions architect needs to design a highly available and fault-tolerant architecture for the application. The solutions architect creates an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances. Which set of additional steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements?

options.A: Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to two. Deploy one On-Demand Instance in one Availability Zone and one On-Demand Instance in a second Availability Zone.
options.B: Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to four. Deploy two On-Demand Instances in one Availability Zone and two On-Demand Instances in a second Availability Zone.
options.C: Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to two. Deploy four Spot Instances in one Availability Zone.
options.D: Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to four. Deploy two On-Demand Instances in one Availability Zone and two Spot Instances in a second Availability Zone.

explanations.A: Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to two. Deploy one On-Demand Instance in one Availability Zone and one On-Demand Instance in a second Availability Zone. 正确性分析：设置Auto Scaling组的最小容量为2是正确的，因为题目要求至少有两个实例运行。 问题：虽然跨两个可用区部署实例是高可用的最佳实践，但此选项没有明确说明如何处理故障转移的情况。如果一个可用区发生故 障，只有一个实例会痰痲运行，无法满足“至少两个实例运行”的要求。 结论：此选项不完全满足高可用性和容错要求。
explanations.B: Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to four. Deploy two On-Demand Instances in one Availability Zone and two On-Demand Instances in a second Availability Zone. 正确性分析：设置Auto Scaling组的最小容量为4，并跨两个可用区部署实例，确保即使一个可用区发生故障，仍有至少两个实例运 行。 优势：此选项完全满足高可用性和容错要求。 结论：此选项是正确答案。
explanations.C: Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to two. Deploy four Spot Instances in one Availability Zone. 正确性分析：Spot实例价格低廉，但不适合运行生产环境的关键任务，因为它们可能随时被中断。 问题：仅在一个可用区中部署实例无法满足高可用性要求，目使用Spot实例不适合生产环境的关键任务。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.D: Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to four. Deploy two On-Demand Instances in one Availability Zone and two Spot Instances in a second Availability Zone. 正确性分析：跨两个可用区部署实例是高可用的最佳实践。 问题：使用Spot实例可能导致实例随时被中断，无法保证生产环境的稳定性。 结论：此选项不完全满足高可用性和容错要求。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce company uses Amazon Route 53 as its DNS provider. The company hosts its website on premises and in the AWS Cloud. The company's on-premises data center is near the us-west-1 Region. The company uses the eu-central-1 Region to host the website. The company wants to minimize load time for the website as much as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up a geolocation routing policy. Send the traffic that is near us-west-1 to the on-premises data center. Send the traffic that is near eu-central-1 to eu-central-1.
options.B: Set up a simple routing policy that routes all traffic that is near eu-central-1 to eu-central-1 and routes all traffic that is near the on-premises datacenter to the on-premises data center.
options.C: Set up a latency routing policy. Associate the policy with us-west-1.
options.D: Set up a weighted routing policy. Split the traffic evenly between eu-central-1 and the on-premises data center.

explanations.A: Set up a geolocation routing policy. Send the traffic that is near us-west-1 to the on-premises data center. Send the traffic that is near eu-central-1 to eu-central-1. 正确：地理位置路由策略允许根据用户的地理位置将流量路由到最接邮的资源，从而减少加载时间。 此选项符合题目要求，因为它根据用户位置将流量分配到最邮的资源（us-west-1附邮的流量到本地数据中心，eu-central-1附邮的 流量到AWS云）。
explanations.B: Set up a simple routing policy that routes all traffic that is near eu-central-1 to eu-central-1 and routes all traffic that is near the on-premises datacenter to the on-premises data center. 错误：简单路由策略不支持基于用户位置的流量分配。它只能将流量随机分配到多个资源或单一资源。 此选项描述的功能实际上是地理位置路由策略的功能，而不是简单路由策略。
explanations.C: Set up a latency routing policy. Associate the policy with us-west-1. 错误：延迟路由策略根据资源的网络延迟来分配流量，而不是用户的地理位置。 题目要求根据用户位置优化流量，而不是基于延迟，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.D: Set up a weighted routing policy. Split the traffic evenly between eu-central-1 and the on-premises data center. 错误：加权路由策略根据预定义的权重分配流量，而不是用户的地理位置。 将流量密均分配可能导致用户访问远离其地理位置的资源，从而增加加载时间。

question: Topic 1 A company has 5 PB of archived data on physical tapes. The company needs to preserve the data on the tapes for another 10 years for compliance purposes. The company wants to migrate to AWS in the next 6 months. The data center that stores the tapes has a 1 Gbps uplink internet connectivity. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Read the data from the tapes on premises. Stage the data in a local NFS storage. Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
options.B: Use an on-premises backup application to read the data from the tapes and to write directly to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.C: Order multiple AWS Snowball devices that have Tape Gateway. Copy the physical tapes to virtual tapes in Snowball. Ship the Snowball devices to AWS. Create a lifecycle policy to move the tapes to Amazon $3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.D: Configure an on-premises Tape Gateway. Create virtual tapes in the AWS Cloud. Use backup software to copy the physical tape to the virtual tape.

explanations.A: Read the data from the tapes on premises. Stage the data in a local NFS storage. Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. 正确性分析：AWS DataSync适用于迁移文件数据，但不直接支持畭带数据的迁移。需要先将畭带数据转换为文件格式，这增加了复 杂性。 成本分析：使用1 Gbps的网痬连接迁移5 PB数据需要很长时间，目网痬成本较高。 结论：此选项不够高效目成本较高。
explanations.B: Use an on-premises backup application to read the data from the tapes and to write directly to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive. 正确性分析：此选项依赖于本地备份应用程序，但没有提到如何处理畭带数据的转换问题。 成本分析：同样需要通过1 Gbps网痬迁移数据，时间和成本都较高。 结论：此选项不够高效目成本较高。
explanations.C: Order multiple AWS Snowball devices that have Tape Gateway. Copy the physical tapes to virtual tapes in Snowball. Ship the Snowball devices to AWS. Create a lifecycle policy to move the tapes to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive. 正确性分析：AWS Snowball设备支持Tape Gateway，可以高效地将物理畭带转换为虚拟畭带并迁移到AWS。 成本分析：使用Snowball设备避免了网痬传输的限制，迁移速度快目成本低。 结论：此选项是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.D: Configure an on-premises Tape Gateway. Create virtual tapes in the AWS Cloud. Use backup software to copy the physical tape to the virtual tape. 正确性分析：此选项需要通过1 Gbps网痬连接将数据迁移到AWS，时间较长目成本较高。 成本分析：网痬传输成本较高，不如使用Snowball设备直接迁移。 结论：此选项不够高效目成本较高。

question: Topic 1 A company is deploying an application that processes large quantities of data in parallel. The company plans to use Amazon EC2 instances for the workload. The network architecture must be configurable to prevent groups of nodes from sharing the same underlying hardware. Which networking solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Run the EC2 instances in a spread placement group.
options.B: Group the EC2 instances in separate accounts.
options.C: Configure the EC2 instances with dedicated tenancy.
options.D: Configure the EC2 instances with shared tenancy.

explanations.A: Run the EC2 instances in a spread placement group. 正确。Spread Placement Group的设计目的是将实例分布在不同的底层 硬件上，以最大程度减少单点故障的影响。这完全符合题目要求，即防止节点共享同一底层硬件。
explanations.B: Group the EC2 instances in separate accounts. 错误。将实例分组到不同账户中并不能保证它们不会共享同一底层硬件。AWS 账户隔离主要用于管理权限和计费，而不是底层硬件的分离。
explanations.C: Configure the EC2 instances with dedicated tenancy. 错误。Dedicated Tenancy确保实例运行在专用硬件上，但它并不能防止 多个实例共享同一底层硬件。它的主要用途是满足合规性或安全性要求，而不是实现节点分离。
explanations.D: Configure the EC2 instances with shared tenancy. 错误。Shared Tenancy是EC2实例的默正选项，实例可能会共享底层硬件。 这与题目要求的防止共享底层硬件相违背。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing a disaster recovery (DR) strategy to provide Amazon EC2 capacity in a failover AWS Region. Business requirements state that the DR strategy must meet capacity in the failover Region. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Purchase On-Demand Instances in the failover Region.
options.B: Purchase an EC2 Savings Plan in the failover Region.
options.C: Purchase regional Reserved Instances in the failover Region.
options.D: Purchase a Capacity Reservation in the failover Region.

explanations.A: Purchase On-Demand Instances in the failover Region. 错误：On-Demand Instances是按需购买的实例，虽然可以快速启动，但无法保证在故障转移时有足够的容量可用，因为容量可能 会受到其他用户的竞争影响。
explanations.B: Purchase an EC2 Savings Plan in the failover Region. 错误：EC2 Savings Plan主要用于优化成本，而不是保证容量。它无法证保在故障转移区域有足够的计算资源可用。
explanations.C: Purchase regional Reserved Instances in the failover Region. 错误：虽然Reserved Instances可以提供成本优化和容量预留，但它的容量预留是基于实例类型和区域的长期承诺，无法灵活地满足 灾难恢复的需求。
explanations.D: Purchase a Capacity Reservation in the failover Region. 正确：Capacity Reservation允许您在指定的区域和可用区中预留EC2容量，确保在故障转移时有足够的计算资源可用。这是灾难恢 复场景中最合适的选项。

question: Topic 1 A company has five organizational units (OUs) as part of its organization in AWS Organizations. Each OU correlates to the five businesses that the company owns. The company’s research and development (R&D) business is separating from the company and will need its own organization. A solutions architect creates a separate new management account for this purpose. What should the solutions architect do next in the new management account?

options.A: Have the R&D AWS account be part of both organizations during the transition.
options.B: Invite the R&D AWS account to be part of the new organization after the R&D AWS account has left the prior organization.
options.C: Create a new R&D AWS account in the new organization. Migrate resources from the prior R&D AWS account to the new R&D AWS account.
options.D: Have the R&D AWS account join the new organization. Make the new management account a member of the prior organization.

explanations.A: Have the R&D AWS account be part of both organizations during the transition. 错误：AWS账户不能同时属于两个组织。一个账户只能属于一个组织，因此此选项不符合AWS Organizations的设计规则。
explanations.B: Invite the R&D AWS account to be part of the new organization after the R&D AWS account has left the prior organization. 正确：这是AWS Organizations中迁移账户的正确流程。首先需要将账户从原组织中移除，然后通过邀请机制将账户加入新的组织。
explanations.C: Create a new R&D AWS account in the new organization. Migrate resources from the prior R&D AWS account to the new R&D AWS account. 错误：创建一个新的账户并迁移资源是一个复杂目不必要的过程。AWS提供了直接迁移账户的机制，无需创建新的账户。
explanations.D: Have the R&D AWS account join the new organization. Make the new management account a member of the prior organization. 错误：管理账户不能成为另一个组织的成员。管理账户是组织的根账户，不能被邀请到其他组织。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing a solution to capture customer activity in different web applications to process analytics and make predictions. Customer activity in the web applications is unpredictable and can increase suddenly. The company requires a solution that integrates with other web applications. The solution must include an authorization step for security purposes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) in front of an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) container instance that stores the information that the company receives in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Authorization is resolved at the GWLB.
options.B: Configure an Amazon API Gateway endpoint in front of an Amazon Kinesis data stream that stores the information that the company receives in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an AWS Lambda function to resolve authorization.
options.C: Configure an Amazon API Gateway endpoint in front of an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose that stores the information that the company receives in an Amazon $3 bucket. Use an API Gateway Lambda authorizer to resolve authorization.
options.D: Configure a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) in front of an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) container instance that stores the information that the company receives on an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Use an AWS Lambda function to resolve authorization.

explanations.A: Configure a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) in front of an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) container instance that stores the information that the company receives in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Authorization is resolved at the GWLB. 错误：GWLB主要用于流量管理和负载均衡，不适合处理授权逻辑。 错误：ECS和EFS的组合虽然可以存储数据，但不适合处理实时数据流和突发流量。 错误：题目要求解决授权问题，而GWLB无法直接处理授权。
explanations.B: Configure an Amazon API Gateway endpoint in front of an Amazon Kinesis data stream that stores the information that the company receives in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an AWS Lambda function to resolve authorization. 部分正确：API Gateway可以处理突发流量并集成其他服务。 错误：Kinesis Data Stream需要额外的处理步骤才能将数据存储到S3，而题目没有提到这些步骤。 错误：Lambda函数可以处理授权，但题目更推荐使用API Gateway的Lambda Authorizer。
explanations.C: Configure an Amazon API Gateway endpoint in front of an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose that stores the information that the company receives in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an API Gateway Lambda authorizer to resolve authorization. 正确：API Gateway可以处理突发流量并集成其他服务。 正确：Kinesis Data Firehose可以直接将数据流写入S3，无需额外处理步骤。 正确：API Gateway的Lambda Authorizer是处理授权的最佳实践。
explanations.D: Configure a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) in front of an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) container instance that stores the information that the company receives on an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Use an AWS Lambda function to resolve authorization. 错误：GWLB主要用于流量管理和负载均衡，不适合处理授权逻辑。 错误：ECS和EFS的组合虽然可以存储数据，但不适合处理实时数据流和突发流量。 错误：Lambda函数可以处理授权，但题目更推荐使用API Gateway的Lambda Authorizer。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce company wants a disaster recovery solution for its Amazon RDS DB instances that run Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise Edition. The company's current recovery point objective (RPO) and recovery time objective (RTO) are 24 hours. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a cross-Region read replica and promote the read replica to the primary instance.
options.B: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create RDS cross-Region replication.
options.C: Use cross-Region replication every 24 hours to copy native backups to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Copy automatic snapshots to another Region every 24 hours.

explanations.A: Create a cross-Region read replica and promote the read replica to the primary instance. 正确性分析：跨区域只读副本可以提供灾备功能，但它是持痲运行的实例，成本较高，不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create RDS cross-Region replication. 正确性分析：AWS DMS主要用于数据迁移，而不是灾备解决方案。虽然可以实现跨区域复制，但设置复杂目不符合题目要求的成本 效益。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Use cross-Region replication every 24 hours to copy native backups to an Amazon S3 bucket. 正确性分析：将原生备份复制到S3是一个低成本的解决方案，但嬛复时间可能较长，无法满足灾备的RTO要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Copy automatic snapshots to another Region every 24 hours. 正确性分析：自动嬎照可以满足RPO和RTO要求，同时成本较低，是最具成本效益的解决方案。 结论：正确。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer that has sticky sessions enabled. The web server currently hosts the user session state. The company wants to ensure high availability and avoid user session state loss in the event of a web server outage. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached instance to store the session data. Update the application to use ElastiCache for Memcached to store the session state.
options.B: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to store the session state. Update the application to use ElastiCache for Redis to store the session state.
options.C: Use an AWS Storage Gateway cached volume to store session data. Update the application to use AWS Storage Gateway cached volume to store the session state.
options.D: Use Amazon RDS to store the session state. Update the application to use Amazon RDS to store the session state.

explanations.A: 使用Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached实例来存储会话数据。 Memcached是一个分布式内存对象缓存系统，适合用于缓存数据，但不支持持久化。 虽然可以用于存储会话状态，但在高可用性场景中，Redis更适合，因为它支持数据持久化和更高级的功能（如复制和故障转移）。 此选项正确，但不是最佳选择。
explanations.B: 使用Amazon ElastiCache for Redis存储会话状态。 Redis支持持久化、故障转移和复制，适合高可用性场景。 Redis还提供丰富的数据结构和功能，能够更好地管理会话状态。 此选项是最佳选择，符合题目要求。
explanations.C: 使用AWS Storage Gateway缓存卷存储会话数据。 Storage Gateway主要用于混合云存储解决方案，适合文件存储或备份场景。 它不适合用于存储会话状态，目不支持高性能的实时会话管理。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: 使用Amazon RDS存储会话状态。 RDS可以存储会话状态，但数据库操作的延迟可能会影响性能，尤其是在高并发场景中。 相比Redis，RDS的性能和实时性较低，不是最佳选择。 此选项正确，但不是最佳选择。

question: Topic 1 A company migrated a MySQL database from the company's on-premises data center to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The company sized the RDS DB instance to meet the company's average daily workload. Once a month, the database performs slowly when the company runs queries for a report. The company wants to have the ability to run reports and maintain the performance of the daily workloads. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a read replica of the database. Direct the queries to the read replica.
options.B: Create a backup of the database. Restore the backup to another DB instance. Direct the queries to the new database.
options.C: Export the data to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the S3 bucket.
options.D: Resize the DB instance to accommodate the additional workload.

explanations.A: Create a read replica of the database. Direct the queries to the read replica. 正确：读副本（Read Replica）是专门用于分担主数据库的读取负载的。将报告查询指向读副本可以有效分离读写操作，确保主数 据库的性能不受影响。 此解决方案符合题目要求，既能运行报告查询，又能维持日常工作负载的性能。
explanations.B: Create a backup of the database. Restore the backup to another DB instance. Direct the queries to the new database. 错误：创建备份并恢复到新实例的过程较为复杂目耗时，无法快速解决性能问题。 此外，这种方法需要额外的管理工作，并不适合频繁的报告查询场景。
explanations.C: Export the data to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the S3 bucket. 错误：将数据导出到S3并使用Athena查询适用于数据分析场景，但不适合实时数据库查询。 此方法需要额外的配置和数据导出桯骤，无法满足题目中对性能的即时需求。
explanations.D: Resize the DB instance to accommodate the additional workload. 错误：调整实例大小可以提高性能，但会影响成本，并且无法解决报告查询与日常工作负载之间的冲突。 此外，实例调整需要停机时间，可能会影响业务连续性。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a container application by using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The application includes microservices that manage customers and place orders. The company needs to route incoming requests to the appropriate microservices. Which solution will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use the AWS Load Balancer Controller to provision a Network Load Balancer.
options.B: Use the AWS Load Balancer Controller to provision an Application Load Balancer.
options.C: Use an AWS Lambda function to connect the requests to Amazon EKS.
options.D: Use Amazon API Gateway to connect the requests to Amazon EKS. {FA Amazon API Gateway

explanations.A: Use the AWS Load Balancer Controller to provision a Network Load Balancer. Network Load Balancer (NLB) 适用于处理高性能、低延迟的流量，但它主要用于第4层（传输层）负载均衡。 题目要求路由请求到具体的布服务，这需要第7层（应用层）的能力，而 NLB 不支持基于路径或主机名的路由。 因此此选项不符合题目需求。
explanations.B: Use the AWS Load Balancer Controller to provision an Application Load Balancer. Application Load Balancer (ALB) 是第7层负载均衡器，支持基于路径或主机名的路由。 AWS Load Balancer Controller 可以自动配置 ALB 来处理 Amazon EKS 的流量。 此选项符合题目需求，并且是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.C: Use an AWS Lambda function to connect the requests to Amazon EKS. AWS Lambda 是无服务器计算服务，但它并不适合作为负载均衡器来路由请求。 使用 Lambda 处理请求可能会增加复杂性和成本，不符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”解决方案。 因此此选项不正确。
explanations.D: Use Amazon API Gateway to connect the requests to Amazon EKS. Amazon API Gateway 是一个强大的 API 管理工具，但它主要用于管理 API 而非直接路由请求到布服务。 使用 API Gateway 可能会增加额外的成本，不符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”解决方案。 因此此选项不正确。

question: Topic 1 A company uses AWS and sells access to copyrighted images. The company’s global customer base needs to be able to access these images quickly. The company must deny access to users from specific countries. The company wants to minimize costs as much as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 to store the images. Turn on multi-factor authentication (MFA) and public bucket access. Provide customers with a link to the S3 bucket.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 to store the images. Create an IAM user for each customer. Add the users to a group that has permission to access the S3 bucket.
options.C: Use Amazon EC2 instances that are behind Application Load Balancers (ALBs) to store the images. Deploy the instances only in the countries the company services. Provide customers with links to the ALBs for their specific country's instances.
options.D: Use Amazon S3 to store the images. Use Amazon CloudFront to distribute the images with geographic restrictions. Provide a signed URL for each customer to access the data in CloudFront.

explanations.A: 使用Amazon S3存储图片。开启多因素正确（MFA）和公共橘访问权限。向客户提供指向S3橘的链接。 错误：MFA适用于用户身份验证，而不是直接控制地理访问。公共橘访问权限无法限制特定国家的访问。 错误：此方案无法满足“拒绝特定国家访问”的要求。
explanations.B: 使用Amazon S3存储图片。为每个客户创建一个IAM用户。将这些用户添加到具有访问S3橘权限的组中。 错误：为每个客户创建IAM用户会导致管理复杂性和高成本。 错误：IAM用户无法直接实现地理限制。
explanations.C: 使用部署在Application Load Balancers (ALBs)后面的Amazon EC2实例存储图片。仅在公司服务的国家部署实例。向客户提供 指向特定国家实例的ALBs链接。 错误：使用EC2实例存储图片成本较高，不符合“尽可能降低成本”的要求。 错误：此方案需要复杂的部署和管理，目无法灵活地实现地理限制。
explanations.D: 使用Amazon S3存储图片。使用Amazon CloudFront分发带有地理限制的图片。为每个客户提供一个签名URL以访问 CloudFront中的数据。 正确：Amazon CloudFront支持地理限制，可以拒绝特定国家的访问。 正确：签名URL可以确保只有授权用户能够访问内容。 正确：使用S3和CloudFront的组合是成本优化的解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing a highly available Amazon ElastiCache for Redis based solution. The solutions architect needs to ensure that failures do not result in performance degradation or loss of data locally and within an AWS Region. The solution needs to provide high availability at the node level and at the Region level. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Multi-AZ Redis replication groups with shards that contain multiple nodes.
options.B: Use Redis shards that contain multiple nodes with Redis append only files (AOF) turned on.
options.C: Use a Multi-AZ Redis cluster with more than one read replica in the replication group.
options.D: Use Redis shards that contain multiple nodes with Auto Scaling turned on.

explanations.A: Use Multi-AZ Redis replication groups with shards that contain multiple nodes. 正确：Multi-AZ Redis复制组提供了节点级别和区域级别的高可用性。通过分片和多个节点的设计，可以确保在故障发生时不会导 致性能下降或数据丢失。 这是AWS推荐的最佳实践，符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Use Redis shards that contain multiple nodes with Redis append only files (AOF) turned on. 错误：虽然AOF可以提供数据持久性，但它并不能保证高可用性，尤其是在区域级别的故障情况下。 此选项未提到Multi-AZ支持，因此不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Use a Multi-AZ Redis cluster with more than one read replica in the replication group. 错误：虽然Multi-AZ Redis集群可以提供高可用性，但仅依赖多个读取副本并不能完全满足题目中关于性能和数据丢失的要求。 读取副本主要用于分担读取负载，而不是提供高可用性。
explanations.D: Use Redis shards that contain multiple nodes with Auto Scaling turned on. 错误：Auto Scaling主要用于动态调整资源以满足负载需求，但它并不能直接提供高可用性。 此选项未提到Multi-AZ支持，因此不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company plans to migrate to AWS and use Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances for its application. During the migration testing phase, a technical team observes that the application takes a long time to launch and load memory to become fully productive. Which solution will reduce the launch time of the application during the next testing phase?

options.A: Launch two or more EC2 On-Demand Instances. Turn on auto scaling features and make the EC2 On-Demand Instances available during the next testing phase.
options.B: Launch EC2 Spot Instances to support the application and to scale the application so it is available during the next testing phase.
options.C: Launch the EC2 On-Demand Instances with hibernation turned on. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling warm pools during the next testing phase.
options.D: Launch EC2 On-Demand Instances with Capacity Reservations. Start additional EC2 instances during the next testing phase.
