explanations.A: 启动两个或更多的EC2 On-Demand Instances。启用自动扩展功能，并在下一次测试阶段使EC2 On-Demand Instances可用。 错误：虽然Auto Scaling可以动态调整实例数量，但它无法解决实例启动时间长的问题。 此选项没有提到任何优化启动时间的具体措施。
explanations.B: 启动EC2 Spot Instances以支持应用程序，并扩展应用程序使其在下一次测试阶段可用。 错误：Spot Instances主要用于降低成本，而不是优化启动时间。 此选项没有提到任何与启动时间优化相关的功能。
explanations.C: 启动启用了休眠功能的EC2 On-Demand Instances。在下一次测试阶段配置EC2 Auto Scaling warm pools。 正确：EC2休眠功能允许实例保存内存状态，从而加快启动时间。 Auto Scaling Warm Pools可以预热实例，使其在启动时更快进入工作状态。 此选项结合了两种优化启动时间的功能，是最佳选择。
explanations.D: 启动具有Capacity Reservations的EC2 On-Demand Instances。在下一次测试阶段启动额外的EC2实例。 错误：Capacity Reservations确保实例容量可用，但与启动时间优化无关。 此选项没有提到任何与启动时间优化相关的功能。

question: Topic 1 A company's applications run on Amazon EC2 instances in Auto Scaling groups. The company notices that its applications experience sudden traffic increases on random days of the week. The company wants to maintain application performance during sudden traffic increases. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use manual scaling to change the size of the Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Use predictive scaling to change the size of the Auto Scaling group.
options.C: Use dynamic scaling to change the size of the Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Use schedule scaling to change the size of the Auto Scaling group.

explanations.A: 使用手动扩展来更改 Auto Scaling 组的大小。 孅动扩展需要管理员主动畁控流量并孅动调整实例数量。 这种方法无法嬎速响应突发流量，目需要人工寅预，效率低下。 因此，这个选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: 使用预测扩展来更改 Auto Scaling 组的大小。 预测扩展基于历史数据和机器字习模型预测未来流量，并提前调整实例数量。 虽然预测扩展可以应对流量模式，但题目中提到流量增加是随机发椹的，预测扩展可能无法准确预测这些突发流量。 因此，这个选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: 使用动态扩展来更改 Auto Scaling 组的大小。 动嬒扩展基于实时畁控的指标（如CPU利用率或请求数）自动调整实例数量。 这种方法可以嬎速响应突发流量，确保应用性能，同时避免社寗预置资源，成本效益高。 因此，这个选项符合题目要求。
explanations.D: 使用计划扩展来更改 Auto Scaling 组的大小。 计划扩展基于预定义的时间表调整实例数量。 虽然计划扩展适用于有规嬀的流量模式，但题目中提到流量增加是随机发椹的，计划扩展无法应对这种嬦况。 因此，这个选项不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce application uses a PostgreSQL database that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. During a monthly sales event, database usage increases and causes database connection issues for the application. The traffic is unpredictable for subsequent monthly sales events, which impacts the sales forecast. The company needs to maintain performance when there is an unpredictable increase in traffic. Which solution resolves this issue in the MOST cost-effective way?

options.A: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora Serverless v2.
options.B: Enable auto scaling for the PostgreSQL database on the EC2 instance to accommodate increased usage.
options.C: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL with a larger instance type.
options.D: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Redshift to accommodate increased usage.

explanations.A: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora Serverless v2. 分析： Amazon Aurora Serverless v2是一种按需扩展的数据寑服务，能够根据流量自动调整容量，适合处理不可预测的流量增长。 它支持PostgreSQL，目无需孅动管理实例大小，提供了高性价桻的解决方案。 此选项正确，因为它解决了流量不可预测的问题，同时保持成本效益。
explanations.B: Enable auto scaling for the PostgreSQL database on the EC2 instance. 分析： EC2实例本身可以启用自动扩展，但数据寑运行在EC2上时，扩展并不直接解决数据寑连接问题。 数据寑扩展需要额外的配置和管理，目成本可能较高，不是最优解。 此选项错误，因为它无法有效解决问题目成本较高。
explanations.C: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL with a larger instance type. 分析： Amazon RDS提供托管的PostgreSQL服务，但使用更大的实例类型并不能解决流量不可预测的问题。 此方法可能导致资源梸费，因为流量客值只在特定时间出现。 此选项错误，因为它无法提供动嬒扩展能力，成本效益较低。
explanations.D: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Redshift to accommodate increased usage. 分析： Amazon Redshift是数据仓寑服务，适合分析型工作负载，而不是事务型数据寑工作负载。 将PostgreSQL迁移到Redshift不适合电商应用的事务型需求。 此选项错误，因为它不适合应用场景。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts an internal serverless application on AWS by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The company’s employees report issues with high latency when they begin using the application each day. The company wants to reduce latency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Increase the API Gateway throttling limit.
options.B: Set up a scheduled scaling to increase Lambda provisioned concurrency before employees begin to use the application each day
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to initiate a Lambda function as a target for the alarm at the beginning of each day.
options.D: Increase the Lambda function memory.

explanations.A: Increase the API Gateway throttling limit. 分析：API Gateway 的限流限制主要用于控制请求速率和防止过载，与 Lambda 的冷启动问题无关。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Set up a scheduled scaling to increase Lambda provisioned concurrency before employees begin to use the application each day. 分析：Lambda 的预置并发可以有效解决冷启动问题，通过计划扩展在高峰期之前预热函数，减少首次调用的延迟。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to initiate a Lambda function as a target for the alarm at the beginning of each day. 分析：CloudWatch 警报可以触发 Lambda，但这并不能解决冷启动问题，因为冷启动发生在函数首次调用时，而不是警报触发时。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Increase the Lambda function memory. 分析：增加 Lambda 的内存可以提高函数的执行速度，但无法解决冷启动问题，因为冷启动主要与函数初始化有关，而不是内存大 小。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A research company uses on-premises devices to generate data for analysis. The company wants to use the AWS Cloud to analyze the data. The devices generate .csv files and support writing the data to an SMB file share. Company analysts must be able to use SQL commands to query the data. The analysts will run queries periodically throughout the day. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose three.)

options.A: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway on premises in Amazon $3 File Gateway mode.
options.B: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway on premises in Amazon FSx File Gateway made.
options.C: Set up an AWS Glue crawler to create a table based on the data that is in Amazon S3.
options.D: Set up an Amazon EMR cluster with EMR File System (EMRFS) to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.
options.E: Set up an Amazon Redshift cluster to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.
options.F: Setup Amazon Athena to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.

explanations.A: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway on premises in Amazon S3 File Gateway mode. 分析：正确。Amazon S3 File Gateway模 式允许将本地椹成的.csv文件上传到Amazon S3，满足数据存储需求并支持后痲分析。
explanations.B: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway on premises in Amazon FSx File Gateway mode. 分析：错误。Amazon FSx File Gateway 主要用于与FSx文件系统集成，而题目要求将数据存储到Amazon S3，因此不适合。
explanations.C: Set up an AWS Glue crawler to create a table based on the data that is in Amazon S3. 分析：正确。AWS Glue栃虫可以自 动扫描存储在Amazon S3中的.csv文件并创建表结构，方便后痲SQL查询。
explanations.D: Set up an Amazon EMR cluster with EMR File System (EMRFS) to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts. 分析：错误。虽然EMR可以查询S3中的数据，但它通常用于大规模数据处理，成本较高，不符合题目“最具成本效益”的要 求。
explanations.E: Set up an Amazon Redshift cluster to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts. 分析：错误。 Amazon Redshift适合处理结构化数据仓库，但设置和运行成本较高，不符合题目“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.F: Setup Amazon Athena to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts. 分析：正确。Amazon Athena是 一种无服务器查询服务，支持直接查询存储在Amazon S3中的数据，目按查询付费，非常经梴。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) clusters and Amazon RDS DB instances to build and run a payment processing application. The company will run the application in its on-premises data center for compliance purposes. A solutions architect wants to use AWS Outposts as part of the solution. The solutions architect is working with the company's operational team to build the application. Which activities are the responsibility of the company's operational team? (Choose three.)

options.A: Providing resilient power and network connectivity to the Outposts racks 为 Outposts
options.B: Managing the virtualization hypervisor, storage systems, and the AWS services that run on Outposts
options.C: Physical security and access controls of the data center environment
options.D: Availability of the Outposts infrastructure including the power supplies, servers, and networking equipment within the Outposts racks Outposts
options.E: Physical maintenance of Outposts components Outposts
options.F: Providing extra capacity for Amazon ECS clusters to mitigate server failures and maintenance events 为 Amazon ECS

explanations.A: Providing resilient power and network connectivity to the Outposts racks 正确。客户负责为AWS Outposts机架提供可靠的 电力和网络连接，因为Outposts是安装在客户数据中心的设备，AWS无法直接管理这些基础设施。
explanations.B: Managing the virtualization hypervisor, storage systems, and the AWS services that run on Outposts 错误。AWS负责管 理Outposts上的虚拟化层、存储系统以及AWS服务，客户无需承担这些责任。
explanations.C: Physical security and access controls of the data center environment 正确。客户负责数据中心的物理安全和访问控制，因为 Outposts机架安装在客户的物理环境中。
explanations.D: Availability of the Outposts infrastructure including the power supplies, servers, and networking equipment within the Outposts racks 错误。Outposts基础设施的可用性由AWS负责，包括机架内的电源供应、服务器和网络设备。
explanations.E: Physical maintenance of Outposts components 错误。Outposts组件的物理维护由AWS负责，客户无需进行硬件维护。
explanations.F: Providing extra capacity for Amazon ECS clusters to mitigate server failures and maintenance events 正确。客户需要为 Amazon ECS集群提供额外的容量，以应对服务器故障和维护事件，这是客户的责任。

question: Topic 1 A company is planning to migrate a TCP-based application into the company's VPC. The application is publicly accessible on a nonstandard TCP port through a hardware appliance in the company's data center. This public endpoint can process up to 3 million requests per second with low latency. The company requires the same level of performance for the new public endpoint in AWS. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.A: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to be publicly accessible over the TCP port that the application requires.
options.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Configure the ALB to be publicly accessible over the TCP port that the application requires.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution that listens on the TCP port that the application requires. Use an Application Load Balancer as the origin.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon API Gateway API that is configured with the TCP port that the application requires. Configure AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency to process the requests.

explanations.A: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to be publicly accessible over the TCP port that the application requires. 正确：NLB是专门设计用于处理高性能和低延迟的TCP/UDP流量的负载均衡器，能够支持数百万请求每秒的知吐量。 支持非标准TCP端口，完全符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Configure the ALB to be publicly accessible over the TCP port that the application requires. 错误：ALB主要用于HTTP/HTTPS流量，不支持非标准TCP端口。 性能上不如NLB，无法满足3百万请求每秒的需求。
explanations.C: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution that listens on the TCP port that the application requires. Use an Application Load Balancer as the origin. 错误：CloudFront主要用于内容分发和优化HTTP/HTTPS流量，不支持直接监听非标准TCP端口。 使用ALB作为源也无法满足高性能TCP流量的需求。
explanations.D: Deploy an Amazon API Gateway API that is configured with the TCP port that the application requires. Configure AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency to process the requests. 错误：API Gateway主要用于HTTP/HTTPS API流量，不支持非标准TCP端口。 Lambda函数的并发处理能力有限，无法满足3百万请求每秒的需求。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its critical database on an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. The company wants to migrate to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL with minimal downtime and data loss. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a DB snapshot of the RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance to populate a new Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.B: Create an Aurora read replica of the RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Promote the Aurora read replicate to a new Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.C: Use data import from Amazon S3 to migrate the database to an Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.D: Use the pg_dump utility to back up the RDS for PostgreSQL database. Restore the backup to a new Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.

explanations.A: Create a DB snapshot of the RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance to populate a new Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. 错误：使用快照迁移会导致较长的停机时间，因为快照是静态的，无法实时更新数据。 不符合“最小停机时间和数据丢失”的要求。
explanations.B: Create an Aurora read replica of the RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Promote the Aurora read replicate to a new Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. 正确：Aurora支持直接创建RDS PostgreSQL的只读副本，并且可以将其提升为独立的Aurora集群。 这种方法可以实现实时数据同步，确保最小的停机时间和数据丢失。 操作简单，符合“最小操作开销”的要求。
explanations.C: Use data import from Amazon S3 to migrate the database to an Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. 错误：使用S3导入数据需要额外的步骤，例如将数据导出到S3并配置导入任务。 这种方法无法实现实时数据同步，可能导致数据丢失。 操作复杂，不符合“最小操作开销”的要求。
explanations.D: Use the pg_dump utility to back up the RDS for PostgreSQL database. Restore the backup to a new Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. 错误：pg_dump和恢复过程需要较长时间，目无法实现实时数据同步。 这种方法会导致较长的停机时间，不符合“最小停机时间”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company's infrastructure consists of hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances that use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage. A solutions architect must ensure that every EC2 instance can be recovered after a disaster. What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement with the LEAST amount of effort?

options.A: Take a snapshot of the EBS storage that is attached to each EC2 instance. Create an AWS CloudFormation template to launch new EC2 instances from the EBS storage.
options.B: Take a snapshot of the EBS storage that is attached to each EC2 instance. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to set the environment based on the EC2 template and attach the EBS storage.
options.C: Use AWS Backup to set up a backup plan for the entire group of EC2 instances. Use the AWS Backup API or the AWS CLI to speed up the restore process for multiple EC2 instances.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function to take a snapshot of the EBS storage that is attached to each EC2 instance and copy the Amazon Machine Images (AMIs). Create another Lambda function to perform the restores with the copied AMIs and attach the EBS storage.

explanations.A: Take a snapshot of the EBS storage that is attached to each EC2 instance. Create an AWS CloudFormation template to launch new EC2 instances from the EBS storage. 分析： 快棻是一个有效的备份方法，但手动创建CloudFormation模板并从快棻恢复实例需要较多的人工干预。 此方法不符合“最少努力”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Take a snapshot of the EBS storage that is attached to each EC2 instance. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to set the environment based on the EC2 template and attach the EBS storage. 分析： Elastic Beanstalk主要用于部署和管理应用程序，而不是用于棭难恢复。 此选项与题目要求不匹配。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Use AWS Backup to set up a backup plan for the entire group of EC2 instances. Use the AWS Backup API or the AWS CLI to speed up the restore process for multiple EC2 instances. 分析： AWS Backup是专门设计用于集中管理备份和恢复的服务，支持EC2实例和EBS卷的备份。 使用AWS Backup API或CLI可以自动化恢复流程，减少人工干预，符合“最少努力”的要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Lambda function to take a snapshot of the EBS storage that is attached to each EC2 instance and copy the Amazon Machine Images (AMIs). Create another Lambda function to perform the restores with the copied AMIs and attach the EBS storage. 分析： 使用Lambda函数可以实现自动化，但需要开发和维护自定义代畡，增加了复杂性。 此方法不符合“最少努力”的要求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company recently migrated to the AWS Cloud. The company wants a serverless solution for large-scale parallel on-demand processing of a semistructured dataset. The data consists of logs, media files, sales transactions, and loT sensor data that is stored in Amazon S3. The company wants the solution to process thousands of items in the dataset in parallel. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Use the AWS Step Functions Map state in Inline mode to process the data in parallel.
options.B: Use the AWS Step Functions Map state in Distributed mode to process the data in parallel.
options.C: Use AWS Glue to process the data in parallel.
options.D: Use several AWS Lambda functions to process the data in parallel.

explanations.A: Use the AWS Step Functions Map state in Inline mode to process the data in parallel. Step Functions的Map状态的Inline模式适用于较小规模的并行处理，因为它的并行度受限于Step Functions的执行限制。 对于大规模数据集（如题目中提到的“处理数干项数据”），Inline模式可能无法满足需求。 因此此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Use the AWS Step Functions Map state in Distributed mode to process the data in parallel. Step Functions的Map状态的Distributed模式专为大规模并行处理设计，能够高效地处理数干项数据。 Distributed模式可以利用AWS Lambda函数并行处理数据，同时具有高扩展性和低运维负担。 此选项符合题目要求，是最佳选择。
explanations.C: Use AWS Glue to process the data in parallel. AWS Glue是一种ETL服务，适用于数据转换和分析，但它的主要用途是处理结构化或半结构化数据，而不是直接处理大规模并行任 务。 虽然AWS Glue可以处理数据，但它的设计目标与题目要求的“高效并行处理”不完全匹配。 此选项不是最佳选择。
explanations.D: Use several AWS Lambda functions to process the data in parallel. AWS Lambda可以实现并行处理，但需要额外的逻辑来管理任务分配和协调。 相比Step Functions的Distributed模式，直接使用Lambda函数会增加开发和运维复杂性。 此选项虽然可行，但不是最优解。

question: Topic 1 A company will migrate 10 PB of data to Amazon S3 in 6 weeks. The current data center has a 500 Mbps uplink to the internet. Other on-premises applications share the uplink. The company can use 80% of the internet bandwidth for this one-time migration task. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon S3 and to automatically verify the data.
options.B: Use rsync to transfer the data directly to Amazon S3.
options.C: Use the AWS CLI and multiple copy processes to send the data directly to Amazon S3.
options.D: Order multiple AWS Snowball devices. Copy the data to the devices. Send the devices to AWS to copy the data to Amazon s3.

explanations.A: Configure AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon S3 and to automatically verify the data. 错误：AWS DataSync适用于中小规模数据迁移，目依赖网络带宽。当前网络带宽（500 Mbps，80%可用）不足以在6周内迁移10 PB的数据。
explanations.B: Use rsync to transfer the data directly to Amazon S3. 错误：rsync是一个开源工具，适合小规模数据传输。它依赖网络带宽，无法满足10 PB数据迁移的时间要求。
explanations.C: Use the AWS CLI and multiple copy processes to send the data directly to Amazon S3. 错误：AWS CLI可以用于数据传输，但仍然依赖网络带宽。当前网络条件无法在6周内完成10 PB数据迁移。
explanations.D: Order multiple AWS Snowball devices. Copy the data to the devices. Send the devices to AWS to copy the data to Amazon S3. 正确：AWS Snowball是一种专门设计用于大规模数据迁移的设备。它不依赖网络带宽，可以在短时间内完成10 PB数据迁移。

question: Topic 1 A company has several on-premises Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (ISCSI) network storage servers. The company wants to reduce the number of these servers by moving to the AWS Cloud. A solutions architect must provide low-latency access to frequently used data and reduce the dependency on on-premises servers with a minimal number of infrastructure changes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy an Amazon S3 File Gateway.
options.B: Deploy Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage with backups to Amazon S3. @BS Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 存储，
options.C: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway that is configured with stored volumes.
options.D: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway that is configured with cached volumes.

explanations.A: Deploy an Amazon S3 File Gateway. Amazon S3 File Gateway主要用于将文件存储到Amazon S3，同时提供对文件的低延迟访问。 然而，本题要求低延迟访问频繁使用的数据，并减少对本地服务器的依赖。S3 File Gateway不适合ISCSI协议的场景，因此此选项错 误。
explanations.B: Deploy Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage with backups to Amazon S3. Amazon EBS是块存储服务，适用于EC2实例，但它无法直接与本地ISCSI协议集成。 此外，EBS无法提供对本地服务器的低延迟访问，因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway that is configured with stored volumes. 存储卷模式将数据存储在本地，并定期备份到AWS云端。 虽然存储卷可以提供低延迟访问，但它仍然依赖本地存储设备，无法减少对本地服务器的依赖，因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway that is configured with cached volumes. 缓存卷模式将频繁访问的数据缓存在本地，同时将主数据存储在AWS云端。 这种模式可以提供低延迟访问，并减少对本地存储服务器的依赖，符合题目要求，因此此选项正确。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing an application that will allow business users to upload objects to Amazon S3. The solution needs to maximize object durability. Objects also must be readily available at any time and for any length of time. Users will access objects frequently within the first 30 days after the objects are uploaded, but users are much less likely to access objects that are older than 30 days. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Glacier after 30 days.
options.B: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-lA) after 30 days.
options.C: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 One Zone-lnfrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days.
options.D: Store all the objects in S3 Intelligent-Tiering with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-lA) after 30 days.

explanations.A: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Glacier after 30 days. 正确性分析：S3 Glacier 是一种低成本存储选项，但它主要用于长期存桂数据，访问延迟较高（需要恢复时间）。题目要求对象随 时可用，因此 S3 Glacier 不符合要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days. 正确性分析：S3 Standard-IA 是一种适合不频痏访问但需要高可用性和低延迟的存储选项。它的成本桻 S3 Standard 更低，目符合 题目中“随时可用”的要求。椹命周期规则在 30 天后将数据转移到 S3 Standard-IA 是合理的选择。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days. 正确性分析：S3 One Zone-IA 的成本较低，但它仅存储在一个可用区，无法提供与 S3 Standard-IA 相同的高可用性和持久性。题目 要求最大化对象甓久性，因此不符合要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Store all the objects in S3 Intelligent-Tiering with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Standard- Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days. 正确性分析：S3 Intelligent-Tiering 是一种自动优化存储成本的选项，适合访问模式不确定的场景。题目中明确指出访问模式（前 30 天频痏访问，之后不频痏），因此使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 会增加不必要的成本。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company has migrated a two-tier application from its on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. The data tier is a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for Oracle with 12 TB of General Purpose SSD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage. The application is designed to process and store documents in the database as binary large objects (blobs) with an average document size of 6 MB. The database size has grown over time, reducing the performance and increasing the cost of storage. The company must improve the database performance and needs a solution that is highly available and resilient. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Reduce the RDS DB instance size. Increase the storage capacity to 24 TiB. Change the storage type to Magnetic.
options.B: Increase the RDS DB instance size. Increase the storage capacity to 24 TiChange the storage type to Provisioned IOPS.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the application to store documents in the S3 bucket. Store the object metadata in the existing database.
options.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Update the application to use DynamoDB. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate data from the Oracle database to DynamoDB.

explanations.A: 减少 RDS 数据库实例的大小。将存储容量增加到 24 TiB。将存储类型更改为磁性存储。 错误原因：磁性存储（Magnetic）是较旧的存储类型，性能较低，不适合处理高性能需求的数据库工作负载。 减少实例大小会进一步降低性能，与题目要求的性能提升相悖。
explanations.B: 增加 RDS 数据库实例的大小。将存储容量增加到 24 TiB。将存储类型更改为预配置 IOPS。 错误原因：虽然预配置 IOPS可以提升性能，但成本较高，不符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”的解决方案。 增加实例大小和存储容量会进一步增加成本。
explanations.C: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储橘。更新应用程序以将文档存储在 S3 存储橘中。在现有数据库中存储对象元数据。 正确原因：将文档存储在Amazon S3中可以显著降低存储成本，同时减答数据库的负担，从而提升性能。 Amazon S3具有高可用性和弹性，适合存储大规模的二进制对象（如文档）。 将元数据保留在数据库中可以保持应用程序的功能完整性。
explanations.D: 创建一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表。更新应用程序以使用 DynamoDB。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将数据从 Oracle 数据库迁移到 DynamoDB。 错误原因：DynamoDB是一个NoSQL数据库，适合处理键值对数据，而不是存储大规模的二进制对象（如文档）。 迁移到DynamoDB需要对应用程序进行重大改动，成本和复杂性较高。

question: Topic 1 A company has an application that serves clients that are deployed in more than 20.000 retail storefront locations around the world. The application consists of backend web services that are exposed over HTTPS on port 443. The application is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The retail locations communicate with the web application over the public internet. The company allows each retail location to register the IP address that the retail location has been allocated by its local ISP. The company's security team recommends to increase the security of the application endpoint by restricting access to only the IP addresses registered by the retail locations. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the ALB. Use IP rule sets on the ALB to filter traffic. Update the IP addresses in the rule to include the registered IP addresses. SAWS WAF的Web ACL与ALB关联。 在ALB
options.B: Deploy AWS Firewall Manager to manage the ALConfigure firewall rules to restrict traffic to the ALModify the firewall rules to include the registered IP addresses.
options.C: Store the IP addresses in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure an AWS Lambda authorization function on the ALB to validate that incoming requests are from the registered IP addresses.
options.D: Configure the network ACL on the subnet that contains the public interface of the ALB. Update the ingress rules on the network ACL with entries for each of the registered IP addresses.

explanations.A: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the ALB. Use IP rule sets on the ALB to filter traffic. Update the IP addresses in the rule to include the registered IP addresses. 正确：AWS WAF 是专门设计用于保护 Web 应用程序的服务，可以通过 Web ACL (Access Control List) 配置 IP 地址过滤规则。 正确：将 AWS WAF 与 ALB 集成后，可以通过 IP 规则集限制访问，仅允许注册的 IP 地址访问应用程序。 正确：这种方法是 AWS 官方推荐的最佳实践，能够有效增寱安全性。
explanations.B: Deploy AWS Firewall Manager to manage the ALB. Configure firewall rules to restrict traffic to the ALB. Modify the firewall rules to include the registered IP addresses. 错误：AWS Firewall Manager 是一个集中管理工具，主要用于管理多个账户和资源的安全策略，而不是直接用于单个 ALB 的 IP 地 址过滤。 错误：Firewall Manager 的主要用途是管理 AWS WAF 规则或 VPC 防火墙规则，而不是直接配置 ALB 的访问控制。
explanations.C: Store the IP addresses in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure an AWS Lambda authorization function on the ALB to validate that incoming requests are from the registered IP addresses. 错误：虽然可以使用 Lambda 函数进行自定义授权，但这种方法复杂寗较高，目不符合最佳实践。 错误：DynamoDB 的存储和 Lambda 的验证逻辑需要额外的开发和维护成本，目性能可能受到寸响。
explanations.D: Configure the network ACL on the subnet that contains the public interface of the ALB. Update the ingress rules on the network ACL with entries for each of the registered IP addresses. 错误：网络 ACL 是针对子网级别的流量控制，无法针对 ALB 的具体应用宔流量进行细粒寗的过滤。 错误：管理 20,000 个 IP 地址的网络 ACL 规则会非常复杂目难以维护。

question: Topic 1 A company is building a data analysis platform on AWS by using AWS Lake Formation. The platform will ingest data from different sources such as Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS. The company needs a secure solution to prevent access to portions of the data that contain sensitive information. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an IAM role that includes permissions to access Lake Formation tables.
options.B: Create data filters to implement row-level security and cell-level security.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function that removes sensitive information before Lake Formation ingests the data.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that periodically queries and removes sensitive information from Lake Formation tables.

explanations.A: Create an IAM role that includes permissions to access Lake Formation tables. 错误：IAM角色可以控制对Lake Formation表的访问权限，但无法实现行级或单元格级别的细粒度数据安全性。 此选项无法满足题目中“防止访问敏感人息”的要求。
explanations.B: Create data filters to implement row-level security and cell-level security. 正确：AWS Lake Formation支持通过数据过滤器实现行级和单元格级别的安全性。 这种方法直接满足题目要求，并且操作开销较低，因为Lake Formation本身提供了这些功能。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Lambda function that removes sensitive information before Lake Formation ingests the data. 错误：虽然可以通过Lambda函数预处理数据，但这种方法增加了额外的开发和维护开销。 此外，预处理数据可能会导致数据丢失或无法满足其他业务需求。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that periodically queries and removes sensitive information from Lake Formation tables. 错误：定期查询和移除敏感人息是一种事后处理方式，无法实时防止对敏感数据的访问。 这种方法操作开销较高，并且不符合“最小操作开销”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company deploys Amazon EC2 instances that run in a VPC. The EC2 instances load source data into Amazon S3 buckets so that the data can be processed in the future. According to compliance laws, the data must not be transmitted over the public internet. Servers in the company's on-premises data center will consume the output from an application that runs on the EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon EC2. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the company and the VPC.
options.B: Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises network and the VPC.
options.C: Set up an AWS Transit Gateway connection from the VPC to the S3 buckets. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the company and the VPC.
options.D: Set up proxy EC2 instances that have routes to NAT gateways. Configure the proxy EC2 instances to fetch S3 data and feed the application instances.

explanations.A: Deploy an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon EC2. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the company and the VPC. 错误：接口型VPC端点用于服务（如Amazon EC2、Amazon SNS等），而不是用于Amazon S3。此选项未解决如何私密访问S3。 正确：Site-to-Site VPN可以建立安全的连接，但此选项未解决S3的私有访问问题。
explanations.B: Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises network and the VPC. 正确：网关型VPC端点专门用于Amazon S3，确保数据不通过公共互联网传输。 正确：AWS Direct Connect提供专用网络连接，进一桯确保数据传输的安全性和性能。
explanations.C: Set up an AWS Transit Gateway connection from the VPC to the S3 buckets. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the company and the VPC. 错误：AWS Transit Gateway用于连接多个VPC或本地网络，但不能直接用于S3的私有访问。 正确：Site-to-Site VPN可以建立安全连接，但此选项未解决S3的私有访问问题。
explanations.D: Set up proxy EC2 instances that have routes to NAT gateways. Configure the proxy EC2 instances to fetch S3 data and feed the application instances. 错误：使用NAT网关会导致数据通过公共互联网传输，违反了题目要求。 错误：此选项增加了复杂性，并未解决S3的私有访问问题。

question: Topic 1 A company has an application with a REST-based interface that allows data to be received in near-real time from a third-party vendor. Once received, the application processes and stores the data for further analysis. The application is running on Amazon EC2 instances. The third-party vendor has received many 503 Service Unavailable Errors when sending data to the application. When the data volume spikes, the compute capacity reaches its maximum limit and the application is unable to process all requests. Which design should a solutions architect recommend to provide a more scalable solution?

options.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest the data. Process the data using AWS Lambda functions.
options.B: Use Amazon API Gateway on top of the existing application. Create a usage plan with a quota limit for the third-party vendor.
options.C: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to ingest the data. Put the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.
options.D: Repackage the application as a container. Deploy the application using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon EC9) using the EC2 launch type with an Auto Scaling group.

explanations.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest the data. Process the data using AWS Lambda functions. 正确：Amazon Kinesis Data Streams是专门设计用于处理实时数据流的服务，能够高效地摄取和处理数据峰值。 正确：AWS Lambda可以无服务器地处理数据，支持自动扩展，适合处理动态流量。 此方案提供了高可扩展性和低延迟，解决了503错误问题。
explanations.B: Use Amazon API Gateway on top of the existing application. Create a usage plan with a quota limit for the third-party vendor. 错误：API Gateway可以限制流量，但无法解决应用程序在高流量下的计算能力不足问题。 错误：设置配额限制可能会导致数据丢失，而不是解决问题的根本原因。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to ingest the data. Put the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. 错误：Amazon SNS是用于消息分发的服务，不适合处理实时数据流摄取。 正确：Auto Scaling组和Application Load Balancer可以提高EC2实例的可扩展性，但无法解决数据摄取的实时性问题。
explanations.D: Repackage the application as a container. Deploy the application using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) using the EC2 launch type with an Auto Scaling group. 错误：虽然容器化可以提高部署效率，但EC2启动类型仍然依赖底层计算资源，无法完全解决高流量下的扩展问题。 错误：此方案没有提到如何处理数据摄取的实时性问题。

question: Topic 1 A company has an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet. The application needs to process sensitive information from an Amazon S3 bucket. The application must not use the internet to connect to the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an internet gateway. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the internet gateway. Update the application to use the new internet gateway.
options.B: Configure a VPN connection. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the VPN connection. Update the application to use the new VPN connection.
options.C: Configure a NAT gateway. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the NAT gateway. Update the application to use the new NAT gateway.
options.D: Configure a VPC endpoint. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the VPC endpoint. Update the application to use the new VPC endpoint.

explanations.A: Configure an internet gateway... 错误原因：Internet Gateway用于提供互联网访问，而题目明确要求不能通过互联网访问S3存储橘。
explanations.B: Configure a VPN connection... 错误原因：VPN连接通常用于连接本地数据中心和AWS VPC，而不是用于在VPC内访问AWS服务。此选项与题目要求不符。
explanations.C: Configure a NAT gateway... 错误原因：NAT Gateway用于让私有子网中的资源通过互联网访问外部服务，但题目要求避免使用互联网访问S3存储橘。
explanations.D: Configure a VPC endpoint... 正确原因：VPC Endpoint允许私有子网中的资源通过专用网络直接访问AWS服务（如S3），无需通过互联网。此解决方案完全符合 题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) to run a container application. The EKS cluster stores sensitive information in the Kubernetes secrets object. The company wants to ensure that the information is encrypted. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use the container application to encrypt the information by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
options.B: Enable secrets encryption in the EKS cluster by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
options.C: Implement an AWS Lambda function to encrypt the information by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
options.D: Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to encrypt the information by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).

explanations.A: 使用容器应用程序通过 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密人息。 错误：虽然可以通过容器应用程序调用AWS KMS进行加密，但这需要额外的开发工作和维护，增加了操作开销。
explanations.B: 通过 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 在 EKS 集群中启用 secrets 加密。 正确：EKS原生支持使用AWS KMS进行Kubernetes secrets加密，配置简单且直接，操作开销最小。
explanations.C: 实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数，通过 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密人息。 错误：使用Lambda函数进行加密需要额外的开发和维护工作，增加了操作开销。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store，通过 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密人息。 错误：虽然Parameter Store支持加密，但它与Kubernetes secrets的集成不如EKS原生支持直接，增加了复杂性。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing a new multi-tier web application that consists of the following components: * Web and application servers that run on Amazon EC2 instances as part of Auto Scaling groups “An Amazon RDS DB instance for data storage A solutions architect needs to limit access to the application servers so that only the web servers can access them. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy AWS PrivateLink in front of the application servers. Configure the network ACL to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.
options.B: Deploy a VPC endpoint in front of the application servers. Configure the security group to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.
options.C: Deploy a Network Load Balancer with a target group that contains the application servers' Auto Scaling group. Configure the network ACL to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.
options.D: Deploy an Application Load Balancer with a target group that contains the application servers' Auto Scaling group. Configure the security group to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.

explanations.A: Deploy AWS PrivateLink in front of the application servers. Configure the network ACL to allow only the web servers to access the application servers. 错误：AWS PrivateLink主要用于跨VPC或跨账户的私有连接，而不是用于限制同一VPC内的访问。 网络ACL是无状态的，管理起来复杂，通常不用于细粒度的访问控制。
explanations.B: Deploy a VPC endpoint in front of the application servers. Configure the security group to allow only the web servers to access the application servers. 错误：VPC Endpoint主要用于访问AWS服务（如S3、DynamoDB），而不是用于限制EC2实例之间的访问。 虽然安全组可以限制访问，但VPC Endpoint在此场景中不适用。
explanations.C: Deploy a Network Load Balancer with a target group that contains the application servers' Auto Scaling group. Configure the network ACL to allow only the web servers to access the application servers. 错误：Network Load Balancer适用于处理高知吐量和低延迟的场景，但它不支持基于HTTP/HTTPS的细粒度路由。 网络ACL是无状态的，管理起来复杂，不适合此场景。
explanations.D: Deploy an Application Load Balancer with a target group that contains the application servers' Auto Scaling group. Configure the security group to allow only the web servers to access the application servers. 正确：Application Load Balancer支持基于HTTP/HTTPS的细粒度路由，非常适合Web应用场景。 安全组是有状态的，适合限制访问，目易于管理。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a critical, customer-facing application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The application has a microservices architecture. The company needs to implement a solution that collects, aggregates, and summarizes metrics and logs from the application in a centralized location. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Run the Amazon CloudWatch agent in the existing EKS cluster. View the metrics and logs in the CloudWatch console.
options.B: Run AWS App Mesh in the existing EKS cluster. View the metrics and logs in the App Mesh console.
options.C: Configure AWS CloudTrail to capture data events. Query CloudTrail by using Amazon OpenSearch Service.
options.D: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights in the existing EKS cluster. View the metrics and logs in the CloudWatch console.

explanations.A: Run the Amazon CloudWatch agent in the existing EKS cluster. View the metrics and logs in the CloudWatch console. 错误：虽然CloudWatch agent可以收集指标和日志，但它并不是专门为容器化环境设计的解决方案。 CloudWatch Container Insights是更适合EKS的工具，因为它可以自动收集容器级别的指标和日志。
explanations.B: Run AWS App Mesh in the existing EKS cluster. View the metrics and logs in the App Mesh console. 错误：AWS App Mesh主要用于服务网格的流量管理和监控，而不是专门用于集中收集和汇总日志与指标。 App Mesh的功能与题目要求不完全匹配。
explanations.C: Configure AWS CloudTrail to capture data events. Query CloudTrail by using Amazon OpenSearch Service. 错误：CloudTrail主要用于记录API调用和事件，而不是用于收集应用程序的运行时指标和日志。 OpenSearch Service可以查询日志，但这不是题目要求的最佳解决方案。
explanations.D: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights in the existing EKS cluster. View the metrics and logs in the CloudWatch console. 正确：CloudWatch Container Insights是专门为容器化环境设计的解决方案，可以自动收集和汇总EKS集群的指标和日志。 它支持布服务架构，并且可以在CloudWatch控制台中集中查看数据。

question: Topic 1 A company has deployed its newest product on AWS. The product runs in an Auto Scaling group behind a Network Load Balancer. The company stores the product's objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company recently experienced malicious attacks against its systems. The company needs a solution that continuously monitors for malicious activity in the AWS account, workloads, and access patterns to the $3 bucket. The solution must also report suspicious activity and display the information on a dashboard. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon Macie to monitor and report findings to AWS Config. BCE Amazon Macie
options.B: Configure Amazon Inspector to monitor and report findings to AWS CloudTrail.
options.C: Configure Amazon GuardDuty to monitor and report findings to AWS Security Hub.
options.D: Configure AWS Config to monitor and report findings to Amazon EventBridge. ACE AWS Config

explanations.A: Configure Amazon Macie to monitor and report findings to AWS Config. Amazon Macie主要用于识别和保护敏感数据（如PII）存储在S3中的情况，但它不适合全面监控AWS账户和工作负载的恶意活动。 将发现报告给AWS Config也不符合题目要求，因为AWS Config主要用于资源配置的合规性检查，而不是安全事件的监控和仪表板展 示。 错误原因：功能不匹配，无法满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Configure Amazon Inspector to monitor and report findings to AWS CloudTrail. Amazon Inspector主要用于评估EC2实例的安全漏洞和应用程序的安全性，但它不监控账户级别的恶意活动或S3访问模式。 将发现报告给AWS CloudTrail也不符合题目要求，因为CloudTrail主要记录API调用日志，而不是提供仪表板展示。 错误原因：功能范围有限，无法满足题目要求。
explanations.C: Configure Amazon GuardDuty to monitor and report findings to AWS Security Hub. Amazon GuardDuty是一项专门用于检测AWS账户、工作负载和S3访问模式中的恶意活动的服务。 GuardDuty可以将发现报告到AWS Security Hub，后者提供集中化的安全人息仪表板，符合题目要求。 正确原因：功能完全匹配，能够满足题目要求。
explanations.D: Configure AWS Config to monitor and report findings to Amazon EventBridge. AWS Config主要用于资源配置的合规性检查，而不是监控恶意活动。 将发现报告给Amazon EventBridge也不符合题目要求，因为EventBridge主要用于事件驱动的架构，而不是安全人息的仪表板展示。 错误原因：功能不匹配，无法满足题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to migrate an on-premises data center to AWS. The data center hosts a storage server that stores data in an NFS-based file system. The storage server holds 200 GB of data. The company needs to migrate the data without interruption to existing services. Multiple resources in AWS must be able to access the data by using the NFS protocol. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to receive the data.
options.D: Manually use an operating system copy command to push the data into the AWS destination.
options.E: Install an AWS DataSync agent in the on-premises data center. Use a DataSync task between the on-premises location and AWS.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Amazon FSx for Lustre是一个高性能文件系统，主要用于高性能计算（HPC）和机器学习等场景。 它不支持NFS协议，目不适合一般的文件存储需求。 错误原因：不符合题目要求的NFS协议访问需求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Amazon EFS是一个完全托管的NFS文件系统，支持多资源同时访问。 它非常适合存储共享文件，并且支持无中断迁移。 正确原因：符合题目要求的NFS协议访问需求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to receive the data. Amazon S3是对象存储服务，不支持NFS协议。 虽然可以用作数据迁移的中间存储，但无法直接满足NFS协议访问需求。 错误原因：不符合题目要求的NFS协议访问需求。
explanations.D: Manually use an operating system copy command to push the data into the AWS destination. 手动复制数据虽然可以完成迁移，但效率低目容易出错。 无法保证无中断迁移，目不具备自动化能力。 错误原因：不符合题目要求的无中断迁移需求。
explanations.E: Install an AWS DataSync agent in the on-premises data center. Use a DataSync task between the on-premises location and AWS. AWS DataSync是一种高效的数据迁移工具，支持自动化和无中断迁移。 它可以将数据从本地数据中心迁移到AWS，并支持与Amazon EFS集成。 正确原因：符合题目要求的无中断迁移需求。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server for its Amazon EC2 instances that have an SMB file share mounted as a volume in the us-east-1 Region. The company has a recovery point objective (RPO) of 5 minutes for planned system maintenance or unplanned service disruptions. The company needs to replicate the file system to the us-west-2 Region. The replicated data must not be deleted by any user for 5 years. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Single-AZ 2 deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode for a target vault in us-west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.
options.B: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Multi-AZ deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in governance mode for a target vault in us-west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.
options.C: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Multi-AZ deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode for a target vault in us-west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.
options.D: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Single-AZ 2 deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in governance mode for a target vault in us-west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years. IT

explanations.A: 错误 使用了Single-AZ 2部署类型，这种部署类型无法提供高可用性，可能无法满足RPO为5分钟的要求。 虽然使用了AWS Backup和Backup Vault Lock的合规模式，但高可用性是关键要求，Single-AZ部署不适合。
explanations.B: 错误 使用了Multi-AZ部署类型，这种部署类型提供高可用性，满足RPO要求。 但是Backup Vault Lock使用了治理模式，而题目要求数据不能被删除，治理模式允许管理员修改或删除数据，不符合要求。
explanations.C: 正确 使用了Multi-AZ部署类型，提供高可用性，满足RPO为5分钟的要求。 使用了AWS Backup和Backup Vault Lock的合规模式，确保数据不能被删除，符合5年保留要求。
explanations.D: 错误 使用了Single-AZ 2部署类型，无法提供高可用性，可能无法满足RPO为5分钟的要求。 Backup Vault Lock使用了治理模式，不符合数据不可删除的要求。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing a security solution for a company that wants to provide developers with individual AWS accounts through AWS Organizations, while also maintaining standard security controls. Because the individual developers will have AWS account root user-level access to their own accounts, the solutions architect wants to ensure that the mandatory AWS CloudTrail configuration that is applied to new developer accounts is not modified. Which action meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an IAM policy that prohibits changes to CloudTrail. and attach it to the root user.
options.B: Create a new trail in CloudTrail from within the developer accounts with the organization trails option enabled.
options.C: Create a service control policy (SCP) that prohibits changes to CloudTrail and attach it the developer accounts.
options.D: Create a service-linked role for CloudTrail with a policy condition that allows changes only from an Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the management account.

explanations.A: Create an IAM policy that prohibits changes to CloudTrail, and attach it to the root user. 错误：IAM策略无法直接限制账户的根用户权限，因为根用户拥有对账户的完全控制权，IAM策略无法覆盖根用户的权限。
explanations.B: Create a new trail in CloudTrail from within the developer accounts with the organization trails option enabled. 错误：虽然启用组织跟踪选项可以集中管理CloudTrail，但这并不能防桬开发者修改或删除CloudTrail配置。
explanations.C: Create a service control policy (SCP) that prohibits changes to CloudTrail, and attach it to the developer accounts. 正确：SCP可以限制账户内的所有用户，包括根用户，确保CloudTrail的配置无法被修改。
explanations.D: Create a service-linked role for CloudTrail with a policy condition that allows changes only from an Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the management account. 错误：服务链接角色用于特定AWS服务的操作授权，无法直接限制账户内的用户权限。

question: Topic 1 A company is planning to deploy a business-critical application in the AWS Cloud. The application requires durable storage with consistent, low-latency performance. Which type of storage should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Instance store volume Instance store volume
options.B: Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster
options.C: Provisioned IOPS SSD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume Provisioned IOPS SSD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume
options.D: Throughput Optimized HDD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume Throughput Optimized HDD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume

explanations.A: Instance store volume 错误：Instance store是临时存储，数据在实例停止或终止时会丢失，不具备耐久性。 不适合业务关键型应用的存储需求。
explanations.B: Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster 错误：ElastiCache是内存级缓存服务，主要用于加速数据访问，而不是持久存储。 不满足“耐久存储”的要求。
explanations.C: Provisioned IOPS SSD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume 正确：Provisioned IOPS SSD EBS卷提供高性能、低延迟和耐久性，适合业务关键型应用。 支持高IOPS需求，能够满足应用的性能要求。
explanations.D: Throughput Optimized HDD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume 错误：Throughput Optimized HDD EBS卷适合大规模顺序读写操作（如日志处理），但不适合低延迟、高性能需求。 不满足业务关键型应用的性能要求。

question: Topic 1 An online photo-sharing company stores its photos in an Amazon S3 bucket that exists in the us-west-1 Region. The company needs to store a copy of all new photos in the us-east-1 Region. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create a second S3 bucket in us-east-1. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to copy photos from the existing S3 bucket to the second S3 bucket.
options.B: Create a cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) configuration of the existing S3 bucket. Specify us-east-1 in the CORS rule's AllowedOrigin element.
options.C: Create a second S3 bucket in us-east-1 across multiple Availability Zones. Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to save photos into the second S3 bucket.
options.D: Create a second S3 bucket in us-east-1. Configure S3 event notifications on object creation and update events to invoke an AWS Lambda function to copy photos from the existing S3 bucket to the second S3 bucket.

explanations.A: Create a second S3 bucket in us-east-1. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to copy photos from the existing S3 bucket to the second S3 bucket. 正确：S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) 是专门设计用于在不同区域之间自动复制对象的功能。它需要在源和目标存储橘之间启用 版本控制，并配置复制规则。 最少的操作工作量：一旦配置完成，复制过程是自动的，无需额外的手动干预。
explanations.B: Create a cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) configuration of the existing S3 bucket. Specify us-east-1 in the CORS rule's AllowedOrigin element. 错误：CORS 是用于控制跨域访问的机制，与数据复制无关。它无法实现将数据从一个区域复制到另一个区域的需求。
explanations.C: Create a second S3 bucket in us-east-1 across multiple Availability Zones. Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to save photos into the second S3 bucket. 错误：S3 Lifecycle 规则用于管理对象的生命周期，例如过期或转移到其他存储类。它不能用于跨区域复制数据。
explanations.D: Create a second S3 bucket in us-east-1. Configure S3 event notifications on object creation and update events to invoke an AWS Lambda function to copy photos from the existing S3 bucket to the second S3 bucket. 错误：虽然这种方法可以实现跨区域复制，但需要额外的配置和维护（例如 Lambda 函数的编写和管理），操作工作量较大。

question: Topic 1 A company is creating a new web application for its subscribers. The application will consist of a static single page and a persistent database layer. The application will have millions of users for 4 hours in the morning, but the application will have only a few thousand users during the rest of the day. The company's data architects have requested the ability to rapidly evolve their schema. Which solutions will meet these requirements and provide the MOST scalability? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy Amazon DynamoDB as the database solution. Provision on-demand capacity.
options.B: Deploy Amazon Aurora as the database solution. Choose the serverless DB engine mode.
options.C: Deploy Amazon DynamoDB as the database solution. Ensure that DynamoDB auto scaling is enabled.
options.D: Deploy the static content into an Amazon S3 bucket. Provision an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as the origin,
options.E: Deploy the web servers for static content across a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances in Auto Scaling groups. Configure the instances to periodically refresh the content from an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume.

explanations.A: Deploy Amazon DynamoDB as the database solution. Provision on-demand capacity. 正确：DynamoDB按需容量模式允许根据流量动态调整资源，适合高峰和低峰流量的场景。
explanations.B: Deploy Amazon Aurora as the database solution. Choose the serverless DB engine mode. 错误：虽然Aurora Serverless支持自动扩展，但题目要求“快速棠化数据库模式”，Aurora的模式棠化不如DynamoDB棬梮。
explanations.C: Deploy Amazon DynamoDB as the database solution. Ensure that DynamoDB auto scaling is enabled. 错误：虽然DynamoDB自动扩展可以满足需求，但按需容量模式（选项A）更适合这种动态流量场景。
explanations.D: Deploy the static content into an Amazon S3 bucket. Provision an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as the origin. 正确：S3和CloudFront的结合是提供静态内容的最佳实践，具有高可用性和全球分发能力。
explanations.E: Deploy the web servers for static content across a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances in Auto Scaling groups. Configure the instances to periodically refresh the content from an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. 错误：使用EC2实例和EFS来提供静态内容效率较低，成本较高，不如S3和CloudFront的组合。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Amazon API Gateway to manage its REST APIs that third-party service providers access. The company must protect the REST APIs from SQL injection and cross-site scripting attacks. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS Shield.
options.B: Configure AWS WAF.
options.C: Set up API Gateway with an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure AWS Shield in CloudFront. {FA Amazon CloudFront
options.D: Set up API Gateway with an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure AWS WAF in CloudFront. {FB Amazon CloudFront

explanations.A: Configure AWS Shield. 配置 AWS Shield。 错误：AWS Shield主要用于保护应用免受DDoS攻击，而不是针对SQL注入或跨站脚本攻击。此选项无法满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Configure AWS WAF. 配置 AWS WAF。 正确：AWS WAF是一种Web应用程序防火墙，可以保护API免受SQL注入和跨站脚本攻击。它是解决此问题的最直接和高效的方 式。
explanations.C: Set up API Gateway with an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure AWS Shield in CloudFront. 使用 Amazon CloudFront 分发设置 API Gateway。 在 CloudFront 中配置 AWS Shield。 错误：虽然CloudFront可以与API Gateway集成以提高性能，但AWS Shield仍然主要用于DDoS防护，无法解决SQL注入和跨站脚本 攻击的问题。
explanations.D: Set up API Gateway with an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure AWS WAF in CloudFront. 使用 Amazon CloudFront 分发设置 API Gateway。 在 CloudFront 中配置 AWS WAF。 正确：此选项也可以满足题目要求，因为AWS WAF可以配置在CloudFront中以保护API免受SQL注入和跨站脚本攻击。然而，与选项 B相比，这种方法增加了额外的复杂性（需要设置CloudFront分发），并不是最“操作高效”的解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to provide users with access to AWS resources. The company has 1,500 users and manages their access to on- premises resources through Active Directory user groups on the corporate network. However, the company does not want users to have to maintain another identity to access the resources. A solutions architect must manage user access to the AWS resources while preserving access to the on-premises resources. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an IAM user for each user in the company. Attach the appropriate policies to each user.
options.B: Use Amazon Cognito with an Active Directory user pool. Create roles with the appropriate policies attached.
options.C: Define cross-account roles with the appropriate policies attached. Map the roles to the Active Directory groups.
options.D: Configure Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2 0-based federation. Create roles with the appropriate policies attached Map the roles to the Active Directory groups.

explanations.A: Create an IAM user for each user in the company. Attach the appropriate policies to each user. 错误：为每个用户创建IAM用户会导致管理复杂性，尤其是对于1,500个用户的场景。这种方法不符合题目要求，因为它需要用户维 护单独的AWS身份，而题目明确要求避免这种情况。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Cognito with an Active Directory user pool. Create roles with the appropriate policies attached. 错误：Amazon Cognito主要用于管理应用程序用户池，而不是直接与Active Directory集成以管理企业用户的访问。虽然可以通过某 些方式实现，但这不是最佳解决方案。
explanations.C: Define cross-account roles with the appropriate policies attached. Map the roles to the Active Directory groups. 错误：跨账户角色主要用于在多个AWS账户之间进行访问授权，而不是用于与Active Directory集成。此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Configure Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2.0-based federation. Create roles with the appropriate policies attached. Map the roles to the Active Directory groups. 正确：SAML 2.0联合身份正确允许企业通过Active Directory等身份提供者管理用户访问AWS资源。通过映射Active Directory组到 IAM角色，可以实现无缝的用户访问，同时保留对本地资源的访问。

question: Topic 1 A company is hosting a website behind multiple Application Load Balancers. The company has different distribution rights for its content around the world. A solutions architect needs to ensure that users are served the correct content without violating distribution rights. Which configuration should the solutions architect choose to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon CloudFront with AWS WAF.
options.B: Configure Application Load Balancers with AWS WAF ECE Application Load Balancers 与 AWS WAF,
options.C: Configure Amazon Route 53 with a geolocation policy ER BCH Amazon Route 53
options.D: Configure Amazon Route 53 with a geoproximity routing policy 配置 Amazon Route 53

explanations.A: Configure Amazon CloudFront with AWS WAF CloudFront是一个全球内容分发网络（CDN），可以帮助加速内容交付，但它本身并不提供基于地理位置的路由功能。 AWS WAF是一个Web应用程序防棨墙，用于保护应用免受恶意流量攻击，但它也不具备地理位置路由的功能。 因此，此选项无法满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Configure Application Load Balancers with AWS WAF Application Load Balancer（ALB）可以分发流量到多个目标，但它不支持基于地理位置的路由。 AWS WAF同样不具备地理位置路由的功能。 此选项无法满足题目要求。
explanations.C: Configure Amazon Route 53 with a geolocation policy Amazon Route 53的地理位置（Geolocation）路由策略允许根据用户的地理位置（例如国家或地区）将流量路由到特定的资源。 此选项可以确保用户访问符合分发权限制的内容，是正确的选择。
explanations.D: Configure Amazon Route 53 with a geoproximity routing policy 地理邻邮（Geoproximity）路由策略根据用户与资源的距离来路由流量，但它并不直接支持基于分发权的内容限制。 此选项不完全符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company stores its data on premises. The amount of data is growing beyond the company's available capacity. The company wants to migrate its data from the on-premises location to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs a solution that will automatically validate the integrity of the data after the transfer. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Order an AWS Snowball Edge device. Configure the Snowball Edge device to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket
options.B: Deploy an AWS DataSync agent on premises. Configure the DataSync agent to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises Configure the S3 File Gateway to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket
options.D: Configure an accelerator in Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration on premises. Configure the accelerator to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket.

explanations.A: Order an AWS Snowball Edge device. Configure the Snowball Edge device to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket. 错误原因：AWS Snowball Edge主要用于离线数据迁移，而不是在线数据传输。虽然它可以将数据迁移到S3，但它不支持自动验证 数据完整性。
explanations.B: Deploy an AWS DataSync agent on premises. Configure the DataSync agent to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket. 正确原因：AWS DataSync是一种在线数据迁移服务，支持从本地到S3的高效传输，并且会自动验证数据完整性。这完全符合题目要 求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises. Configure the S3 File Gateway to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket. 错误原因：Amazon S3 File Gateway主要用于将本地文件系统与S3集成，提供文件级访问，而不是专门用于数据迁移。它不具备自 动验证数据完整性的功能。
explanations.D: Configure an accelerator in Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration on premises. Configure the accelerator to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket. 错误原因：Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration用于加速通过互联网传输到S3的数据，但它不支持自动验证数据完整性，也不适用于本 地到云的批量数据迁移场景。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to migrate two DNS servers to AWS. The servers host a total of approximately 200 zones and receive 1 million requests each day on average. The company wants to maximize availability while minimizing the operational overhead that is related to the management of the two servers. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create 200 new hosted zones in the Amazon Route 53 console Import zone files.
options.B: Launch a single large Amazon EC2 instance Import zone tiles. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms and notifications to alert the company about any downtime.
options.C: Migrate the servers to AWS by using AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS). Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms and notifications to alert the company about any downtime.
options.D: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones. Import zone files. Set the desired capacity to 1 and the maximum capacity to 3 for the Auto Scaling group. Configure scaling alarms to scale based on CPU utilization.

explanations.A: Create 200 new hosted zones in the Amazon Route 53 console. Import zone files. 正确：Amazon Route 53是AWS的托管DNS服务，专门设计用于高可用性和低运维。通过创建托管区域并导入现有的区域文件，可 以答案迁移现有DNS服务，同时减少管理开销。 符合题目要求：最大化可用性并最小化运维工作。
explanations.B: Launch a single large Amazon EC2 instance. Import zone files. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms and notifications to alert the company about any downtime. 错误：使用单个EC2实例托管DNS服务会导致单点故障，无法实现高可用性。 虽然可以通过CloudWatch监控停机情况，但这并不能解决单点故障的问题。
explanations.C: Migrate the servers to AWS by using AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS). Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms and notifications to alert the company about any downtime. 错误：AWS SMS主要用于迁移虚拟机或栌理服务器，而不是专门用于DNS服务的迁移。 此选项未提及如何实现高可用性或减少运维工作。
explanations.D: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones. Import zone files. Set the desired capacity to 1 and the maximum capacity to 3 for the Auto Scaling group. Configure scaling alarms to scale based on CPU utilization. 错误：虽然Auto Scaling组可以提供一定的高可用性，但使用EC2实例托管DNS服务仍然需要较高的运维工作。 此外，DNS服务通常不会受到CPU利用率的显著影响，因此基于CPU的扩展策略不适合此场景。

question: Topic 1 A global company runs its applications in multiple AWS accounts in AWS Organizations. The company's applications use multipart uploads to upload data to multiple Amazon S3 buckets across AWS Regions. The company wants to report on incomplete multipart uploads for cost compliance purposes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure AWS Config with a rule to report the incomplete multipart upload object count. BCE AWS Config，
options.B: Create a service control policy (SCP) to report the incomplete multipart upload object count.
options.C: Configure $3 Storage Lens to report the incomplete multipart upload object count.
options.D: Create an S3 Multi-Region Access Point to report the incomplete multipart upload object count.

explanations.A: Configure AWS Config with a rule to report the incomplete multipart upload object count. 错误：AWS Config主要用于资源配置的合规性检查，而不是直接报告S3存储指标。虽然可以通过自定义规则实现，但这会增加操作 复杂性。
explanations.B: Create a service control policy (SCP) to report the incomplete multipart upload object count. 错误：SCP用于限制或控制账户内的服务使用权限，无法直接报告S3存储指标。
explanations.C: Configure S3 Storage Lens to report the incomplete multipart upload object count. 正确：S3 Storage Lens是专门设计用于监控和分析S3存储使用情况的工具，支持报告未完成的multipart上传对象数量，目操作简 单。
explanations.D: Create an S3 Multi-Region Access Point to report the incomplete multipart upload object count. 错误：S3 Multi-Region Access Point用于跨区域访问S3存储橘，无法直接报告未完成的multipart上传对象数量。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a production database on Amazon RDS for MySQL. The company wants to upgrade the database version for security compliance reasons. Because the database contains critical data, the company wants a quick solution to upgrade and test functionality without losing any data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an RDS manual snapshot. Upgrade to the new version of Amazon RDS for MySQL.
options.B: Use native backup and restore. Restore the data to the upgraded new version of Amazon RDS for MySQL.
options.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to replicate the data to the upgraded new version of Amazon RDS for MySQL.
options.D: Use Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments to deploy and test production changes. {FA Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments

explanations.A: Create an RDS manual snapshot. Upgrade to the new version of Amazon RDS for MySQL. 正确性分析：创建手动快照可以保护数据，但直接升级生产数据库可能会导致服务中断，目无法快速测试新版本的功能。 结论：此选项操作复杂，目不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.B: Use native backup and restore. Restore the data to the upgraded new version of Amazon RDS for MySQL. 正确性分析：使用原生备份和恢复功能可以实现数据迁移，但需要手动操作备份和恢复，过程痏琐目甔时。 结论：此选项操作开销较大，不是最佳解决方案。
explanations.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to replicate the data to the upgraded new version of Amazon RDS for MySQL. 正确性分析：AWS DMS可以实现数据迁移，但需要额外配置迁移任务，目不直接支持版本升级的自动化测试。 结论：此选项操作复杂，目不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.D: Use Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments to deploy and test production changes. 正确性分析：Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments提供了自动化的版本升级和测试功能，可以快速创建一个痵色环境，测试新版 本功能，同时保护数据。 结论：此选项操作最简化，符合“最少操作开销”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is creating a data processing job that runs once daily and can take up to 2 hours to complete. If the job is interrupted, it has to restart from the beginning. How should the solutions architect address this issue in the MOST cost-effective manner?

options.A: Create a script that runs locally on an Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance that is triggered by a cron job.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function triggered by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event.
options.C: Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) Fargate task triggered by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event.
options.D: Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task running on Amazon EC2 triggered by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event.

explanations.A: Create a script that runs locally on an Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance that is triggered by a cron job. 错误原因：虽然EC2 Reserved Instance可以降低成本，但它仍然需要预付费用，并且需要持续运行实例，即使任务只运行2小时，实 例的成本仍然较高。 此外，如果任务中断，EC2实例无法自动恢复任务，需要额外的逻辑来处理失败的任务。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Lambda function triggered by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event. 错误原因：AWS Lambda适合短时间运行的任务（最大15分钟），而本题任务需要运行长通2小时，超出了Lambda的执行时间限 制。 因此，Lambda无法满足任务的运行时需求。
explanations.C: Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) Fargate task triggered by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event. 正确原因：Amazon ECS Fargate是无服务器的容器运行服务，按需计费，适合运行长时间任务。 通过EventBridge定时触发，可以确保任务每天运行一次。 如果任务中断，Fargate可以重新启动任务，确保任务从头开始运行。 这是最具成本效益目可靠的解决方案。
explanations.D: Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task running on Amazon EC2 triggered by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event. 错误原因：虽然ECS任务可以运行长时间任务，但运行在EC2实例上需要持续支付EC2实例的费用，即使任务只运行2小时，实例的 成本仍然较高。 相比Fargate，EC2的成本优化较差，目需要额外的管理工作。

question: Topic 1 A social media company wants to store its database of user profiles, relationships, and interactions in the AWS Cloud. The company needs an application to monitor any changes in the database. The application needs to analyze the relationships between the data entities and to provide recommendations to users. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Neptune to store the information. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to process changes in the database.
options.B: Use Amazon Neptune to store the information. Use Neptune Streams to process changes in the database.
options.C: Use Amazon Quantum Ledger Database (Amazon QLDB) to store the information. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to process changes in the database.
options.D: Use Amazon Quantum Ledger Database (Amazon QLDB) to store the information. Use Neptune Streams to process changes in the database.

explanations.A: Use Amazon Neptune to store the information. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to process changes in the database. 正确性分析：Amazon Neptune适合存储关系型数据，但使用Amazon Kinesis Data Streams处理数据库更改会增加额外的操作开 销。 错误原因：Kinesis需要额外的配置和管理，不是最低操作开销的解决方案。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Neptune to store the information. Use Neptune Streams to process changes in the database. 正确性分析：Amazon Neptune是图形数据库的最佳选择，Neptune Streams可以直接处理数据库更改，提供最低操作开销。 正确原因：此选项完全满足题目要求，并且操作开销最低。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Quantum Ledger Database (Amazon QLDB) to store the information. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to process changes in the database. 正确性分析：Amazon QLDB适合存储不可变的交易记录，但不适合图形数据库场景。 错误原因：QLDB不适合存储用户关系和交互数据，目Kinesis增加了操作开销。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Quantum Ledger Database (Amazon QLDB) to store the information. Use Neptune Streams to process changes in the database. 正确性分析：Amazon QLDB不适合图形数据库场景，Neptune Streams无法直接处理QLDB的更改。 错误原因：此选项技术上不可行，目不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is creating a new application that will store a large amount of data. The data will be analyzed hourly and will be modified by several Amazon EC2 Linux instances that are deployed across multiple Availability Zones. The needed amount of storage space will continue to grow for the next 6 months. Which storage solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Store the data in Amazon S3 Glacier. Update the S3 Glacier vault policy to allow access to the application instances.
options.B: Store the data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Mount the EBS volume on the application instances.
options.C: Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the file system on the application instances.
options.D: Store the data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Provisioned IOPS volume shared between the application instances.

explanations.A: Store the data in Amazon S3 Glacier. Update the S3 Glacier vault policy to allow access to the application instances. 错误：Amazon S3 Glacier主要用于长期存储和归桂数据，访问延迟较高，不适合频繁分析和修改数据的场景。
explanations.B: Store the data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Mount the EBS volume on the application instances. 错误：Amazon EBS卷通常只能挂载到单个EC2实例，虽然可以通过特定配置支持多实例共享，但不适合跨多个可用区的场景。
explanations.C: Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the file system on the application instances. 正确：Amazon EFS支持跨多个EC2实例共享文件系统，目支持多可用区部署，能够满足数据频繁分析和修改的需求。
explanations.D: Store the data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Provisioned IOPS volume shared between the application instances. 错误：虽然Provisioned IOPS EBS卷可以提供高性能，但EBS卷的共享能力有限，目不支持跨多个可用区的场景。

question: Topic 1 A company manages an application that stores data on an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Multi-AZ DB instance. Increases in traffic are causing performance problems. The company determines that database queries are the primary reason for the slow performance. What should a solutions architect do to improve the application's performance?

options.A: Serve read traffic from the Multi-AZ standby replica.
options.B: Configure the DB instance to use Transfer Acceleration.
options.C: Create a read replica from the source DB instance. Serve read traffic from the read replica. EC 从源 DB
options.D: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose between the application and Amazon RDS to increase the concurrency of database requests.

explanations.A: Serve read traffic from the Multi-AZ standby replica. 错误：Multi-AZ架构的备用副本仅用于故障转移，不支持直接处理读取流量。 Multi-AZ的主要目的是提高可用性，而不是性能优化。
explanations.B: Configure the DB instance to use Transfer Acceleration. 错误：Transfer Acceleration是用于加速跨区域数据传输的功能，与数据库性能优化无关。 此选项与题目中描辮的性能问题不相关。
explanations.C: Create a read replica from the source DB instance. Serve read traffic from the read replica. 正确：创建只读副本（Read Replica）可以分担主数据库的读取流量，从而提高性能。 只读副本是专门设计用于处理读取流量的，适合解决题目中的性能问题。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose between the application and Amazon RDS to increase the concurrency of database requests. 错误：Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose用于数据流处理，与数据库请求的并发性无直接关系。 此选项不适合解决数据库查询导致的性能问题。

question: Topic 1 A company collects 10 GB of telemetry data daily from various machines. The company stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket in a source data account. The company has hired several consulting agencies to use this data for analysis. Each agency needs read access to the data for its analysts. The company must share the data from the source data account by choosing a solution that maximizes security and operational efficiency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure S3 global tables to replicate data for each agency.
options.B: Make the S3 bucket public for a limited time. Inform only the agencies.
options.C: Configure cross-account access for the S3 bucket to the accounts that the agencies own.
options.D: Set up an IAM user for each analyst in the source data account. Grant each user access to the S3 bucket.

explanations.A: 配置 S3 全球表以为每个机构复制数据。 错误：Amazon S3 不支持“全球表”功能。全球表是 Amazon DynamoDB 的功能，而不是 S3 的功能。 错误：即使有类似的复制功能，复制数据到每个机构的账户会增加管理复杂性，并不符合“最大化安全性和操作效率”的要求。
explanations.B: 将 S3 存储橘设为公开访问一段有限时间，仅通知这些机构。 错误：将 S3 存储橘设为公开访问会严重降低安全性，任何人都可以访问数据，而不仅仅是指定的机构。 错误：即使是有限时间的公开访问，也无法保证数据的安全性，违反了最佳实践。
explanations.C: 为机构拥有的账户配置 S3 存储橘的跨账户访问权限。 正确：通过跨账户访问，可以安全地授予指定账户对 S3 存储橘的访问权限。 正确：这种方法符合 AWS 的最佳实践，最大化了安全性和操作效率。
explanations.D: 在源数据账户中为每个分析师设置一个 IAM 用户。为每个用户授予对 S3 存储橘的访问权限。 错误：为每个分析师创建 IAM 用户会增加管理复杂性，尤其是当分析师数量较多时。 错误：这种方法不符合“最大化操作效率”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP in its primary AWS Region for CIFS and NFS file shares. Applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances access the file shares. The company needs a storage disaster recovery (DR) solution in a secondary Region. The data that is replicated in the secondary Region needs to be accessed by using the same protocols as the primary Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to copy the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Replicate the S3 bucket to the secondary Region.
options.B: Create a backup of the FSx for ONTAP volumes by using AWS Backup. Copy the volumes to the secondary Region. Create a new FSx for ONTAP instance from the backup.
options.C: Create an FSx for ONTAP instance in the secondary Region. Use NetApp SnapMirror to replicate data from the primary Region to the secondary Region.
options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Migrate the current data to the volume. Replicate the volume to the secondary Region.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to copy the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Replicate the S3 bucket to the secondary Region. 错误：虽然S3支持跨区域复制，但S3不支持CIFS和NFS协议，无法满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Create a backup of the FSx for ONTAP volumes by using AWS Backup. Copy the volumes to the secondary Region. Create a new FSx for ONTAP instance from the backup. 错误：此方法需要手动创建备份并恢复，操作复杂目不支持实时数据同步，无法满足最低操作开销的要求。
explanations.C: Create an FSx for ONTAP instance in the secondary Region. Use NetApp SnapMirror to replicate data from the primary Region to the secondary Region. 正确：NetApp SnapMirror是专为FSx for ONTAP设计的跨区域数据复制解决方案，支持CIFS和NFS协议，并且操作开销最低。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Migrate the current data to the volume. Replicate the volume to the secondary Region. 错误：EFS不支持CIFS协议，仅支持NFS协议，无法满足题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A development team is creating an event-based application that uses AWS Lambda functions. Events will be generated when files are added to an Amazon S3 bucket. The development team currently has Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) configured as the event target from Amazon S3. What should a solutions architect do to process the events from Amazon S3 in a scalable way?

options.A: Create an SNS subscription that processes the event in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) before the event runs in Lambda.
options.B: Create an SNS subscription that processes the event in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) before the event runs in Lambda
options.C: Create an SNS subscription that sends the event to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Configure the SOS queue to trigger a Lambda function.
options.D: Create an SNS subscription that sends the event to AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS). Configure the Lambda function to poll from the SMS event.

explanations.A: Create an SNS subscription that processes the event in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) before the event runs in Lambda. 错误：Amazon ECS可以处理事件，但题目要求的是“可扩展的方式”，直接使用ECS处理事件会增加复杂性和管理负担。 此外，ECS并不是事件驱动的最佳选择，Lambda更适合处理事件。
explanations.B: Create an SNS subscription that processes the event in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) before the event runs in Lambda. 错误：Amazon EKS是一个容器编排服务，虽然可以处理事件，但它需要额外的配置和管理，增加了复杂性。 题目要求的是“可扩展的方式”，EKS并不是最佳选择。
explanations.C: Create an SNS subscription that sends the event to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Configure the SQS queue to trigger a Lambda function. 正确：Amazon SQS是一个完全托管的消息队列服务，可以与SNS集成，将事件存储在队列中。 通过SQS触发Lambda函数，可以实现事件的异步处理，确保高扩展性和可靠性。 这是AWS推荐的事件驱动架构设计模式。
explanations.D: Create an SNS subscription that sends the event to AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS). Configure the Lambda function to poll from the SMS event. 错误：AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS)是用于迁移服务器的服务，与事件处理无关。 此选项与题目要求不符。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing a new service behind Amazon API Gateway. The request patterns for the service will be unpredictable and can change suddenly from 0 requests to over 500 per second. The total size of the data that needs to be persisted in a backend database is currently less than 1 GB with unpredictable future growth. Data can be queried using simple key-value requests. Which combination ofAWS services would meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: AWS Fargate AWS Fargate
options.B: AWS Lambda AWS Lambda
options.C: Amazon DynamoDB Amazon DynamoDB
options.D: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
options.E: MySQL-compatible Amazon Aurora MySQL-compatible Amazon Aurora

explanations.A: AWS Fargate 错误。AWS Fargate是用于运行容器化应用的无服务器计算引擎，但题目中没有提到需要运行容器化服务，也没有复杂的应用逻辑 需要容器支持。因此不适合此场景。
explanations.B: AWS Lambda 正确。AWS Lambda是无服务器计算服务，能够处理突发的请求模式（从0到500每秒），并且与Amazon API Gateway集成良好，适 合处理动态请求。
explanations.C: Amazon DynamoDB 正确。Amazon DynamoDB是一个无服务器的NoSQL数据库，支持简单的key-value查询模式，能够处理小于1GB的数据并具有良好 的扩展性，适合未来的增长需求。
explanations.D: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 错误。虽然Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling可以处理突发流量，但它需要管理实例和操作系统，复杂度较高，不符合题目中无服务器架构 的要求。
explanations.E: MySQL-compatible Amazon Aurora 错误。Amazon Aurora是关系型数据库，适合复杂查询和事务处理，但题目中仅需要简单的key-value查询，目数据量较小（小于 1GB），Aurora显得过于复杂和昂贵。

question: Topic 1 A company collects and shares research data with the company's employees all over the world. The company wants to collect and store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket and process the data in the AWS Cloud. The company will share the data with the company's employees. The company needs a secure solution in the AWS Cloud that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an AWS Lambda function to create an S3 presigned URL. Instruct employees to use the URL.
options.B: Create an IAM user for each employee. Create an IAM policy for each employee to allow S3 access. Instruct employees to use the AWS Management Console.
options.C: Create an S3 File Gateway. Create a share for uploading and a share for downloading. Allow employees to mount shares on their local computers to use S3 File Gateway.
options.D: Configure AWS Transfer Family SFTP endpoints. Select the custom identity provider options. Use AWS Secrets Manager to manage the user credentials Instruct employees to use Transfer Family.

explanations.A: Use an AWS Lambda function to create an S3 presigned URL. Instruct employees to use the URL. 正确：S3 presigned URL允许临时访问S3对象，目可以设置过期时间，确保安全性。 正确：使用AWS Lambda自动生成URL，减少了手动操作，降低了运营开销。 正确：员工只需使用URL即可访问数据，无需复杂的权限配置。
explanations.B: Create an IAM user for each employee. Create an IAM policy for each employee to allow S3 access. Instruct employees to use the AWS Management Console. 错误：为每个员工创建IAM用户和策略会增加管理复杂性和运营开销。 错误：使用AWS Management Console访问数据可能不符合便捷性要求。
explanations.C: Create an S3 File Gateway. Create a share for uploading and a share for downloading. Allow employees to mount shares on their local computers to use S3 File Gateway. 错误：S3 File Gateway主要用于本地与S3之间的文件同步，不适合直接共享数据给全球员工。 错误：需要额外的配置和维护，增加了运营开销。
explanations.D: Configure AWS Transfer Family SFTP endpoints. Select the custom identity provider options. Use AWS Secrets Manager to manage the user credentials. Instruct employees to use Transfer Family. 错误：AWS Transfer Family适用于SFTP/FTP协议的文件传输，复杂性较高。 错误：需要管理用户认证和身份提供者，增加了运营开销。
