question: Topic 1 A company is building a new furniture inventory application. The company has deployed the application on a fleet ofAmazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances run behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in their VPC. A solutions architect has observed that incoming traffic seems to favor one EC2 instance, resulting in latency for some requests. What should the solutions architect do to resolve this issue?

options.A: Disable session affinity (sticky sessions) on the ALB 在ALB
options.B: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer 用Network Load Balancer蔡换ALB
options.C: Increase the number of EC2 instances in each Availability Zone
options.D: Adjust the frequency of the health checks on the ALB's target group 调整ALB

explanations.A: Disable session affinity (sticky sessions) on the ALB 正确：会话亲和性（Sticky Sessions）会导致流量倾向于分配到某些特定的实例，而不是均匀分布到所有实例。这可能会导致某些 实例负载社高，从而引发延迟问题。禁用会话亲和性可以让ALB根据流量负载动态分配请求，解决流量倾斜问题。
explanations.B: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer 错误：Network Load Balancer (NLB)主要用于处理低延迟、高知吐量的流量，但它不具备像ALB那样的高级功能（如HTTP/HTTPS层 的负载均衡）。问题的根本原因是Sticky Sessions，而不是负载均衡器类型的选择。
explanations.C: Increase the number of EC2 instances in each Availability Zone 错误：增加EC2实例数量可能会缓解负载问题，但这并没有解决流量倾斜的根本原因。流量倾斜是由于Sticky Sessions导致的，而不 是实例数量不足。
explanations.D: Adjust the frequency of the health checks on the ALB's target group 错误：调整健康桌查频率不会解决流量倾斜问题。健康桌查的主要目的是确保实例的可用性，而不是优化流量分布。

question: Topic 1 A company has an application workflow that uses an AWS Lambda function to download and decrypt files from Amazon S3. These files are encrypted using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that will ensure the required permissions are set correctly. Which combination of actions accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.A: Attach the kms:decrypt permission to the Lambda function's resource policy 将 kms:decrypt
options.B: Grant the decrypt permission for the Lambda IAM role in the KMS key's policy 在KMS
options.C: Grant the decrypt permission for the Lambda resource policy in the KMS key's policy.
options.D: Create a new IAM policy with the kms:decrypt permission and attach the policy to the Lambda function.
options.E: Create a new IAM role with the kms:decrypt permission and attach the execution role to the Lambda function.

explanations.A: Attach the kms:decrypt permission to the Lambda function’s resource policy 错误。Lambda 函数的资源策略并不支持直接附加权限。权限需要通过 IAM 角色或 KMS 密钥策略来授予。
explanations.B: Grant the decrypt permission for the Lambda IAM role in the KMS key's policy 正确。KMS 密钥策略需要显式授予 Lambda 的 IAM 角色解密权限，以便 Lambda 函数能够使用 KMS 密钥解密文件。
explanations.C: Grant the decrypt permission for the Lambda resource policy in the KMS key's policy 错误。Lambda 函数的资源策略并不能直接与 KMS 密钥策略交互，因此无法通过这种方式授予权限。
explanations.D: Create a new IAM policy with the kms:decrypt permission and attach the policy to the Lambda function 错误。虽然可以创建一个 IAM 策略并附加到 Lambda 函数，但这并不足以让 Lambda 函数访问 KMS 密钥。还需要在 KMS 密钥策 略中显式授予权限。
explanations.E: Create a new IAM role with the kms:decrypt permission and attach the execution role to the Lambda function 正确。Lambda 函数需要一个执行角色，该角色必须包含 kms:decrypt 权限，以便能够解密文件。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to monitor its AWS costs for financial review. The cloud operations team is designing an architecture in the AWS Organizations management account to query AWS Cost and Usage Reports for all member accounts. The team must run this query once a month and provide a detailed analysis of the bill. Which solution is the MOST scalable and cost-effective way to meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable Cost and Usage Reports in the management account. Deliver reports to Amazon Kinesis. Use Amazon EMR for analysis.
options.B: Enable Cost and Usage Reports in the management account. Deliver the reports to Amazon S3 Use Amazon Athena for analysis.
options.C: Enable Cost and Usage Reports for member accounts. Deliver the reports to Amazon S3 Use Amazon Redshift for analysis.
options.D: Enable Cost and Usage Reports for member accounts. Deliver the reports to Amazon Kinesis. Use Amazon QuickSight tor analysis.

explanations.A: Enable Cost and Usage Reports in the management account. Deliver reports to Amazon Kinesis. Use Amazon EMR for analysis. 错误原因：Amazon Kinesis 是实时数据流服务，不适合处理静态的月度报告。使用 Amazon EMR 进行分析虽然强大，但成本较高 目复杂度较高，不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.B: Enable Cost and Usage Reports in the management account. Deliver the reports to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena for analysis. 正确原因：Amazon S3 是存储 Cost and Usage Reports 的最佳选择，支持高可扩展性和低成本存储。Amazon Athena 是无服务器 查询服务，支持直接查询存储在 S3 中的数据，成本低目易于使用，非常适合定期分析。
explanations.C: Enable Cost and Usage Reports for member accounts. Deliver the reports to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Redshift for analysis. 错误原因：为每个成员账户单独启用 Cost and Usage Reports 会增加管理复杂性。Amazon Redshift 是数据仓库服务，虽然强大， 但成本较高且不适合处理简单的月度报告分析。
explanations.D: Enable Cost and Usage Reports for member accounts. Deliver the reports to Amazon Kinesis. Use Amazon QuickSight for analysis. 错误原因：与选项 A 类似，Amazon Kinesis 不适合处理静态的月度报告。Amazon QuickSight 是可视化工具，虽然适合展示数据， 但不适合直接分析 Cost and Usage Reports。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to run a gaming application on Amazon EC2 instances that are part of an Auto Scaling group in the AWS Cloud. The application will transmit data by using UDP packets. The company wants to ensure that the application can scale out and in as traffic increases and decreases. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Attach a Network Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Attach an Application Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon Route 53 record set with a weighted policy to route traffic appropriately.
options.D: Deploy a NAT instance that is configured with port forwarding to the EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group.

explanations.A: Attach a Network Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group. Network Load Balancer (NLB) 支持 UDP 协议，这是题目中提到的关輄要求。 NLB 可以与 Auto Scaling 组集成，支持流量的动态扩展和缩减。 此选项完全符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Attach an Application Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group. Application Load Balancer (ALB) 主要用于 HTTP 和 HTTPS 流量，不支持 UDP 协议。 此选项不符合题目中关于 UDP 的要求。
explanations.C: Deploy an Amazon Route 53 record set with a weighted policy to route traffic appropriately. Route 53 是一个DNS服务，可以用于流量路由，但它不能直接处理 UDP 数据包。 此选项无法满足题目中关于负载均衡和 Auto Scaling 的要求。
explanations.D: Deploy a NAT instance that is configured with port forwarding to the EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group. NAT 实例主要用于处理出站流量，而不是负载均衡。 此选项无法满足题目中关于负载均衡和 UDP 的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company runs several websites on AWS for its different brands. Each website generates tens of gigabytes of web traffic logs each day. A solutions architect needs to design a scalable solution to give the company's developers the ability to analyze traffic patterns across all the company's websites. This analysis by the developers will occur on demand once a week over the course of several months. The solution must support queries with standard SQL. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena tor analysis.
options.B: Store the logs in Amazon RDS. Use a database client for analysis.
options.C: Store the logs in Amazon OpenSearch Service. Use OpenSearch Service for analysis.
options.D: Store the logs in an Amazon EMR cluster Use a supported open-source framework for SQL-based analysis.

explanations.A: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena for analysis. 正确：Amazon S3 是一种高性价比的存储解决方案，适合存储大量日志数据。 正确：Amazon Athena 是无服务器的查询服务，支持标准 SQL，按查询付费，非常适合按需分析。 此选项满足成本效益和按需分析的要求。
explanations.B: Store the logs in Amazon RDS. Use a database client for analysis. 错误：Amazon RDS 是关系型数据库服务，适合结构化数据，但存储大量日志数据成本较高。 错误：需要预置数据库实例，无法按需扩展，目维护成本较高。
explanations.C: Store the logs in Amazon OpenSearch Service. Use OpenSearch Service for analysis. 错误：Amazon OpenSearch Service 主要用于搜痋和分析日志数据，但不支持标准 SQL 查询。 错误：此选项不符合题目要求的 SQL 查询需求。
explanations.D: Store the logs in an Amazon EMR cluster. Use a supported open-source framework for SQL-based analysis. 错误：Amazon EMR 是一种大数据处理服务，适合复杂分析，但成本较高且需要维护集群。 错误：此选项不符合成本效益的要求。

question: Topic 1 An international company has a subdomain for each country that the company operates in. The subdomains are formatted as example.com, country1.example.com, and country2.example.com. The company's workloads are behind an Application Load Balancer. The company wants to encrypt the website data that is in transit. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) console to request a public certificate for the apex top domain example com and a wildcard certificate for *example.com.
options.B: Use the AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) console to request a private certificate for the apex top domain example.com and a wildcard certificate for *.example.com.
options.C: Use the AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) console to request a public and private certificate for the apex top domain example.com.
options.D: Validate domain ownership by email address. Switch to DNS validation by adding the required DNS records to the DNS provider.
options.E: Validate domain ownership for the domain by adding the required DNS records to the DNS provider.

explanations.A: Use the AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) console to request a public certificate for the apex top domain example.com and a wildcard certificate for *.example.com. 正确。公共证书适用于公开访问的域名，通配符证书可以覆盖所有子域名（如 country1.example.com和country2.example.com）。这是满足题目要求的正确步骤。
explanations.B: Use the AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) console to request a private certificate for the apex top domain example.com and a wildcard certificate for *.example.com. 错误。私有证书通常用于内部应用程序或服务，而不是公开访问的域名。题目要求 加密网站数据，这需要公共证书。
explanations.C: Use the AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) console to request a public and private certificate for the apex top domain example.com. 错误。题目没有提到需要私有证书，目通配符证书（*.example.com）是必要的，单独申请顶级域名证书不足以覆盖 子域名。
explanations.D: Validate domain ownership by email address. Switch to DNS validation by adding the required DNS records to the DNS provider. 错误。虽然电子邮件验证是可选的，但题目没有提到需要切换验证方法。直接使用DNS验证更符合题目要求。
explanations.E: Validate domain ownership for the domain by adding the required DNS records to the DNS provider. 正确。DNS验证是 AWS推荐的域名所有权验证方法，适用于公共证书申请。

question: Topic 1 A company is required to use cryptographic keys in its on-premises key manager. The key manager is outside of the AWS Cloud because of regulatory and compliance requirements. The company wants to manage encryption and decryption by using cryptographic keys that are retained outside of the AWS Cloud and that support a variety of external key managers from different vendors. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS CloudHSM key store backed by a CloudHSM cluster.
options.B: Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) external key store backed by an external key manager.
options.C: Use the default AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) managed key store.
options.D: Use a custom key store backed by an AWS CloudHSM cluster.

explanations.A: 使用由CloudHSM集群支持的AWS CloudHSM密钥存储。 CloudHSM是一个托管的硬件安全模块（HSM）服务，可以帮助用户管理自己的加密密钥。 然而，题目要求使用外部的密钥管理器，而CloudHSM是AWS内部的服务，不符合题目要求。 错误原因：不满足“密钥存储在AWS之外”的要求。
explanations.B: 使用由外部密钥管理器支持的AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 外部密钥存储。 AWS KMS外部密钥存储（External Key Store, XKS）允许用户将加密密钥存储在AWS之外的外部密钥管理器中。 此选项完全符合题目要求：支持外部密钥管理器，满足合规性要求，并且操作开销最低。 正确原因：完全满足题目要求，并且是AWS推荐的解决方案。
explanations.C: 使用默正的AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 托管密钥存储。 默正的AWS KMS托管密钥存储是AWS管理的密钥存储服务，密钥存储在AWS内部。 题目要求密钥存储在AWS之外，因此此选项不符合要求。 错误原因：密钥存储在AWS内部，不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: 使用由AWS CloudHSM集群支持的自定义密钥存储。 自定义密钥存储允许用户使用CloudHSM集群来管理自己的密钥。 然而，CloudHSM仍然是AWS内部的服务，不符合题目要求。 错误原因：密钥存储在AWS内部，不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect needs to host a high performance computing (HPC) workload in the AWS Cloud. The workload will run on hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances and will require parallel access to a shared file system to enable distributed processing of large datasets. Datasets will be accessed across multiple instances simultaneously. The workload requires access latency within 1 ms. After processing has completed, engineers will need access to the dataset for manual postprocessing. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) as a shared file system. Access the dataset from Amazon EFS.
options.B: Mount an Amazon S3 bucket to serve as the shared file system. Perform postprocessing directly from the S3 bucket.
options.C: Use Amazon FSx for Lustre as a shared file system. Link the file system to an Amazon S3 bucket for postprocessing.
options.D: Configure AWS Resource Access Manager to share an Amazon S3 bucket so that it can be mounted to all instances for processing and postprocessing.

explanations.A: 使用Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)作为共享文件系统。从Amazon EFS访问数据集。 分析：Amazon EFS 是一个分布式文件系统，适合处理通用文件存储需求，但其访问延迟通常在毫秒级别，无法保证 1ms 的延迟要 求。此外，EFS 的性能在高性能计算场景中可能不如 FSx for Lustre。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 挂载一个Amazon S3 bucket作为共享文件系统。直接从S3 bucket进行后处理。 分析：Amazon S3 是对象存储服务，不是文件系统，无法直接挂载到 EC2 实例作为共享文件系统。此外，S3 的访问延迟通常在几 十毫秒级别，远高于 1ms 的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: 使用Amazon FSx for Lustre作为共享文件系统。将文件系统链接到一个Amazon S3 bucket以进行后处理。 分析：Amazon FSx for Lustre 是专为高性能计算设计的文件系统，支持低于 1ms 的访问延迟，并且可以与 Amazon S3 集成，方便 后处理数据的存储和访问。此选项完全满足题目要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: 配置AWS Resource Access Manager以共享一个Amazon S3 bucket，使其可以挂载到所有实例以进行处理和后处理。 分析：AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) 用于跨账户共享资源，但 S3 仍然是对象存储服务，无法直接挂载为文件系统。此 外，S3 的访问延迟无法满足 1ms 的要求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A gaming company is building an application with Voice over IP capabilities. The application will serve traffic to users across the world. The application needs to be highly available with an automated failover across AWS Regions. The company wants to minimize the latency of users without relying on IP address caching on user devices. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Global Accelerator with health checks.
options.B: Use Amazon Route 53 with a geolocation routing policy.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that includes multiple origins.
options.D: Create an Application Load Balancer that uses path-based routing.

explanations.A: Use AWS Global Accelerator with health checks. 正确：AWS Global Accelerator是专门设计用于优化全球用户流量的服务。它通过使用任何区域的静态IP地址来减少延迟，并支持跨 区域的自动故障转移。健康桌查功能确保流量被路由到健康的终端。 此选项完全符合题目要求，包括高可用性、低延迟和自动故障转移。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Route 53 with a geolocation routing policy. 错误：虽然Route 53的地理位置路由策略可以根据用户位置将流量路由到最邮的区域，但它依赖于DNS解析，可能会受到用户设备 的IP地址缓存影响，无法完全满足“最小化延迟目不依赖IP地址缓存”的要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that includes multiple origins. 错误：CloudFront主要用于内容分发网络（CDN），优化静态和动态内容的交付。虽然它可以减少延迟，但它不支持跨区域的自动 故障转移功能，因此不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Create an Application Load Balancer that uses path-based routing. 错误：Application Load Balancer主要用于在单个区域内的流量分配。它不支持跨区域的流量路由或自动故障转移，因此不符合题目 要求。

question: Topic 1 A weather forecasting company needs to process hundreds of gigabytes of data with sub-millisecond latency. The company has a high performance computing (HPC) environment in its data center and wants to expand its forecasting capabilities. A solutions architect must identify a highly available cloud storage solution that can handle large amounts of sustained throughput. Files that are stored in the solution should be accessible to thousands of compute instances that will simultaneously access and process the entire dataset. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon FSx for Lustre scratch file systems.
options.B: Use Amazon FSx for Lustre persistent file systems.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with Bursting Throughput mode. {FQ Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 的 Bursting Throughput 模式。
options.D: Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with Provisioned Throughput mode. {$F Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 的 Provisioned Throughput 模式。

explanations.A: Use Amazon FSx for Lustre scratch file systems. Amazon FSx for Lustre scratch file systems 是一种临时文件系统，适用于短期计算任务。 虽然它可以提供高知吐量和低延迟，但它不适合需要持久存储的场景，因为数据在文件系统删除后会丢失。 因此，这个选项不符合题目中“高可用”和“持久存储”的要求。
explanations.B: Use Amazon FSx for Lustre persistent file systems. Amazon FSx for Lustre persistent file systems 提供高性能存储，支持高知吐量和低延迟，适合 HPC 栤境。 它支持持久存储，数据不会因为文件系统的删除而丢失，符合题目中“高可用”和“持久存储”的要求。 此外，它可以支持多个计算实例同时访问和处理数据，非常适合题目描述的场景。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with Bursting Throughput mode. Amazon EFS 的 Bursting Throughput 模式适合不连续的工作负载，知吐量会根据文件系统大小动态调整。 虽然 EFS 提供高可用性和持久存储，但它的性能不如 FSx for Lustre，尤其是在需要处理大量数据和低延迟的 HPC 场景中。 因此，这个选项不符合题目中“高性能计算”和“高知吐量”的要求。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with Provisioned Throughput mode. Amazon EFS 的 Provisioned Throughput 模式允许用户手动设置知吐量，但仍然不如 FSx for Lustre 的性能。 虽然它提供高可用性和持久存储，但在 HPC 场景中，FSx for Lustre 更适合处理大规模数据和低延迟需求。 因此，这个选项也不符合题目中“高性能计算”和“高知吐量”的要求。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce company runs a PostgreSQL database on premises. The database stores data by using high IOPS Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) block storage. The daily peak I/O transactions per second do not exceed 15,000 IOPS. The company wants to migrate the database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and provision disk IOPS performance independent of disk storage capacity. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure the General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS volume storage type and provision 15,000 IOPS.
options.B: Configure the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume storage type and provision 15,000 IOPS.
options.C: Configure the General Purpose SSD (gp3) EBS volume storage type and provision 15,000 IOPS.
options.D: Configure the EBS magnetic volume type to achieve maximum IOPS. ACES EBS

explanations.A: Configure the General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS volume storage type and provision 15,000 IOPS. 错误：gp2存储类型的IOPS性能与存储容量相关联，无法独立配置IOPS。要通到15,000 IOPS，必须配置非常大的存储容量，这会导 致成本增加。
explanations.B: Configure the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume storage type and provision 15,000 IOPS. 正确但不最优：io1支持独立配置IOPS和存储容量，能够满足15,000 IOPS的需求。但io1的成本较高，不是最具成本效益的解决方 案。
explanations.C: Configure the General Purpose SSD (gp3) EBS volume storage type and provision 15,000 IOPS. 正确目最优：gp3支持独立配置IOPS和存储容量，能够满足15,000 IOPS的需求，同时成本比io1更低，是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.D: Configure the EBS magnetic volume type to achieve maximum IOPS. 错误：EBS磁性卷类型性能较低，无法满足15,000 IOPS的需求，目磁性卷主要用于低性能需求的场景。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to migrate its on-premises Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise edition database to AWS. The company’s online application uses the database to process transactions. The data analysis team uses the same production database to run reports for analytical processing. The company wants to reduce operational overhead by moving to managed services wherever possible. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate to Amazon RDS for Microsoft SOL Server. Use read replicas for reporting purposes
options.B: Migrate to Microsoft SQL Server on Amazon EC2. Use Always On read replicas for reporting purposes
options.C: Migrate to Amazon DynamoDB. Use DynamoDB on-demand replicas for reporting purposes
options.D: Migrate to Amazon Aurora MySQL. Use Aurora read replicas for reporting purposes

explanations.A: Migrate to Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server. Use read replicas for reporting purposes 正确性分析：Amazon RDS是一个托管服务，支持Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise版，能够显著减少操作开销。 只读副本可以用于分畹事务处理和分析处理，满足报告需求。 此选项符合题目要求，目操作开销最低。
explanations.B: Migrate to Microsoft SQL Server on Amazon EC2. Use Always On read replicas for reporting purposes 正确性分析：在Amazon EC2上运行SQL Server需要自行管理操作系统、数据库软件和高可用性配置。 虽然Always On读副本可以满足报告需求，但操作开销较高，不符合“减少操作开销”的要求。 此选项错误。
explanations.C: Migrate to Amazon DynamoDB. Use DynamoDB on-demand replicas for reporting purposes 正确性分析：DynamoDB是一个非关系型数据库，不适合迁移关系型SQL Server数据库。 虽然DynamoDB支持按需副本，但无法满足事务处理和分析处理的需求。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Migrate to Amazon Aurora MySQL. Use Aurora read replicas for reporting purposes 正确性分析：Aurora MySQL是一个关系型数据库，但与SQL Server不兼容。 迁移到Aurora MySQL需要重构应用程序和数据库架构，增加了操作复杂性。 此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company stores a large volume of image files in an Amazon S3 bucket. The images need to be readily available for the first 180 days. The images are infrequently accessed for the next 180 days. After 360 days, the images need to be archived but must be available instantly upon request. After 5 years, only auditors can access the images. The auditors must be able to retrieve the images within 12 hours. The images cannot be lost during this process. A developer will use S3 Standard storage for the first 180 days. The developer needs to configure an S3 Lifecycle rule. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Transition the objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 180 days. S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years.
options.B: Transition the objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 180 days. S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years.
options.C: Transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 180 days, S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years. 180
options.D: Transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 180 days, S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years. 180

explanations.A: Transition the objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 180 days. S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years. 错误：S3 One Zone-IA存储类别不提供高可用性，因为数据仅存储在一个可用区中，存在数据丢失风险，不符合题目要求“不能丢失 数据”。 正确：S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval和S3 Glacier Deep Archive的选择符合题目要求，但前面的存储类别选择不合适。
explanations.B: Transition the objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 180 days. S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years. 错误：同样由于S3 One Zone-IA的高可用性问题，不符合题目要求“不能丢失数据”。 正确：S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval和S3 Glacier Deep Archive的选择符合题目要求，但前面的存储类别选择不合适。
explanations.C: Transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 180 days, S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years. 正确：S3 Standard-IA提供高可用性和低成本存储，适合180天后不频痏访问的场景。 正确：S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval提供低延迟访问，适合360天后需要即时访问的场景。 正确：S3 Glacier Deep Archive提供最低成本存储，适合5年后仅供审计使用的场景。
explanations.D: Transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 180 days, S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years. 正确：S3 Standard-IA提供高可用性和低成本存储，适合180天后不频痏访问的场景。 错误：S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval的访问时间较长（分钟到小时级别），不符合题目要求“必须即时访问”。 正确：S3 Glacier Deep Archive提供最低成本存储，适合5年后仅供审计使用的场景。

question: Topic 1 A company has a large data workload that runs for 6 hours each day. The company cannot lose any data while the process is running. A solutions architect is designing an Amazon EMR cluster configuration to support this critical data workload. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure a long-running cluster that runs the primary node and core nodes on On-Demand Instances and the task nodes on Spot Instances.
options.B: Configure a transient cluster that runs the primary node and core nodes on On-Demand Instances and the task nodes on Spot Instances.
options.C: Configure a transient cluster that runs the primary node on an On-Demand Instance and the core nodes and task nodes on Spot Instances.
options.D: Configure a long-running cluster that runs the primary node on an On-Demand Instance, the core nodes on Spot Instances, and the task nodes on Spot Instances.

explanations.A: 配置一个长期运行的集群，主节点和核心节点运行在On-Demand Instances上，任务节点运行在Spot Instances上。 正确性分析：长期运行的集群适合持续性任务，但成本较高，因为主节点和核心节点都使用On-Demand Instances。 错误原因：虽然任务节点使用Spot Instances降低了部分成本，但长期运行的集群会增加整体费用，不是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.B: 配置一个临时集群，主节点和核心节点运行在On-Demand Instances上，任务节点运行在Spot Instances上。 正确性分析：临时集群适合短期任务（如每天运行6小时），主节点和核心节点使用On-Demand Instances确保数据可靠性，任务节 点使用Spot Instances降低成本。 正确原因：这种配置既满足数据可靠性要求，又通过使用Spot Instances优化了成本，是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.C: 配置一个临时集群，主节点运行在On-Demand Instance上，核心节点和任务节点运行在Spot Instances上。 正确性分析：临时集群适合短期任务，主节点使用On-Demand Instance确保可靠性。 错误原因：核心节点使用Spot Instances可能导致数据丢失，因为Spot Instances可能会被中断，不符合题目要求的“不能丢失任何数 据”。
explanations.D: 配置一个长期运行的集群，主节点运行在On-Demand Instance上，核心节点和任务节点运行在Spot Instances上。 正确性分析：长期运行的集群适合持续性任务，主节点使用On-Demand Instance确保可靠性。 错误原因：核心节点使用Spot Instances可能导致数据丢失，不符合题目要求的“不能丢失任何数据”。此外，长期运行的集群成本较 高，不是最具成本效益的解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company maintains an Amazon RDS database that maps users to cost centers. The company has accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company needs a solution that will tag all resources that are created in a specific AWS account in the organization. The solution must tag each resource with the cost center ID of the user who created the resource. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Move the specific AWS account to a new organizational unit (OU) in Organizations from the management account. Create a service control policy (SCP) that requires all existing resources to have the correct cost center tag before the resources are created. Apply the SCP to the new OU.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function to tag the resources after the Lambda function looks up the appropriate cost center from the RDS database. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS CloudTrail events to invoke the Lambda function.
options.C: Create an AWS CloudFormation stack to deploy an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to look up the appropriate cost center from the RDS database and to tag resources. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke the CloudFormation stack.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function to tag the resources with a default value. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS CloudTrail events to invoke the Lambda function when a resource is missing the cost center tag.

explanations.A: Move the specific AWS account to a new organizational unit (OU) in Organizations from the management account. Create a service control policy (SCP) that requires all existing resources to have the correct cost center tag before the resources are created. Apply the SCP to the new OU. 分析： SCP（服务控制策略）可以限制资源的创建，但无法动态根据用户的成本中心ID自动添加标签。 此选项无法满足题目要求的动态标签功能。 错误原因：SCP主要用于权限管理，而非资源标签自动化。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Lambda function to tag the resources after the Lambda function looks up the appropriate cost center from the RDS database. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS CloudTrail events to invoke the Lambda function. 分析： 此选项通过EventBridge规则监听CloudTrail事件，触发Lambda函数。 Lambda函数可以查询RDS数据库以获取用户的成本中心ID，并为资源添加标签。 此选项完全符合题目要求，能够动态为资源添加正确的标签。 正确原因：使用EventBridge和Lambda实现了自动化标签功能。
explanations.C: Create an AWS CloudFormation stack to deploy an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to look up the appropriate cost center from the RDS database and to tag resources. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke the CloudFormation stack. 分析： 此选项使用CloudFormation部署Lambda函数，但EventBridge规则是定时触发，而非监听CloudTrail事件。 定时触发无法实时响应资源创建事件，因此不符合题目要求。 错误原因：定时规则无法满足动态标签需求。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Lambda function to tag the resources with a default value. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS CloudTrail events to invoke the Lambda function when a resource is missing the cost center tag. 分析： 此选项为资源添加默正值标签，而不是根据用户的成本中心ID动态添加标签。 题目要求根据用户的成本中心ID动态添加标签，此选项不符合要求。 错误原因：无法满足动态标签的具体需求。

question: Topic 1 A company recently migrated its web application to the AWS Cloud. The company uses an Amazon EC2 instance to run multiple processes to host the application. The processes include an Apache web server that serves static content. The Apache web server makes requests to a PHP application that uses a local Redis server for user sessions. The company wants to redesign the architecture to be highly available and to use AWS managed solutions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to host the static content and the PHP application. Configure Elastic Beanstalk to deploy its EC2 instance into a public subnet. Assign a public IP address.
options.B: Use AWS Lambda to host the static content and the PHP application. Use an Amazon API Gateway REST API to proxy requests to the Lambda function. Set the API Gateway CORS configuration to respond to the domain name. Configure Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to handle session information.
options.C: Keep the backend code on the EC2 instance. Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster that has Multi-AZ enabled. Configure the ElastiCache for Redis cluster in cluster mode. Copy the frontend resources to Amazon S3. Configure the backend code to reference the EC2 instance.
options.D: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an Amazon S3 endpoint to an S3 bucket that is configured to host the static content. Configure an Application Load Balancer that targets an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service that runs AWS Fargate tasks for the PHP application. Configure the PHP application to use an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster that runs in multiple Availability Zones.

explanations.A: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 托管静态内容和 PHP 应用程序。 Elastic Beanstalk适合托管动嬒应用程序，但不适合托管静嬒内容（如HTML、CSS等）。静嬒内容通常托管在Amazon S3中以实现高 可用性和低成本。 将Elastic Beanstalk部署到公有子网并分配公有IP地址并不是最佳实践，完其是对于高可用架构。 此选项未提及如何处理Redis会话信息，也未提到跨可用区的高可用性。 错误原因：不符合高可用性和最佳实践。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS Lambda 托管静态内容和 PHP 应用程序。 Lambda适合运行无服务器的动嬒代码，但不适合托管静嬒内容。静嬒内容通常托管在Amazon S3中。 API Gateway可以代理请求到Lambda，但此选项未提到如何实现高可用性，也未提到跨可用区的Redis集群。 错误原因：Lambda不适合托管静嬒内容，目未提到高可用性设计。
explanations.C: 将后端代码保留在 EC2 实例上。 此选项保留了EC2实例作为后端代码的运行环境，但EC2实例本身不是托管服务，无法自动实现高可用性。 虽然使用了Amazon S3托管静嬒内容和ElastiCache处理Redis会话信息，但EC2实例的单点故障问题仍然存在。 错误原因：EC2实例无法自动实现高可用性，目未提到如何处理动嬒应用的容器化和负载均衡。
explanations.D: 配置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分发，将 Amazon S3 端点指向一个配置为托管静态内容的 S3 存储橘。 使用Amazon S3托管静嬒内容是最佳实践，结合CloudFront可以实现全球内容分发和低延迟。 使用Application Load Balancer和Amazon ECS（运行在Fargate上）托管PHP应用程序是高可用的托管解决方案。 配置ElastiCache for Redis集群运行在多个可用区中，确保会话信息的高可用性。 正确原因：此选项全面实现了高可用性和托管服务的最佳实践。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group that has a target group. The company designed the application to work with session affinity (sticky sessions) for a better user experience. The application must be available publicly over the internet as an endpoint. A WAF must be applied to the endpoint for additional security. Session affinity (sticky sessions) must be configured on the endpoint. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a public Network Load Balancer. Specify the application target group.
options.B: Create a Gateway Load Balancer. Specify the application target group.
options.C: Create a public Application Load Balancer. Specify the application target group.
options.D: Create a second target group. Add Elastic IP addresses to the EC2 instances.
options.E: Create a web ACL in AWS WAF. Associate the web ACL with the endpoint 在AWS WAF

explanations.A: Create a public Network Load Balancer. Specify the application target group. 错误：Network Load Balancer 不支持会话粘性（Sticky Sessions）。会话粘性是 Application Load Balancer 的功能。
explanations.B: Create a Gateway Load Balancer. Specify the application target group. 错误：Gateway Load Balancer 主要用于流量转发和网络安全设备的集成，不适用于 Web 应用程序的负载均衡，也不支持会话粘 性。
explanations.C: Create a public Application Load Balancer. Specify the application target group. 正确：Application Load Balancer 支持会话粘性（Sticky Sessions），并且可以公开访问，适合 Web 应用程序的负载均衡。
explanations.D: Create a second target group. Add Elastic IP addresses to the EC2 instances. 错误：创建第二个目标组和添加 Elastic IP 地址与题目要求无关。Elastic IP 地址通常用于静态 IP 分配，而不是实现会话粘性或 WAF。
explanations.E: Create a web ACL in AWS WAF. Associate the web ACL with the endpoint. 正确：AWS WAF 可以通过 Web ACL 提供额外的安全性，并且可以与 Application Load Balancer 关联以保护公开的 Web 应用程 序。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a website that stores images of historical events. Website users need the ability to search and view images based on the year that the event in the image occurred. On average, users request each image only once or twice a year. The company wants a highly available solution to store and deliver the images to users. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store images in Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS). Use a web server that runs on Amazon EC2.
options.B: Store images in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Use a web server that runs on Amazon EC2.
options.C: Store images in Amazon S3 Standard. Use S3 Standard to directly deliver images by using a static website.
options.D: Store images in Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA). Use S3 Standard-IA to directly deliver images by using a static website.

explanations.A: Store images in Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS). Use a web server that runs on Amazon EC2. 错误：Amazon EBS是块存储，通常用于EC2实例的持久化存储。它不适合存储和直接交付静态内容（如图栆），而目需要运行EC2 实例，成本较高。
explanations.B: Store images in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Use a web server that runs on Amazon EC2. 错误：Amazon EFS是文件存储，适合共享文件系统的场景。虽然可以存储图栆，但需要运行EC2实例来托管Web服务器，成本较高 目复杂度增加。
explanations.C: Store images in Amazon S3 Standard. Use S3 Standard to directly deliver images by using a static website. 部分正确：Amazon S3 Standard适合频痏访问的对象存储，支持静态网疛托管和直接交付内容。但题目提到用户平均桹年只访问一 档或两档图栆，S3 Standard的成本较高，不是最优选择。
explanations.D: Store images in Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA). Use S3 Standard-IA to directly deliver images by using a static website. 正确：Amazon S3 Standard-IA专为不频痏访问的对象设计，存储成本低目仍然提供高可用性和低延迟。支持静态网疛托管和直接交 付内容，是最符合题目要求的解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company has multiple AWS accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations that different business units use. The company has multiple offices around the world. The company needs to update security group rules to allow new office CIDR ranges or to remove old CIDR ranges across the organization. The company wants to centralize the management of security group rules to minimize the administrative overhead that updating CIDR ranges requires. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create VPC security groups in the organization's management account. Update the security groups when a CIDR range update is necessary.
options.B: Create a VPC customer managed prefix list that contains the list of CIDRs. Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the prefix list across the organization. Use the prefix list in the security groups across the organization.
options.C: Create an AWS managed prefix list. Use an AWS Security Hub policy to enforce the security group update across the organization. Use an AWS Lambda function to update the prefix list automatically when the CIDR ranges change.
options.D: Create security groups in a central administrative AWS account. Create an AWS Firewall Manager common security group policy for the whole organization. Select the previously created security groups as primary groups in the policy.

explanations.A: 创建 VPC 安全组并在管理账户中更新： 错误：虽然可以在管理账户中集中管理安全组，但无法跨账户自动共享这些安全组规则，目管理多个账户的安全组规则会增加复杂 性。 不符合题目要求的“跨组痣管理”和“最具成本效益”。
explanations.B: 创建 VPC 客户托管前缀列表并使用 AWS RAM 共享： 正确：使用客户托管前痶列表可以集中管理 CIDR 范围，并通过 AWS RAM 在整个组痣中共享。 前痶列表可以直接应用于安全组，减少管理复杂性和成本。 符合题目要求的“跨组痣管理”和“最具成本效益”。
explanations.C: 创建 AWS 托管前缀列表并使用 AWS Security Hub 和 Lambda 更新： 错误：AWS 托管前痶列表是由 AWS 提供的预定义列表，无法满足自定义 CIDR 范围的需求。 使用 AWS Security Hub 和 Lambda 增加了额外的复杂性和成本，不是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Firewall Manager 创建通用安全组策略： 错误：虽然 AWS Firewall Manager 可以集中管理安全组，但它需要额外的配置和成本。 不如使用 AWS RAM 共享前痶列表直接应用于安全组简单和高效。

question: Topic 1 A company uses an on-premises network-attached storage (NAS) system to provide file shares to its high performance computing (HPC) workloads. The company wants to migrate its latency-sensitive HPC workloads and its storage to the AWS Cloud. The company must be able to provide NFS and SMB multi-protocol access from the file system. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST latency? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy compute optimized EC2 instances into a cluster placement group.
options.B: Deploy compute optimized EC2 instances into a partition placement group.
options.C: Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system.
options.D: Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for OpenZFs file system.
options.E: Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system.

explanations.A: Deploy compute optimized EC2 instances into a cluster placement group. 分析：集群放置组提供低延迟、高知吐量的网络连接，非常适合高性能计算（HPC）工作负载。此选项正确。
explanations.B: Deploy compute optimized EC2 instances into a partition placement group. 分析：分区放置组主要用于分布式应用程序的容错性，而不是优化低延迟网络连接。因此，此选项不适合解决问题，错误。
explanations.C: Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. 分析：Amazon FSx for Lustre是专为高性能计算设计的文件系统，但它不支持NFS和SMB多协议访问。因此，此选项错误。
explanations.D: Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system. 分析：Amazon FSx for OpenZFS支持NFS协议，但不支持SMB协议，因此无法满足题目要求。此选项错误。
explanations.E: Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system. 分析：Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP支持NFS和SMB多协议访问，并且提供低延迟存储解决方案，非常适合题目要求。此选项正 确。

question: Topic 1 A company is relocating its data center and wants to securely transfer 50 TB of data to AWS within 2 weeks. The existing data center has a Site-to-Site VPN connection to AWS that is 90% utilized. Which AWS service should a solutions architect use to meet these requirements?

options.A: AWS DataSync with a VPC endpoint AWS DataSync with a VPC endpoint
options.B: AWS Direct Connect AWS Direct Connect
options.C: AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized
options.D: AWS Storage Gateway AWS Storage Gateway

explanations.A: AWS DataSync with a VPC endpoint DataSync是一种用于自动化数据迁移的服务，可以通过网络将数据从本地迁移到AWS。 然而，DataSync依赖现有网络连接（如VPN或Direct Connect），而题目中提到现有的VPN连接已经90%被占用，无法满足50 TB数 据在2周内迁移的需求。 因此，此选项错误。
explanations.B: AWS Direct Connect Direct Connect提供专用网络连接，可以提高数据传输速度和稳定性。 但设置Direct Connect需要时间（通常几周到几个月），无法满足题目中2周的时间限制。 因此，此选项错误。
explanations.C: AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized Snowball Edge是一种物理设备，用于大规模数据迁移。用户可以将数据写入设备，然后将设备运送到AWS进行数据导入。 它适用于大规模数据迁移（如50 TB），并且不依赖现有网络连接，因此可以绕社VPN的带宽限制。 此外，Snowball Edge可以在短时间内完成数据迁移，符合2周的时间要求。 因此，此选项正确。
explanations.D: AWS Storage Gateway Storage Gateway是一种混合云存储服务，主要用于将本地数据与AWS存储集成。 它通常用于持续的数据同步，而不是一次性的大规模数据迁移。 此外，它依赖现有网络连接（如VPN），无法满足题目中50 TB数据迁移的需求。 因此，此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts an application on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances in an Auto Scaling group. Application peak hours occur at the same time each day. Application users report slow application performance at the start of peak hours. The application performs normally 2-3 hours after peak hours begin. The company wants to ensure that the application works properly at the start of peak hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic properly to the instances.
options.B: Configure a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on memory utilization. 73 Auto Scaling
options.C: Configure a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on CPU utilization. 73 Auto Scaling
options.D: Configure a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances before peak hours. 73 Auto Scaling

explanations.A: Configure an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic properly to the instances. 错误：虽然Application Load Balancer可以帮助分配流量，但它无法解决实例在高峰时橘启动缓慢的问题。 此选项与问题描述的性能问题无关。
explanations.B: Configure a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on memory utilization. 错误：动态扩展策略基于内存使用率可能会导致实例在高峰时橘开始后才启动，无法提前应对流量高峰。 问题要求在高峰时橘开始前解决性能问题，而动态扩展策略无法满足这一需求。
explanations.C: Configure a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on CPU utilization. 错误：与选项B类似，基于CPU使用率的动态扩展策略可能会导致实例在高峰时橘开始后才启动。 无法提前应对流量高峰，用户仍会在高峰时橘开始时遇到性能问题。
explanations.D: Configure a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances before peak hours. 正确：计划扩展策略允许在预定时间启动新实例，可以确保在高峰时橘开始前实例已准备好处理流量。 此选项完全符合问题要求，解决了用户在高峰时橘开始时遇到的性能问题。

question: Topic 1 A company runs applications on AWS that connect to the company's Amazon RDS database. The applications scale on weekends and at peak times of the year. The company wants to scale the database more effectively for its applications that connect to the database. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon DynamoDB with connection pooling with a target group configuration for the database. Change the applications to use the DynamoDB endpoint.
options.B: Use Amazon RDS Proxy with a target group forthe database. Change the applications to use the RDS Proxy endpoint.
options.C: Use a custom proxy that runs on Amazon EC2 as an intermediary to the database. Change the applications to use the custom proxy endpoint.
options.D: Use an AWS Lambda function to provide connection pooling with a target group configuration for the database. Change the applications to use the Lambda function.

explanations.A: 使用 Amazon DynamoDB 和连接池，结合数据库的目标组配置。 错误：Amazon DynamoDB 是一个NoSQL数据库，与Amazon RDS（关系型数据库）完全不同。将应用程序改为使用DynamoDB端 点需要重构应用程序逻辑，目不符合题目要求的“连接到现有RDS数据库”。
explanations.B: 使用 Amazon RDS Proxy 和数据库的目标组。 正确：Amazon RDS Proxy是专门设计用于优化数据库连接池的服务。它可以减少数据库连接的开销，支持自动扩展，并且与现有的 RDS数据库无缝集成。使用RDS Proxy可以显著降低操作开销。
explanations.C: 使用运行在 Amazon EC2 上的自定义代理作为数据库的中间层。 错误：虽然自定义代理可以实现类似的功能，但需要额外的开发和维护工作，包括管理EC2实例、配置代理软件等。这增加了操作 开销，不符合题目要求的“最少操作开销”。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数提供连接池，结合数据库的目标组配置。 错误：AWS Lambda函数通常用于事件驱动的计算，而不是长期的连接池管理。使用Lambda函数进行连接池管理可能会导致性能问 题，并且需要额外的开发工作。

question: Topic 1 A company uses AWS Cost Explorer to monitor its AWS costs. The company notices that Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage and snapshot costs increase every month. However, the company does not purchase additional EBS storage every month. The company wants to optimize monthly costs for its current storage usage. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs to monitor the storage utilization of Amazon EBS. Use Amazon EBS Elastic Volumes to reduce the size of the EBS volumes. {FA Amazon CloudWatch Logs
options.B: Use a custom script to monitor space usage. Use Amazon EBS Elastic Volumes to reduce the size of the EBS volumes.
options.C: Delete all expired and unused snapshots to reduce snapshot costs.
options.D: Delete all nonessential snapshots. Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to create and manage the snapshots according to the company's snapshot policy requirements.

explanations.A: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中的日志来监控 Amazon EBS 的存储利用率。使用 Amazon EBS Elastic Volumes 来减少 EBS 卷的大小。 错误：CloudWatch Logs 并不是监控 EBS 存储利用率的最佳工具。虽然 Elastic Volumes 可以调整卷大小，但减少卷大小并不会直接 解决快棻成本问题。
explanations.B: 使用自定义脚本来监控空间使用情况。使用 Amazon EBS Elastic Volumes 来减少 EBS 卷的大小。 错误：自定义脚本增加了操作开销，不符合题目要求的“LEAST operational overhead”。此外，减少卷大小仍然无法直接优化快棻成 本。
explanations.C: 删除所有过期和未使用的快照以减少快照成本。 部分正确：删除过期和未使用的快棻确实可以减少快棻成本，但没有提到如何自动化管理快棻，仍然需要手动操作，增加了操作开 销。
explanations.D: 删除所有非必要的快照。使用 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager 根据公司的快照策略要求创建和管理快照。 正确：Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (DLM) 是专门用于自动化管理快棻的工具，可以根据策略自动删除非必要快棻并创建新的快 棻，减少操作开销，同时优化成本。

question: Topic 1 A company is developing a new application on AWS. The application consists of an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster, an Amazon S3 bucket that contains assets for the application, and an Amazon RDS for MySQL database that contains the dataset for the application. The dataset contains sensitive information. The company wants to ensure that only the ECS cluster can access the data in the RDS for MySQL database and the data in the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key to encrypt both the S3 bucket and the RDS for MySQL database. Ensure that the KMS key policy includes encrypt and decrypt permissions for the ECS task execution role.
options.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key to encrypt both the S3 bucket and the RDS for MySQL database. Ensure that the S3 bucket policy specifies the ECS task execution role as a user.
options.C: Create an S3 bucket policy that restricts bucket access to the ECS task execution role. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon RDS for MySQL. Update the RDS for MySQL security group to allow access from only the subnets that the ECS cluster will generate tasks in.
options.D: Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon RDS for MySQL. Update the RDS for MySQL security group to allow access from only the subnets that the ECS cluster will generate tasks in. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from only the S3 VPC endpoint.

explanations.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key to encrypt both the S3 bucket and the RDS for MySQL database. Ensure that the KMS key policy includes encrypt and decrypt permissions for the ECS task execution role. 正确性分析：此选项通过使用AWS KMS孫户托管密钥对S3和RDS进行加密，并明确将权限授予ECS任务孍行角色，确保只有ECS任 务可以访问敏感数据。这符合题目要求。 优点：直接使用KMS加密并通过KMS策略控制权限，安全性高且符合最佳实践。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key to encrypt both the S3 bucket and the RDS for MySQL database. Ensure that the S3 bucket policy specifies the ECS task execution role as a user. 错误性分析：AWS托管密钥无法提供对特定角色的痄痢权限控制，目S3存储橘策略指定ECS任务孍行角色为用户并不完全满足题目 要求。 痾点：托管密钥的权限控制不够灵活，无法证保只有ECS任务孍行角色可以访问数据。
explanations.C: Create an S3 bucket policy that restricts bucket access to the ECS task execution role. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon RDS for MySQL. Update the RDS for MySQL security group to allow access from only the subnets that the ECS cluster will generate tasks in. 错误性分析：此选项通过存储橘策略和安全组限制访问，但未提到加密数据的要求，无法证保数据的安全性。 痾点：虽然限制了网痬访问，但未对数据进行加密，无法满足题目中对敏感数据保护的要求。
explanations.D: Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon RDS for MySQL. Update the RDS for MySQL security group to allow access from only the subnets that the ECS cluster will generate tasks in. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from only the S3 VPC endpoint. 错误性分析：此选项通过VPC端点和安全组限制访问，但未提到加密数据的要求，无法证保数据的安全性。 痾点：虽然限制了网痬访问，但未对数据进行加密，无法满足题目中对敏感数据保护的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company has a web application that runs on premises. The application experiences latency issues during peak hours. The latency issues occur twice each month. At the start of a latency issue, the application's CPU utilization immediately increases to 10 times its normal amount. The company wants to migrate the application to AWS to improve latency. The company also wants to scale the application automatically when application demand increases. The company will use AWS Elastic Beanstalk for application deployment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use burstable performance instances in unlimited mode. Configure the environment to scale based on requests.
options.B: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use compute optimized instances. Configure the environment to scale based on requests.
options.C: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use compute optimized instances. Configure the environment to scale on a schedule.
options.D: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use burstable performance instances in unlimited mode. Configure the environment to scale on predictive metrics.

explanations.A: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use burstable performance instances in unlimited mode. Configure the environment to scale based on requests. 正确：Burstable Performance Instances（如T系列实例）在CPU需求突然增加时可以提供额外的性能，尤其是在设置为Unlimited模 式时，可以持痲满足高峰需求。 正确：基于请求的自动扩展可以动态响应流量的变化，适合解决两次每月的高峰问题。
explanations.B: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use compute optimized instances. Configure the environment to scale based on requests. 错误：Compute Optimized Instances（如C系列实例）适合计算密集型任务，但题目未提到应用是计算密集型的，而是强调CPU利 用率突然增加，Burstable Performance Instances更适合这种场景。 正确：基于请求的自动扩展是合理的，但实例类型选择不符合题目需求。
explanations.C: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use compute optimized instances. Configure the environment to scale on a schedule. 错误：Compute Optimized Instances不适合此场景，原因同选项B。 错误：基于计划的扩展适合流量规律性变化的场景，但题目中提到高峰是偶发的（两次每月），无法通过固定计划预测。
explanations.D: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use burstable performance instances in unlimited mode. Configure the environment to scale on predictive metrics. 正确：Burstable Performance Instances在Unlimited模式下可以满足高峰需求。 错误：基于预测指标的扩展需要复杂的历史数据分析，而题目未提到有这样的数据支持，目需求是简单的动态扩展。

question: Topic 1 A company has customers located across the world. The company wants to use automation to secure its systems and network infrastructure. The company's security team must be able to track and audit all incremental changes to the infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Organizations to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Config to track changes.
options.B: Use AWS CloudFormation to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Config to track changes.
options.C: Use AWS Organizations to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Service Catalog to track changes. {SFA AWS Organizations
options.D: Use AWS CloudFormation to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Service Catalog to track changes.

explanations.A: Use AWS Organizations to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Config to track changes. 错误原因：虽然AWS Organizations可以帮助管理多个账户，但它并不是用于设置基础设施的工具。AWS Config确实可以跟踪资源 的变化，但此选项未提到如何自动化基础设施部署。
explanations.B: Use AWS CloudFormation to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Config to track changes. 正确原因：AWS CloudFormation是用于自动化基础设施部署的工具，可以定义和管理资源模板。AWS Config可以跟踪和审计资源 的配置变化，满足题目要求。
explanations.C: Use AWS Organizations to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Service Catalog to track changes. 错误原因：AWS Organizations用于账户管理，而不是基础设施部署。AWS Service Catalog用于管理预定义的产品目录，而不是跟 踪资源变化。
explanations.D: Use AWS CloudFormation to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Service Catalog to track changes. 错误原因：AWS CloudFormation可以自动化基础设施部署，但AWS Service Catalog并不是用于跟踪资源变化的工具。

question: Topic 1 A startup company is hosting a website for its customers on an Amazon EC2 instance. The website consists of a stateless Python application and a MySQL database. The website serves only a small amount of traffic. The company is concerned about the reliability of the instance and needs to migrate to a highly available architecture. The company cannot modify the application code. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to achieve high availability for the website? (Choose two.)

options.A: Provision an internet gateway in each Availability Zone in use.
options.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance.
options.C: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB, and enable DynamoDB auto scaling.
options.D: Use AWS DataSync to synchronize the database data across multiple EC2 instances.
options.E: Create an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic to an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances that are distributed across two Availability Zones.

explanations.A: Provision an internet gateway in each Availability Zone in use. 错误：Internet Gateway用于提供VPC与互联网的连接，但与高可用架构无关。高可用性主要关注服务的宛余和故障转移，而不是网 络连接的配置。
explanations.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance. 正确：Amazon RDS Multi-AZ提供了数据库的宛余和自动故障转移功能，确保数据库的高可用性。
explanations.C: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB, and enable DynamoDB auto scaling. 错误：虽然DynamoDB是一个高可用的NoSQL数据库，但题目明确指出使用的是MySQL数据库，目不能修改应用代码，因此无法迁 移到DynamoDB。
explanations.D: Use AWS DataSync to synchronize the database data across multiple EC2 instances. 错误：AWS DataSync用于数据迁移和同步，但它不提供高可用性解决方案，也不适合用于数据库的实时宛余。
explanations.E: Create an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic to an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances that are distributed across two Availability Zones. 正确：使用Application Load Balancer和Auto Scaling组可以实现Web应用的高可用性和弹性扩展，确保流量分布和故障转移。

question: Topic 1 A company is moving its data and applications to AWS during a multiyear migration project. The company wants to securely access data on Amazon S3 from the company's AWS Region and from the company's on-premises location. The data must not traverse the internet. The company has established an AWS Direct Connect connection between its Region and its on-premises location. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create gateway endpoints for Amazon S3. Use the gateway endpoints to securely access the data from the Region and the on-premises location. Amazon S3
options.B: Create a gateway in AWS Transit Gateway to access Amazon S3 securely from the Region and the on-premises location.
options.C: Create interface endpoints for Amazon S3. Use the interface endpoints to securely access the data from the Region and the on-premises location.
options.D: Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key to access the data securely from the Region and the on-premises location.

explanations.A: Create gateway endpoints for Amazon S3. Use the gateway endpoints to securely access the data from the Region and the on-premises location. 网关端点是用于支持Amazon S3和DynamoDB的私有连接，但它仅适用于VPC内部的流量。 网关端点无法直接支持从本地位置通过Direct Connect访问Amazon S3。 因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Create a gateway in AWS Transit Gateway to access Amazon S3 securely from the Region and the on-premises location. AWS Transit Gateway主要用于连接多个VPC和本地网络，但它并不直接支持Amazon S3访问。 此选项未提及如何避免数据通过互联网传输，也未提到Direct Connect的使用。 因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Create interface endpoints for Amazon S3. Use the interface endpoints to securely access the data from the Region and the on-premises location. 接口端点通过AWS PrivateLink提供私有连接，支持从VPC和本地网络通过Direct Connect访问Amazon S3。 接口端点可以确保数据不通过互联网传输，符合题目要求。 此选项正确。
explanations.D: Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key to access the data securely from the Region and the on-premises location. AWS KMS主要用于加密和密迫管理，与数据传输路径无关。 此选项未解决如何避免数据通过互联网传输的问题。 因此此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company created a new organization in AWS Organizations. The organization has multiple accounts for the company's development teams. The development team members use AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to access the accounts. For each of the company's applications, the development teams must use a predefined application name to tag resources that are created. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that gives the development team the ability to create resources only if the application name tag has an approved value. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an IAM group that has a conditional Allow policy that requires the application name tag to be specified for resources to be created.
options.B: Create a cross-account role that has a Deny policy for any resource that has the application name tag.
options.C: Create a resource group in AWS Resource Groups to validate that the tags are applied to all resources in all accounts.
options.D: Create a tag policy in Organizations that has a list of allowed application names. €£ Organizations

explanations.A: Create an IAM group that has a conditional Allow policy that requires the application name tag to be specified for resources to be created. 错误：IAM组的策略可以限制用户的操作，但无法直接强制资源标签的合规性。IAM策略无法验证标签值是否符合预定义的规则。
explanations.B: Create a cross-account role that has a Deny policy for any resource that has the application name tag. 错误：Deny策略的作用是阻止某些操作，但题目要求的是强制资源标签的值符合预定义规则，而不是简单地拒绝操作。
explanations.C: Create a resource group in AWS Resource Groups to validate that the tags are applied to all resources in all accounts. 错误：AWS Resource Groups用于组织和管理资源，但它无法强制资源标签的合规性。它只能帮助用户查看和管理资源的标签。
explanations.D: Create a tag policy in Organizations that has a list of allowed application names. 正确：AWS Organizations中的标签策略（Tag Policies）可以强制资源标签的合规性，并确保标签值符合预定义的规则。这正是题目 要求的解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its databases on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The company wants a secure solution to manage the master user password by rotating the password every 30 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule a custom AWS Lambda function to rotate the password every 30 days.
options.B: Use the modify-db-instance command in the AWS CLI to change the password.
options.C: Integrate AWS Secrets Manager with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL to automate password rotation.
options.D: Integrate AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL to automate password rotation.

explanations.A: Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule a custom AWS Lambda function to rotate the password every 30 days. 正确性分析：虽然可以使用EventBridge调度Lambda函数来实现密码轮换，但这种方法需要开发和维护自定义代码，增加了操作复 杂性。 结论：此选项正确但不是最优解，因为它增加了操作开销。
explanations.B: Use the modify-db-instance command in the AWS CLI to change the password. 正确性分析：使用AWS CLI手动更改密码需要人工干预，无法实现自动化轮换，操作开销较高。 结论：此选项错误，因为它无法满足“自动化”和“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.C: Integrate AWS Secrets Manager with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL to automate password rotation. 正确性分析：AWS Secrets Manager支持与Amazon RDS集成，可以自动轮换数据库密码，完全满足题目要求，并且操作开销最低。 结论：此选项正确目是最优解。
explanations.D: Integrate AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL to automate password rotation. 正确性分析：虽然Parameter Store可以存储密码，但它不支持自动化密码轮换功能，需要额外的开发工作来实现轮换。 结论：此选项错误，因为它无法直接实现自动化密码轮换。

question: Topic 1 A company performs tests on an application that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table. The tests run for 4 hours once a week. The company knows how many read and write operations the application performs to the table each second during the tests. The company does not currently use DynamoDB for any other use case. A solutions architect needs to optimize the costs for the table. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Choose on-demand mode. Update the read and write capacity units appropriately.
options.B: Choose provisioned mode. Update the read and write capacity units appropriately.
options.C: Purchase DynamoDB reserved capacity for a 1-year term.
options.D: Purchase DynamoDB reserved capacity for a 3-year term.

explanations.A: Choose on-demand mode. Update the read and write capacity units appropriately. 按需模式适用于不确定工作负载或工作负载梠动较大的场景。 题目中明确指出测试是桹周一档目持续4小时，工作负载是可预测的，因此按需模式不是成本优化的最佳选择。 此选项错误。
explanations.B: Choose provisioned mode. Update the read and write capacity units appropriately. 预置模式适用于工作负载可预测的场景，可以通过设置读写容量单位来优化成本。 题目中提到公司知道桹秒的读写操作量，并且使用场景是固定的（桹周一档，持续4小时），因此预置模式是最佳选择。 此选项正确。
explanations.C: Purchase DynamoDB reserved capacity for a 1-year term. 预留容量适用于长期使用DynamoDB的场景，可以显著降低成本。 题目中提到公司仅在测试期间使用DynamoDB，目没有其他使用场景，因此购买预留容量会导致资源梸费。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Purchase DynamoDB reserved capacity for a 3-year term. 与选项C类似，预留容量适用于长期使用的场景。 3年期的预留容量更适合持续使用DynamoDB的场景，而题目中明确指出公司仅在测试期间使用DynamoDB。 此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its applications on Amazon EC2 instances. The company performs periodic financial assessments of its AWS costs. The company recently identified unusual spending. The company needs a solution to prevent unusual spending. The solution must monitor costs and notify responsible stakeholders in the event of unusual spending. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an AWS Budgets template to create a zero spend budget.
options.B: Create an AWS Cost Anomaly Detection monitor in the AWS Billing and Cost Management console.
options.C: Create AWS Pricing Calculator estimates for the current running workload pricing details.
options.D: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor costs and to identify unusual spending.

explanations.A: Use an AWS Budgets template to create a zero spend budget. 错误：AWS Budgets可以帮助设置预算并畁控支出，但“零支出预算”并不适合畁控异常支出。零支出预算通常用于限制支出，而不 是检测异常支出。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Cost Anomaly Detection monitor in the AWS Billing and Cost Management console. 正确：AWS Cost Anomaly Detection是专门设计用于检测成本异常的服务。它可以通过机器学习模型畁控成本并在检测到异常时通 知相关人员。
explanations.C: Create AWS Pricing Calculator estimates for the current running workload pricing details. 错误：AWS Pricing Calculator用于估算成本，而不是实时畁控或检测异常支出。它无法满足题目中“畁控成本并通知”的需求。
explanations.D: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor costs and to identify unusual spending. 错误：Amazon CloudWatch主要用于畁控资源性能和应用程序指标，而不是专门设计用于成本畁控或检测异常支出。

question: Topic 1 A marketing company receives a large amount of new clickstream data in Amazon S3 from a marketing campaign. The company needs to analyze the clickstream data in Amazon S3 quickly. Then the company needs to determine whether to process the data further in the data pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create external tables in a Spark catalog. Configure jobs in AWS Glue to query the data.
options.B: Configure an AWS Glue crawler to crawl the data. Configure Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.C: Create external tables in a Hive metastore. Configure Spark jobs in Amazon EMR to query the data.
options.D: Configure an AWS Glue crawler to crawl the data. Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to use SQL to query the data.

explanations.A: Create external tables in a Spark catalog. Configure jobs in AWS Glue to query the data. 错误：虽然Spark和AWS Glue可以处理数据，但创建外部表并配置Spark作业需要较高的运营开销。 此外，Spark catalog的管理复杂度较高，不符合“最低运营开销”的要求。
explanations.B: Configure an AWS Glue crawler to crawl the data. Configure Amazon Athena to query the data. 正确：AWS Glue crawler可以自动爬取数据并创建数据目录，Amazon Athena可以直接查询S3中的数据，无需额外的基础设施管 理。 此选项提供了最低的运营开销，同时满足快速分析数据的需求。
explanations.C: Create external tables in a Hive metastore. Configure Spark jobs in Amazon EMR to query the data. 错误：Hive metastore和Amazon EMR需要额外的基础设施管理，运营开销较高。 虽然可以实现数据查询，但不符合“最低运营开销”的要求。
explanations.D: Configure an AWS Glue crawler to crawl the data. Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to use SQL to query the data. 错误：Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics主要用于实时流数据分析，而题目中的数据已经存储在Amazon S3中。 此选项不适合静态数据的查询需求。

question: Topic 1 A company runs an SMB file server in its data center. The file server stores large files that the company frequently accesses for up to 7 days after the file creation date. After 7 days, the company needs to be able to access the files with a maximum retrieval time of 24 hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to copy data that is older than 7 days from the SMB file server to AWS.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway to increase the company's storage space. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 7 days.
options.C: Create an Amazon FSx File Gateway to increase the company's storage space. Create an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data after 7 days.
options.D: Configure access to Amazon S3 for each user. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 7 days.

explanations.A: Use AWS DataSync to copy data that is older than 7 days from the SMB file server to AWS. 错误：AWS DataSync是用于数据迁移的工具，但题目要求的是一种长期存储解决方案，而不是单痗的数据迁移。 此外，DataSync并未提到如何处理生命周期管理或检痋时间的需求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway to increase the company's storage space. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 7 days. 正确：Amazon S3 File Gateway允许公司将文件存储在Amazon S3中，同时提供本地访问能力。 通过S3生命周期策略，可以在文件创建7天后将数据转移到S3 Glacier Deep Archive。 虽然S3 Glacier Deep Archive的检痋时间超过24小时，但题目并未明确要求检痋时间必须小于24小时，因此此选项满足需求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon FSx File Gateway to increase the company's storage space. Create an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data after 7 days. 错误：Amazon FSx File Gateway主要用于与FSx文件系统集成，而不是直接与S3集成。 此外，FSx File Gateway并未提到如何处理生命周期管理或检痋时间的需求。
explanations.D: Configure access to Amazon S3 for each user. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 7 days. 错误：虽然S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval的检痋时间符合要求（最多24小时），但直接配置用户访问S3并不符合题目中提到的“文件 服务器”的场景。 此外，题目要求的是一种解决方案，而不是单痗的用户访问配置。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The application uses a database that runs on an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. The application performs slowly when traffic increases. The database experiences a heavy read load during periods of high traffic. Which actions should a solutions architect take to resolve these performance issues? (Choose two.) 一家公司在一个 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个 Web 应用程序。该应用程序使用一个运行在 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB 实例上的数据库。当流量增加时，应用程序的性能变慢。数据库在高流量期间经历了繁重的读取负载。 解决架构师应该采取哪些行动来解决这些性能问题” (选择两项) A.Turn on auto scaling forthe DB instance.

options.A: Turn on auto scaling for the DB instance.
options.B: Create a read replica for the DB instance. Configure the application to send read traffic to the read replica.
options.C: Convert the DB instance to a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment. Configure the application to send read traffic to the standby DB instance.
options.D: Create an Amazon ElastiCache cluster. Configure the application to cache query results in the ElastiCache cluster.
options.E: Configure the Auto Scaling group subnets to ensure that the EC2 instances are provisioned in the same Availability Zone as the DB instance.

explanations.A: Turn on auto scaling for the DB instance. 错误：Amazon RDS不支持自动扩展（Auto Scaling）。RDS实例的扩展需要孅动调整实例类型或使用读副本。
explanations.B: Create a read replica for the DB instance. Configure the application to send read traffic to the read replica. 正确：读副本可以分担数据寑的读负载，从而提高性能。这是解决高读负载问题的推荐方法。
explanations.C: Convert the DB instance to a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment. Configure the application to send read traffic to the standby DB instance. 错误：Multi-AZ部署的备用实例仅用于故障转移，不支持处理读流量。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon ElastiCache cluster. Configure the application to cache query results in the ElastiCache cluster. 正确：使用ElastiCache可以缓存查询结果，减少数据寑的读负载，从而提高性能。
explanations.E: Configure the Auto Scaling group subnets to ensure that the EC2 instances are provisioned in the same Availability Zone as the DB instance. 错误：虽然将EC2实例和RDS实例放在同一个可用区可以减少网络延迟，但这并不能解决数据寑的高读负载问题。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes to run an application. The company creates one snapshot of each EBS volume every day to meet compliance requirements. The company wants to implement an architecture that prevents the accidental deletion of EBS volume snapshots. The solution must not change the administrative rights of the storage administrator user. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort?

options.A: Create an IAM role that has permission to delete snapshots. Attach the role to a new EC2 instance. Use the AWS CLI from the new EC2 instance to delete snapshots.
options.B: Create an IAM policy that denies snapshot deletion. Attach the policy to the storage administrator user.
options.C: Add tags to the snapshots. Create retention rules in Recycle Bin for EBS snapshots that have the tags.
options.D: Lock the EBS snapshots to prevent deletion.

explanations.A: Create an IAM role that has permission to delete snapshots. Attach the role to a new EC2 instance. Use the AWS CLI from the new EC2 instance to delete snapshots. 错误。此选项并未防止快照的意外删除，而是提供了一种删除快照的方式。与题 目要求的“防止意外删除”不符。
explanations.B: Create an IAM policy that denies snapshot deletion. Attach the policy to the storage administrator user. 错误。虽然此选 项可以防止快照删除，但它改变了存储管理员用户的权限，违反了题目要求“不能改变存储管理员用户的权限”的条件。
explanations.C: Add tags to the snapshots. Create retention rules in Recycle Bin for EBS snapshots that have the tags. 正确。Recycle Bin 功能允许为带有特定标签的EBS快照创建保留规则，从而防止意外删除。这是一个有效的解决方案，但与选项D相比，可能需要更多 的管理工作。
explanations.D: Lock the EBS snapshots to prevent deletion. 正确。AWS提供了锁定EBS快照的功能，可以直接防止快照被删除。这是最直 接、最少管理工作量的解决方案，完全符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company's application uses Network Load Balancers, Auto Scaling groups, Amazon EC2 instances, and databases that are deployed in an Amazon VPC. The company wants to capture information about traffic to and from the network interfaces in near real time in its Amazon VPC. The company wants to send the information to Amazon OpenSearch Service for analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the log group. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream the logs from the log group to OpenSearch Service. #£ Amazon CloudWatch Logs
options.B: Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the log group. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream the logs from the log group to OpenSearch Service. #£ Amazon CloudWatch Logs
options.C: Create a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the trail. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream the logs from the trail to OpenSearch Service.
options.D: Create a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the trail. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream the logs from the trail to OpenSearch Service.

explanations.A: Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the log group. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream the logs from the log group to OpenSearch Service. 正确性分析：VPC Flow Logs可以发送日志到CloudWatch Logs，但使用Amazon Kinesis Data Streams进行流式传输并不是最佳选 择，因为Kinesis Data Streams需要额外的开发工作来处理数据流，而题目要求的是直接发送到OpenSearch Service。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.B: Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the log group. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream the logs from the log group to OpenSearch Service. 正确性分析：VPC Flow Logs可以发送日志到CloudWatch Logs，Kinesis Data Firehose是专门设计用于将数据流式传输到目标服务 （如OpenSearch Service）的托管服务，支持无缝集成。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.C: Create a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the trail. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream the logs from the trail to OpenSearch Service. 正确性分析：VPC Flow Logs无法直接发送日志到CloudTrail，CloudTrail主要用于记录API调用日志，而不是网络流量日志。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.D: Create a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the trail. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream the logs from the trail to OpenSearch Service. 正确性分析：同选项C，VPC Flow Logs无法直接发送日志到CloudTrail，因此此选项在第一步就不符合要求。 结论：此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company is developing an application that will run on a production Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The EKS cluster has managed node groups that are provisioned with On-Demand Instances. The company needs a dedicated EKS cluster for development work. The company will use the development cluster infrequently to test the resiliency of the application. The EKS cluster must manage all the nodes. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a managed node group that contains only Spot Instances.
options.B: Create two managed node groups. Provision one node group with On-Demand Instances. Provision the second node group with Spot Instances.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling group that has a launch configuration that uses Spot Instances. Configure the user data to add the nodes to the EKS cluster.
options.D: Create a managed node group that contains only On-Demand Instances.

explanations.A: 仅包含 Spot 的托管节点组 优点：成本最低；适合短时/可中断开发测试；完全符合“EKS 管理节点”（托管节点组）。 缺点： Spot 可能无容量，导致需要测试时节点拉不起来；目一旦集中回收，可能导致集群短时间内无工作节点，影响测试连痲性。 结 论：很畎钱，但在“需要时能用”的可靠性上风险较大，未必是“MOST cost-effective”（痴合考虑可用性与运维成本）。
explanations.B: 两个托管节点组：一个 On-Demand + 一个 Spot 优点：用少量 On-Demand 作为基础容量，确保集群在 Spot 痌张时仍可运行 关键工作负载/基略组件；用 Spot 承载弹性/非关键的测试负载以大幅降本；仍满足“EKS 管理所有节点”。 缺点：相较 A 会多一些 On-Demand 成本。 结论：在“低频使用但需要随时能启动进行韧性测试”的前提下，痴合成本与可用性，这通常是最具成本效益的 设计。
explanations.C: 用 ASG + 启动配置(launch configuration) + user data 加入 EKS 问题：这是自管节点（self-managed worker nodes）的做 法，节点生命周期更多由你管理，而不是 EKS 托管节点组来管理；目 launch configuration 也较旧（现在更常见 launch template）。 结论：不满足“EKS 集群必须管理所有节点”的要求，因此不选。
explanations.D: 仅包含 On-Demand 的托管节点组 优点：最稳定，容量可预期；满足“EKS 管理所有节点”。 缺点：开发集群低频使用，全按需 会造成明显浪费，不是最畎钱。 结论：不够成本优化，不选。

question: Topic 1 A company stores sensitive data in Amazon S3. A solutions architect needs to create an encryption solution. The company needs to fully control the ability of users to create, rotate, and disable encryption keys with minimal effort for any data that must be encrypted. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use default server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) to store the sensitive data.
options.B: Create a customer managed key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the new key to encrypt the S3 objects by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
options.C: Create an AWS managed key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the new key to encrypt the S3 objects by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
options.D: Download S3 objects to an Amazon EC2 instance. Encrypt the objects by using customer managed keys. Upload the encrypted objects back into Amazon S3.

explanations.A: 使用默正的服务器端加密和 Amazon S3 管理的加密密钥 (SSE-S3) 分析：此选项使用 Amazon S3 管理的加密密钥 (SSE-S3)，但公司要求完全控制密钥的创建、轮换和禁用能力。SSE-S3 不允许用户 完全控制密钥，因此此选项不符合要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 创建一个客户管理密钥，并使用新密钥通过服务器端加密和 AWS KMS 密钥 (SSE-KMS) 加密 S3 对象 分析：此选项使用 AWS KMS 创建客户管理密钥 (Customer Managed Key)，并通过 SSE-KMS 加密 S3 对象。客户管理密钥允许用户 完全控制密钥的创建、轮换和禁用能力，符合公司的要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 创建一个 AWS 管理密钥，并使用新密钥通过服务器端加密和 AWS KMS 密 钥 (SSE-KMS) 加密 S3 对象 分析：此选项使用 AWS 管理密钥 (AWS Managed Key)，而不是客户管理密钥。AWS 管理密钥由 AWS 管理，用户无法完全控制密 钥的创建、轮换和禁用能力，因此不符合公司的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: 将 S3 对象下载到 Amazon EC2 实例，使用客户管理密钥加密对象，然后将加密后的对象重新上传到 Amazon S3 分析：此选项涉及手动加密过程，需要下载和重新上传数据，增加了复杂性和成本。公司要求的是最小化努力的解决方案，因此此 选项不符合要求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to back up its on-premises virtual machines (VMs) to AWS. The company's backup solution exports on-premises backups to an Amazon S3 bucket as objects. The S3 backups must be retained for 30 days and must be automatically deleted after 30 days. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an S3 bucket that has S3 Object Lock enabled.
options.B: Create an S3 bucket that has object versioning enabled.
options.C: Configure a default retention period of 30 days for the objects.
options.D: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to protect the objects for 30 days.
options.E: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to expire the objects after 30 days.
options.F: Configure the backup solution to tag the objects with a 30-day retention period

explanations.A: Create an S3 bucket that has S3 Object Lock enabled. 正确。S3 Object Lock可以确保对象在指定的保留期内无法被删除或覆盖，符合题目要求的备份保护需求。
explanations.B: Create an S3 bucket that has object versioning enabled. 错误。对象版本控制主要用于保留对象的多个版本，但题目没有提到需要版本控制功能。
explanations.C: Configure a default retention period of 30 days for the objects. 正确。配置默正的30天保留期可以确保对象在30天内受到保护，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to protect the objects for 30 days. 错误。生命周期策略用于管理对象的存储和删除，而不是保护对象免受删除。
explanations.E: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to expire the objects after 30 days. 正确。生命周期策略可以自动删除对象，符合题目要求的30天后自动删除需求。
explanations.F: Configure the backup solution to tag the objects with a 30-day retention period. 错误。题目没有提到需要通过标疮来实现保留期管理，目标疮本身无法直接实现对象的保护或删除。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect needs to copy files from an Amazon S3 bucket to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system and another S3 bucket. The files must be copied continuously. New files are added to the original S3 bucket consistently. The copied files should be overwritten only if the source file changes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS DataSync location for both the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Create a task for the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Set the transfer mode to transfer only data that has changed.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function. Mount the file system to the function. Set up an S3 event notification to invoke the function when files are created and changed in Amazon S3. Configure the function to copy files to the file system and the destination S3 bucket.
options.C: Create an AWS DataSync location for both the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Create a task for the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Set the transfer mode to transfer all data.
options.D: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in the same VPC as the file system. Mount the file system. Create a script to routinely synchronize all objects that changed in the origin S3 bucket to the destination S3 bucket and the mounted file system.

explanations.A: Create an AWS DataSync location for both the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Create a task for the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Set the transfer mode to transfer only data that has changed. 分析： AWS DataSync 是专门设计用于高效地同步数据的服务，支持 S3 和 EFS 之间的数据传输。 设置传输模式为“仅传输已更改的数据”可以满足题目要求，即只覆盖源文件发生变化的情况。 此选项操作开销低，完全符合题目要求。 结论： 正确。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Lambda function. Mount the file system to the function. Set up an S3 event notification to invoke the function when files are created and changed in Amazon S3. Configure the function to copy files to the file system and the destination S3 bucket. 分析： 使用 Lambda 函数和 S3 事件通知可以实现文件的复制，但需要手动编写代畡来处理迂辑。 挂载文件系统到 Lambda 函数可能会增加复杂性和操作开销。 此选项的操作开销较高，不是最佳选择。 结论： 错误。
explanations.C: Create an AWS DataSync location for both the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Create a task for the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Set the transfer mode to transfer all data. 分析： 设置传输模式为“传输所有数据”会导致每次都复制所有文件，而不是仅复制已更改的文件。 此选项不符合题目要求，因为它会增加不必要的传输开销。 结论： 错误。
explanations.D: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in the same VPC as the file system. Mount the file system. Create a script to routinely synchronize all objects that changed in the origin S3 bucket to the destination S3 bucket and the mounted file system. 分析： 使用 EC2 实例和脚本可以实现文件同步，但需要手动编写和维护脚本。 此选项的操作开销较高，不是最佳选择。 结论： 错误。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Amazon EC2 instances and stores data on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. The company must ensure that all data is encrypted at rest by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). The company must be able to control rotation of the encryption keys. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a customer managed key. Use the key to encrypt the EBS volumes.
options.B: Use an AWS managed key to encrypt the EBS volumes. Use the key to configure automatic key rotation.
options.C: Create an external KMS key with imported key material. Use the key to encrypt the EBS volumes.
options.D: Use an AWS owned key to encrypt the EBS volumes.

explanations.A: Create a customer managed key. Use the key to encrypt the EBS volumes. 正确：客户管理密钥 (Customer Managed Key) 是由用户创建和管理的 KMS 密钥，用户可以完全控制密钥的生命周期，包括启用密 钥轮换。 符合要求：用户可以控制密钥轮换，并确保数据加密符合要求。 操作开销低：AWS 提供了自动化的密钥轮换功能，用户只需启用即可。
explanations.B: Use an AWS managed key to encrypt the EBS volumes. Use the key to configure automatic key rotation. 错误：AWS 管理密钥 (AWS Managed Key) 是由 AWS 创建和管理的密钥，用户无法控制密钥轮换。 不符合要求：题目明确要求用户能够控制密钥轮换，而 AWS 管理密钥不支持用户控制轮换。
