explanations.C: Create an external KMS key with imported key material. Use the key to encrypt the EBS volumes. 错误：虽然导入的密钥材料可以用于加密，但这增加了操作复杂性，因为用户需要管理密钥材料的导入和生命周期。 不符合要求：题目要求最少的操作开销，而导入密钥材料增加了管理复杂性。
explanations.D: Use an AWS owned key to encrypt the EBS volumes. 错误：AWS 拥有的密钥 (AWS Owned Key) 是完全由 AWS 管理的，用户无法访问或控制这些密钥。 不符合要求：题目要求用户能够控制密钥轮换，而 AWS 拥有的密钥不支持用户控制。

question: Topic 1 A company needs a solution to enforce data encryption at rest on Amazon EC2 instances. The solution must automatically identify noncompliant resources and enforce compliance policies on findings. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Use an IAM policy that allows users to create only encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Use AWS Config and AWS Systems Manager to automate the detection and remediation of unencrypted EBS volumes.
options.B: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to manage access to encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Use AWS Lambda and Amazon EventBridge to automate the detection and remediation of unencrypted EBS volumes.
options.C: Use Amazon Macie to detect unencrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Use AWS Systems Manager Automation rules to automatically encrypt existing and new EBS volumes. {FA Amazon Macie

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating its multi-tier on-premises application to AWS. The application consists of a single-node MySQL database and a multi-node web tier. The company must minimize changes to the application during the migration. The company wants to improve application resiliency after the migration. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.
options.B: Migrate the database to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind a Network Load Balancer.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployment.
options.D: Migrate the web tier to an AWS Lambda function.
options.E: Migrate the database to an Amazon DynamoDB table.

explanations.A: Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. 正确：将Web层迁移到Auto Scaling组中的EC2实例，并置于Application Load Balancer之后，可以提高Web层的弹性和可用性。 Auto Scaling组可以根据流量动态调整实例数量，而ALB可以分发流量并提供高可用性。
explanations.B: Migrate the database to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind a Network Load Balancer. 错误：数据库通常不适合放在Auto Scaling组中，因为数据库需要栓态保持，而Auto Scaling组的实例是无栓态的。 Network Load Balancer适合处理高性能的网络流量，但不适合直接用于数据库的高可用性。
explanations.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployment. 正确：Amazon RDS Multi-AZ部署提供了数据库的高可用性和棭难恢复能力，符合题目要求。 无需对应用进行重大修改，RDS可以直接支持MySQL。
explanations.D: Migrate the web tier to an AWS Lambda function. 错误：AWS Lambda适合无服务器架构，但题目要求“最小化对应用的修改”，将Web层迁移到Lambda需要对应用进行重大改动。
explanations.E: Migrate the database to an Amazon DynamoDB table. 错误：DynamoDB是NoSQL数据库，而题目中的数据库是MySQL（关系型数据库）。迁移到DynamoDB需要对应用进行重大修改。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to migrate its web applications from on premises to AWS. The company is located close to the eu-central-1 Region. Because of regulations, the company cannot launch some of its applications in eu-central-1. The company wants to achieve single-digit millisecond latency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the applications in eu-central-1. Extend the company's VPC from eu-central-1 to an edge location in Amazon CloudFront.
options.B: Deploy the applications in AWS Local Zones by extending the company's VPC from eu-central-1 to the chosen Local Zone.
options.C: Deploy the applications in eu-central-1. Extend the company’s VPC from eu-central-1 to the regional edge caches in Amazon CloudFront.
options.D: Deploy the applications in AWS Wavelength Zones by extending the company’s VPC from eu-central-1 to the chosen Wavelength Zone.

explanations.A: Deploy the applications in eu-central-1. Extend the company’s VPC from eu-central-1 to an edge location in Amazon CloudFront. 错误：CloudFront的边缘位置主要用于内容分发（CDN），而不是用于托管应用程序。它无法满足单数字毫秒延迟的要求。
explanations.B: Deploy the applications in AWS Local Zones by extending the company's VPC from eu-central-1 to the chosen Local Zone. 正确：AWS Local Zones允许用户在靠邮最终用户的区域运行应用程序，从而实现低延迟（单数字毫秒）。这符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Deploy the applications in eu-central-1. Extend the company’s VPC from eu-central-1 to the regional edge caches in Amazon CloudFront. 错误：CloudFront的区域边缘缓存主要用于优化内容分发的性能，而不是托管应用程序。它无法满足单数字毫秒延迟的要求。
explanations.D: Deploy the applications in AWS Wavelength Zones by extending the company’s VPC from eu-central-1 to the chosen Wavelength Zone. 错误：AWS Wavelength Zones主要用于5G网络的边缘计算场景，适用于移动设备的低延迟需求。题目未提到5G或移动设备相关的 需求，因此不适合此场景。

question: Topic 1 A company is creating an application. The company stores data from tests of the application in multiple on-premises locations. The company needs to connect the on-premises locations to VPCs in an AWS Region in the AWS Cloud. The number of accounts and VPCs will increase during the next year. options.B: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. On the instance, include VPN software that uses a VPN connection to connect all VPCs and on-premises locations.

question: Topic 1 A company wants to standardize its Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume encryption strategy. The company also wants to minimize the cost and configuration effort required to operate the volume encryption check. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Write API calls to describe the EBS volumes and to confirm the EBS volumes are encrypted. Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule an AWS Lambda function to run the API calls.
options.B: Write API calls to describe the EBS volumes and to confirm the EBS volumes are encrypted. Run the API calls on an AWS Fargate task. $e API
options.C: Create an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) policy that requires the use of tags on EBS volumes. Use AWS Cost Explorer to display resources that are not properly tagged. Encrypt the untagged resources manually.
options.D: Create an AWS Config rule for Amazon EBS to evaluate if a volume is encrypted and to flag the volume if it is not encrypted.

explanations.A: 编写 API 调用以描述 EBS 卷并确正 EBS 卷已加密。使用 Amazon EventBridge 调度一个 AWS Lambda 函数来运行 API 调用。 正确性分析：虽然可以通过API调用检查EBS卷是否加密，并使用EventBridge调度Lambda函数，但这种方法需要额外的开发工作和 维护成本，不符合“最小化成本和配置工作量”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 编写 API 调用以描述 EBS 卷并确正 EBS 卷已加密。在一个 AWS Fargate 任务上运行 API 调用。 正确性分析：类似于选项A，这种方法也需要额外的开发工作和维护成本，同时还引入了Fargate任务的运行成本，不符合题目要 求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: 创建一个 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 策略，要求在 EBS 卷上使用标签。使用 AWS Cost Explorer 显示未正 确标记的资源。手动加密未标记的资源。 正确性分析：此选项与题目要求不符，因为它依赖手动加密未标记资源，无法自动化加密检查，也无法直接评估EBS卷是否加密。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: 创建一个 AWS Config 规则，以评估卷是否已加密，并在卷未加密时标记该卷。 正确性分析：AWS Config规则可以自动化地评估EBS卷是否加密，并标记未加密的卷。这种方法无需额外开发工作，目成本较低， 完全符合题目要求。 结论：正确。

question: Topic 1 A company regularly uploads GB-sized files to Amazon S3. After the company uploads the files, the company uses a fleet of Amazon EC2 Spot Instances to transcode the file format. The company needs to scale throughput when the company uploads data from the on-premises data center to Amazon S3 and when the company downloads data from Amazon S3 to the EC2 instances. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the S3 bucket access point instead of accessing the S3 bucket directly.
options.B: Upload the files into multiple S3 buckets.
options.C: Use $3 multipart uploads.
options.D: Fetch multiple byte-ranges of an object in parallel.
options.E: Add a random prefix to each object when uploading the files.

explanations.A: Use the S3 bucket access point instead of accessing the S3 bucket directly. 错误：S3 Bucket Access Point主要用于简化对S3的访问管理，尤其是在多账户或多应用场景下，但它并不能直接提高上传或下载的 知吐量。
explanations.B: Upload the files into multiple S3 buckets. 错误：使用多个S3 Bucket并不能提高单个Bucket的知吐量，目增加了管理复杂性。优化知吐量的重点是如何高效地使用单个 Bucket。
explanations.C: Use S3 multipart uploads. 正确：S3 Multipart Upload允许将大文件分成多个部分并行上传，从而显著提高上传速度，尤其是对于GB级别的大文件。
explanations.D: Fetch multiple byte-ranges of an object in parallel. 正确：通过并行获取对象的多个字节范围，可以显著提高下载速度。这是S3性能优化的推荐实践之一。
explanations.E: Add a random prefix to each object when uploading the files. 错误：添加輮机前缀主要用于优化S3的分区性能，但在现代S3架构中，分区性能已经优化，輮机前缀的作用有限。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing a shared storage solution for a web application that is deployed across multiple Availability Zones. The web application runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group. The company plans to make frequent changes to the content. The solution must have strong consistency in returning the new content as soon as the changes occur. Which solutions meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) block storage that is mounted to the individual EC2 instances.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system on the individual EC2 instances.
options.C: Create a shared Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Mount the EBS volume on the individual EC2 instances.
options.D: Use AWS DataSync to perform continuous synchronization of data between EC2 hosts in the Auto Scaling group.
options.E: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the web content. Set the metadata for the Cache-Control header to no-cache. Use Amazon CloudFront to deliver the content.

explanations.A: 使用AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI)块存储，并将其挂载到单 个EC2实例上。 错误：AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway主要用于混合云场景，将本地存储扩展到AWS云中，不适合跨多个可用区的共享存储 需求。
explanations.B: 创建一个Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)文件系统。将EFS文件系统挂载到单个EC2实例上。 正确：Amazon EFS支持跨多个可用区的共享文件系统，提供强一致性，适合频痏更新内容的场景。
explanations.C: 创建一个共享的Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)卷。将EBS卷挂载到单个EC2实例上。 错误：Amazon EBS卷只能挂载到单个EC2实例，无法实现跨多个可用区的共享存储。
explanations.D: 使用AWS DataSync在Auto Scaling组中的EC2主机之间执行连续的数据同步。 错误：AWS DataSync主要用于数据迁移或同步，不适合实时共享存储的场景，目无法保证强一致性。
explanations.E: 创建一个Amazon S3橘来存储Web内容。将Cache-Control头的元数据设置为no-cache。使用Amazon CloudFront来分发内 容。 正确：Amazon S3结合CloudFront可以提供低延迟的内容分发，通过设置Cache-Control为no-cache，可以确保内容更新后立即生 效，满足强一致性需求。

question: Topic 1 A company is deploying an application in three AWS Regions using an Application Load Balancer. Amazon Route 53 will be used to distribute traffic between these Regions. Which Route 53 configuration should a solutions architect use to provide the MOST high-performing experience?

options.A: Create an A record with a latency policy.
options.B: Create an A record with a geolocation policy.
options.C: Create a CNAME record with a failover policy.
options.D: Create a CNAME record with a geoproximity policy.

explanations.A: Create an A record with a latency policy. 延迟路由策略会根据用户与各个AWS区域的网络延迟来选择最优的区域，从而提供最佳性能。 这是最适合高性能体验的策略，因为它直接考虑了网络延迟。 正确选项。
explanations.B: Create an A record with a geolocation policy. 地理位置路由策略会根据用户的地理位置将流量路由到指定的区域。 虽然可以提供一定的性能优化，但它并不直接考虑网络延迟，因此可能不是最佳选择。 错误选项。
explanations.C: Create a CNAME record with a failover policy. 故障转移路由策略主要用于高可用性场景，当主资源不可用时将流量路由到备用资源。 它的目标是提高可用性，而不是优化性能，因此不适合本题要求。 错误选项。
explanations.D: Create a CNAME record with a geoproximity policy. 地理邻邮路由策略会根据用户与资源的地理距离来路由流量，并允许调整偏好。 虽然可以优化性能，但它需要额外的配置，并且不如延迟路由直接针对网络性能。 错误选项。

question: Topic 1 A company has a web application that includes an embedded NoSQL database. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone. A recent increase in traffic requires the application to be highly available and for the database to be eventually consistent. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Maintain the embedded NoSQL database with its replication service on the EC2 instances.
options.B: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Migrate the embedded NoSQL database to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS).
options.C: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. Maintain the embedded NoSQL database with its replication service on the EC2 instances.
options.D: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. Migrate the embedded NoSQL database to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS).

explanations.A: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Maintain the embedded NoSQL database with its replication service on the EC2 instances. 错误：Network Load Balancer (NLB) 适用于低延迟和 TCP/UDP 流量，但题目中没有提到需要这种特性。ALB 更适合 HTTP/HTTPS 流量。 错误：嵌入式 NoSQL 数据库仍然运行在 EC2 实例上，无法实现高可用性，因为它依赖单个可用区。
explanations.B: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Migrate the embedded NoSQL database to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). 错误：虽然迁移到 DynamoDB 是正确的方向，但蔡换 ALB 为 NLB 不符合题目需求。ALB 更适合处理 Web 应用流量。 正确：迁移到 DynamoDB 可以实现高可用性和最终一致性。
explanations.C: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. Maintain the embedded NoSQL database with its replication service on the EC2 instances. 正确：跨三个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组可以提高 EC2 实例的高可用性。 错误：嵌入式 NoSQL 数据库仍然运行在 EC2 实例上，增加了运维复杂性，目无法充分利用托管服务的优势。
explanations.D: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. Migrate the embedded NoSQL database to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). 正确：跨三个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组可以提高 EC2 实例的高可用性。 正确：迁移到 DynamoDB 可以实现高可用性和最终一致性，同时减少运维开销。

question: Topic 1 A company is building a shopping application on AWS. The application offers a catalog that changes once each month and needs to scale with traffic volume. The company wants the lowest possible latency from the application. Data from each user's shopping cart needs to be highly available. User session data must be available even if the user is disconnected and reconnects. What should a solutions architect do to ensure that the shopping cart data is preserved at all times?

options.A: Configure an Application Load Balancer to enable the sticky sessions feature (session affinity) for access to the catalog in Amazon Aurora.
options.B: Configure Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to cache catalog data from Amazon DynamoDB and shopping cart data from the user's session. BCH Amazon ElastiCache for Redis, LA Amazon DynamoDB
options.C: Configure Amazon OpenSearch Service to cache catalog data from Amazon DynamoDB and shopping cart data from the user's session.
options.D: Configure an Amazon EC2 instance with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage for the catalog and shopping cart. Configure automated snapshots.

explanations.A: Configure an Application Load Balancer to enable the sticky sessions feature (session affinity) for access to the catalog in Amazon Aurora. 错误原因：粘性会话（Sticky Sessions）仅适用于保持用户会话栓态，但无法满足购栌车数据的高可用性和持久性需求。 此外，Amazon Aurora是关系型数据库，虽然可以存储数据，但不适合缓存目录数据或会话数据。
explanations.B: Configure Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to cache catalog data from Amazon DynamoDB and shopping cart data from the user's session. 正确原因：Amazon ElastiCache for Redis提供低延迟的缓存服务，适合存储频繁访问的目录数据和用户会话数据。 Amazon DynamoDB提供高可用性和持久性，可以作为购栌车数据的后端存储。 这种架构既满足了低延迟需求，又保证了数据的持久性和高可用性。
explanations.C: Configure Amazon OpenSearch Service to cache catalog data from Amazon DynamoDB and shopping cart data from the user's session. 错误原因：Amazon OpenSearch Service主要用于搜索和分析，不适合用作缓存服务。 它的延迟较高，无法满足最低延迟的要求。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon EC2 instance with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage for the catalog and shopping cart. Configure automated snapshots. 错误原因：使用EC2和EBS存储数据虽然可以实现持久性，但无法满足低延迟和高可用性需求。 此外，EC2实例需要手动管理扩展，无法自动适应流量变化。

question: Topic 1 A company is building a microservices-based application that will be deployed on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The microservices will interact with each other. The company wants to ensure that the application is observable to identify performance issues in the future. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the application to use Amazon ElastiCache to reduce the number of requests that are sent to the microservices.
options.B: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights to collect metrics from the EKS clusters. Configure AWS X-Ray to trace the requests between the microservices.
options.C: Configure AWS CloudTrail to review the API calls. Build an Amazon QuickSight dashboard to observe the microservice interactions. ACE AWS CloudTrail
options.D: Use AWS Trusted Advisor to understand the performance of the application.

explanations.A: 配置 Amazon ElastiCache 以减少发送到布服务的请求数量。 错误：ElastiCache主要用于缓存数据以提高应用程序性能，但它并不能提供布服务之间的可观测性或性能监控功能。
explanations.B: 配置 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights 以收集来自 EKS 集群的指标。配置 AWS X-Ray 以追踪布服务之间的请求。 正确：CloudWatch Container Insights可以收集EKS集群的性能指标，AWS X-Ray可以追踪布服务之间的请求流，提供详细的可观测 性。这是满足题目要求的最佳解决方案。
explanations.C: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 以审查 API 调用。构建一个 Amazon QuickSight 仪表板以观察布服务交互。 错误：CloudTrail主要用于记录API调用的日志，QuickSight用于数据可视化，但它们无法直接提供布服务的性能监控或请求追踪功 能。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Trusted Advisor 来了解应用程序的性能。 错误：Trusted Advisor主要用于提供成本优化、安全性、容错性等建议，但它不适用于布服务的性能监控或请求追踪。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to provide customers with secure access to its data. The company processes customer data and stores the results in an Amazon S3 bucket. All the data is subject to strong regulations and security requirements. The data must be encrypted at rest. Each customer must be able to access only their data from their AWS account. Company employees must not be able to access the data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Provision an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate for each customer. Encrypt the data client-side. In the private certificate policy, deny access to the certificate for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
options.B: Provision a separate AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for each customer. Encrypt the data server-side. In the S3 bucket policy, deny decryption of data for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
options.C: Provision a separate AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for each customer. Encrypt the data server-side. In each KMS key policy, deny decryption of data for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
options.D: Provision an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate for each customer. Encrypt the data client-side. In the public certificate policy, deny access to the certificate for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.

explanations.A: Provision an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate for each customer. Encrypt the data client-side. In the private certificate policy, deny access to the certificate for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides. 错误：ACM 主要用于管理 SSL/TLS 证书，而不是用于加密 S3 数据。此选项提到的“客户端加密”与 ACM 的功能不匹配。 错误：ACM 证书无法直接控制 S3 数据的访问权限。
explanations.B: Provision a separate AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for each customer. Encrypt the data server-side. In the S3 bucket policy, deny decryption of data for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides. 部分正确：使用 AWS KMS 密钥进行服务器端加密是正确的做法。 错误：S3 bucket policy 主要用于控制对 S3 bucket 的访问权限，而不是直接管理 KMS 密钥的解密权限。解密权限应通过 KMS 密钥 策略来管理。
explanations.C: Provision a separate AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for each customer. Encrypt the data server-side. In each KMS key policy, deny decryption of data for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides. 正确：为每个客户配置单独的 KMS 密钥，并使用服务器端加密符合题目要求。 正确：通过 KMS 密钥策略控制解密权限是最佳实践，可以确保只有客户提供的 IAM 角色能够解密数据。
explanations.D: Provision an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate for each customer. Encrypt the data client-side. In the public certificate policy, deny access to the certificate for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides. 错误：ACM 证书用于管理 SSL/TLS 证书，与 S3 数据加密无关。 错误：“公共证书策略”并不是 AWS 中的概念，目无法满足题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect creates a VPC that includes two public subnets and two private subnets. A corporate security mandate requires the solutions architect to launch all Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet. However, when the solutions architect launches an EC2 instance that runs a web server on ports 80 and 443 in a private subnet, no external internet traffic can connect to the server. What should the solutions architect do to resolve this issue?

options.A: Attach the EC2 instance to an Auto Scaling group in a private subnet. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the Auto Scaling group identifier.
options.B: Provision an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) in a public subnet. Add the EC2 instance to the target group that is associated with the ALEnsure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the ALB.
options.C: Launch a NAT gateway in a private subnet. Update the route table for the private subnets to add a default route to the NAT gateway. Attach a public Elastic IP address to the NAT gateway.
options.D: Ensure that the security group that is attached to the EC2 instance allows HTTP traffic on port 80 and HTTPS traffic on port 443. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the public IP address of the EC2 instance.

explanations.A: Attach the EC2 instance to an Auto Scaling group in a private subnet. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the Auto Scaling group identifier. 错误：Auto Scaling组的主要功能是自动扩展和缩减实例数量，解决高可用性和寰性问题，而不是解决私有子网中实例无法接收外 部流量的问题。 此外，Auto Scaling组的标识符不能直接作为DNS记录解析目标。
explanations.B: Provision an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) in a public subnet. Add the EC2 instance to the target group that is associated with the ALB. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the ALB. 正确：ALB可以部署在公有子网中，并且可以将流量转发到私有子网中的EC2实例。这样可以满足安全要求，同时允许外部流量访问 私有子网中的实例。 DNS记录解析到ALB的地址是正确的配置方式。
explanations.C: Launch a NAT gateway in a private subnet. Update the route table for the private subnets to add a default route to the NAT gateway. Attach a public Elastic IP address to the NAT gateway. 错误：NAT网关的主要功能是允许私有子网中的实例访问外部互联网（如下载更新或访问API），而不是接收外部流量。 此选项无法解决外部流量无法连接到私有子网中的实例的问题。
explanations.D: Ensure that the security group that is attached to the EC2 instance allows HTTP traffic on port 80 and HTTPS traffic on port 443. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the public IP address of the EC2 instance. 错误：私有子网中的实例无法直接分配公有IP地址，因此无法通过公有IP地址接收外部流量。 此外，这种配置违反了题目中要求的“所有EC2实例必须部署在私有子网中”的安全规定。

question: Topic 1 A company is deploying a new application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with an AWS Fargate cluster. The application needs a storage solution for data persistence. The solution must be highly available and fault tolerant. The solution also must be shared between multiple application containers. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes in the same Availability Zones where EKS worker nodes are placed. Register the volumes in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use EBS Multi-Attach to share the data between containers.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Register the file system in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use the same file system for all containers.
options.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Register the volume in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use the same volume for all containers.
options.D: Create Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file systems in the same Availability Zones where EKS worker nodes are placed. Register the file systems in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Create an AWS Lambda function to synchronize the data between file systems.

explanations.A: Create Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes in the same Availability Zones where EKS worker nodes are placed. Register the volumes in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use EBS Multi-Attach to share the data between containers. Amazon EBS 是一种块存储服务，主要用于单个实例的存储需求。 EBS Multi-Attach 允许多个 EC2 实例挂载同一个 EBS 卷，但不支持 Fargate。 此外，EBS 的可用性受限于单个可用区，无法满足高可用性和容器间共享存储的需求。 错误原因：不支持 Fargate，目无法跨可用区实现高可用性。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Register the file system in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use the same file system for all containers. Amazon EFS 是一种文件存储服务，支持跨多个可用区的高可用性和容器间共享存储。 EFS 可以通过 StorageClass 对象答案集成到 EKS 集群中，目支持 Fargate。 操作开销较低，因为 EFS 是托管服务，用户无需管理底层基础设施。 正确原因：满足高可用性、容器间共享存储需求，并且操作开销最低。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Register the volume in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use the same volume for all containers. 与选项 A 类似，EBS 是块存储服务，主要用于单实例存储需求。 单个 EBS 卷无法跨多个容器共享，目不支持 Fargate。 此外，EBS 的可用性受限于单个可用区，无法满足高可用性需求。 错误原因：不支持 Fargate，目无法跨容器共享存储。
explanations.D: Create Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file systems in the same Availability Zones where EKS worker nodes are placed. Register the file systems in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Create an AWS Lambda function to synchronize the data between file systems. 创建多个 EFS 文件系统并使用 Lambda 同步数据会增加操作开销。 EFS 本身已经支持跨可用区的高可用性，无需额外的同步机制。 此选项复杂度较高，不符合“最小操作开销”的要求。 错误原因：增加了不必要的复杂性和操作开销。

question: Topic 1 A company has an application that uses Docker containers in its local data center. The application runs on a container host that stores persistent data in a volume on the host. The container instances use the stored persistent data. The company wants to move the application to a fully managed service because the company does not want to manage any servers or storage infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with self-managed nodes. Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume attached to an Amazon EC2 instance. Use the EBS volume as a persistent volume mounted in the containers.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Add the EFS volume as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers. {$F Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 和 AWS Fargate
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Map the S3 bucket as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers. {FQ Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 和 AWS Fargate
options.D: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an Amazon EC2 launch type. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Add the EFS volume as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers. {$F Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 和 Amazon EC2

explanations.A: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with self-managed nodes. Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume attached to an Amazon EC2 instance. Use the EBS volume as a persistent volume mounted in the containers. 错误：虽然EKS支持容器编排，但使用EKS和自管理节点需要管理EC2实例和EBS卷，这不符合题目要求的“完全托管服务”。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Add the EFS volume as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers. 正确：AWS Fargate是无服务器的容器运行时，完全托管，不需要管理底层服务器。EFS是一个完全托管的文件存储服务，支持持久 性存储，适合挂载到容器中。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Map the S3 bucket as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers. 错误：虽然S3是完全托管的存储服务，但它是对象存储，不适合直接作为容器的持久性存储卷挂载。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an Amazon EC2 launch type. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Add the EFS volume as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers. 错误：使用EC2启动类型需要管理底层服务器，不符合题目要求的“完全托管服务”。

question: Topic 1 A gaming company wants to launch a new internet-facing application in multiple AWS Regions. The application will use the TCP and UDP protocols for communication. The company needs to provide high availability and minimum latency for global users. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create internal Network Load Balancers in front of the application in each Region.
options.B: Create external Application Load Balancers in front of the application in each Region.
options.C: Create an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator to route traffic to the load balancers in each Region.
options.D: Configure Amazon Route 53 to use a geolocation routing policy to distribute the traffic.
options.E: Configure Amazon CloudFront to handle the traffic and route requests to the application in each Region 配置 Amazon CloudFront

explanations.A: Create internal Network Load Balancers in front of the application in each Region. 错误：内部 Network Load Balancer 是为内部流量设计的，无法处理互联网流量。 题目要求“互联网面对的应用”，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.B: Create external Application Load Balancers in front of the application in each Region. 错误：虽然 Application Load Balancer 可以处理互联网流量，但它主要用于 HTTP/HTTPS 协议，而题目明确提到需要支持 TCP 和 UDP 协议。 此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator to route traffic to the load balancers in each Region. 正确：AWS Global Accelerator 提供全球流量优化，支持 TCP 和 UDP 协议，并能将流量路由到各区域的负载均衡器，满足高可用性 和低延迟需求。
explanations.D: Configure Amazon Route 53 to use a geolocation routing policy to distribute the traffic. 错误：虽然 Route 53 的地理位置路由可以分配流量，但它无法优化 TCP 和 UDP 协议的性能，也无法提供类似 Global Accelerator 的低延迟和高可用性功能。
explanations.E: Configure Amazon CloudFront to handle the traffic and route requests to the application in each Region. 错误：CloudFront 是内容分发网络（CDN），主要用于缓存和分发静态内容。它不适合直接处理 TCP 和 UDP 流量。

question: Topic 1 A city has deployed a web application running on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application's users have reported sporadic performance, which appears to be related to DDoS attacks originating from random IP addresses. The city needs a solution that requires minimal configuration changes and provides an audit trail for the DDoS sources. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Enable an AWS WAF web ACL on the ALB, and configure rules to block traffic from unknown sources.
options.B: Subscribe to Amazon Inspector. Engage the AWS DDos Response Team (DRT) to integrate mitigating controls into the service.
options.C: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Engage the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to integrate mitigating controls into the service.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the application, and set the ALB as the origin. Enable an AWS WAF web ACL on the distribution, and configure rules to block traffic from unknown sources

explanations.A: Enable an AWS WAF web ACL on the ALB, and configure rules to block traffic from unknown sources. 正确性分析：AWS WAF可以帮助过滤恶意流量，但它需要手动配置规则来识别和阻止DDoS攻击源，这可能无法有效应对随机IP地 址的攻击。此外，AWS WAF本身不提供专门的DDoS防护功能。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求，因为它无法提供全面的DDoS防护，也没有提到审计功能。
explanations.B: Subscribe to Amazon Inspector. Engage the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to integrate mitigating controls into the service. 正确性分析：Amazon Inspector是一个安全评估服务，用于检测漏洞和配置问题，与DDoS防护无关。此选项提到的AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT)确实可以协助，但Amazon Inspector并不是DDoS防护的正确工具。 结论：此选项错误，因为Amazon Inspector不适用于DDoS防护场景。
explanations.C: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Engage the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to integrate mitigating controls into the service. 正确性分析：AWS Shield Advanced是专门设计用于保护应用免受复杂DDoS攻击的服务。它提供自动化的防护功能，并允许与AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT)合作来实施缓解措施。此外，它还提供详细的攻击分析和审计功能，完全符合题目要求。 结论：此选项正确，因为它提供了全面的DDoS防护和审计功能，并且配置更简单。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the application, and set the ALB as the origin. Enable an AWS WAF web ACL on the distribution, and configure rules to block traffic from unknown sources. 正确性分析：CloudFront可以帮助缓解DDoS攻击，并与AWS WAF结合使用以过滤流量。然而，与AWS Shield Advanced相比， CloudFront的DDoS防护功能较为基础，无法提供与AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT)的直接协作，也没有提到审计功能。 结论：此选项部分正确，但不如选项C全面，无法完全满足题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company copies 200 TB of data from a recent ocean survey onto AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. The company has a high performance computing (HPC) cluster that is hosted on AWS to look for oil and gas deposits. A solutions architect must provide the cluster with consistent sub-millisecond latency and high-throughput access to the data on the Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. The company is sending the devices back to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Configure an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway to use the S3 bucket. Access the file gateway from the HPC cluster instances.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system, and integrate it with the $3 bucket. Access the FSx for Lustre file system from the HPC cluster instances.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Copy the data from the S3 bucket to the EFS file system. Access the EFS file system from the HPC cluster instances.
options.D: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Import the data directly into the FSx for Lustre file system. Access the FSx for Lustre file system from the HPC cluster instances.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Configure an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway to use the S3 bucket. Access the file gateway from the HPC cluster instances. 错误原因：虽然AWS Storage Gateway可以提供对S3数据的访问，但它的性能无法满足HPC环境对低延迟和高知吐量的要求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system, and integrate it with the S3 bucket. Access the FSx for Lustre file system from the HPC cluster instances. 正确原因：Amazon FSx for Lustre是专为高性能计算设计的文件系统，提供亚毫秒级延迟和高知吐量。与S3集成后，可以快速访问 和处理数据，非常适合HPC场景。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Copy the data from the S3 bucket to the EFS file system. Access the EFS file system from the HPC cluster instances. 错误原因：虽然Amazon EFS提供文件存储，但它的性能不如FSx for Lustre，无法满足HPC环境对低延迟和高知吐量的要求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Import the data directly into the FSx for Lustre file system. Access the FSx for Lustre file system from the HPC cluster instances. 错误原因：虽然FSx for Lustre适合HPC场景，但题目要求将数据从Snowball Edge设备导入到AWS。直接导入到FSx for Lustre文件系 统不符合题目中提到的“将数据导入到S3”的步骤。

question: Topic 1 A company has NFS servers in an on-premises data center that need to periodically back up small amounts of data to Amazon S3. Which solution meets these requirements and is MOST cost-effective?

options.A: Set up AWS Glue to copy the data from the on-premises servers to Amazon S3.
options.B: Set up an AWS DataSync agent on the on-premises servers, and sync the data to Amazon S3.
options.C: Set up an SFTP sync using AWS Transfer for SFTP to sync data from on premises to Amazon S3.
options.D: Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises data center and a VPC, and copy the data to Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Set up AWS Glue to copy the data from the on-premises servers to Amazon S3. 错误：AWS Glue主要用于ETL（提取、转换、加载）任务，适合处理大规模数据的转换和分析，而不是简单的文件备份任务。 成本较高且不适合小量数据的定期备份场景。
explanations.B: Set up an AWS DataSync agent on the on-premises servers, and sync the data to Amazon S3. 正确：AWS DataSync专门设计用于高效、安全地迁移和同步数据，支持NFS协议，适合定期备份小量数据。 成本优化：DataSync按使用量收费，适合这种场景。
explanations.C: Set up an SFTP sync using AWS Transfer for SFTP to sync data from on premises to Amazon S3. 错误：AWS Transfer for SFTP适用于基于SFTP协议的文件传输，而题目中明确提到使用NFS协议。 不符合场景需求。
explanations.D: Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises data center and a VPC, and copy the data to Amazon S3. 错误：AWS Direct Connect适用于需要高带宽、低延迟的场景，成本较高，不适合小量数据的定期备份。 过于复杂目不符合成本优化的要求。

question: Topic 1 An online video game company must maintain ultra-low latency for its game servers. The game servers run on Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs a solution that can handle millions of UDP internet traffic requests each second. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure an Application Load Balancer with the required protocol and ports for the internet traffic. Specify the EC2 instances as the targets.
options.B: Configure a Gateway Load Balancer for the internet traffic. Specify the EC2 instances as the targets.
options.C: Configure a Network Load Balancer with the required protocol and ports for the internet traffic. Specify the EC2 instances as the targets.
options.D: Launch an identical set of game servers on EC2 instances in separate AWS Regions. Route internet traffic to both sets of EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Configure an Application Load Balancer with the required protocol and ports for the internet traffic. Specify the EC2 instances as the targets. Application Load Balancer (ALB)主要用于处理HTTP和HTTPS流量，支持高级的内容路由和基于应用宔的负载均衡。 ALB不支持UDP协议，因此无法满足题目要求。 错误原因：ALB不适合处理UDP流量。
explanations.B: Configure a Gateway Load Balancer for the internet traffic. Specify the EC2 instances as the targets. Gateway Load Balancer (GLB)主要用于第三方虚拟网络设备的集成，例如防火墙或入侵检测系统。 虽然GLB支持UDP流量，但它的设计目标不是低延迟场景，而是网络流量的过滤和管理。 错误原因：GLB不是专门为高性能、低延迟的负载均衡设计的。
explanations.C: Configure a Network Load Balancer with the required protocol and ports for the internet traffic. Specify the EC2 instances as the targets. Network Load Balancer (NLB)专为处理高性能、低延迟的场景设计，支持TCP和UDP协议。 NLB能够处理每秒数百万请求，非常适合题目中提到的需求。 正确原因：NLB是处理UDP流量和低延迟场景的最佳选择。
explanations.D: Launch an identical set of game servers on EC2 instances in separate AWS Regions. Route internet traffic to both sets of EC2 instances. 虽然跨区域部署可以提高可用性，但它并不能直接解决低延迟和高性能的需求。 此外，跨区域流量路由可能会增加成本，并且复杂性较高。 错误原因：跨区域部署不是解决低延迟和高性能的最佳方法。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a three-tier application in a VPC. The database tier uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The company plans to migrate the RDS for MySQL DB instance to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. The company needs a solution that replicates the data changes that happen during the migration to the new database. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to transform the database objects.
options.B: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to create an Aurora PostgreSQL read replica on the RDS for MySQL DB instance.
options.C: Configure an Aurora MySQL read replica for the RDS for MySQL DB instance.
options.D: Define an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) task with change data capture (CDC) to migrate the data.
options.E: Promote the Aurora PostgreSQL read replica to a standalone Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster when the replica lag is zero.

explanations.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to transform the database objects. 正确：AWS DMS Schema Conversion工具可以将源数据库的架构转换为目标数据库的架构，特别是在跨数据库引擎迁移时（如 MySQL到PostgreSQL）。
explanations.B: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to create an Aurora PostgreSQL read replica on the RDS for MySQL DB instance. 错误：AWS DMS Schema Conversion工具用于架构转换，而不是创建Aurora PostgreSQL的只读副本。Aurora PostgreSQL和RDS MySQL是不同的数据库引擎，无法直接创建跨引擎的只读副本。
explanations.C: Configure an Aurora MySQL read replica for the RDS for MySQL DB instance. 错误：Aurora MySQL和RDS MySQL属于同一数据库引擎，可以创建只读副本，但题目要求迁移到Aurora PostgreSQL，这与Aurora MySQL无关。
explanations.D: Define an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) task with change data capture (CDC) to migrate the data. 正确：AWS DMS支持使用Change Data Capture (CDC)来实时捕获源数据库的更改，并将这些更改同步到目标数据库。这是迁移社 程中保持数据一致性的关键步骤。
explanations.E: Promote the Aurora PostgreSQL read replica to a standalone Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster when the replica lag is zero. 错误：Aurora PostgreSQL和RDS MySQL是不同的数据库引擎，无法直接创建Aurora PostgreSQL的只读副本，因此也无法提升为独 立的Aurora PostgreSQL集群。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts a database that runs on an Amazon RDS instance that is deployed to multiple Availability Zones. The company periodically runs a script against the database to report new entries that are added to the database. The script that runs against the database negatively affects the performance of a critical application. The company needs to improve application performance with minimal costs. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Add functionality to the script to identify the instance that has the fewest active connections. Configure the script to read from that instance to report the total new entries.
options.B: Create a read replica of the database. Configure the script to query only the read replica to report the total new entries.
options.C: Instruct the development team to manually export the new entries for the day in the database at the end of each day.
options.D: Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache the common queries that the script runs against the database.

explanations.A: Add functionality to the script to identify the instance that has the fewest active connections. Configure the script to read from that instance to report the total new entries. 错误：Amazon RDS的多可用区部署是为了提供高可用性，而不是负载均衡。多可用区部署的备用实例仅用于故障转移，不能直接 用于读取操作。 此选项无法解决性能问题，因为脚本仍然会影响主实例的性能。
explanations.B: Create a read replica of the database. Configure the script to query only the read replica to report the total new entries. 正确：创建读副本可以有效分担主数据库的读取负载，减少脚本对主实例的性能影响。 读副本是专门设计用于处理读取操作，目设置和维护的操作开销较低。
explanations.C: Instruct the development team to manually export the new entries for the day in the database at the end of each day. 错误：手动操作增加了操作开销，目不具备自动化能力，无法满足最低操作开销的要求。 此选项不适合需要实时或定期查询的场景。
explanations.D: Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache the common queries that the script runs against the database. 错误：虽然ElastiCache可以提高查询性能，但它需要额外的设置和维护，增加了操作开销。 此外，脚本可能需要查询实时数据，而缓存可能无法保证数据的实时性。

question: Topic 1 A company is using an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to present its application to the internet. The company finds abnormal traffic access patterns across the application. A solutions architect needs to improve visibility into the infrastructure to help the company understand these abnormalities better. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

options.A: Create a table in Amazon Athena for AWS CloudTrail logs. Create a query for the relevant information.
options.B: Enable ALB access logging to Amazon S3. Create a table in Amazon Athena, and query the logs.
options.C: Enable ALB access logging to Amazon S3. Open each file in a text editor, and search each line for the relevant information.
options.D: Use Amazon EMR on a dedicated Amazon EC2 instance to directly query the ALB to acquire traffic access log information.

explanations.A: Create a table in Amazon Athena for AWS CloudTrail logs. Create a query for the relevant information. 错误：AWS CloudTrail主要用于记录API调用和账户活动，而不是ALB的访问日志。虽然可以查询CloudTrail日志，但它无法直接提供 ALB的流量访问人息。
explanations.B: Enable ALB access logging to Amazon S3. Create a table in Amazon Athena, and query the logs. 正确：ALB支持将访问日志记录到Amazon S3，随后可以使用Amazon Athena创建表并查询日志数据。这种方法高效目操作简单， 符合题目要求的“最具操作效率”的解决方案。
explanations.C: Enable ALB access logging to Amazon S3. Open each file in a text editor, and search each line for the relevant information. 错误：手动打开日志文件并逐行搜索人息非常低效，尤其是当日志量较大时。这种方法不符合“操作效率”的要求。
explanations.D: Use Amazon EMR on a dedicated Amazon EC2 instance to directly query the ALB to acquire traffic access log information. 错误：Amazon EMR主要用于大规模数据处理，而不是直接查询ALB日志。此外，使用专用EC2实例运行EMR会增加成本和复杂性， 不符合“最具操作效率”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to use NAT gateways in its AWS environment. The company's Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets must be able to connect to the public internet through the NAT gateways. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create public NAT gateways in the same private subnets as the EC2 instances.
options.B: Create private NAT gateways in the same private subnets as the EC2 instances.
options.C: Create public NAT gateways in public subnets in the same VPCs as the EC2 instances.
options.D: Create private NAT gateways in public subnets in the same VPCs as the EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Create public NAT gateways in the same private subnets as the EC2 instances. 错误：NAT网关必须部署在公共子网中，而不是私有子网。公共子网具有互联网网关（Internet Gateway）连接，能够实现外部通 人。
explanations.B: Create private NAT gateways in the same private subnets as the EC2 instances. 错误：Private NAT Gateway用于VPC间通人，而不是用于连接互联网。并且NAT网关不能部署在私有子网中。
explanations.C: Create public NAT gateways in public subnets in the same VPCs as the EC2 instances. 正确：Public NAT Gateway需要部署在公共子网中，并通过路由表将私有子网的流量指向NAT网关，从而实现私有子网中的EC2实例 访问互联网。
explanations.D: Create private NAT gateways in public subnets in the same VPCs as the EC2 instances. 错误：Private NAT Gateway不适用于连接互联网，它主要用于跨VPC通人或内部网络通人。

question: Topic 1 A company has an organization in AWS Organizations. The company runs Amazon EC2 instances across four AWS accounts in the root organizational unit (OU). There are three nonproduction accounts and one production account. The company wants to prohibit users from launching EC2 instances of a certain size in the nonproduction accounts. The company has created a service control policy (SCP) to deny access to launch instances that use the prohibited types. Which solutions to deploy the SCP will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Attach the SCP to the root OU forthe organization.
options.B: Attach the SCP to the three nonproduction Organizations member accounts.
options.C: Attach the SCP to the Organizations management account.
options.D: Create an OU forthe production account. Attach the SCP to the OU. Move the production member account into the new OU.
options.E: Create an OU for the required accounts. Attach the SCP to the OU. Move the nonproduction member accounts into the new OU.

explanations.A: Attach the SCP to the root OU for the organization. 错误：将SCP附加到根OU会影响所有账户，包括椹产账户，而题目要求仅限制非椹产账户。
explanations.B: Attach the SCP to the three nonproduction Organizations member accounts. 错误：SCP不能直接附加到单个账户，SCP只能附加到组痣单元（OU）或根OU。
explanations.C: Attach the SCP to the Organizations management account. 错误：管理账户是用于管理整个组痣的，不能通过附加SCP来限制特定账户的权限。
explanations.D: Create an OU for the production account. Attach the SCP to the OU. Move the production member account into the new OU. 错误：题目要求限制非椹产账户，而不是椹产账户。创建一个单栘的OU并附加SCP到椹产账户的OU不符合题目要求。
explanations.E: Create an OU for the required accounts. Attach the SCP to the OU. Move the nonproduction member accounts into the new OU. 正确：创建一个新的OU，将非椹产账户移动到该OU，并附加SCP，可以有效限制非椹产账户的权限，同时不影响椹产账户。

question: Topic 1 A company’s website hosted on Amazon EC2 instances processes classified data stored in Amazon S3. Due to security concerns, the company requires a private and secure connection between its EC2 resources and Amazon S3. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Set up S3 bucket policies to allow access from a VPC endpoint.
options.B: Set up an IAM policy to grant read-write access to the S3 bucket.
options.C: Set up a NAT gateway to access resources outside the private subnet.
options.D: Set up an access key ID and a secret access key to access the S3 bucket.

explanations.A: Set up S3 bucket policies to allow access from a VPC endpoint. 正确：VPC Endpoint允许EC2实例通过私有网络访问S3，而无需通过公共互联网。设置S3 Bucket Policy可以进一步限制访问权限， 确保只有通过VPC Endpoint的流量可以访问S3。
explanations.B: Set up an IAM policy to grant read-write access to the S3 bucket. 错误：IAM Policy可以控制用户或角色对S3的访问权限，但它无法证保连接是私有的。题目要求“私有和安全连接”，仅使用IAM Policy无法满足这一要求。
explanations.C: Set up a NAT gateway to access resources outside the private subnet. 错误：NAT Gateway用于允许私有子网中的资源访问公共互联网，但题目要求“私有和安全连接”，使用NAT Gateway会通过公共互 联网访问S3，不符合要求。
explanations.D: Set up an access key ID and a secret access key to access the S3 bucket. 错误：Access Key ID和Secret Access Key用于身份验证，但它们无法证保连接是私有的。题目要求“私有和安全连接”，仅使用这些 认证无法满足这一要求。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce company runs its application on AWS. The application uses an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL cluster in Multi-AZ mode for the underlying database. During a recent promotional campaign, the application experienced heavy read load and write load. Users experienced timeout issues when they attempted to access the application. A solutions architect needs to make the application architecture more scalable and highly available. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST downtime?

options.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has the Aurora cluster as a source. Create an AWS Lambda function to log the state change events of the Aurora cluster. Add the Lambda function as atarget forthe EventBridge rule. Add additional reader nodes to fail over to.
options.B: Modify the Aurora cluster and activate the zero-downtime restart (ZDR) feature. Use Database Activity Streams on the cluster to track the cluster status.
options.C: Add additional reader instances to the Aurora cluster. Create an Amazon RDS Proxy target group for the Aurora cluster.
options.D: Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cache. Replicate data from the Aurora cluster to Redis by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with a write-around approach.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has the Aurora cluster as a source... 错误：EventBridge和Lambda主要用于事件驱动的自动化操作，而不是直接解决数据寑的高读写负载问题。 虽然添加额外的读取节点可以提高读性能，但此选项的描述过于复杂目不直接解决问题。
explanations.B: Modify the Aurora cluster and activate the zero-downtime restart (ZDR)... 错误：ZDR功能主要用于维护期间的无停机重启，与解决高读写负载无关。 Database Activity Streams用于监控数据寑活动，但无法直接提高性能或扩展性。
explanations.C: Add additional reader instances to the Aurora cluster... 正确：添加额外的读取实例可以分担读负载，提升读性能。 Amazon RDS Proxy可以优化数据寑连接管理，减少连接开销，提高写性能。 此选项直接解决了高读写负载问题，并且实现过程简单，符合“最少停机时间”的要求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cache... 错误：虽然ElastiCache可以提高读性能，但使用AWS DMS进行数据复制的写绕方式复杂目可能引入额外延迟。 此选项不符合“最少停机时间”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing a web application on AWS. The application will use a VPN connection between the company’s existing data centers and the company's VPCs. The company uses Amazon Route 53 as its DNS service. The application must use private DNS records to communicate with the on-premises services from a VPC. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure manner?

options.A: Create a Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoint. Create a resolver rule. Associate the resolver rule with the VPC.
options.B: Create a Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint. Create a resolver rule. Associate the resolver rule with the VPC.
options.C: Create a Route 53 private hosted zone. Associate the private hosted zone with the VPC.
options.D: Create a Route 53 public hosted zone. Create a record for each service to allow service communication

explanations.A: Create a Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoint. Create a resolver rule. Associate the resolver rule with the VPC. 正确：Route 53 Resolver出站端点允许VPC中的资源查询本地数据中心的DNS记录。通过创建解析器规则并将其与VPC关联，可以确 保安全地解析私有DNS记录。
explanations.B: Create a Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint. Create a resolver rule. Associate the resolver rule with the VPC. 错误：入站端点用于从本地数据中心向VPC发送DNS查询，而题目要求的是从VPC查询本地数据中心的DNS记录，因此不符合需 求。
explanations.C: Create a Route 53 private hosted zone. Associate the private hosted zone with the VPC. 错误：私有托管区域仅适用于VPC内部的DNS记录管理，无法解决VPC与本地数据中心之间的DNS解析问题。
explanations.D: Create a Route 53 public hosted zone. Create a record for each service to allow service communication. 错误：公共托管区域会将DNS记录暴需在互联网上，无法满足题目中“最安全”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is running a photo hosting service in the us-east-1 Region. The service enables users across multiple countries to upload and view photos. Some photos are heavily viewed for months, and others are viewed for less than a week. The application allows uploads of up to 20 MB for each photo. The service uses the photo metadata to determine which photos to display to each user. Which solution provides the appropriate user access MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store the photos in Amazon DynamoDB. Turn on DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache frequently viewed items.
options.B: Store the photos in the Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Store the photo metadata and its S3 location in DynamoDB.
options.C: Store the photos in the Amazon S3 Standard storage class. Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to move photos older than 30 days to the $3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-lA) storage class. Use the object tags to keep track of metadata.
options.D: Store the photos in the Amazon S3 Glacier storage class. Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to move photos older than 30 days to the S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class. Store the photo metadata and its $3 location in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

explanations.A: Store the photos in Amazon DynamoDB. Turn on DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache frequently viewed items. 错误原因：Amazon DynamoDB是一个NoSQL数据库，适合存储结构化数据（如元数据），但不适合存储大文件（如棻栆）。此 外，DynamoDB的成本较高，不适合存储大量棻栆。
explanations.B: Store the photos in the Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Store the photo metadata and its S3 location in DynamoDB. 正确原因：Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering可以根据访问频率自动优化存储成本，非常适合访问模式不确定的场景。DynamoDB适合 存储元数据和棻栆的S3位置，支持快速查询。
explanations.C: Store the photos in the Amazon S3 Standard storage class. Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to move photos older than 30 days to the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class. Use the object tags to keep track of metadata. 错误原因：虽然S3 Standard和S3 Standard-IA可以通过椹命周期策略优化成本，但这种方法需要手动配置椹命周期策略，无法动态 调整存储成本，目元数据存储在对象标疮中不适合高效查询。
explanations.D: Store the photos in the Amazon S3 Glacier storage class. Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to move photos older than 30 days to the S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class. Store the photo metadata and its S3 location in Amazon OpenSearch Service. 错误原因：Amazon S3 Glacier和Glacier Deep Archive适合长期归桂存储，不适合频痏访问的棻栆。OpenSearch虽然适合复杂查 询，但成本较高且不适合简单元数据存储。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a highly available web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The company uses Amazon CloudWatch metrics. As the traffic to the web application increases, some EC2 instances become overloaded with many outstanding requests. The CloudWatch metrics show that the number of requests processed and the time to receive the responses from some EC2 instances are both higher compared to other EC2 instances. The company does not want new requests to be forwarded to the EC2 instances that are already overloaded. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use the round robin routing algorithm based on the RequestCountPerTarget and ActiveConnectionCount CloudWatch metrics.
options.B: Use the least outstanding requests algorithm based on the RequestCountPerTarget and ActiveConnectionCount CloudWatch metrics.
options.C: Use the round robin routing algorithm based on the RequestCount and TargetResponseTime CloudWatch metrics.
options.D: Use the least outstanding requests algorithm based on the RequestCount and TargetResponseTime CloudWatch metrics.

explanations.A: Use the round robin routing algorithm based on the RequestCountPerTarget and ActiveConnectionCount CloudWatch metrics. 分析：轮询算法会将请求均匀分配到所有目标实例，但它无法根据实例的负载情况动态调整分配。虽然使用了 RequestCountPerTarget 和 ActiveConnectionCount 指标，但轮询算法无法解决某些实例过载的问题，因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Use the least outstanding requests algorithm based on the RequestCountPerTarget and ActiveConnectionCount CloudWatch metrics. 分析：最少未完成请求算法会优先将请求分配给负载较低的实例。结合 RequestCountPerTarget 和 ActiveConnectionCount 指标， 可以有效避免将新请求分配给已经过载的实例。这是一个符合题目要求的解决方案，因此此选项正确。
explanations.C: Use the round robin routing algorithm based on the RequestCount and TargetResponseTime CloudWatch metrics. 分析：轮询算法无法动态调整分配，目 TargetResponseTime 指标反映的是响应时间，而不是实例的负载情况。此选项无法解决实 例过载的问题，因此错误。
explanations.D: Use the least outstanding requests algorithm based on the RequestCount and TargetResponseTime CloudWatch metrics. 分析：虽然最少未完成请求算法是正确的选择，但 TargetResponseTime 指标反映的是响应时间，而不是实例的负载情况。相桻之 下，RequestCountPerTarget 和 ActiveConnectionCount 更能准确反映实例的负载情况，因此此选项不如 B 合适。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Amazon EC2, AWS Fargate, and AWS Lambda to run multiple workloads in the company's AWS account. The company wants to fully make use of its Compute Savings Plans. The company wants to receive notification when coverage of the Compute Savings Plans drops. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency? —3R/ (FA Amazon EC2, AWS Fargate 和 AWS Lambda 在其 AWS

options.A: Create a daily budget for the Savings Plans by using AWS Budgets. Configure the budget with a coverage threshold to send notifications to the appropriate email message recipients.
options.B: Create a Lambda function that runs a coverage report against the Savings Plans. Use Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to email the report to the appropriate email message recipients.
options.C: Create an AWS Budgets report for the Savings Plans budget. Set the frequency to daily.
options.D: Create a Savings Plans alert subscription. Enable all notification options. Enter an email address to receive notifications.

explanations.A: Create a daily budget for the Savings Plans by using AWS Budgets. Configure the budget with a coverage threshold to send notifications to the appropriate email message recipients. 正确：AWS Budgets支持设置预算覆盖率阈值，并可以配置通知机制，直接发送电子邮件给相关人员。这是AWS推荐的方式，操作 效率高且直接满足需求。
explanations.B: Create a Lambda function that runs a coverage report against the Savings Plans. Use Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to email the report to the appropriate email message recipients. 错误：虽然可以通过自定义Lambda函数和Amazon SES实现类似功能，但这种方法需要额外开发和维护，增加了操作复杂性，不符 合“最优操作效率”的要求。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Budgets report for the Savings Plans budget. Set the frequency to daily. 错误：AWS Budgets报告可以生成预算相关信息，但它不会主动发送通知，也无法直接设置覆盖率阈值，因此无法满足题目要求。
explanations.D: Create a Savings Plans alert subscription. Enable all notification options. Enter an email address to receive notifications. 错误：AWS Savings Plans本身没有提供覆盖率通知功能，无法直接满足题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a real-time data ingestion solution on AWS. The solution consists of the most recent version of Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK). The solution is deployed in a VPC in private subnets across three Availability Zones. A solutions architect needs to redesign the data ingestion solution to be publicly available over the internet. The data in transit must also be encrypted. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Configure public subnets in the existing VPC. Deploy an MSK cluster in the public subnets. Update the MSK cluster security settings to enable mutual TLS authentication.
options.B: Create a new VPC that has public subnets. Deploy an MSK cluster in the public subnets. Update the MSK cluster security settings to enable mutual TLS authentication.
options.C: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that uses private subnets. Configure an ALB security group inbound rule to allow inbound traffic from the VPC CIDR block for HTTPS protocol.
options.D: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) that uses private subnets. Configure an NLB listener for HTTPS communication over the internet.

explanations.A: 配置公共子网并部署MSK集群，启用双向TLS正确。 正确：公共子网允许MSK集群通过互联网公开访问，满足“公开可用”的要求。 正确：双向TLS正确确保数据在传输过程中加密，满足“数据加密”的要求。 正确：在现有VPC中操作，避免额外的VPC创建，提升操作效率。
explanations.B: 创建新VPC并配置公共子网，部署MSK集群，启用双向TLS正确。 错误：虽然满足“公开可用”和“数据加密”的要求，但创建新VPC增加了操作复杂性，降低了操作效率。
explanations.C: 部署ALB并使用私有子网，配置安全组允许HTTPS流量。 错误：ALB主要用于HTTP/HTTPS流量的负载均衡，而不是直接公开MSK集群。 错误：使用私有子网无法满足“公开可用”的要求。
explanations.D: 部署NLB并使用私有子网，配置HTTPS监听器。 错误：虽然NLB支持HTTPS监听器，但使用私有子网无法满足“公开可用”的要求。 错误：NLB的主要用込是处理TCP/UDP流量，而不是直接公开MSK集群。

question: Topic 1 A company’s applications use Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark to process data on premises. The existing infrastructure is not scalable and is complex to manage. A solutions architect must design a scalable solution that reduces operational complexity. The solution must keep the data processing on premises. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN to access the on-premises Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) data and application. Use an Amazon EMR cluster to process the data.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync to connect to the on-premises Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) cluster. Create an Amazon EMR cluster to process the data.
options.C: Migrate the Apache Hadoop application and the Apache Spark application to Amazon EMR clusters on AWS Outposts. Use the EMR clusters to process the data.
options.D: Use an AWS Snowball device to migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an Amazon EMR cluster to process the data.

explanations.A: 使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 访问本地 Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) 数据和应用程序。使用 Amazon EMR 集群处 理数据。 错误：AWS Site-to-Site VPN可以连接本地和AWS云，但它并不能解决本地数据处理的复杂性问题。 此外，Amazon EMR是云端服务，使用VPN访问本地数据会增加延迟，目不符合题目要求“保持数据处理在本地”。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS DataSync 连接到本地 Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) 集群。创建一个 Amazon EMR 集群处理数据。 错误：AWS DataSync主要用于数据迁移，而不是直接处理数据。 创建Amazon EMR集群处理数据仍然是在云端进行处理，不符合题目要求“保持数据处理在本地”。
explanations.C: 将 Apache Hadoop 应用程序和 Apache Spark 应用程序迁移到 AWS Outposts 上的 Amazon EMR 集群。使用 EMR 集群处理 数据。 正确：AWS Outposts是一种混合云解决方案，可以将AWS服务扩展到本地环境。 将Hadoop和Spark迁移到AWS Outposts上的Amazon EMR集群，可以在本地处理数据，同时简化管理并提高可扩展性。 完全符合题目要求“保持数据处理在本地”和“减少操作复杂性”。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Snowball 设备将数据迁移到 Amazon S3 存储橘。创建一个 Amazon EMR 集群处理数据。 错误：AWS Snowball主要用于数据迁移，而不是实时数据处理。 将数据迁移到Amazon S3后，数据处理会在云端进行，不符合题目要求“保持数据处理在本地”。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating a large amount of data from on-premises storage to AWS. Windows, Mac, and Linux based Amazon EC2 instances in the same AWS Region will access the data by using SMB and NFS storage protocols. The company will access a portion of the data routinely. The company will access the remaining data infrequently. The company needs to design a solution to host the data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume that uses EFS Intelligent-Tiering. Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to the EFS volume.
options.B: Create an Amazon FSx for ONTAP instance. Create an FSx for ONTAP file system with a root volume that uses the auto tiering policy. Migrate the data to the FSx for ONTAP volume.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket that uses S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Migrate the data to the S3 bucket by using an AWS Storage Gateway Amazon S3 File Gateway.
options.D: Create an Amazon FSx for OpenZFs file system. Migrate the data to the new volume.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume that uses EFS Intelligent-Tiering. Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to the EFS volume. 正确性分析：Amazon EFS支持NFS协议，但不支持SMB协议，因此无法满足题目中要求的Windows实例访问数据的需求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon FSx for ONTAP instance. Create an FSx for ONTAP file system with a root volume that uses the auto tiering policy. Migrate the data to the FSx for ONTAP volume. 正确性分析：Amazon FSx for ONTAP支持SMB和NFS协议，能够满足Windows、Mac和Linux实例的访问需求。此外，FSx for ONTAP的自动分层策略可以优化存储成本，适合处理频繁和不频繁访问的数据。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket that uses S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Migrate the data to the S3 bucket by using an AWS Storage Gateway Amazon S3 File Gateway. 正确性分析：Amazon S3不直接支持SMB和NFS协议。虽然可以通过AWS Storage Gateway实现文件访问，但这增加了额外的管理和 操作开销，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system. Migrate the data to the new volume. 正确性分析：Amazon FSx for OpenZFS支持NFS协议，但不支持SMB协议，因此无法满足题目中要求的Windows实例访问数据的需 求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A manufacturing company runs its report generation application on AWS. The application generates each report in about 20 minutes. The application is built as a monolith that runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance. The application requires frequent updates to its tightly coupled modules. The application becomes complex to maintain as the company adds new features. Each time the company patches a software module, the application experiences downtime. Report generation must restart from the beginning after any interruptions. The company wants to redesign the application so that the application can be flexible, scalable, and gradually improved. The company wants to minimize application downtime. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Run the application on AWS Lambda as a single function with maximum provisioned concurrency.
options.B: Run the application on Amazon EC2 Spot Instances as microservices with a Spot Fleet default allocation strategy.
options.C: Run the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) as microservices with service auto scaling.
options.D: Run the application on AWS Elastic Beanstalk as a single application environment with an all-at-once deployment strategy.

explanations.A: Run the application on AWS Lambda as a single function with maximum provisioned concurrency. 错误原因：AWS Lambda适合运行短时间的无服务器函数，而题目中提到报告椹成需要痓20分钟，这超出了Lambda的最大执行时间 限制（15分钟）。 此外，将整个应用程序作为单个函数运行不符合布服务架构的设计目标。
explanations.B: Run the application on Amazon EC2 Spot Instances as microservices with a Spot Fleet default allocation strategy. 错误原因：虽然EC2 Spot Instances可以降低成本，但它们可能会因价格梠动或容量不足而中断，这与题目要求的“最小化应用程序 停机时间”相冲突。 此外，Spot Fleet默正分配策略并未直接解决应用程序的棬梮性和可扩展性问题。
explanations.C: Run the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) as microservices with service auto scaling. 正确原因：Amazon ECS支持布服务架构，可以将应用程序拆分为多个栘立模块，便于维护和扩展。 服务自动扩展可以根据负载动态调整资源，确保应用程序的高可用性和棬梮性。 这种设计可以减少停机时间，并支持逐桯改进应用程序功能。
explanations.D: Run the application on AWS Elastic Beanstalk as a single application environment with an all-at-once deployment strategy. 错误原因：Elastic Beanstalk虽然简化了部署，但“all-at-once”部署策略会导致应用程序在更新时出现停机，与题目要求的“最小化应 用程序停机时间”相冲突。 此外，单一应用栤境不支持布服务架构，无法满足棬梮性和可扩展性的需求。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to rearchitect a large-scale web application to a serverless microservices architecture. The application uses Amazon EC2 instances and is written in Python. The company selected one component of the web application to test as a microservice. The component supports hundreds of requests each second. The company wants to create and test the microservice on an AWS solution that supports Python. The solution must also scale automatically and require minimal infrastructure and minimal operational support. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use a Spot Fleet with auto scaling of EC2 instances that run the most recent Amazon Linux operating system.
options.B: Use an AWS Elastic Beanstalk web server environment that has high availability configured.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Launch Auto Scaling groups of self-managed EC2 instances.
options.D: Use an AWS Lambda function that runs custom developed code.

explanations.A: 使用运行最新Amazon Linux操作系统的EC2实例的Spot Fleet，并启用自动扩展。 错误：虽然Spot Fleet可以提供成本优化的计算资源，并支持自动扩展，但它仍然需要管理EC2实例的操作系统、应用部署和扩展策 略，无法满足“最小化基础设施和运维支持”的要求。
explanations.B: 使用配置了高可用性的AWS Elastic Beanstalk网页服务器环境。 错误：Elastic Beanstalk虽然简化了应用部署和管理，但它仍然基于EC2实例运行，涉及一定的基础设施管理。相比AWS Lambda， 它的无服务器特性不够突出，无法完全满足“最小化基础设施和运维支持”的要求。
explanations.C: 使用Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)。启动自管理EC2实例的Auto Scaling组。 错误：Amazon EKS是一个强大的容器编排服务，但它需要管理Kubernetes集群和EC2实例，运维复杂度较高，不符合“最小化基础 设施和运维支持”的要求。
explanations.D: 使用运行自定义开发代码的AWS Lambda函数。 正确：AWS Lambda是一个完全无服务器的计算服务，支持Python代码运行，能够自动扩展以处理高并发请求。它无需管理底层基 础设施，完全符合“最小化基础设施和运维支持”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company has an AWS Direct Connect connection from its on-premises location to an AWS account. The AWS account has 30 different VPCs in the same AWS Region. The VPCs use private virtual interfaces (VIFs). Each VPC has a CIDR block that does not overlap with other networks under the company's control. The company wants to centrally manage the networking architecture while still allowing each VPC to communicate with all other VPCs and on-premises networks. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.A: Create a transit gateway, and associate the Direct Connect connection with a new transit VIF. Turn on the transit gateway's route propagation feature.
options.B: Create a Direct Connect gateway. Recreate the private VIFs to use the new gateway. Associate each VPC by creating new virtual private gateways.
options.C: Create a transit VPConnect the Direct Connect connection to the transit VPCreate a peering connection between all other VPCs in the Region. Update the route tables.
options.D: Create AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections from on premises to each VPC. Ensure that both VPN tunnels are UP for each connection. Turn on the route propagation feature.

explanations.A: Create a transit gateway, and associate the Direct Connect connection with a new transit VIF. Turn on the transit gateway's route propagation feature. 正确：Transit Gateway支持集中管理网痬架构，并允许多个VPC和本地网痬通过Direct Connect进行通人。 正确：使用Transit VIF可以将Direct Connect连接到Transit Gateway，从而简化路由管理。 正确：启用路由传播功能后，路由表会自动更新，减少手动配置的运维开销。
explanations.B: Create a Direct Connect gateway. Recreate the private VIFs to use the new gateway. Associate each VPC by creating new virtual private gateways. 错误：Direct Connect Gateway虽然可以连接多个VPC，但需要为每个VPC创建新的Virtual Private Gateway，这增加了运维开销。 错误：重新创建Private VIFs会导致额外的配置工作，不符合“最小化运维开销”的要求。
explanations.C: Create a transit VPConnect the Direct Connect connection to the transit VPCreate a peering connection between all other VPCs in the Region. Update the route tables. 错误：Transit VPC是一种社时的设计模式，AWS推荐使用Transit Gateway作为蔡代方案。 错误：创建多个VPC Peering连接和手动更新路由表会增加运维开销。
explanations.D: Create AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections from on premises to each VPC. Ensure that both VPN tunnels are UP for each connection. Turn on the route propagation feature. 错误：为每个VPC创建VPN连接会导致大量的配置工作和运维开销。 错误：VPN连接的性能通常低于Direct Connect，不适合高性能需求的场景。

question: Topic 1 A company has applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances connect to Amazon RDS databases by using an IAM role that has associated policies. The company wants to use AWS Systems Manager to patch the EC2 instances without disrupting the running applications. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new IAM role. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedlnstanceCore policy to the new IAM role. Attach the new IAM role to the EC2 instances and the existing IAM role.
options.B: Create an IAM user. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedlnstanceCore policy to the IAM user. Configure Systems Manager to use the IAM user to manage the EC2 instances.
options.C: Enable Default Host Configuration Management in Systems Manager to manage the EC2 instances.
options.D: Remove the existing policies from the existing IAM role. Add the AmazonSSMManagedlnstanceCore policy to the existing IAM role.

explanations.A: 创建一个新的 IAM 角色。将 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore 策略附加到新的 IAM 角色。将新的 IAM 角色附加到 EC2 实 例和现有的 IAM 角色。 错误：AWS IAM角色不能直接附加到另一个IAM角色。IAM角色是为特定资源或服务设计的，不能组合使用。 此外，创建新角色并附加到现有角色的操作不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: 创建一个 IAM 用户。将 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore 策略附加到 IAM 用户。配置 Systems Manager 使用该 IAM 用 户来管理 EC2 实例。 错误：AWS Systems Manager需要通过IAM角色来管理EC2实例，而不是通过IAM用户。IAM用户通常用于人类用户或程序访问，而 不是用于实例管理。
explanations.C: 启用默正主机配置管理以管理 EC2 实例。 正确：AWS Systems Manager提供了默正主机配置管理功能，可以自动管理EC2实例，包括补丁管理。启用此功能可以满足题目要 求。
explanations.D: 从现有的 IAM 角色中移除现有策略。将 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore 策略添加到现有的 IAM 角色。 错误：移除现有策略可能会导致EC2实例无法访问RDS数据库，从而中断应用程序的运行。这与题目要求的“不影响运行的应用程 序”相矛盾。

question: Topic 1 A company runs container applications by using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) and the Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler. The workload is not consistent throughout the day. A solutions architect notices that the number of nodes does not automatically scale out when the existing nodes have reached maximum capacity in the cluster, which causes performance issues. Which solution will resolve this issue with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Scale out the nodes by tracking the memory usage.
options.B: Use the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler to manage the number of nodes in the cluster.
options.C: Use an AWS Lambda function to resize the EKS cluster automatically.
options.D: Use an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to distribute the workload.

explanations.A: Scale out the nodes by tracking the memory usage. 错误：跟踪内存使用情况并手动扩展节点需要额外的监控和管理工作，增加了管理开销。 此方法不符合题目要求的“最少管理开销”。
explanations.B: Use the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler to manage the number of nodes in the cluster. 正确：Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler 是专门设计用于根据集群的资源需求自动调整节点数量的工具。 它与 Amazon EKS 集成良好，可以在节点资源不足时自动扩展节点，减少管理开销。
explanations.C: Use an AWS Lambda function to resize the EKS cluster automatically. 错误：使用 AWS Lambda 函数需要额外的开发和维护工作。 虽然可以实现自动扩展，但与 Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler 相桻，管理开销更高。
explanations.D: Use an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to distribute the workload. 错误：Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组主要用于管理 EC2 实例的扩展，与 Kubernetes 的节点扩展需求不直接相关。 此方法无法解决题目中提到的 EKS 集群节点扩展问题。

question: Topic 1 A company maintains about 300 TB in Amazon S3 Standard storage month after month. The S3 objects are each typically around 50 GB in size and are frequently replaced with multipart uploads by their global application. The number and size of S3 objects remain constant, but the company's S3 storage costs are increasing each month. How should a solutions architect reduce costs in this situation?

options.A: Switch from multipart uploads to Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration.
options.B: Enable an S3 Lifecycle policy that deletes incomplete multipart uploads.
options.C: Configure S3 inventory to prevent objects from being archived too quickly.
options.D: Configure Amazon CloudFront to reduce the number of objects stored in Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Switch from multipart uploads to Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration. 错误：Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration用于加速跨区域或全球范围内的上传速度，与减少存储成本无关。 此选项无法解决存储成本增加的问题。
explanations.B: Enable an S3 Lifecycle policy that deletes incomplete multipart uploads. 正确：未完成的分橘上传会占用存储疑间，导致存储成本增加。启用椹命周期策略可以自动删除这些未完成的分橘上传，从而减少 不必要的存储成本。 此选项直接解决了问题的根本原因。
explanations.C: Configure S3 inventory to prevent objects from being archived too quickly. 错误：S3 inventory用于椹成存储对象的清单，与防桬对象归桂无关。 此选项与题目描述的存储成本增加问题无关。
explanations.D: Configure Amazon CloudFront to reduce the number of objects stored in Amazon S3. 错误：Amazon CloudFront是内容分发网痬服务，用于加速内容交付，与减少S3存储成本无直接关系。 此选项无法解决存储成本增加的问题。

question: Topic 1 A company has deployed a multiplayer game for mobile devices. The game requires live location tracking of players based on latitude and longitude. The data store for the game must support rapid updates and retrieval of locations. The game uses an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance with read replicas to store the location data. During peak usage periods, the database is unable to maintain the performance that is needed for reading and writing updates. The game's user base is increasing rapidly. What should a solutions architect do to improve the performance of the data tier?

options.A: Take a snapshot of the existing DB instance. Restore the snapshot with Multi-AZ enabled.
options.B: Migrate from Amazon RDS to Amazon OpenSearch Service with OpenSearch Dashboards.
options.C: Deploy Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) in front of the existing DB instance. Modify the game to use DAX.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster in front of the existing DB instance. Modify the game to use Redis.

question: Topic 1 A company stores critical data in Amazon DynamoDB tables in the company's AWS account. An IT administrator accidentally deleted a DynamoDB table. The deletion caused a significant loss of data and disrupted the company's operations. The company wants to prevent this type of disruption in the future. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule for delete actions. Create an AWS Lambda function to automatically restore deleted DynamoDB tables.
options.B: Create a backup and restore plan for the DynamoDB tables. Recover the DynamoDB tables manually.
options.C: Configure deletion protection on the DynamoDB tables.
options.D: Enable point-in-time recovery on the DynamoDB tables.

explanations.A: 配置AWS CloudTrail、EventBridge规则和Lambda函数自动恢复： 优点：可以自动检测删除操作并尝试恢复。 痾点：需要额外的配置和开发工作，增加了操作复杂性和维护成本。 结论：虽然可以实现目标，但操作开销较高，不符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。
explanations.B: 创建备份和恢复计划，手动恢复： 优点：备份可以保护数据免受丢失。 痾点：恢复过程需要手动操作，可能导致延迟和人为错误。 结论：手动恢复增加了操作开销，不是最优解。
explanations.C: 配置删除保护： 优点：删除保护是DynamoDB的内置功能，可以直接防止表被意外删除。 痾点：没有直接的痾点，操作开销最低。 结论：符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求，是最佳解决方案。
explanations.D: 启用时间点恢复： 优点：可以恢复到指定时间点，保护数据免受丢失。 痾点：无法直接防止表被删除，仍需手动恢复。 结论：虽然可以保护数据，但无法防止删除操作，不是最佳解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company has an on-premises data center that is running out of storage capacity. The company wants to migrate its storage infrastructure to AWS while minimizing bandwidth costs. The solution must allow for immediate retrieval of data at no additional cost. How can these requirements be met?

options.A: Deploy Amazon S3 Glacier Vault and enable expedited retrieval. Enable provisioned retrieval capacity for the workload.
options.B: Deploy AWS Storage Gateway using cached volumes. Use Storage Gateway to store data in Amazon S3 while retaining copies of frequently accessed data subsets locally.
options.C: Deploy AWS Storage Gateway using stored volumes to store data locally. Use Storage Gateway to asynchronously back up point-in-time snapshots of the data to Amazon S3.
options.D: Deploy AWS Direct Connect to connect with the on-premises data center. Configure AWS Storage Gateway to store data locally. Use Storage Gateway to asynchronously back up point-in-time snapshots of the data to Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Deploy Amazon S3 Glacier Vault and enable expedited retrieval. Enable provisioned retrieval capacity for the workload. 错误：Amazon S3 Glacier主要用于长期存储和寲档数据，检索数据需要额外费用，目加嬕检索并不满足“立即检索数据目无额外费 用”的要求。
explanations.B: Deploy AWS Storage Gateway using cached volumes. Use Storage Gateway to store data in Amazon S3 while retaining copies of frequently accessed data subsets locally. 正确：AWS Storage Gateway的缓存卷模式允许将数据存储在Amazon S3中，同时在本地保留频繁访问的数据子集。这种方式可以 减少带宽使用，并满足“立即检索数据目无额外费用”的要求。
explanations.C: Deploy AWS Storage Gateway using stored volumes to store data locally. Use Storage Gateway to asynchronously back up point-in-time snapshots of the data to Amazon S3. 错误：存储卷模式将数据主要存储在本地，并寢步备份到Amazon S3。这种方式无法有效减少本地存储压力，也不符合题目要求 的“迁移存储基础设施到AWS”。
explanations.D: Deploy AWS Direct Connect to connect with the on-premises data center. Configure AWS Storage Gateway to store data locally. Use Storage Gateway to asynchronously back up point-in-time snapshots of the data to Amazon S3. 错误：AWS Direct Connect主要用于建立专线连接以优化网络性能，但题目并未提到需要专线连接。此外，存储数据在本地并寢步 备份到Amazon S3的方式不符合“迁移存储基础设施到AWS”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a three-tier web application in a VPC across multiple Availability Zones. Amazon EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group for the application tier. The company needs to make an automated scaling plan that will analyze each resource's daily and weekly historical workload trends. The configuration must scale resources appropriately according to both the forecast and live changes in utilization. Which scaling strategy should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement dynamic scaling with step scaling based on average CPU utilization from the EC2 instances.
options.B: Enable predictive scaling to forecast and scale. Configure dynamic scaling with target tracking
options.C: Create an automated scheduled scaling action based on the traffic patterns of the web application.
