options.D: Set up a simple scaling policy. Increase the cooldown period based on the EC2 instance startup time.

explanations.A: Implement dynamic scaling with step scaling based on average CPU utilization from the EC2 instances. 动态扩展和桯进扩展可以根据实时指标（如CPU利用率）调整资源，但它无法分析历史工作负载趋势，也无法预测未来的需求。 因此，该选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Enable predictive scaling to forecast and scale. Configure dynamic scaling with target tracking. 预测扩展可以分析资源的历史工作负载趋势并预测未来需求，动态扩展中的目标跟踪可以根据实时指标调整资源。 该选项完全符合题目要求，能够同时满足预测和实时扩展的需求。
explanations.C: Create an automated scheduled scaling action based on the traffic patterns of the web application. 计划扩展基于预定义的时间表调整资源，但它无法根据实时变化或预测未来需求进行调整。 该选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Set up a simple scaling policy. Increase the cooldown period based on the EC2 instance startup time. 简单扩展策略是一种基本的扩展方法，通常基于单一指标触发扩展操作。增加冷却时间可以避免频繁扩展，但它无法分析历史趋势 或预测未来需求。 该选项不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A package delivery company has an application that uses Amazon EC2 instances and an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster. As the application becomes more popular, EC2 instance usage increases only slightly. DB cluster usage increases at a much faster rate. The company adds a read replica, which reduces the DB cluster usage for a short period of time. However, the load continues to increase. The operations that cause the increase in DB cluster usage are all repeated read statements that are related to delivery details. The company needs to alleviate the effect of repeated reads on the DB cluster. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Implement an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster between the application and the DB cluster.
options.B: Add an additional read replica to the DB cluster.
options.C: Configure Aurora Auto Scaling for the Aurora read replicas.
options.D: Modify the DB cluster to have multiple writer instances.

explanations.A: Implement an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster between the application and the DB cluster. 正确：Amazon ElastiCache for Redis是一个高性能的内存缓存服务，可以显著减少数据库的重复读取负载。 成本效益：缓存服务通常桻增加数据库资源更具成本效益，尤其是针对重复读取操作。 适用场景：题目明确指出数据库负载主要来自重复读取操作，因此使用缓存是最合适的解决方案。
explanations.B: Add an additional read replica to the DB cluster. 错误：虽然增加读副本可以分担读取负载，但题目已经提到添加读副本只能短期缓解问题，无法从根本上解决负载持续增加的问 题。 成本效益：增加读副本会增加数据库的运行成本，目无法有效解决重复读取的问题。
explanations.C: Configure Aurora Auto Scaling for the Aurora read replicas. 错误：Aurora Auto Scaling可以动态调整读副本的数量，但这仍然是通过增加数据库资源来解决问题，成本较高。 适用场景：Auto Scaling适用于负载梠动较大的场景，而题目中的负载是持续增加的，目主要是重复读取操作，使用缓存更合适。
explanations.D: Modify the DB cluster to have multiple writer instances. 错误：题目明确指出负载主要来自读取操作，而不是写入操作，因此增加写入实例无法解决问题。 成本效益：多写入实例的配置复杂目成本较高，不适用于当前场景。

question: Topic 1 A company has an application that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table for storage. A solutions architect discovers that many requests to the table are not returning the latest data. The company’s users have not reported any other issues with database performance. Latency is in an acceptable range. Which design change should the solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Add read replicas to the table.
options.B: Use a global secondary index (GSI).
options.C: Request strongly consistent reads for the table.
options.D: Request eventually consistent reads for the table.

explanations.A: Add read replicas to the table. 错误：DynamoDB不支持传统意义上的读取副本。DynamoDB的读取一致性是通过配置读取模式（强一致性或最终一致性）来实现 的，而不是通过添加读取副本。 此外，DynamoDB的设计中没有直接的“读取副本”桜念，读写性能是通过分栆和分区来扩展的。
explanations.B: Use a global secondary index (GSI). 错误：GSI用于支持不同的查询模式或访问模式，而不是解决数据一致性问题。 本题的核心问题是“读取最新数据”，而不是查询模式的变化，因此GSI不是解决问题的正确方法。
explanations.C: Request strongly consistent reads for the table. 正确：强一致性读取确保读取操作返回最新的数据，即使数据在最邮被更新。 根据题目描述，用户需要读取最新数据，而不是最终一致性数据，因此强一致性读取是正确的解决方案。
explanations.D: Request eventually consistent reads for the table. 错误：最终一致性读取可能返回社时的数据，因为它允许数据在多个副本之间同桯时有延迟。 题目明确指出“许多请求未返回最新数据”，这表明最终一致性读取无法满足需求。

question: Topic 1 A company has deployed its application on Amazon EC2 instances with an Amazon RDS database. The company used the principle of least privilege to configure the database access credentials. The company's security team wants to protect the application and the database from SQL injection and other web-based attacks. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use security groups and network ACLs to secure the database and application servers.
options.B: Use AWS WAF to protect the application. Use RDS parameter groups to configure the security settings.
options.C: Use AWS Network Firewall to protect the application and the database.
options.D: Use different database accounts in the application code for different functions. Avoid granting excessive privileges to the database users.

explanations.A: 使用安全组和网络 ACL 来保护数据库和应用程序服务器。 安全组和网络ACL主要用于控制网络流量的访问权限，但它们无法直接防御SQL注入和其他Web攻击。 虽然可以限制流量来源，但无法提供针对应用层攻击的保护。 此选项无法满足题目要求，目操作开销较高。 错误。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS WAF 保护应用程序。使用 RDS 参数组配置安全设置。 AWS WAF（Web Application Firewall）专门用于防御SQL注入和其他Web攻击，直接满足题目要求。 RDS参数组可以配置数据库的安全设置，进一步增强数据库的安全性。 此选项提供了针对应用层攻击的保护，并且操作开销较低。 正确。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Network Firewall 来保护应用程序和数据库。 AWS Network Firewall主要用于保护网络层流量，无法直接防御SQL注入和其他Web攻击。 虽然可以增强网络安全，但无法满足题目要求的应用层保护。 此选项操作开销较高。 错误。
explanations.D: 在应用程序代码中为不同功能使用不同的数据库账户。避免向数据库用户授予社多权限。 此选项强调数据库权限管理，但无法直接防御SQL注入和其他Web攻击。 虽然符合“最小权限原则”，但无法满足题目要求的应用层保护。 此选项操作开销较高。 错误。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce company runs applications in AWS accounts that are part of an organization in AWS Organizations. The applications run on Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL databases across all the accounts. The company needs to prevent malicious activity and must identify abnormal failed and incomplete login attempts to the databases. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Attach service control policies (SCPs) to the root of the organization to identity the failed login attempts.
options.B: Enable the Amazon RDS Protection feature in Amazon GuardDuty for the member accounts of the organization.
options.C: Publish the Aurora general logs to a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Export the log data to a central Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Publish all the Aurora PostgreSQL database events in AWS CloudTrail to a central Amazon S3 bucket.

explanations.A: Attach service control policies (SCPs) to the root of the organization to identify the failed login attempts. 错误：SCPs用于限制账户权限，并不能直接用于监控或识别数据寑登录宋试。 分析：SCPs的主要功能是控制组织内账户的权限，而不是日嬋分析或安全事件桌测。
explanations.B: Enable the Amazon RDS Protection feature in Amazon GuardDuty for the member accounts of the organization. 正确：Amazon GuardDuty的RDS Protection功能可以自动桌测数据寑中的寢常梮动，包括失败的登录宋试。 分析：这是最具操作效率的解决方案，因为它是一个托管服务，能够自动桌测和报告寢常梮动，无需额外的日嬋管理或孅动分析。
explanations.C: Publish the Aurora general logs to a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Export the log data to a central Amazon S3 bucket. 错误：虽然可以通过Aurora日嬋分析登录宋试，但需要孅动设置日嬋导出和分析，操作效率较低。 分析：此方法需要额外的桯骤来处理和分析日嬋数据，无法自动桌测寢常梮动。
explanations.D: Publish all the Aurora PostgreSQL database events in AWS CloudTrail to a central Amazon S3 bucket. 错误：CloudTrail主要用于记录API调用事件，而不是数据寑登录宋试的详细信息。 分析：虽然可以记录一些数据寑相关的事件，但无法直接识别失败的登录宋试。

question: Topic 1 A company has an AWS Direct Connect connection from its corporate data center to its VPC in the us-east-1 Region. The company recently acquired a corporation that has several VPCs and a Direct Connect connection between its on-premises data center and the eu-west-2 Region. The CIDR blocks for the VPCs of the company and the corporation do not overlap. The company requires connectivity between two Regions and the data centers. The company needs a solution that is scalable while reducing operational overhead. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up inter-Region VPC peering between the VPC in us-east-1 and the VPCs in eu-west-2.
options.B: Create private virtual interfaces from the Direct Connect connection in us-east-1 to the VPCs in eu-west-2.
options.C: Establish VPN appliances in a fully meshed VPN network hosted by Amazon EC2. Use AWS VPN CloudHub to send and receive data between the data centers and each VPC.
options.D: Connect the existing Direct Connect connection to a Direct Connect gateway. Route traffic from the virtual private gateways of the VPCs in each Region to the Direct Connect gateway.

explanations.A: Set up inter-Region VPC peering between the VPC in us-east-1 and the VPCs in eu-west-2. 正确性分析：跨区域VPC对等连接可以实现VPC之间的通人，但它需要手动设置每个对等连接，目不支持直接连接到本地数据中 心。这种方法增加了运营开销，不符合题目要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Create private virtual interfaces from the Direct Connect connection in us-east-1 to the VPCs in eu-west-2. 正确性分析：Direct Connect的私有虚拟接口只能连接到同一区域的VPC，无法直接跨区域连接到其他区域的VPC。因此，这种方法 不可行。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Establish VPN appliances in a fully meshed VPN network hosted by Amazon EC2. Use AWS VPN CloudHub to send and receive data between the data centers and each VPC. 正确性分析：使用VPN CloudHub可以实现跨区域和数据中心的连接，但需要设置和维护EC2实例作为VPN设备。这种方法增加了运 营开销，不符合题目要求的“减少运营开销”。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Connect the existing Direct Connect connection to a Direct Connect gateway. Route traffic from the virtual private gateways of the VPCs in each Region to the Direct Connect gateway. 正确性分析：Direct Connect Gateway支持跨区域连接，可以将多个区域的VPC连接到本地数据中心，同时减少运营开销并提供可扩 展性。这种方法完全符合题目要求。 结论：正确。

question: Topic 1 A company is developing a mobile game that streams score updates to a backend processor and then posts results on a leaderboard. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that can handle large traffic spikes, process the mobile game updates in order of receipt, and store the processed updates in a highly available database. The company also wants to minimize the management overhead required to maintain the solution. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Push score updates to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Process the updates in Kinesis Data Streams with AWS Lambda. Store the processed updates in Amazon DynamoDB.
options.B: Push score updates to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Process the updates with a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances set up for Auto Scaling. Store the processed updates in Amazon Redshift.
options.C: Push score updates to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe an AWS Lambda function to the SNS topic to process the updates. Store the processed updates in a SQL database running on Amazon EC2.
options.D: Push score updates to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances with Auto Scaling to process the updates in the SQS queue. Store the processed updates in an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance.

explanations.A: Push score updates to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Process the updates in Kinesis Data Streams with AWS Lambda. Store the processed updates in Amazon DynamoDB. 正确：Kinesis Data Streams可以处理大流量数据并保证顺序处理，符合题目要求。 正确：AWS Lambda可以无服务器地处理数据，减少管理开销。 正确：Amazon DynamoDB是高可用的数据库，目管理开销低，符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Push score updates to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Process the updates with a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances set up for Auto Scaling. Store the processed updates in Amazon Redshift. 正确：Kinesis Data Streams可以处理大流量数据并保证顺序处理。 错误：使用EC2实例需要额外的管理开销，不符合题目要求的“最小化管理开销”。 错误：Amazon Redshift是数据仓库，适合分析型数据存储，不适合实时更新的游戏分数存储。
explanations.C: Push score updates to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe an AWS Lambda function to the SNS topic to process the updates. Store the processed updates in a SQL database running on Amazon EC2. 错误：SNS是发布/订輗服务，无法保证消息的顺序处理，不符合题目要求。 正确：AWS Lambda可以处理数据，但SNS的顺序问题使其不适合此场景。 错误：SQL数据库运行在EC2上需要额外的管理开销，不符合题目要求的“最小化管理开销”。
explanations.D: Push score updates to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances with Auto Scaling to process the updates in the SQS queue. Store the processed updates in an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance. 正确：SQS可以保证消息的顺序处理。 错误：使用EC2实例需要额外的管理开销，不符合题目要求的“最小化管理开销”。 正确：Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB实例是高可用的数据库，但管理开销高于DynamoDB。

question: Topic 1 A company has multiple AWS accounts with applications deployed in the us-west-2 Region. Application logs are stored within Amazon $3 buckets in each account. The company wants to build a centralized log analysis solution that uses a single S3 bucket. Logs must not leave us-west-2, and the company wants to incur minimal operational overhead. Which solution meets these requirements and is MOST cost-effective?

options.A: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy that copies the objects from one of the application S3 buckets to the centralized S3 bucket.
options.B: Use S3 Same-Region Replication to replicate logs from the S3 buckets to another S3 bucket in us-west-2. Use this S3 bucket for log analysis.
options.C: Write a script that uses the PutObject API operation every day to copy the entire contents of the buckets to another S3 bucket in us-west-2. Use this $3 bucket for log analysis.
options.D: Write AWS Lambda functions in these accounts that are triggered every time logs are delivered to the S3 buckets (s3:ObjectCreated:* event). Copy the logs to another S3 bucket in us-west-2. Use this S3 bucket for log analysis.

explanations.A: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy that copies the objects from one of the application S3 buckets to the centralized S3 bucket. 错误原因：Amazon S3 Lifecycle policies用于管理对象的生命周期（例如过期或转移到其他存储层），而不是用于跨橘复制。此选 项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Use S3 Same-Region Replication to replicate logs from the S3 buckets to another S3 bucket in us-west-2. Use this S3 bucket for log analysis. 正确原因：S3 Same-Region Replication (SRR) 是专门设计用于在同一区域内复制对象的功能。它支持跨账户复制，能够满足集中化 日志分析的需求，同时保持日志在 us-west-2 区域内。这种方法操作简单且成本较低。
explanations.C: Write a script that uses the PutObject API operation every day to copy the entire contents of the buckets to another S3 bucket in us-west-2. Use this S3 bucket for log analysis. 错误原因：使用脚本进行复制需要额外的开发和维护工作，增加了操作复杂性。此外，PutObject API 的调用可能会产生额外的成 本，不如 SRR 高效。
explanations.D: Write AWS Lambda functions in these accounts that are triggered every time logs are delivered to the S3 buckets (s3:ObjectCreated:* event). Copy the logs to another S3 bucket in us-west-2. Use this S3 bucket for log analysis. 错误原因：虽然 Lambda 函数可以实现实时复制，但需要在每个账户中部署和管理函数，增加了操作复杂性。此外，Lambda 的执 行成本可能高于 SRR，尤其是在日志量较大的情况下。

question: Topic 1 A company has an application that delivers on-demand training videos to students around the world. The application also allows authorized content developers to upload videos. The data is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket in the us-east-2 Region. The company has created an S3 bucket in the eu-west-2 Region and an S3 bucket in the ap-southeast-1 Region. The company wants to replicate the data to the new S3 buckets. The company needs to minimize latency for developers who upload videos and students who stream videos near eu-west-2 and ap-southeast-1. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the application? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure one-way replication from the us-east-2 S3 bucket to the eu-west-2 S3 bucket. Configure one-way replication from the us-east-2 S3 bucket to the ap-southeast-1 S3 bucket.
options.B: Configure one-way replication from the us-east-2 S3 bucket to the eu-west-2 S3 bucket. Configure one-way replication from the eu-west-2 S3 bucket to the ap-southeast-1 S3 bucket.
options.C: Configure two-way (bidirectional) replication among the S3 buckets that are in all three Regions.
options.D: Create an S3 Multi-Region Access Point. Modify the application to use the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Multi- Region Access Point for video streaming. Do not modify the application for video uploads.
options.E: Create an S3 Multi-Region Access Point. Modify the application to use the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Multi- Region Access Point for video streaming and uploads.

explanations.A: 配置从us-east-2 S3橘到eu-west-2 S3橘的单向复制。配置从us-east-2 S3橘到ap-southeast-1 S3橘的单向复制。 正确性分析：此选项使用了跨区域复制 (CRR)，可以将数据从us-east-2复制到其他区域的S3橘，满足数据复制需求。 问题：虽然可以实现数据复制，但无法优化视频上传和流式播放的延迟，因为开发者和学生仍然需要直接访问us-east-2的S3橘。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 配置从us-east-2 S3橘到eu-west-2 S3橘的单向复制。配置从eu-west-2 S3橘到ap-southeast-1 S3橘的单向复制。 正确性分析：此选项使用了链式跨区域复制 (CRR)，可以将数据从us-east-2复制到eu-west-2，再从eu-west-2复制到ap-southeast- 1。 问题：链式复制增加了复杂性，目无法优化视频上传和流式播放的延迟。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: 配置所有三个区域中的S3橘之间的双向（双向）复制。 正确性分析：双向复制可以确保所有区域的S3橘都保持同步，满足数据复制需求。 优势：开发者和学生可以访问最邮的区域，从而优化延迟。 问题：双向复制可能增加成本和复杂性，但符合题目要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: 创建一个S3 Multi-Region Access Point。修改应用程序以使用Multi-Region Access Point的Amazon Resource Name (ARN) 进行视频流式播放。不要修改应用程序以进行视频上传。 正确性分析：Multi-Region Access Point可以优化视频流式播放的延迟，但未解决视频上传的延迟问题。 问题：未完全满足题目要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.E: 创建一个S3 Multi-Region Access Point。修改应用程序以使用Multi-Region Access Point的Amazon Resource Name (ARN) 进行视频流式播放和上传。 正确性分析：Multi-Region Access Point可以优化视频上传和流式播放的延迟，目最小化了对应用程序的修改。 优势：完全满足题目要求，目减少了复杂性。 结论：正确。

question: Topic 1 A company has a new mobile app. Anywhere in the world, users can see local news on topics they choose. Users also can post photos and videos from inside the app. Users access content often in the first minutes after the content is posted. New content quickly replaces older content, and then the older content disappears. The local nature of the news means that users consume 90% of the content within the AWS Region where it is uploaded. Which solution will optimize the user experience by providing the LOWEST latency for content uploads?

options.A: Upload and store content in Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront for the uploads.
options.B: Upload and store content in Amazon $3. Use $3 Transfer Acceleration for the uploads.
options.C: Upload content to Amazon EC2 instances in the Region that is closest to the user. Copy the data to Amazon S3.
options.D: Upload and store content in Amazon S3 in the Region that is closest to the user. Use multiple distributions of Amazon CloudFront.

explanations.A: Upload and store content in Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront for the uploads. 错误：Amazon CloudFront主要用于内容分发（下载），而不是优化上传。使用CloudFront进行上传并不能显著降低延迟。
explanations.B: Upload and store content in Amazon S3. Use S3 Transfer Acceleration for the uploads. 正确：S3 Transfer Acceleration通过使用AWS的全球加速网络优化上传速度，尤其适合跨区域上传内容。
explanations.C: Upload content to Amazon EC2 instances in the Region that is closest to the user. Copy the data to Amazon S3. 错误：虽然EC2实例可以提供低延迟，但需要额外的管理和维护工作。将数据从EC2复制到S3增加了复杂性和成本。
explanations.D: Upload and store content in Amazon S3 in the Region that is closest to the user. Use multiple distributions of Amazon CloudFront. 错误：虽然将内容存储在最接邮用户的Region可以降低延迟，但CloudFront的主要功能是优化内容分发（下载），而不是上传。

question: Topic 1 A company is building a new application that uses serverless architecture. The architecture will consist of an Amazon API Gateway REST API and AWS Lambda functions to manage incoming requests. The company wants to add a service that can send messages received from the API Gateway REST API to multiple target Lambda functions for processing. The service must offer message filtering that gives the target Lambda functions the ability to receive only the messages the functions need. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues to the SNS topic. Configure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues.
options.B: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon EventBridge. Configure EventBridge to invoke the target Lambda functions.
options.C: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSN). Configure Amazon MSK to publish the messages to the target Lambda functions.
options.D: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Configure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues.

explanations.A: 1. 考察的知识点 本题考察的是 AWS 服务的集成能力，尤其是如何使用消息队列和事件驱动架构来实现消息分发和过滤。 涉及的服务包括 Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, Amazon SNS. Amazon SQS、Amazon EventBridge 和 Amazon MSK。 重点在于选择一个具有最少运维开销的解决方案，同时满足消息过滤和分发的需求。 2. 独立分析每个选项 A. Send the requests from the API Gateway REST APl to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues to the SNS topic. Configure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues. Amazon SNS 是一个发布/订阅服务，可以将消息分发到多个订阅者 (如 SQs 队列) 。 通过将 SQS 队列订阅到 SNS 主题，可以实现消息过滤，因为 SNS 支持基于消息属性的过滤规则。 Lambda 函数可以轮询 SQs 队列以处理消息，但这种方式需要配置多个队列和轮询逻辑，增加了一些运维开销。 虽然可以满足需求，但运维开销不一定是最低的。 B. Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon EventBridge. Configure EventBridge to invoke the target Lambda functions. Amazon EventBridge 是一个事件总线服务，支持事件路由和过滤，可以直接将事件发送到目标 Lambda 函数。 EventBridge 的事件过滤功能非常强大，可以基于事件模式定义规则，确保每个 Lambda 函数只接收需要的消息。 这种方式的运维开销非常低，因为不需要额外配置队列或轮询逻辑。 从功能和运维角度来看，这是一个更优的选择。 C. Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK). Configure Amazon MSK to publish the messages to the target Lambda functions. Amazon MSK 是一个托管的 Kafka 服务，适用于处理高吞吐量的实时流数据。 昌然 Kafka 支持消息分发，但配置和管理 Kafka 集群的运维开销较高，不符合"最少运维开销"的要求。 此外，Kafka 的消息过滤功能需要额外的开发工作，不如 EventBridge 或 SNS 原生支持过滤规则。 因此，这个选项不适合本题需求。 D. Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Configure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues. 直接使用多个 SQs 队列可以实现消息分发，但无法实现消息过滤功能。 此外，配置多个队列和轮询逻辑会增加运维开销，不符合"最少运维开销"的要求。 因此，这个选项不符合题目需求。 3. 我的选择 我选择的答案是: B 4. 官方答案 官方答案是: A 5. 比较与重新思考 官方答案选择 A，可能是因为 SNS 和 SQS 的组合可以实现消息分发和过滤功能。 然而，A 的运维开销较高，因为需要配置多个 SQs 队列和轮询逻辑。 B 使用 EventBridge，可以直接实现消息过滤和分发，且运维开销最低。 综合考虑功能和运维开销，我认为 B 是更优的选择。 IT认证轻松过淘宝: https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com [A\&: https://www.goofish.com/personal?userld=2645260430 ”微信: Examtopics IT认证轻松过 淘宝: https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com “闲鱼: https//www.goofish.comy/personal?userld=2645260430 ”微信: Examtopics =XAMTOPICS AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 (2026/03/11) JOSE: " IT认证轻松过" https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼: "IT认证轻松过" https://www.goofish.com/personal?userld=2645260430 苇wechat letacbao shop 芭xianyu shop 微信:" Examtopics "

question: Topic 1 A company migrated millions of archival files to Amazon S3. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution that will encrypt all the archival data by using a customer-provided key. The solution must encrypt existing unencrypted objects and future objects. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a list of unencrypted objects by filtering an Amazon S3 Inventory report. Configure an S3 Batch Operations job to encrypt the objects from the list with a server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C). Configure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C).
options.B: Use S3 Storage Lens metrics to identify unencrypted S3 buckets. Configure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server- side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
options.C: Create a list of unencrypted objects by filtering the AWS usage report for Amazon S3. Configure an AWS Batch job to encrypt the objects from the list with a server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Configure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
options.D: Create a list of unencrypted objects by filtering the AWS usage report for Amazon S3. Configure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C).

explanations.A: Create a list of unencrypted objects by filtering an Amazon S3 Inventory report. Configure an S3 Batch Operations job to encrypt the objects from the list with a server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C). Configure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C). 正确：此选项使用Amazon S3 Inventory报告来识别未加密的对象，并通过S3 Batch Operations对这些对象进行加密，符合要求。 正确：配置S3默正加密功能以使用SSE-C确保未来对象加密，满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Use S3 Storage Lens metrics to identify unencrypted S3 buckets. Configure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). 错误：S3 Storage Lens主要用于监控和分析存储使用情况，而不是直接识别未加密对象。 错误：题目要求使用客户提供的密钥（SSE-C），而此选项使用AWS KMS密钥（SSE-KMS），不符合要求。
explanations.C: Create a list of unencrypted objects by filtering the AWS usage report for Amazon S3. Configure an AWS Batch job to encrypt the objects from the list with a server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Configure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). 错误：AWS使用报告不适合直接过滤未加密对象。 错误：题目要求使用客户提供的密钥（SSE-C），而此选项使用AWS KMS密钥（SSE-KMS），不符合要求。
explanations.D: Create a list of unencrypted objects by filtering the AWS usage report for Amazon S3. Configure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C). 错误：AWS使用报告不适合直接过滤未加密对象。 正确：配置S3默正加密功能以使用SSE-C确保未来对象加密，但未处理现有未加密对象，不完全满足要求。

question: Topic 1 The DNS provider that hosts a company's domain name records is experiencing outages that cause service disruption for a website running on AWS. The company needs to migrate to a more resilient managed DNS service and wants the service to run on AWS. What should a solutions architect do to rapidly migrate the DNS hosting service?

options.A: Create an Amazon Route 53 public hosted zone for the domain name. Import the zone file containing the domain records hosted by the previous provider.
options.B: Create an Amazon Route 53 private hosted zone forthe domain name. Import the zone file containing the domain records hosted by the previous provider.
options.C: Create a Simple AD directory in AWS. Enable zone transfer between the DNS provider and AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for the domain records.
options.D: Create an Amazon Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint in the VPC. Specify the IP addresses that the provider's DNS will forward DNS queries to. Configure the provider's DNS to forward DNS queries for the domain to the IP addresses that are specified in the inbound endpoint.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Route 53 public hosted zone for the domain name. Import the zone file containing the domain records hosted by the previous provider. 正确：Amazon Route 53公共托管区域是用于管理互联网可访问的域名记录的最佳选择。 正确：导入区域文件可以快速迁移现有的DNS记录，减少服务中断时间。 此选项符合题目要求，能够快速迁移到AWS托管的DNS服务。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Route 53 private hosted zone for the domain name. Import the zone file containing the domain records hosted by the previous provider. 错误：私有托管区域仅适用于VPC内部的DNS解析，无法用于互联网可访问的域名。 错误：题目要求迁移的是公共DNS服务，而不是私有DNS服务。
explanations.C: Create a Simple AD directory in AWS. Enable zone transfer between the DNS provider and AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for the domain records. 错误：Simple AD和AWS Directory Service主要用于管理企业内部的目录服务，与公共DNS服务无关。 错误：此选项无法满足题目中快速迁移DNS服务的需求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint in the VPC. Specify the IP addresses that the provider's DNS will forward DNS queries to. Configure the provider's DNS to forward DNS queries for the domain to the IP addresses that are specified in the inbound endpoint. 错误：Route 53 Resolver主要用于混合云环境中的DNS解析，与公共DNS服务无关。 错误：此选项无法解决题目中提到的DNS服务中断问题。

question: Topic 1 A company is building an application on AWS that connects to an Amazon RDS database. The company wants to manage the application configuration and to securely store and retrieve credentials for the database and other services. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Use AWS AppConfig to store and manage the application configuration. Use AWS Secrets Manager to store and retrieve the credentials.
options.B: Use AWS Lambda to store and manage the application configuration. Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to store and retrieve the credentials.
options.C: Use an encrypted application configuration file. Store the file in Amazon S3 for the application configuration. Create another S3 file to store and retrieve the credentials.
options.D: Use AWS AppConfig to store and manage the application configuration. Use Amazon RDS to store and retrieve the credentials.

explanations.A: Use AWS AppConfig to store and manage the application configuration. Use AWS Secrets Manager to store and retrieve the credentials. 正确： AWS AppConfig是专门设计用于管理和分发应用程序配置的服务，能够动态更新配置，减少停机时间。 AWS Secrets Manager是专门用于安全存储和管理敏感人息（如数据库认证）的服务，支持自动轮换认证，减少管理开销。 此选项结合了两个服务的最佳实践，满足了题目要求，并且具有最低的管理开销。
explanations.B: Use AWS Lambda to store and manage the application configuration. Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to store and retrieve the credentials. 错误： AWS Lambda不是专门设计用于存储和管理应用程序配置的服务，虽然可以通过代码实现，但会增加开发和管理复杂性。 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store可以存储认证，但与Secrets Manager相比，缺乏自动轮换功能，管理开销更高。
explanations.C: Use an encrypted application configuration file. Store the file in Amazon S3 for the application configuration. Create another S3 file to store and retrieve the credentials. 错误： 虽然Amazon S3可以存储文件，但它不是专门设计用于动态管理应用程序配置的服务，缺乏版本控制和动态更新功能。 存储敏感人息（如认证）在S3中需要额外的加密和访问控制，管理开销较高。
explanations.D: Use AWS AppConfig to store and manage the application configuration. Use Amazon RDS to store and retrieve the credentials. 错误： AWS AppConfig适合管理应用程序配置，但Amazon RDS不是专门设计用于存储和管理敏感人息（如认证）的服务。 将认证存储在RDS中会增加开发复杂性，并且不符合最佳实践。

question: Topic 1 To meet security requirements, a company needs to encrypt all of its application data in transit while communicating with an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. A recent security audit revealed that encryption at rest is enabled using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS), but data in transit is not enabled. What should a solutions architect do to satisfy the security requirements?

options.A: Enable IAM database authentication on the database.
options.B: Provide self-signed certificates. Use the certificates in all connections to the RDS instance.
options.C: Take a snapshot of the RDS instance. Restore the snapshot to a new instance with encryption enabled.
options.D: Download AWS-provided root certificates. Provide the certificates in all connections to the RDS instance.

explanations.A: Enable IAM database authentication on the database. 分析：IAM 数据库身份验证用于管理数据库访问权限，但它与数据传输加密无关。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Provide self-signed certificates. Use the certificates in all connections to the RDS instance. 分析：自签名证书可以用于加密，但它不符合 AWS 的最佳实践，也不提供与 AWS RDS 的内置加密功能的兼容性。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Take a snapshot of the RDS instance. Restore the snapshot to a new instance with encryption enabled. 分析：此选项梾及的是数据静态加密（encryption at rest），而题目要求解决的是数据传输加密（encryption in transit）。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Download AWS-provided root certificates. Provide the certificates in all connections to the RDS instance. 分析：AWS 提供的根证书可以用于加密数据传输，符合题目要求。通过使用这些证书，应用程序可以确保与 RDS 的连接是加密 的。 结论：正确。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing a new web service that will run on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) load balancer. However, many of the web service clients can only reach IP addresses authorized on their firewalls. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet the clients’ needs?

options.A: A Network Load Balancer with an associated Elastic IP address.
options.B: An Application Load Balancer with an associated Elastic IP address.
options.C: An A record in an Amazon Route 53 hosted zone pointing to an Elastic IP address. f£ Amazon Route 53
options.D: An EC2 instance with a public IP address running as a proxy in front of the load balancer.

explanations.A: A Network Load Balancer with an associated Elastic IP address. Network Load Balancer (NLB) 支持静态 IP 地址（包括 Elastic IP 地址），这使得客户端可以通过固定的 IP 地址访问服务。 这种配置满足题目中“客户端只能访问授权的 IP 地址”的需求。 正确选项。
explanations.B: An Application Load Balancer with an associated Elastic IP address. Application Load Balancer (ALB) 不支持直接绑定 Elastic IP 地址。 ALB 的 IP 地址是动态分配的，无法满足题目中“客户端只能访问授权的 IP 地址”的需求。 错误选项。
explanations.C: An A record in an Amazon Route 53 hosted zone pointing to an Elastic IP address. Route 53 的 A 记录可以指向一个 Elastic IP 地址，但这并不能解决负载均衡的问题。 题目要求使用 ELB，而不是直接使用 Elastic IP 地址。 错误选项。
explanations.D: An EC2 instance with a public IP address running as a proxy in front of the load balancer. 使用 EC2 实例作为代理可以提供一个固定的 IP 地址，但这会增加管理复杂性和单点故障的风险。 题目要求使用 ELB，而不是直接使用 EC2 实例作为代理。 错误选项。

question: Topic 1 A company has established a new AWS account. The account is newly provisioned and no changes have been made to the default settings. The company is concerned about the security of the AWS account root user. What should be done to secure the root user?

options.A: Create IAM users for daily administrative tasks. Disable the root user.
options.B: Create IAM users for daily administrative tasks. Enable multi-factor authentication on the root user.
options.C: Generate an access key for the root user. Use the access key for daily administration tasks instead of the AWS Management Console.
options.D: Provide the root user credentials to the most senior solutions architect. Have the solutions architect use the root user for daily administration tasks. FHRAP Sie RA RHA RID. LATA AIRA PETA BEES.

explanations.A: Create IAM users for daily administrative tasks. Disable the root user. 错误：AWS不允许禁用根用户。根用户是账户的最高权限用户，无法被禁用。 正确部分：创建IAM用户用于日常管理任务是最佳实践。
explanations.B: Create IAM users for daily administrative tasks. Enable multi-factor authentication on the root user. 正确：这是AWS推荐的最佳实践。创建IAM用户用于日常管理任务可以减少对根用户的依赖，而启用多因痊正确（MFA）可以显著 提高根用户的安全性。
explanations.C: Generate an access key for the root user. Use the access key for daily administration tasks instead of the AWS Management Console. 错误：AWS明确建议不要为根用户椹成访问密钥，因为这会增加安全风险。 错误部分：根用户不应该用于日常管理任务，无论是通过访问密钥还是管理控制台。
explanations.D: Provide the root user credentials to the most senior solutions architect. Have the solutions architect use the root user for daily administration tasks. 错误：根用户不应该被用于日常管理任务，也不应该将其认证分享给任何人。 错误部分：这种做法违反了AWS的安全最佳实践。

question: Topic 1 A company is deploying an application that processes streaming data in near-real time. The company plans to use Amazon EC2 instances for the workload. The network architecture must be configurable to provide the lowest possible latency between nodes. Which combination of network solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Enable and configure enhanced networking on each EC2 instance.
options.B: Group the EC2 instances in separate accounts.
options.C: Run the EC2 instances in a cluster placement group.
options.D: Attach multiple elastic network interfaces to each EC2 instance.
options.E: Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) optimized instance types.

explanations.A: Enable and configure enhanced networking on each EC2 instance. 正确：增强型网络（Enhanced Networking）通过使用高性能网络接口（如Elastic Network Adapter或ENA）显著降低网络延迟并提 高知吐量。 这是实现最低网络延迟的关键配置之一。
explanations.B: Group the EC2 instances in separate accounts. 错误：将实例分组到不同账户中不会降低网络延迟，反而可能增加跨账户通人的复杂性。 与题目要求的“最低可能的延迟”无关。
explanations.C: Run the EC2 instances in a cluster placement group. 正确：集群放置组（Cluster Placement Group）允许EC2实例在物理硬件上紧密分布，从而显著降低网络延迟。 这是实现最低延迟的另一关键配置。
explanations.D: Attach multiple elastic network interfaces to each EC2 instance. 错误：虽然附加多个网络接口可以增加网络带宽，但它不会直接降低节点之间的网络延迟。 题目要求的是最低延迟，而不是带宽优化。
explanations.E: Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) optimized instance types. 错误：EBS优化实例类型主要用于提高存储性能，与网络延迟无关。 题目要求的是网络架构优化，而非存储性能优化。

question: Topic 1 A financial services company wants to shut down two data centers and migrate more than 100 TB of data to AWS. The data has an intricate directory structure with millions of small files stored in deep hierarchies of subfolders. Most of the data is unstructured, and the company’s file storage consists of SMB-based storage types from multiple vendors. The company does not want to change its applications to access the data after migration. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Direct Connect to migrate the data to Amazon S3.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon FSx for Lustre.
options.C: Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.
options.D: Use AWS Direct Connect to migrate the data on-premises file storage to an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway.

explanations.A: Use AWS Direct Connect to migrate the data to Amazon S3. 错误原因：Amazon S3是对象存储服务，不支持直接访问文件系统的复杂目录结构和SMB协议。题目要求迁移后无需更改应用程 序，而S3不支持原生的文件系统访问。
explanations.B: Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon FSx for Lustre. 错误原因：Amazon FSx for Lustre主要用于高性能计算和处理临时数据，适合与S3集成，但不支持SMB协议。题目要求迁移后无需 更改应用程序，而FSx for Lustre不符合这一要求。
explanations.C: Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. 正确原因：Amazon FSx for Windows File Server支持SMB协议，能够无痼迁移和访问复杂目录结构的数据。使用AWS DataSync可以 高效迁移数据，同时满足题目要求的“无需更改应用程序”和“最少操作开销”。
explanations.D: Use AWS Direct Connect to migrate the data on-premises file storage to an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway. 错误原因：虽然AWS Storage Gateway可以提供文件访问，但它主要用于混合云场景，适合将本地数据缓存到云端，而不是直接迁 移数据到AWS。Direct Connect也不是专门的数据迁移工具。

question: Topic 1 A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage AWS accounts that contain applications. The company sets up a dedicated monitoring member account in the organization. The company wants to query and visualize observability data across the accounts by using Amazon CloudWatch. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable CloudWatch cross-account observability for the monitoring account. Deploy an AWS CloudFormation template provided by the monitoring account in each AWS account to share the data with the monitoring account.
options.B: Set up service control policies (SCPs) to provide access to CloudWatch in the monitoring account under the Organizations root organizational unit (OU).
options.C: Configure a new IAM user in the monitoring account. In each AWS account, configure an IAM policy to have access to query and visualize the CloudWatch data in the account. Attach the new IAM policy to the new IAM user.
options.D: Create a new IAM user in the monitoring account. Create cross-account IAM policies in each AWS account. Attach the IAM policies to the new IAM user.

explanations.A: Enable CloudWatch cross-account observability for the monitoring account. Deploy an AWS CloudFormation template provided by the monitoring account in each AWS account to share the data with the monitoring account. 正确：CloudWatch跨账户可观察性是专门设计用于跨账户查询和可视化数据的功能。通过CloudFormation模板可以自动化配置，确 保桹个账户的数据共享到监控账户。
explanations.B: Set up service control policies (SCPs) to provide access to CloudWatch in the monitoring account under the Organizations root organizational unit (OU). 错误：SCP主要用于限制或允许账户的服务访问权限，但它不能直接实现跨账户数据共享或可视化功能。
explanations.C: Configure a new IAM user in the monitoring account. In each AWS account, configure an IAM policy to have access to query and visualize the CloudWatch data in the account. Attach the new IAM policy to the new IAM user. 错误：这种方法需要手动配置多个IAM策略，复杂目不适合大规模账户管理。此外，它没有利用CloudWatch跨账户可观察性功能。
explanations.D: Create a new IAM user in the monitoring account. Create cross-account IAM policies in each AWS account. Attach the IAM policies to the new IAM user. 错误：虽然可以通过跨账户IAM策略实现访问，但这种方法不如CloudWatch跨账户可观察性功能高效，目需要手动配置。

question: Topic 1 A company’s website is used to sell products to the public. The site runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). There is also an Amazon CloudFront distribution, and AWS WAF is being used to protect against SQL injection attacks. The ALB is the origin for the CloudFront distribution. A recent review of security logs revealed an external malicious IP that needs to be blocked from accessing the website. What should a solutions architect do to protect the application?

options.A: Modify the network ACL on the CloudFront distribution to add a deny rule for the malicious IP address.
options.B: Modify the configuration of AWS WAF to add an IP match condition to block the malicious IP address.
options.C: Modify the network ACL for the EC2 instances in the target groups behind the ALB to deny the malicious IP address.
options.D: Modify the security groups for the EC2 instances in the target groups behind the ALB to deny the malicious IP address.

explanations.A: 修改 CloudFront 分发的网络 ACL，添加一个拒绝规则以阻止恶意 IP 地址。 错误：CloudFront本身不支持直接修改网络ACL。网络ACL是针对子网级别的，而CloudFront是一个全球分发服务，无法通过网络 ACL直接控制其访问。
explanations.B: 修改 AWS WAF 的配置，添加一个 IP 匹配条件以阻止恶意 IP 地址。 正确：AWS WAF是专门设计用于保护Web应用程序的服务，可以通过IP匹配条件阻止特定的嬡嬯IP地址。这是最直接和有效的解决 方案。
explanations.C: 修改 ALB 后端目标组中 EC2 实例的网络 ACL，拒绝恶意 IP 地址。 错误：网络ACL是针对子网级别的，而ALB的流量已经通过CloudFront和WAF过滤。修改网络ACL无法有效阻止嬡嬯IP，因为流量在 到通EC2实例之前已经经过ALB和WAF。
explanations.D: 修改 ALB 后端目标组中 EC2 实例的安全组，拒绝恶意 IP 地址。 错误：安全组是针对实例级别的，而嬡嬯流量在到通EC2实例之前已经经过ALB和WAF。修改安全组无法有效阻止嬡嬯IP。

question: Topic 1 A company sets up an organization in AWS Organizations that contains 10 AWS accounts. A solutions architect must design a solution to provide access to the accounts for several thousand employees. The company has an existing identity provider (IdP). The company wants to use the existing IdP for authentication to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create IAM users for the employees in the required AWS accounts. Connect IAM users to the existing IdP. Configure federated authentication for the IAM users.
options.B: Set up AWS account root users with user email addresses and passwords that are synchronized from the existing IdP.
options.C: Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). Connect IAM Identity Center to the existing IdP. Provision users and groups from the existing IdP.
options.D: Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share access to the AWS accounts with the users in the existing IdP.

explanations.A: Create IAM users for the employees in the required AWS accounts. Connect IAM users to the existing IdP. Configure federated authentication for the IAM users. 错误：创建IAM用户并连接到IdP的方式不符合大规模用户管理的需求。IAM用户的管理复杂目不适合数干名员工的场景。 IAM用户通常用于单个用户或服务账户，而不是大规模用户的联合身份验证。
explanations.B: Set up AWS account root users with user email addresses and passwords that are synchronized from the existing IdP. 错误：AWS账户的根用户不应该用于日常操作或身份验证。根用户的使用应受到严格限制，目不支持与IdP同桯。 根用户的设计是为了管理账户，而不是为数干名员工提供访问权限。
explanations.C: Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). Connect IAM Identity Center to the existing IdP. Provision users and groups from the existing IdP. 正确：AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 是专门设计用于与现有IdP集成的服务，可以答案管理数干名员工的身份验证 和访问权限。 通过IAM Identity Center，可以将现有IdP中的用户和组直接预置到AWS账户中，满足题目要求。
explanations.D: Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share access to the AWS accounts with the users in the existing IdP. 错误：AWS RAM用于跨账户共享资源，而不是身份验证或用户管理。它无法直接与IdP集成来管理数干名员工的访问权限。 本题的重点是身份验证，而不是资源共享，因此AWS RAM不适合此场景。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) authorization model for a company's AWS account. The company has designated five specific employees to have full access to AWS services and resources in the AWS account. The solutions architect has created an IAM user for each of the five designated employees and has created an IAM user group. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Attach the AdministratorAccess resource-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group.
options.B: Attach the SystemAdministrator identity-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group.
options.C: Attach the AdministratorAccess identity-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group.
options.D: Attach the SystemAdministrator resource-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group.

explanations.A: Attach the AdministratorAccess resource-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group. 错误：资源基于策略（Resource-based policy）是直接附加到资源上的，而不是附加到用户组或用户。IAM用户组无法使用资源基 于策略。
explanations.B: Attach the SystemAdministrator identity-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group. 错误：AWS中没有名为“SystemAdministrator”的预定义策略。此选项无效。
explanations.C: Attach the AdministratorAccess identity-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group. 正确：AdministratorAccess是AWS提供的预定义策略，授予完全访问权限。将此策略附加到IAM用户组，并将用户添加到该组，可 以满足题目要求。
explanations.D: Attach the SystemAdministrator resource-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group. 错误：资源基于策略（Resource-based policy）无法附加到IAM用户组。此外，“SystemAdministrator”不是AWS的预定义策略。
